words.definition: The abandonment of a place, thing, or person is the act of leaving it permanently or for a long time, especially when you should not do so; rejection, loose
words.translation: 放弃；[法]抛弃；放纵

examples.en: ...memories of her father's complete abandonment of her.
examples.zh: …她父亲对她的彻底抛弃的那些记忆。

words.definition: eccentrically, freakishly
words.translation: 不正常的；反常地；变态地；不规则地

examples.en: Both were big at birth but were not abnormally large.
examples.zh: 这两个孩子出生时都比较大，但并非异常的大。

examples.en: This way, if the function or procedure crashes or terminates abnormally, it will not affect any of the other instance processes.
examples.zh: 这样，如果该函数或过程崩溃或者异常终止，也不会对其他实例进程产生任何影响。

examples.en: People with the condition have red blood cells smaller than normal — causing a mild form of anaemia — but abnormally high levels of them.
examples.zh: 患有这种病的人的红细胞比正常人的更小——这导致了一种轻微的贫血——但是红细胞水平异常地高。

words.definition: used when you strongly disagree with someone or when you do not want someone to do something; totally, entirely, completely, thoroughly, strictly, fully
words.translation: 当然；绝对地；完全地

examples.en: ‘Do you let your kids travel alone at night?’ ‘Absolutely not!’
examples.zh: “你会让孩子们晚上单独外出吗？”“当然不行！”

words.definition: based on general ideas or principles rather than specific examples or real events; brief, summary, resume; deep, nonobjective; extract, brief
words.translation: 抽象的；[图情]摘要；抽象；抽象的概念；深奥的；提取；使……抽象化

examples.en: By the age of seven, children are capable of thinking in abstract terms .
examples.zh: 儿童到了七岁就具有抽象思维的能力。

examples.en: Human beings are the only creatures capable of abstract thought (=  thinking about ideas  ) .
examples.zh: 人类是唯一具有抽象思维能力的动物。

words.definition: cruel or violent treatment of someone; to deliberately use something for the wrong purpose or for your own advantage; punishment, vice; strain, maltreat
words.translation: 虐待；滥用；辱骂；弊端；恶习，陋习

examples.en: several cases of child abuse
examples.zh: 数宗虐待儿童案

examples.en: An independent committee will look into alleged human rights abuses.
examples.zh: 一个独立委员会将对涉嫌践踏人权的行为进行调查。

words.definition: if a process accelerates or if something accelerates it, it happens faster than usual or sooner than you expect; improve, increase speed
words.translation: 加速；促进；增加

examples.en: measures to accelerate the rate of economic growth
examples.zh: 加快经济增长速度的措施

words.definition: to succeed in doing something, especially after trying very hard; carry out, come true, perform, complete, fulfill
words.translation: 实现；完成；达到

examples.en: We have accomplished all we set out to do.
examples.zh: 所有计划要做的事情，我们都已完成。

examples.en: (=  we have done what we intended to do  ) .
examples.zh: 大功告成。

words.definition: someone whose job is to keep and check financial accounts, calculate taxes etc
words.translation: 会计

examples.en: The boss dropped an accountant from the payroll.
examples.zh: 老板把一名会计师从在职人员名单中除了名。

examples.en: The accountant checked this unnecessary spending in good time.
examples.zh: 会计及时卡住了这笔不必要的开支。

examples.en: They conferred with the accountant vis-à-vis the proposed budget.
examples.zh: 他们与会计商量有关预算提案的事。

words.definition: if money accrues or is accrued, it gradually increases over a period of time; result, breed; acquire, earn, buy, score, find
words.translation: 积累；产生；自然增长或利益增加；获得

examples.en: Interest will accrue until payment is made.
examples.zh: 利息将会累计增加，直至付清款项。

words.definition: correct and true in every detail; precise, mathematical, strict, rigid, refined
words.translation: 精确的

examples.en: The brochure tries to give a fair and accurate description of each hotel.
examples.zh: 该手册尽量公正、准确地介绍每一家酒店。

words.definition: to say that you believe someone is guilty of a crime or of doing something bad; blame, law; law, come in for blame
words.translation: 指控；控告，指控；谴责；归咎于；指责；控告

examples.en: The professor stands accused of (=  has been accused of  ) stealing his student’s ideas and publishing them.
examples.zh: 那位教授被指控剽窃学生的观点拿去发表。

words.definition: to make yourself or another person become used to a situation or place; habituate
words.translation: 使习惯；使习惯于

examples.en: She tried to accustom herself to the tight bandages.
examples.zh: 她尝试着使自己习惯那些紧绷的绷带。

words.definition: to successfully complete something or get a good result, especially by working hard; accomplish, carry out, perform, complete, fulfil; gain one's ends, Make it.
words.translation: 达到，实现；达到；完成；达到目的；如愿以偿

examples.en: Frances achieved very good exam results.
examples.zh: 弗朗西丝考试取得了优异成绩。

examples.en: Wilson has achieved considerable success as an artist.
examples.zh: 威尔逊作为一名艺术家成就斐然。

examples.en: She eventually achieved her goal of becoming a professor.
examples.zh: 她终于实现目标，当上了教授。

words.definition: someone you know, but who is not a close friend; knowledge, awareness
words.translation: 熟人；相识；了解；知道

examples.en: She was a casual acquaintance of my family in Vienna.
examples.zh: 她是我们家在维也纳的一个交情不深的朋友。

examples.en: He heard about the job through a mutual acquaintance (=  someone you and another person both know  ) .
examples.zh: 他是通过一个双方都认识的人知道有这份工作的。

words.definition: to make an electrical system or chemical process start working; stimulate, fan, motivate, needle
words.translation: 激活；刺激；使活动；使活泼；使产生放射性

examples.en: Cooking fumes may activate the alarm.
examples.zh: 烹调时的油烟可能会触发警报器。

examples.en: The yeast’s growth is activated by sugar and warmth.
examples.zh: 糖分和温暖的环境会激发酵母菌的生长。

words.definition: pointedly, pungently
words.translation: 敏锐地；尖锐地；剧烈地

examples.en: We continue to conduct tests, but increasingly, we conduct long conversations with her, acutely aware that our creation will raise many ethical questions on the part of the public.
examples.zh: 我们将继续进行测试，但越来越多地，随着长时间的交谈，我们敏锐地意识到，我们的作品将在公众当中引起许多道德问题。

words.translation: 上瘾，沉溺

examples.en: Meanwhile, Walt's meth-business partner, the addict Jesse, is still recovering from the drug-related death of his girlfriend Jane at the end of last season.
examples.zh: 而沃特的制毒搭档——瘾君子杰西还未从女朋友之死的痛苦中恢复过来。 他的女朋友简在上一季结尾时死于毒品。

words.definition: if you address a problem, you start trying to solve it; undertake, pursue, have; speech, lecture, talk
words.translation: 解决；演说；从事；忙于；写姓名地址；向…致辞；[计]地址；演讲；致辞；说话的技巧

words.definition: the activities that are involved in managing the work of a company or organization; governance, management, supervision, regulation, enforcement
words.translation: 管理，政府；[管理]管理；行政；实施；行政机构

examples.en: We’re looking for someone with experience in administration.
examples.zh: 我们正在寻找一个有管理经验的人。

examples.en: The health service spends too much on administration.
examples.zh: 医疗服务部门在行政方面花费太多。

words.definition: to start to deal with or think about something in a particular way; assume, take in sth
words.translation: 采纳；采取；接受；收养；正式通过

examples.en: The courts were asked to adopt a more flexible approach to young offenders.
examples.zh: 法庭被要求对少年犯采取更为灵活的处理方法。

examples.en: The store recently adopted a drug testing policy for all new employees.
examples.zh: 这家商店近来实行新雇员一律要做药检的政策。

examples.en: California has adopted a tough stance on the issue.
examples.zh: 加利福尼亚州对这一问题持强硬立场。

words.definition: an exciting experience in which dangerous or unusual things happen; risk, throw, venture; take a chance, run a risk; take a risk, run a risk, stick one's neck out, take chances
words.translation: 冒险；冒险精神；投机活动；大胆说出

examples.en: a great adventure
examples.zh: 一大奇遇

examples.en: Ahab’s adventures at sea
examples.zh: 亚哈的海上历险

examples.en: an adventure story
examples.zh: 一个历险故事

words.definition: someone who enjoys adventure; sportsman, gambler
words.translation: 冒险者；冒险家；投机商人

examples.en: an adventurer travelling the world
examples.zh: 周游世界的冒险家

words.definition: not good or favourable; against, contrary, opposite, counter, cross
words.translation: 相反的，敌对的；不利的；相反的；[植]敌对的（名词adverseness，副词adversely）

examples.en: They fear it could have an adverse effect on global financial markets.
examples.zh: 他们担心这会对全球金融市场产生不利影响。

examples.en: Miller’s campaign has received a good deal of adverse publicity .
examples.zh: 米勒的竞选活动招来许多负面报道。

words.definition: ill, disadvantageously
words.translation: 不利地；逆地；反对地

examples.en: I think everyone has something from their past that they're worried might adversely affect how they raise their children.
examples.zh: 我想每个人都会担心自己过去的某些事可能会对他们如何培养孩子产生不利的影响。

examples.en: As my national security advisor, he had to deal with the British on many other issues that could be adversely affected by the visa.
examples.zh: 作为我的国家安全顾问，托尼需要在许多其它问题上与英国人打交道，签证问题可能会对这些问题产生不利的影响。

words.definition: a feeling of liking or love and caring; infection, impression, favor, effect, influence
words.translation: 喜爱；喜爱，[心理]感情；影响；感染

examples.en: She looked back on those days with affection .
examples.zh: 她深情地回顾那些日子。

examples.en: Their father never showed them much affection .
examples.zh: 他们的父亲对他们从来没有表现出多少慈爱。

examples.en: The church was held in great affection (=  loved and cared about a lot  ) by the local residents.
examples.zh: 教会深受当地民众爱戴。

words.definition: a list of problems or subjects that a government, organization etc is planning to deal with
words.translation: 议程

examples.en: The Republicans have stuck to their conservative agenda.
examples.zh: 共和党人坚持自己的保守议题。

words.definition: to make a bad situation, an illness, or an injury worse; anger, complicate
words.translation: 加重，加剧；加重；使恶化；激怒

examples.en: Their money problems were further aggravated by a rise in interest rates.
examples.zh: 由于利率上调，他们的财务问题更加严重。

examples.en: Building the new road will only aggravate the situation .
examples.zh: 建造那条新路只会使情况恶化。

words.definition: struggle along; harry, worry, trouble, tear
words.translation: 使痛苦；感到极度痛苦；挣扎；使极度痛苦；折磨

examples.en: As a mother, I agonize over what my children will inherit.
examples.zh: 作为一个母亲，我对我的孩子们将要继承的东西感到极度痛苦。

words.definition: to help someone do something; assistance, friend, hand, help, boost; facilitate, bolster up; lend a hand, to help
words.translation: 援助，有助于；援助；帮助；助手；帮助者；有助于

examples.en: an index to aid the reader
examples.zh: 方便读者的索引

words.definition: giving all your attention to what is happening, being said etc; to make someone realize something important or dangerous; alarm, warn; vigilant, precautious; guard, vigilance
words.translation: 机警的；提醒；警告；使警觉，使意识到；[军]警惕的，警觉的；留心的；[军]警戒，警惕；警报

examples.en: The animal raised its head, suddenly alert.
examples.zh: 那只动物突然警觉地抬起头来。

examples.en: Taking notes is one of the best ways to stay alert in lectures.
examples.zh: 记笔记是听课时集中注意力的最佳方法之一。

words.definition: very different from what you are used to, especially in a way that is difficult to understand or accept; foreign, external; foreigner, uitlander; transfer, negotiate
words.translation: 陌生的；外国的；相异的，性质不同的；不相容的；外国人，外侨；外星人；让渡，转让

examples.en: the alien environment of the city
examples.zh: 城里陌生的环境

words.definition: having an allergy
words.translation: 过敏的

examples.en: an allergic reaction to nuts
examples.zh: 对坚果的过敏性反应

words.definition: If one thing is an alternative to another, the first can be found, used, or done instead of the second; selective, vicissitudinary
words.translation: 代替品；供选择的；选择性的；交替的

examples.en: New ways to treat arthritis may provide an alternative to painkillers.
examples.zh: 治疗关节炎的新方法可能会提供一种止痛药的替代品。

words.definition: thinking about things in a detailed and intelligent way, so that you can examine and understand things
words.translation: 分析的

examples.en: She’s got an analytical mind.
examples.zh: 她思维缜密。

words.definition: belonging to a time long ago in history, especially thousands of years ago; old, aged, advanced; elder, old folk
words.translation: 古代的；古老的，过时的；年老的；古代人；老人

examples.en: the ancient civilizations of Asia
examples.zh: 亚洲的古代文明

words.definition: the joint between your foot and your leg; gambrel, malleolus
words.translation: 脚踝；踝关节，[解剖]踝

examples.en: slender ankles
examples.zh: 纤细的脚踝

words.definition: unknown by name; faceless, innominate
words.translation: 匿名的；匿名的，无名的；无个性特征的

examples.en: the anonymous author of a collection of poems
examples.zh: 一本诗集的佚名作者

examples.en: According to one employee, who wishes to remain anonymous , the company engaged in illegal activities.
examples.zh: 根据一位不愿透露姓名的员工所述，这家公司曾从事非法活动。

words.definition: to expect that something will happen and be ready for it; hope, presume upon
words.translation: 期望，预期；预期，期望；占先，抢先；提前使用

examples.en: Sales are better than anticipated.
examples.zh: 销量比预期要好。

examples.en: A good speaker is able to anticipate an audience’s needs and concerns.
examples.zh: 好的演讲者能够预先考虑到听众需要什么、关注什么。

words.definition: the feeling of being very worried about something; solicitude, aspiration
words.translation: 焦虑；[心理]焦虑；渴望；挂念；令人焦虑的事

examples.en: his feelings of anxiety
examples.zh: 他焦虑的心情

examples.en: A high level of anxiety was created by the introduction of cameras into the factory.
examples.zh: 工厂安装了摄像头，这引起了工人的高度不安。

examples.en: It can help if you discuss your anxieties with someone.
examples.zh: 与别人谈谈自己的忧虑会有帮助的。

words.definition: a set of rooms on one floor of a large building, where someone lives; chamber, flat
words.translation: 公寓；[建]公寓；房间

examples.en: She lives in a small apartment.
examples.zh: 她住在一套小公寓里。

words.definition: the feeling of not being interested in something, and not willing to make any effort to change or improve things; aloofness, apartness
words.translation: 冷漠；冷漠，无兴趣，漠不关心；无感情

examples.en: The campaign failed because of public apathy.
examples.zh: 由于公众反应冷淡，这次运动失败了。

words.definition: to tell someone that you are sorry that you have done something wrong; square oneself, make an apology
words.translation: 道歉；辩解；赔不是；谢罪；辩白

examples.en: I’m so sorry, I do apologize.
examples.zh: 非常对不起，我真心道歉。

words.definition: if something is applicable to a particular person, group, or situation, it affects them or is related to them; becoming, shaped, likely, possible, meet
words.translation: 可应用的；[药]可适用的；合适的

examples.en: What is a reasonable standard for one family is not applicable for another.
examples.zh: 对一个家庭合理的标准对于另一个家庭并不适用。

words.definition: someone who has formally asked, usually in writing, for a job, university place etc; postulant, proposer
words.translation: 申请者；[专利]申请人，申请者；请求者

examples.en: We have had lots of applicants for these positions.
examples.zh: 对这些职位我们已有了很多申请人。

words.definition: to choose someone for a position or a job; install, constitute, name, place, specify; nominate sb to, institute to
words.translation: 任命；指定；约定；委派

examples.en: officials appointed by the government
examples.zh: 政府任命的官员

words.definition: feeling or showing that you enjoy something or are pleased about it; obliged, indebted
words.translation: 表示赞赏的，感谢的；感激的；赏识的；有欣赏力的；承认有价值的

examples.en: There is a murmur of appreciative laughter.
examples.zh: 有一阵低低的赞赏的笑声。

words.definition: a method of doing something or dealing with a problem; method, way, system, mechanism, medium; border, go on for; come near to, draw near
words.translation: 方法；途径；接近；着手处理；靠近

examples.en: He decided to adopt a different approach and teach the Bible through story-telling.
examples.zh: 他决定采用一种不同的方法，通过讲故事来教授《圣经》。

examples.en: This book takes an unorthodox approach to art criticism.
examples.zh: 这本书采用的是非传统的艺术评论方法。

examples.en: organizations which take a positive approach to creative thinking
examples.zh: 对创造性思维采取积极态度的组织

words.definition: correct or suitable for a particular time, situation, or purpose; suitable, proper, adequate, becoming; engage, take up to
words.translation: 适当的；占用；拨出

examples.en: The timing of the announcement was particularly appropriate .
examples.zh: 通告发布的时机很合适。

examples.en: Where appropriate , I delegate as much work as possible.
examples.zh: 只要合适，我就尽量把工作分派出去。

examples.en: Mark box 1 or 2, as appropriate .
examples.zh: 把方框1和2中的合适者标出来。

words.definition: to think that someone or something is good, right, or suitable; confirm, agree, uphold, authorize; to ratify, give someone the green light
words.translation: 赞同；批准；赞成；为…提供证据；满意

examples.en: You've never approved of Henry, have you?
examples.zh: 你从未赞赏过亨利，是吧？

words.definition: around, something
words.translation: 大约；大约，近似地；近于

words.definition: to provide weapons for yourself, an army, a country etc in order to prepare for a fight or a war; weapon, equipment, setup; war preparation
words.translation: 装备，武装；手臂；武器；袖子；[军]装备；武装；备战

words.definition: to make you become interested, expect something etc; encourage, attract, cause, produce, occasion; make someone tick, wake up
words.translation: 唤起；引起；唤醒；鼓励；激发；醒来；发奋

examples.en: Matt’s behavior was arousing the interest of the neighbors.
examples.zh: 马特的行为渐渐引起了邻居的兴趣。

words.definition: behaving in an unpleasant or rude way because you think you are more important than other people; haughty, cocky
words.translation: 傲慢无礼的；自大的，傲慢的

examples.en: He was unbearably arrogant.
examples.zh: 他的傲慢让人无法忍受。

examples.en: an arrogant attitude
examples.zh: 傲慢的态度

words.definition: not real or not made of natural things but made to be like something that is real or natural; synthetic, false, simulated, arbitrary
words.translation: 人造的，虚伪的；人造的；[自]仿造的；虚伪的；非原产地的；武断的

examples.en: artificial flowers
examples.zh: 假花

examples.en: artificial light
examples.zh: 人造光

examples.en: artificial fertilizers
examples.zh: 化肥

words.definition: one part of a situation, idea, plan etc that has many parts; direction, orientation, situation, side, respect
words.translation: 方面；[建]方向；形势；外貌

examples.en: a south-facing aspect
examples.zh: 朝南方向

words.definition: to murder an important person
words.translation: 刺杀，暗杀

examples.en: a plot to assassinate the President
examples.zh: 刺杀总统的阴谋

words.definition: to put all the parts of something together; aggregate, fall in; concentrate, collect, aggregate, mass, crowd
words.translation: 收集，组装；集合，聚集；装配；收集

examples.en: The aircraft will continue to be assembled in France.
examples.zh: 飞机将继续在法国组装。

words.definition: a process in which you make a judgment about a person or situation, or the judgment you make; appraisal, evaluation, valuation, estimate
words.translation: 评估，评价；评定；[税收]估价

examples.en: a reading assessment test
examples.zh: 阅读评估测试

words.definition: a relationship with a particular person, organization, group etc; union, alliance, society, corporation, unity, combination
words.translation: 联系；协会，联盟，社团；联合；[心理]联想

examples.en: Scotland has all kinds of happy associations for me.
examples.zh: 苏格兰给我各种各样愉快的联想。

words.definition: physically strong and good at sport; sport, kinetic
words.translation: 运动的，运动员的；体格健壮的

examples.en: a tall athletic man
examples.zh: 一个高大强壮的男子

words.definition: the feeling that an event or place gives you; mood, ambience
words.translation: 气氛，空气；[心理]气氛；[气象][地物]大气；空气

examples.en: The hotel had a lovely relaxed atmosphere .
examples.zh: 那家宾馆的气氛轻松愉快。

examples.en: The atmosphere at home was rather tense.
examples.zh: 家里的气氛很紧张。

words.definition: someone whose job is to look after or help customers in a public place; accompanied; waiter, suite
words.translation: 服务人员；伴随的；侍候的；服务员，侍者；随员，陪从

examples.en: a car park attendant
examples.zh: 停车场的服务员

words.definition: Theauthorities are the people who have the power to make decisions and to make sure that laws are obeyed
words.translation: 当局

examples.en: This provided a pretext for the authorities to cancel the elections.
examples.zh: 这给当局提供了一个取消选举的借口。

words.definition: the power you have because of your official position; rod, jurisdiction
words.translation: 权威；[法]权力；当局

examples.en: an agreement between the US and Colombian authorities
examples.zh: 美国和哥伦比亚当局的一份协议

words.definition: official permission to do something, or the document giving this permission; commission, confirmation, warranty
words.translation: 授权；[计][法]授权，认可；批准，委任

examples.en: You need special authorization to park here.
examples.zh: 在此停车要有特别的许可。

examples.en: Children may not leave the building without the authorization of the principal.
examples.zh: 没有校长的许可，孩子们不能离开这幢楼。

words.definition: an automatic machine is designed to work without needing someone to operate it for each part of a process; inevitable, mechanical, certain, necessary, unconscious; robot
words.translation: 自动的；[军][自]自动的；无意识的；必然的；自动机械；[军]自动手枪

examples.en: an automatic weapon
examples.zh: 自动武器

examples.en: an automatic gearbox
examples.zh: 自动变速箱

examples.en: My camera is fully automatic .
examples.zh: 我的照相机是全自动的。

words.definition: auxiliary workers provide additional help for another group of workers; helping verb, adminicle; additional, assistant, helping, attached, deputy
words.translation: 辅助的；助动词；辅助者，辅助物；附属机构；副的；附加的

examples.en: an auxiliary nurse
examples.zh: 助理护士

examples.en: auxiliary staff
examples.zh: 辅助员工

words.definition: something that is available is able to be used or can easily be bought or found; valid, effective, virtual, telling, significant
words.translation: 可获得的，可利用的；[交]有效的，可得的；可利用的；空闲的

examples.en: Tickets are available from the box office.
examples.zh: 售票处有票出售。

examples.en: Meetings were held to update employees as soon as new information became available .
examples.zh: 一有新的信息就开会告诉员工。

examples.en: Further building can continue when money is made available .
examples.zh: 有了资金就可以继续进一步的施工。

words.definition: knowledge or understanding of a particular subject or situation; consciousness, knowledge, cognition
words.translation: 意识；意识，认识；明白，知道

examples.en: Health officials have tried to raise awareness (=  improve people’s knowledge  ) about AIDS.
examples.zh: 卫生部官员努力提高人们对艾滋病的认识。

words.definition: extremely impressive, serious, or difficult so that you feel great respect, worry, or fear; terrible, horrible, fearful, dire, dreadful
words.translation: 极好的，令人敬畏的；可怕的，引起敬畏的

examples.en: an awesome responsibility
examples.zh: 一项令人惊惧的责任

examples.en: the awesome sweep of the scenery
examples.zh: 连绵的壮丽景色

words.definition: Backup consists of extra equipment, resources, or people that you can get help or support from if necessary; holding, support, adhesion; supporting, friendly
words.translation: 后补，援助；支持；[计]后援；阻塞；支持的；候补的

examples.en: There is no emergency back-up immediately available.
examples.zh: 没有立即就能获得的后备。

words.definition: very small living things, some of which cause illness or disease; microbe, bacilus
words.translation: 细菌

examples.en: Is it possible to multiply bacteria in the laboratory?
examples.zh: 有可能在实验室繁殖细菌吗?

examples.en: When you eat off the plate, all of those bacteria go into your stomach.
examples.zh: 当你吃掉了盘子里的食物时，这些细菌就会进入你的肚子。

words.definition: a performance in which dancing and music tell a story without any speaking
words.translation: 芭蕾

examples.en: We’re going to the ballet tomorrow evening.
examples.zh: 我们明天晚上要去看芭蕾舞演出。

words.definition: almost not; merely, simply, just, only, but
words.translation: 几乎不，仅仅；仅仅，勉强；几乎不；公开地；贫乏地

examples.en: She was barely aware of his presence.
examples.zh: 她几乎没有注意到他的存在。

examples.en: Joe and his brother are barely on speaking terms.
examples.zh: 乔和他哥哥几乎不说话。

words.definition: a rule, problem etc that prevents people from doing something, or limits what they can do; limit, block, bottleneck
words.translation: 障碍，阻碍；[地物]障碍物，[建]屏障；界线

examples.en: He advocated the removal of trade barriers.
examples.zh: 他提倡消除贸易壁垒。

words.definition: an object that provides a supply of electricity for something such as a radio, car, or toy; electric cell, electric element
words.translation: 电池；[电]电池，蓄电池

examples.en: You have to take the top off to change the batteries .
examples.zh: 你得把顶盖拿掉才能更换电池。

examples.en: When the red light comes on, you should recharge the battery .
examples.zh: 红灯亮起的时候你就应该给电池充电了。

examples.en: The car’s got a flat battery .
examples.zh: 汽车的蓄电池没电了。

words.definition: a fight between opposing armies, groups of ships, groups of people etc, especially one that is part of a larger war; war, conflict, campaign; campaign, fight, war
words.translation: 激战，战役；战役；斗争；作战

examples.en: the Battle of Trafalgar
examples.zh: 特拉法尔加战役

examples.en: a pitched battle (=  a long and serious battle  ) between police and drug gangs
examples.zh: 警方和贩毒团伙之间的一场激战

words.definition: an opinion about whether a person, group, or idea is good or bad that influences how you deal with it; preference, favour; deflective
words.translation: 偏见；偏爱；斜纹；乖离率；偏斜的

examples.en: Students were evaluated without bias.
examples.zh: 对学生的评估都是公正的。

words.definition: a book that tells what has happened in someone’s life, written by someone else; file, record
words.translation: 自传；传记；档案；个人简介

examples.en: ...recent biographies of Stalin.
examples.zh: …近年的斯大林传记。

words.definition: making you feel very unhappy and upset; painful, hurt; gall; strongly, hotly
words.translation: 痛苦的；[食品]苦的；尖刻的；充满仇恨的；[食品]苦味；苦啤酒；激烈地；严寒刺骨地

examples.en: His photo stirred up bitter memories.
examples.zh: 他的照片勾起了痛苦的回忆。

words.definition: very unusual or strange; fantastic, funny, fatastic
words.translation: 古怪的；奇怪的；奇异的（指态度，容貌，款式等）

examples.en: a bizarre coincidence
examples.zh: 奇怪的巧合

examples.en: dancers in rather bizarre costumes
examples.zh: 身着奇装异服的舞者

words.definition: to say or think that someone or something is responsible for something bad; talk to, tell off; duty, liability, error, burden, trust
words.translation: 谴责；责备；归咎于；责任；过失

examples.en: Don’t blame me – it’s not my fault.
examples.zh: 别来怪我——又不是我的错。

examples.en: I blame his mother. She does everything for him.
examples.zh: 怪他母亲不好，她什么事都要为他做。

words.definition: a shirt for women
words.translation: 衬衫

examples.en: a silk blouse
examples.zh: 丝质女衬衫

words.definition: a plan for achieving something; schedule, design, map, propose, project; plan, scheme, programme, project
words.translation: 蓝图，设计图；计划；制成蓝图；[印刷]蓝图，设计图

examples.en: By changing the tomato’s genetic blueprint , scientists can alter the rate at which it ripens.
examples.zh: 科学家可以通过改变番茄的基因蓝图来改变它的成熟速度。

words.definition: a group of people in a company or other organization who make the rules and important decisions; meal, directorate; attend; guest, stay over
words.translation: 董事会；木板；甲板；膳食；上（飞机、车、船等）；用板盖上；给提供膳宿；寄宿

examples.en: a board meeting
examples.zh: 董事会会议

examples.en: a board member
examples.zh: 董事会成员

words.definition: a quick increase of business activity; prosperity, up, speed
words.translation: 繁荣；[机]吊杆；隆隆声

examples.en: The boom has created job opportunities.
examples.zh: 经济繁荣创造了就业的机会。

examples.en: the economic boom of the 1950s
examples.zh: 20世纪50年代的经济繁荣

examples.en: The economy went from boom to bust (=  from increasing to decreasing  ) very quickly.
examples.zh: 经济很快就从繁荣走向了萧条。

words.definition: facilitate, promote, enhance, further, jack; pick pocket, rip off; assistance, motivation, hand, aid, publicity
words.translation: 提高；促进；增加；支援；宣扬；偷窃；推动；帮助

examples.en: So go out there and boost your brainpower, your mind will thank you.
examples.zh: 所以走出去提升你的智力，你的思想会感谢你自己。

words.definition: relating to plants or the scientific study of plants; phytological
words.translation: 植物学的

examples.en: The area is of great botanical interest.
examples.zh: 该地区很有植物学研究价值。

words.definition: to annoy someone, especially by interrupting them when they are trying to do something; eat, burden; worry, go to trouble; trouble, worry, headache
words.translation: 困扰；烦扰，打扰；使……不安；使……恼怒；操心，麻烦；烦恼；麻烦

examples.en: Danny, don’t bother Ellen while she’s reading.
examples.zh: 丹尼，埃伦看书的时候不要去打扰她 。

examples.en: Would it bother you if I put on some music?
examples.zh: 我放点音乐会你介意吗？

words.definition: a local business, shop etc that is part of a larger business etc; sticks, feeder
words.translation: 分支，分公司；[林]树枝，[植]分枝；分部；[地理][水文]支流

examples.en: The bank has branches all over the country.
examples.zh: 这家银行在全国各地都有分行。

examples.en: a branch office in Boston
examples.zh: 在波士顿的分公司

examples.en: She now works in our Denver branch.
examples.zh: 现在她在我们的丹佛分部工作。

words.definition: an important new discovery in something you are studying, especially one made after trying for a long time; penetration
words.translation: 突破性进展；突破

examples.en: The company looks poised to make a significant breakthrough in China.
examples.zh: 该公司看上去稳将在中国实现一次重大突破。

words.definition: if animals breed, they  mate  in order to have babies; increase, result; attract, keep, school, cause, mother; category, variety, manner, nature, description
words.translation: 繁殖；导致；饲养；产生；养育，教育；引起；[生物]品种；种类，类型

examples.en: Eagles breed during the cooler months of the year.
examples.zh: 鹰在一年中较凉爽的季节交配繁殖。

words.definition: a breezy person is happy, confident, and relaxed; alive, lively, activated
words.translation: 轻松愉快的；有微风的；通风好的；活泼的

examples.en: a breezy and relaxed air of confidence
examples.zh: 轻松自信的神态

words.definition: to illegally give someone, especially a public official, money or a gift in order to persuade them to do something for you; buy over, grease; corrupt practices; fix, golden key, payola, glove money
words.translation: 贿赂；[法]贿赂，收买；[法]行贿；[法]贿赂

examples.en: The only way we could get into the country was by bribing the border officials.
examples.zh: 我们要进入这个国家，唯一的办法是贿赂边境官员。

words.definition: to build or form a bridge over something; ponte, pons; cross
words.translation: 缩小；架桥于…之上；[交]桥；桥牌；[计][电]桥接器；船桥；架桥；渡过

examples.en: a fallen tree bridging the stream
examples.zh: 倒下来架在小溪上的树

words.definition: if part of your body bruises, or if you bruise part of your body, it gets hit or hurt and a bruise appears; abrasion, brush-burn; wound, brush burn
words.translation: 使碰伤，擦伤；擦伤；挫伤；[外科]青肿；受伤

examples.en: She fell off her bike and bruised her knee.
examples.zh: 她从自行车上摔下来，擦伤了膝盖。

words.definition: very cruel and violent; wild, cruel, inhuman
words.translation: 残酷的；残忍的；野蛮的，不讲理的

examples.en: a brutal man
examples.zh: 一个凶残的男人

words.definition: to oppose something in a direct way; a US, Canadian, or Australian dollar; money, yuan, QIAN, pocket, sen
words.translation: 反对；美元；（美）钱，元；雄鹿；纨绔子弟；年轻的印第安人或黑人

examples.en: He was a rebel who bucked the system (=  opposed rules or authority  ) .
examples.zh: 他是一个反抗体制的叛逆者。

examples.en: Unemployment in the area has bucked the trend by falling over the last month.
examples.zh: 这个地区的失业现象已经有所逆转，最近一个月来失业率下降了。

words.definition: something difficult or worrying that you are responsible for; liability, duty, weight, strain, trust; eat, bother
words.translation: 负担；责任；船的载货量；使负担；烦扰；装货于

examples.en: His family responsibilities had started to become a burden.
examples.zh: 家庭责任已开始成为他的负担。

words.definition: a complicated official system that is annoying or confusing because it has a lot of rules, processes etc
words.translation: 官僚主义

examples.en: the reduction of unnecessary bureaucracy
examples.zh: 消除不必要的官僚体制

words.definition: the act or ceremony of putting a dead body into a  grave; interment, entombment; funerary
words.translation: 埋葬；葬礼；弃绝；埋葬的

examples.en: The priest prepared the body for burial.
examples.zh: 牧师为尸体做好了下葬的准备。

words.definition: A calculation is something that you think about and work out mathematically. Calculation is the process of working something out mathematically.; computation, estimation, appraisal, valuation, count
words.translation: 计算；[数]计算；估计；计算的结果；深思熟虑

examples.en: Leonard made a rapid calculation: he'd never make it in time.
examples.zh: 伦纳德做了个快速的估算：他不可能及时做完。

words.definition: a unit for measuring the amount of  energy  that food will produce
words.translation: 卡路里

examples.en: A potato has about 90 calories.
examples.zh: 一个马铃薯大约有90卡路里的热量。

examples.en: a calorie-controlled diet
examples.zh: 控制热量的日常饮食

examples.en: I need to burn off a few calories (= lose some weight by exercising ) .
examples.zh: 我要消耗掉一些卡路里。

words.definition: a series of actions intended to achieve a particular result relating to politics or business, or a social improvement; war, battle; movement, activity, exercise, sport, battle
words.translation: 活动；作战；参加竞选；参加活动；运动；战役

examples.en: Jones ran a good campaign.
examples.zh: 琼斯的活动搞得很成功。

examples.en: Police have launched a campaign to crack down on drug dealers.
examples.zh: 警方发起了一场严厉打击毒贩的运动。

words.definition: to decide that something that was officially planned will not happen; recall, call it off; call it off, declare off; withdrawal, revocation
words.translation: 取消；[计]取消；删去；相互抵销；[计]取消，撤销

examples.en: Our flight was cancelled.
examples.zh: 我们的航班取消了。

examples.en: I’m afraid I’ll have to cancel our meeting tomorrow.
examples.zh: 恐怕我得取消我们明天的会议。

examples.en: You’ll just have to ring John and cancel.
examples.zh: 你只能打电话给约翰取消了。

words.definition: having the qualities or ability needed to do something; able, competent
words.translation: 有能力的；能干的，能胜任的；有才华的

examples.en: I don’t think he’s capable of murder.
examples.zh: 我认为他没有能力杀人。

examples.en: The company isn’t capable of handling an order that large.
examples.zh: 那家公司没有能力应付那么大的订单。

examples.en: I’m perfectly capable of looking after myself, thank you!
examples.zh: 我完全能够自己照顾自己，多谢了！

words.definition: the amount of space a container, room etc has to hold things or people; ability, competence, membership, status, productivity
words.translation: 能力，容量；能力；[物]容量；资格，地位；生产力

examples.en: The room had seating capacity for about 80.
examples.zh: 这房间能坐80个人左右。

examples.en: The orchestra played to a capacity crowd (= the largest number of people who can fit into a hall, theatre etc ) .
examples.zh: 管弦乐队为满场的观众演奏。

examples.en: All the hotels were filled to capacity .
examples.zh: 所有的宾馆都住满了。

words.definition: relating to money that you use to start a business or to make more money; fund, upper case; crucial, important, considerable, material, big
words.translation: 资金的，资本的；首都，省会；[会计]资金；大写字母；资本家；首都的；重要的；大写的

examples.en: capital investments
examples.zh: 资本投资

words.definition: to catch a person and keep them as a prisoner; snatch; taking, prize, acquiring
words.translation: 捕捉；[物]俘获；夺得；捕获；战利品，俘虏

examples.en: Government troops have succeeded in capturing the rebel leader.
examples.zh: 政府军已经成功抓获叛乱分子的头目。

examples.en: 40 captured French soldiers
examples.zh: 40名被俘虏的法国士兵

words.definition: to make light or a shadow appear somewhere; throw, pitch, mould, figure; putting, throw; figure, shy
words.translation: 投掷，扔；投，抛；计算；[印刷]浇铸；投射（光、影、视线等）；投掷，抛；[机]铸件，[古生]铸型；演员阵容；脱落物；投，抛垂钓鱼钩；计算，把几个数字加起来

examples.en: the shade cast by low-hanging branches
examples.zh: 低垂的树枝投下的阴影

words.definition: contretemps, fortuity
words.translation: 伤亡人数；意外事故；伤亡人员；急诊室

examples.en: Any history of bombing must also be a history of civilian casualty, for bombing saves the lives of soldiers only at the expense of other lives.
examples.zh: 任何空袭的历史也必定是平民伤亡的历史，因为空袭救了士兵的性命只能以其他人的生命为代价。

examples.en: The first item always on that was the overnight casualty report from Iraq and Afghanistan, and I would often come and see that had been circled by the president or that he would be reflecting on that.
examples.zh: 上面的第一条永远是,这一晚在伊拉克和阿富汗,士兵的伤亡报告，我来的时候会看到那条消息,被布什总统圈了出来,他看着报告会陷入沉思。

words.definition: a group of people or things that are all of the same type; variety, classification, kind, manner, sort, nature
words.translation: 种类；种类，分类；[数]范畴

examples.en: people in the over-45 age category
examples.zh: 属45岁以上年龄组的人

examples.en: Seats are available in eight of the ten price categories .
examples.zh: 座位共有10种票价，现有8种可售。

examples.en: Williams’ style does not fit easily into the category of jazz.
examples.zh: 威廉斯的风格不能轻易归入爵士乐的范畴。

words.definition: careful to avoid danger or risks; prudent, wary
words.translation: 谨慎的；十分小心的

examples.en: a cautious driver
examples.zh: 一位谨慎的司机

examples.en: a cautious approach to the crisis
examples.zh: 处理危机的谨慎态度

examples.en: The air-pollution board has reacted with cautious optimism to the announcement.
examples.zh: 空气污染委员会对这项通告表示谨慎乐观。

words.definition: a number of shops, hotels, cinemas etc owned or managed by the same company or person; restriction, cord; bound, enslave
words.translation: 连锁店；[计]链；束缚；枷锁；囚禁；用铁练锁住

examples.en: ...a large supermarket chain.
examples.zh: …一家大型连锁超市。

words.definition: a situation in which everything is happening in a confused way and nothing is organized or arranged in order; disorder, confusion, involvement, mix, turmoil
words.translation: 混乱；[物]混沌，混乱

examples.en: The country was plunged into economic chaos.
examples.zh: 这个国家陷入了经济大混乱。

words.definition: the particular combination of features and qualities that makes a thing or place different from all others; quality, role, workers, identity, tang; print...
words.translation: 角色；性格，品质；特性；[计]字符；印，刻；使具有特征

examples.en: A soulless shopping centre stands across from one of the few buildings with character, the town hall.
examples.zh: 一座毫无生气的购物中心对面就是少有的几个别具特色的建筑物之一：市政厅。

words.definition: to do something in order to find out whether something really is correct, true, or in good condition; examine, inspect, review, park; prevention, cheque
words.translation: 检查；阻止；制止；寄存；[金融]支票；阻止物

examples.en: Check the tiles carefully before you buy them.
examples.zh: 购买之前要把瓷砖仔细检查一下。

examples.en: A first rule in solving any mystery is to check the facts.
examples.zh: 揭开谜团的第一条规则是核查事实。

examples.en: Fill in the cash book carefully and always check your calculations.
examples.zh: 仔细填写现金账簿，每次都要检查计算结果。

words.definition: to describe events in the order in which they happened; page, register; register, to record
words.translation: 记录；编年史，年代记；把…载入编年史

examples.en: His life is chronicled in a new biography published last week.
examples.zh: 他的生平被写成一本新传记，于上周出版。

examples.en: The book chronicles the events leading up to the war.
examples.zh: 该书记述了导致战争爆发的一系列事件。

words.definition: the average number of copies of a newspaper or magazine that are usually sold each day, week, month etc; revolution, rotation, cycle, propagation, diffusion
words.translation: 发行量；[贸易]流通，传播；循环；[图情]发行量

examples.en: The Daily News once had the highest circulation of any daily in the country.
examples.zh: 《每日新闻报》一度在该国所有日报中拥有最高发行量。

words.definition: the conditions that affect a situation, action, event etc; context, situation, setting, event, occurrence, thing, scene
words.translation: 情况，环境；环境，情况；事件；境遇

examples.en: The Soviet Union had been forced by circumstances to sign a pact with Nazi Germany.
examples.zh: 苏联为形势所迫同纳粹德国签订了一项条约。

examples.en: I can’t imagine a circumstance in which I would be willing to steal.
examples.zh: 我无法想象我在什么情况下会愿意去偷东西。

words.definition: a line taken from a book, speech etc; citing, quotation
words.translation: 引文；引用，引证；[法]传票；褒扬

examples.en: The essay begins with a citation from ‘Hamlet’.
examples.zh: 这篇文章开头引用了《哈姆雷特》中的一句话。

words.definition: to state that something is true, even though it has not been proved; exact, say, lack, desire, call for; requirement, do, assurance, need, desire
words.translation: 索取，声称；要求；声称；需要；认领；[贸易]索赔；断言；值得

examples.en: I don’t claim to be a feminist, but I’d like to see more women in top jobs.
examples.zh: 我不会自称是女权主义者，但我希望看到更多的女性担任高职。

examples.en: Opposition leaders will claim victory if the turnout is lower than 50%.
examples.zh: 如果投票率低于 50%，反对党领袖将宣布获胜。

words.definition: to make something clearer or easier to understand; illustrate, elucidate
words.translation: 澄清，明确；澄清；阐明

examples.en: Reporters asked him to clarify his position (= say exactly what his beliefs are ) on welfare reform.
examples.zh: 记者们要求他阐明他在福利改革问题上的立场。

words.definition: to decide what group something belongs to; categorize, sort through
words.translation: 分类；分等

examples.en: We’d classify Drabble’s novels under ‘Romance’.
examples.zh: 我们把德拉布尔的小说归类为“言情小说”。

examples.en: Families are classified according to the father’s occupation.
examples.zh: 各个家庭按父亲的职业分类。

words.definition: a part of a written law or legal document covering a particular subject of the whole law or document; item, provision, article
words.translation: 条款；[法]条款；[计]子句

examples.en: A confidentiality clause was added to the contract.
examples.zh: 合同中加上了一项保密条款。

words.definition: an object or piece of information that helps someone solve a crime or mystery; action, plot, scenario
words.translation: 线索；（故事等的）情节

examples.en: Police have found a vital clue .
examples.zh: 警方发现了至关重要的线索。

examples.en: Archaeological evidence will provide clues about what the building was used for.
examples.zh: 考古证据将为这幢建筑的用途提供线索。

examples.en: a desperate search for clues
examples.zh: 拼命寻找线索

words.definition: in the sea or on the land near the coast; maritime, littoral
words.translation: 海滨的；[海洋]沿海的；海岸的

examples.en: the coastal waters of Britain
examples.zh: 英国的近海水域

examples.en: the coastal path
examples.zh: 海滨小道

words.definition: password, cryptogram; encode
words.translation: 代号，密码；代码，[遗][通信]密码；[计]编码；[法]法典；制成法典

examples.en: The spy sent his message in code.
examples.zh: 这个间谍用密码发送情报。

examples.en: But we have not yet implemented this in the code.
examples.zh: 但我们在代码中尚未实现此功能。

examples.en: The hacker came smack up against the company's policy of keeping its records in code.
examples.zh: 这个计算机黑客突然碰壁了，因这家公司实行了用密码保存公司纪录的政策。

words.definition: a job or piece of work that involves two or more people working together to achieve something; cooperative, coefficient, synergic
words.translation: 合作的；合作的，协作的

examples.en: ...a collaborative research project.
examples.zh: …一个合作研究项目。

words.definition: if a building, wall etc collapses, it falls down suddenly, usually because it is weak or damaged; founder, fall in; crumple up; failure, loss, losing, defeat, reverse
words.translation: 坍塌，崩塌；倒塌；瓦解；暴跌；使倒塌，使崩溃；使萎陷；失败；衰竭

examples.en: Uncle Ted’s chair collapsed under his weight.
examples.zh: 椅子承受不了特德叔叔的重量，塌架了。

examples.en: The roof had collapsed long ago.
examples.zh: 屋顶早就塌了。

words.definition: shared or made by every member of a group or society; mutual, corporate, common, joint; bloc, clan
words.translation: 共同的；集体的；集合的；集体主义的；集团；集合体；集合名词

examples.en: a collective decision made by all board members
examples.zh: 董事会所有成员作出的集体决定

examples.en: our collective responsibility for the environment
examples.zh: 我们对环境的共同责任

words.definition: to hit something or someone that is moving in a different direction from you; hit, impact on, crash
words.translation: 撞击，碰撞；碰撞；抵触，冲突

examples.en: A car and a van collided on the motorway.
examples.zh: 一辆汽车和一辆小型货车在高速公路上相撞了。

examples.en: Two trains collided head-on (= when they were moving directly towards each other ) .
examples.zh: 两辆火车迎头相撞。

words.definition: the buying and selling of goods and services; trade, traffic
words.translation: 商业；贸易，[贸易]商业

examples.en: measures promoting local commerce and industry
examples.zh: 促进地方工商业发展的措施

words.definition: a promise to do something or to behave in a particular way; assurance, certification, guarantee, security, compliance
words.translation: 承诺；承诺，保证；委托；承担义务；献身

examples.en: Are you ready to make a long-term commitment ?
examples.zh: 你是否准备好作出长久的承诺？

words.definition: a product that is bought and sold; cargo, merchandise
words.translation: 商品；商品，[贸易]货物；日用品

examples.en: agricultural commodities
examples.zh: 农业商品

examples.en: Commodity prices fell sharply.
examples.zh: 商品价格急剧下跌。

words.definition: a smaller enclosed space inside something larger; to divide, measure off
words.translation: 车厢, 隔间；分隔；划分

examples.en: The bag is divided into separate compartments .
examples.zh: 这个包有一些独立的隔层。

examples.en: {"COLLOINEXA":["engine compartment"]}
examples.zh: 发动机室

examples.en: She kept the money hidden in a secret compartment in her briefcase.
examples.zh: 她把钱藏在公文包的暗层里。

words.definition: to force someone to do something; pressure, force, enforce
words.translation: 强迫；强迫，迫使；强使发生

examples.en: ...the introduction of legislation to compel cyclists to wear a helmet.
examples.zh: …强制骑车人戴头盔的法律的引入。

words.definition: very interesting or exciting, so that you have to pay attention; attractive, dramatic; coercing
words.translation: 引人注目的；强制的；激发兴趣的；强迫；以强力获得（compel的ing形式）

examples.en: His life makes a compelling story .
examples.zh: 他的一生是个引人入胜的故事。

words.definition: to replace or balance the effect of something bad; make good, to make up for
words.translation: 弥补；补偿，赔偿；抵消；付报酬

examples.en: Because my left eye is so weak, my right eye has to work harder to compensate.
examples.zh: 因为我左眼视力差，右眼就要辛苦点来弥补一下。

words.definition: the ability to do something well; ability, capacity, rights, power, jurisdiction
words.translation: 能力；能力，[胚]胜任；权限；作证能力；足以过舒适生活的收入

examples.en: Typing is considered by most employers to be a basic competence.
examples.zh: 大多数雇主认为打字是一项基本技能。

words.definition: a statement in which someone complains about something; sickness, complain of
words.translation: 抱怨，投诉；抱怨；诉苦；疾病；委屈

examples.en: If you wish to make a complaint, you should see the manager.
examples.zh: 如果你要投诉，应该去找经理。

examples.en: The sales assistants are trained to deal with customer complaints in a friendly manner.
examples.zh: 售货员都受过培训，要以友好的态度处理顾客的投诉。

words.definition: consisting of many closely connected parts; involved, detailed, sophisticated, elusive
words.translation: 复杂的；难懂的，复杂的

examples.en: a complicated pattern
examples.zh: 复杂的图案

examples.en: The human brain is an incredibly complicated organ.
examples.zh: 人脑是一个结构极其复杂的器官。

words.definition: including all the necessary facts, details, or problems that need to be dealt with; extensive, integrated, synthetic, widespread, general
words.translation: 综合的，全面的；综合的；广泛的；有理解力的

examples.en: We offer our customers a comprehensive range of financial products.
examples.zh: 我们为客户提供全面的金融产品。

examples.en: a comprehensive guide to British hotels and restaurants
examples.zh: 一本介绍英国酒店和餐厅的详尽指南

examples.en: The following guidelines do not aim to be totally comprehensive.
examples.zh: 以下指导原则并非想要面面俱到。

words.definition: a change in your behaviour that you make because of a particular situation or idea; recognition, license
words.translation: 妥协；让步；特许（权）；承认；退位

examples.en: He took off his jacket as a concession to the heat.
examples.zh: 因为气温高，他只好脱掉了夹克衫。

examples.en: He made no concessions to fashion.
examples.zh: 他从不迎合时尚。

words.definition: showing that something is definitely true; crucial, critical, final, finishing, decisive
words.translation: 得出结论的；决定性的；最后的；确实的；确定性的

words.definition: definite and specific; honest, effective, real; to freeze, clot; coagulation
words.translation: 具体的；[建]混凝土的；实在的，具体的；有形的；凝结；具体物；凝结物

examples.en: What does that mean in concrete terms ?
examples.zh: 具体来说那到底是什么意思？

examples.en: the lack of any concrete evidence
examples.zh: 缺少具体证据的

examples.en: a dialogue about concrete issues and problems
examples.zh: 有关具体事情和问题的对话

words.definition: if something conducts electricity or heat, it allows electricity or heat to travel along or through it; lead through; manage, run, direct, represent, aim; going on, behavior, dealing, enforcement, administration
words.translation: 引导，管理；导电；带领；管理；引导；表现；进行；行为；实施

examples.en: Aluminium, being a metal, readily conducts heat .
examples.zh: 铝这种金属导热性能很好。

words.definition: to keep someone or something within the limits of a particular activity or subject; boundary, border; block, set a limit to
words.translation: 限制；界限，边界；禁闭

examples.en: Vaughan is confined to a wheelchair .
examples.zh: 沃恩离不开轮椅。

words.definition: a state of disagreement or argument between people, groups, countries etc; interference, difference, war, battle, collision; combat, collide with
words.translation: 冲突；冲突，矛盾；斗争；争执；冲突，抵触；战斗

examples.en: the threat of industrial conflict in the coalfields
examples.zh: 煤田发生劳资纠纷的风险

examples.en: Marx points out the potential conflicts below the surface of society.
examples.zh: 马克思指出了隐藏在社会表层之下的潜在矛盾。

examples.en: His views on the literal truth of the Bible brought him into conflict with other Christian leaders.
examples.zh: 他坚持《圣经》字面真理的观点使他与其他的基督教领袖发生了冲突。

words.definition: in a way that obeys rules, customs etc; accordance, unity, agreement, identity, consensus
words.translation: 一致；一致，适合；符合；相似

examples.en: We must act in conformity with local regulations.
examples.zh: 我们必须按当地的法规行事。

words.definition: If you describe the way that someone behaves as confrontational, you are showing your disapproval of the fact that they are aggressive and likely to cause an argument or dispute; adversarial, oppositional
words.translation: 对抗的，有敌意的；对抗的；对抗性的

examples.en: The committee's confrontational style of campaigning has made it unpopular.
examples.zh: 该委员会挑衅的宣传方式使之不得人心。

words.definition: an opinion that everyone in a group agrees with or accepts; accordance, unity, agreement, identity, keeping
words.translation: 共识，一致；一致；舆论；合意

examples.en: The EU Council of Finance Ministers failed to reach a consensus on the pace of integration.
examples.zh: 欧盟财政部长会议未能就一体化的进度达成共识。

examples.en: the current consensus of opinion
examples.zh: 目前观点上的一致

examples.en: The general consensus was that technology was a good thing.
examples.zh: 大家都认为科技是好东西。

words.definition: the protection of natural things such as animals, plants, forests etc, to prevent them from being spoiled or destroyed; preservation, protection, maintenance, lee, safeguard
words.translation: 保护；保存，保持

examples.en: wildlife conservation
examples.zh: 野生生物保护

examples.en: a local conservation group
examples.zh: 当地的一个环境保护团体

words.definition: not liking changes or new ideas; standpat, backward-looking; old guard, pontificator
words.translation: 保守的；保守派，守旧者

examples.en: a very conservative attitude to education
examples.zh: 对待教育非常守旧的态度

examples.en: conservative views
examples.zh: 保守的观点

words.definition: fairly large, especially large enough to have an effect or be important; crucial, important, material, big, major
words.translation: 相当多的；相当大的；重要的，值得考虑的

examples.en: Michael has already spent considerable time in Barcelona.
examples.zh: 迈克尔在巴塞罗那已经待了相当长的时间了。

examples.en: issues of considerable importance
examples.zh: 相当重要的问题

examples.en: The series has aroused considerable interest.
examples.zh: 这套系列节目引起了观众相当浓厚的兴趣。

words.definition: to make someone feel better when they are feeling sad or disappointed; Prefs, operation desk; comfort, quiet
words.translation: 安慰；[计]控制台；[电]操纵台；慰藉

examples.en: No one could console her when Peter died.
examples.zh: 彼得去世时没人能够安慰她。

words.definition: happening regularly or all the time; permanent, steady; invariable
words.translation: 不断的；不变的；恒定的；经常的；[数]常数；恒量

examples.en: There was a constant stream of visitors to the house.
examples.zh: 参观这幢房子的游客川流不息。

examples.en: Amy lived in constant fear of being attacked.
examples.zh: 埃米一直生活在害怕遭到袭击的恐惧之中。

examples.en: He kept in constant contact with his family while he was in Australia.
examples.zh: 他在澳大利亚时一直和家人保持着联系。

words.definition: the process of building things such as houses, bridges, roads etc; interpretation, explanation, fabric, building, structure
words.translation: 建筑；[建]建设；建筑物；解释；造句

examples.en: a road construction project
examples.zh: 道路修建计划

examples.en: construction workers
examples.zh: 建筑工人

words.definition: a company that gives advice on a particular subject; consulting firm, consultation company
words.translation: 咨询；咨询公司；顾问工作

examples.en: a management consultancy
examples.zh: 管理咨询公司

examples.en: a consultancy firm
examples.zh: 咨询公司

words.definition: the amount of energy, oil, electricity etc that is used; expense, depletion
words.translation: 消费, 消耗；[经]消费；消耗；肺痨

examples.en: Vigorous exercise increases oxygen consumption.
examples.zh: 剧烈运动增加氧的消耗。

words.definition: pollution, impureness
words.translation: 污染；[环境]污染，玷污；污染物

examples.en: However, contamination can occur at any point along the food chain, from field to table.
examples.zh: 然而，污染沿着食物链可能在任何的点上发生，从田地到餐桌。

examples.en: There is no evidence of contamination in our lab, and we have controlled for that all along.
examples.zh: 我们的实验室不存在污染，在整个实验过程中我们都控制的很好。

examples.en: Others have said that all of Mars should be protected as a wildlife preserve where we do everything possible to avoid contamination; on the assumption Martian microbes could exist.
examples.zh: 假设火星上可能存在微生物，其他人就认为火星应该是我们做任何事来避免污染的野生动物保护区那样来被保护着。

words.definition: happy and satisfied; satisfaction, directory, bulk, list, fill; satisfactory, well-pleasing; gratify, appease
words.translation: 满意的；内容，目录；满足；[物]容量；使满足

examples.en: Andy was a good husband, and Nicky was clearly very content.
examples.zh: 安迪是个好丈夫，尼基显然非常满足。

words.definition: a strong opinion that someone expresses; thesis, combat
words.translation: 争论；争论，争辩；争夺；论点

examples.en: His case has become a source of contention between civil liberties activists and the government.
examples.zh: 他的案子已变成了公民自由活动家们和政府之间的争论缘由。

words.definition: contrary ideas, opinions, or actions are completely different and opposed to each other; opposite, adverse, counter, against, cross; counter, backward, conversely, inversely; inverse, verso
words.translation: 相反的；对立的；相反地；相反；反面

examples.en: Two contrary views emerged.
examples.zh: 出现了两种相反的观点。

examples.en: The men shouted contrary orders.
examples.zh: 这些人大声喊叫的命令互相矛盾。

words.definition: To contribute money or resources to something means to give money or resources to help pay for something or to help achieve a particular purpose; make contribution, offer up
words.translation: 有助于；贡献，出力；[图情]投稿；[经]捐献

examples.en: The U.S. is contributing $4 billion in loans, credits, and grants.
examples.zh: 美国以信贷和赠与的方式捐助了40亿美元。

examples.en: Local businesses have agreed to contribute.
examples.zh: 当地的公司已经同意捐助了。

words.definition: something that you give or do in order to help something be successful; subscription, contributing to
words.translation: 贡献；捐献；投稿

examples.en: All the money has been raised by voluntary contribution.
examples.zh: 所有这些钱都是靠自愿捐献筹集的。

words.definition: a serious argument about something that involves many people and continues for a long time; combat, debate, dispute
words.translation: 争议；争论；论战；辩论

examples.en: a political controversy
examples.zh: 政治争议

examples.en: the controversy surrounding Skinner’s theories
examples.zh: 围绕斯金纳的理论的争议

examples.en: (= began ) over the use of the chemicals on crops.
examples.zh: 对庄稼施用化学品的做法引起了争论。

words.definition: a conventional method, product, practice etc has been used for a long time and is considered the usual type; traditional, usual, familiar, classical
words.translation: 传统的；符合习俗的，传统的；常见的；惯例的

examples.en: Internet connections through conventional phone lines are fairly slow.
examples.zh: 通过传统的电话线来连接因特网速度很慢。

examples.en: Bake for 20 minutes in a conventional oven; 8 in a microwave.
examples.zh: 在传统的烤炉中烘烤20分钟，在微波炉里则烤8分钟。

words.definition: to change something into a different form, or to change something so that it can be used for a different purpose or in a different way; transform, shift; idolater, proselytizer
words.translation: 转换，改变；转变，变换；皈依；改变信仰；皈依者；改变宗教信仰者

examples.en: a 19th-century converted barn
examples.zh: 由19世纪谷仓改建的房子

words.definition: to prove or officially announce that someone is guilty of a crime after a  trial  in a law court; criminal offender, culprit
words.translation: 证明……有罪；罪犯

examples.en: a convicted murderer
examples.zh: 已定罪的谋杀犯

words.definition: If someone or something convinces you of something, they make you believe that it is true or that it exists; assure, reason, satisfy, argue
words.translation: 使……相信；说服；使确信，使信服

examples.en: Although I soon convinced him of my innocence, I think he still has serious doubts about my sanity.
examples.zh: 尽管我很快就使他相信我是清白的，但是他还是非常怀疑我精神是否正常。

words.definition: the way in which your muscles move together when you perform a movement; harmony, keeping
words.translation: 协调；协调，调和；对等，同等

examples.en: Too much alcohol affects your coordination.
examples.zh: 喝酒太多会影响你动作的协调。

words.definition: dishonest, illegal, or immoral behaviour, especially from someone with power; degradation, deterioration
words.translation: 腐败；[法]贪污，腐败；堕落

examples.en: officials charged with bribery and corruption
examples.zh: 被指控受贿和贪污的官员

examples.en: The investigation uncovered widespread corruption within the police force.
examples.zh: 这项调查揭发出了警察机关内部普遍的腐败。

words.definition: to advise someone; advice, discussion; agree to sb, make suggestions
words.translation: 建议，忠告；法律顾问；忠告；商议；讨论；决策；建议；劝告

examples.en: My advisers counselled me to do nothing.
examples.zh: 我的顾问建议我不要做任何事情。

words.definition: consultant, brain truster
words.translation: 咨询顾问；顾问；法律顾问；参事（等于counsellor）

words.definition: an action taken to prevent another action from having a harmful effect
words.translation: 对策

examples.en: new countermeasures against terrorism
examples.zh: 对抗恐怖主义的新措施

words.definition: to report the details of an event for a newspaper or a television or radio programme; deal with, complete with; envelope, coer; write over, substitute for
words.translation: 报道；包括；采访，报导；涉及；封面，封皮；盖子；掩蔽物；覆盖；代替

examples.en: I’d just returned from covering the Cambodian war.
examples.zh: 我刚报道完柬埔寨战争回来。

words.definition: when a subject or event is reported on television or radio, or in newspapers; lay over, decken
words.translation: 报道；[植]覆盖，覆盖范围

examples.en: live coverage of the match (= the match is broadcast at the same time that it is happening )
examples.zh: 这场比赛的现场直播

words.definition: relating to crime; someone who is involved in illegal activities or has been proved guilty of a crime; offender, culprit; penal, peccant
words.translation: 犯罪的；罪犯；刑事的；罪恶的

examples.en: Experts cannot agree on the causes of criminal behaviour .
examples.zh: 专家对犯罪行为的原因不能取得一致意见。

examples.en: I was sure he was involved in some kind of criminal activity .
examples.zh: 我肯定他在从事某种犯罪活动。

examples.en: She has not committed a criminal offence (= a crime ) .
examples.zh: 她没有犯罪。

words.definition: A criterion is a factor on which you judge or decide something; standards, conditions, indexes
words.translation: 标准；标准，条件（criterion的复数）

examples.en: The most important criterion for entry is that applicants must design and make their own work.
examples.zh: 参加的最重要标准就是申请人必须设计并制作自己的作品。

words.definition: if you are critical, you criticize someone or something; dangerous, crucial, final, decisive, marginal
words.translation: 挑剔的，批评的；关键的；鉴定的；[核]临界的；批评的，爱挑剔的；危险的；决定性的；评论的

examples.en: He made some highly critical remarks.
examples.zh: 他发表了一些严厉的批判性言论。

words.definition: remarks that say what you think is bad about someone or something; comment, animadversion
words.translation: 批评；考证；苛求

examples.en: Despite strong criticism , the new system is still in place.
examples.zh: 尽管遭到了猛烈的批评，新制度依然原封不动。

examples.en: There has been widespread criticism of the decision.
examples.zh: 这一决定受到了普遍的批评。

examples.en: We try to give students constructive criticism .
examples.zh: 我们设法对学生提出有建设性的批评。

words.definition: something that is crucial is extremely important, because everything else depends on it; important, considerable, material, critical, big
words.translation: 关键的；重要的；决定性的；定局的；决断的

examples.en: The conservation of tropical forests is of crucial importance .
examples.zh: 保护热带雨林至关重要。

words.definition: to control or limit something in order to prevent it from having a harmful effect; checking, control, restraint, suppression, inhibition; possess, contain, regulate, bit, bottle
words.translation: 限制，控制；抑制；路边；勒马绳；控制；勒住

examples.en: measures to curb the spread of the virus
examples.zh: 控制病毒扩散的措施

words.definition: the system or type of money that a country uses; money, circulating medium
words.translation: 货币；[金融]货币；通货

examples.en: The bank can supply you with foreign currency .
examples.zh: 这家银行能为你提供外币。

examples.en: There are moves towards a single currency in Europe.
examples.zh: 欧洲有向单一货币发展的趋势。

examples.en: The local currency is the Swiss franc.
examples.zh: 当地的货币是瑞士法郎。

words.definition: to be brave enough to do something that is risky or that you are afraid to do – used especially in questions or negative sentences; challenge, defi; make bold to
words.translation: 勇敢，敢于做；挑战；挑动；敢；胆敢

examples.en: He wanted to ask her, but he didn’t dare.
examples.zh: 他想问她，但又不敢。

examples.en: ‘I’ll tell Dad.’ ‘You wouldn’t dare!’
examples.zh: “我要告诉爸爸。” “谅你也不敢！”

words.definition: the pieces of something that are left after it has been destroyed in an accident, explosion etc; remain, chip
words.translation: 残骸，碎片；碎片，残骸

examples.en: She was hit by flying debris from the blast.
examples.zh: 她被爆炸产生的飞散碎片击中。

words.definition: proper, goodish
words.translation: 体面的；正派的；得体的；相当好的

examples.en: He was the only thing there that seemed decent: and I thought he never looked better.
examples.zh: 他是那里唯一的看上去很体面的人；我认为他从来没有这样好看过。

examples.en: A decent argument can almost certainly be made against all of those statements, which is why this award is so close this year, especially between Kobe and Paul.
examples.zh: 一个得体的争论几乎可以明确的作出来对抗所有这些争论，那就是为什么今年这个奖项如此激烈，特别是在科比和保罗之间。

words.definition: an action, event etc that is decisive has a big effect on the way that something develops; crucial, critical, final, committed, confirmed
words.translation: 决定性的；果断的，坚定的

examples.en: a decisive leader
examples.zh: 果断的领袖

words.definition: to say no politely when someone invites you somewhere, offers you something, or wants you to do something; reduction, recession, fall; go down, slump; excuse oneself from
words.translation: 拒绝；下降；衰退；斜面；衰落；谢绝；婉拒

examples.en: Offered the position of chairman, Smith declined, preferring to keep his current job.
examples.zh: 对担任主席的邀约，史密斯拒绝了，他宁愿留在现在的职位上。

examples.en: Mary declined a hot drink and went to her room.
examples.zh: 玛丽谢绝了热饮料，到自己的房间去了。

examples.en: The minister declined to comment (= refused to speak to people who report the news ) about the progress of the peace talks.
examples.zh: 部长拒绝就和谈进程发表评论。

words.definition: to think of something in a particular way or as having a particular quality; count, feel, find, guess, rate; consider, take for
words.translation: 认为；认为，视作；相信；认为，持某种看法；作某种评价

examples.en: French and German were deemed essential.
examples.zh: 法语和德语被认为是必需的。

words.definition: a fault or a lack of something that means that something or someone is not perfect; deficiency, disadvantage, vice, fault, shortcoming; apostatize, rise up
words.translation: 缺点；缺点，[晶体][材]缺陷；不足之处；变节；叛变

examples.en: All the cars are tested for defects before they leave the factory.
examples.zh: 所有汽车在出厂前都经过品质检验。

examples.en: a genetic defect
examples.zh: 遗传缺陷

words.definition: used or intended to protect someone or something against attack; self-defensive; defence against, phylaxis
words.translation: 防守的，防御的；自卫的；防御用的；防御；守势

examples.en: The prince drew up his forces in a strong defensive position.
examples.zh: 亲王将部队布成坚固的防御阵势。

examples.en: The rockets are a purely defensive measure against nuclear attack.
examples.zh: 火箭弹纯粹是针对核攻击的防御性措施。

words.definition: not containing or having enough of something; insufficient, short, inadequate, lacking, disabled
words.translation: 不足的，缺乏的；不足的；有缺陷的；不充分的

examples.en: Women who are dieting can become iron deficient.
examples.zh: 节食的女性有可能缺铁。

words.definition: the difference between the amount of something that you have and the higher amount that you need; red ink
words.translation: 赤字；[财政]赤字；不足额

examples.en: the country’s widening budget deficit
examples.zh: 这个国家日益严重的预算赤字

examples.en: the US’s foreign trade deficit
examples.zh: 美国的对外贸易逆差

words.definition: to refuse to obey a law or rule, or refuse to do what someone in authority tells you to do; spurn at, sneeze at; challenge, dare, war, confrontation
words.translation: 违背，违抗；藐视；公然反抗；挑衅；使落空；挑战；对抗

examples.en: people who openly defy the law
examples.zh: 公然抗拒法律的人

words.definition: intended or planned; intended, studied, designed, contained, conscious; negotiate, mull over
words.translation: 故意的；深思熟虑的；从容的；仔细考虑；商议

examples.en: a deliberate attempt to humiliate her
examples.zh: 对她的故意羞辱

examples.en: The attack on him was quite deliberate.
examples.zh: 对他的袭击完全是有预谋的。

words.definition: needing to be dealt with carefully or sensitively in order to avoid problems or failure; subtle, female, refined, fine, fragile
words.translation: 精细的，细微的；微妙的；精美的，雅致的；柔和的；易碎的；纤弱的；清淡可口的

examples.en: There’s something I have to speak to you about – it’s a delicate matter .
examples.zh: 我有件事要跟你讲——是一件需要谨慎处理的事。

examples.en: delicate negotiations
examples.zh: 微妙的谈判

words.definition: to take goods, letters, packages etc to a particular place or person; afford, allow, extend, deal, free; come true, come to pass
words.translation: 发表，递送；交付；发表；递送；释放；给予（打击）；给…接生；实现；传送；履行；投递

examples.en: The morning mail has just been delivered.
examples.zh: 早晨的邮件刚送到。

examples.en: Do you deliver on Saturdays?
examples.zh: 星期六你们送货吗？

examples.en: I’m having some flowers delivered for her birthday.
examples.zh: 我在安排人给她送花祝贺生日。

words.definition: a system of government in which every citizen in the country can vote to elect its government officials
words.translation: 民主

examples.en: a return to democracy after 16 years of military rule
examples.zh: 16年军人统治后民主制度的恢复

words.definition: to sell a business or industry that is owned by the state, so that it is then owned privately
words.translation: 使非国有化

examples.en: The government started to denationalize financial institutions.
examples.zh: 政府开始将金融机构私有化。

words.definition: to say that something is not true, or that you do not believe something; negative, disavow; object, refuse
words.translation: 否认；否定，否认；拒绝给予；拒绝…的要求；拒绝

examples.en: The government denied the existence of poverty among 16- and 17-year-olds.
examples.zh: 政府否认十六七岁的青少年当中存在贫困问题。

words.definition: If you deprive someone of something that they want or need, you take it away from them, or you prevent them from having it; shear, strip of
words.translation: 剥夺；使丧失，剥夺

examples.en: They've been deprived of the fuel necessary to heat their homes.
examples.zh: 他们无法得到住房取暖必需的燃料。

words.definition: if a train derails or something derails it, it goes off the tracks; digression
words.translation: 脱轨；[铁路]脱轨；脱轨器

examples.en: At least six people were killed and about twenty injured when a train was derailed in an isolated mountain region.
examples.zh: 火车在一片偏僻的山区脱轨，导致至少六人死亡，约二十人受伤。

words.definition: to get something, especially an advantage or a pleasant feeling, from something; to originate
words.translation: 获得；起源

examples.en: Mr. Ying is one of those happy people who derive pleasure from helping others.
examples.zh: 英先生是那种助人为乐的快活人。

words.definition: someone who is related to a person who lived a long time ago, or to a family, group of people etc that existed in the past; falling, downward; child, seed
words.translation: 子孙后代；下降的；祖传的；后裔；子孙

examples.en: He was a direct descendant of Napoleon Bonaparte.
examples.zh: 他是拿破仑·波拿巴的嫡系后裔。

words.definition: giving a description of something; related, depictive
words.translation: 描写的，描述的；描写的，叙述的；描写性的

examples.en: the descriptive passages in the novel
examples.zh: 小说中的描写性段落

words.definition: to have earned something by good or bad actions or behaviour; be deserving of
words.translation: 值得；应受，应得

examples.en: What have I done to deserve this?
examples.zh: 我做了什么事，要得到这样的报应？

examples.en: I’m sorry for the kids. They deserve better (= deserve to be treated in a better way ) .
examples.zh: 我为这些孩子感到难过，他们应该过得更好。

examples.en: Ledley deserves a place in the team.
examples.zh: 莱德利应该在队里占有一席之地。

words.definition: willing to do anything to change a very bad situation, and not caring about danger; venturous, devil-may-care
words.translation: 绝望的，不顾一切的；不顾一切的；令人绝望的；极度渴望的

examples.en: I had no money left and was desperate.
examples.zh: 我身无分文，已经走投无路了。

examples.en: Time was running out and we were getting desperate .
examples.zh: 时间越来越少，我们越来越感到绝望。

examples.en: the missing teenager’s desperate parents
examples.zh: 失踪少年绝望的父母

words.definition: the place that someone or something is going to; goal, end-point
words.translation: 目的地；[计]目的地，终点

examples.en: Ellis Island has become one of America's most popular tourist destinations.
examples.zh: 埃利斯岛已经成为美国最受欢迎的游览地之一。

words.definition: causing damage to people or things; harmful, evil, fell, negative, passive
words.translation: 破坏性的，毁灭性的；破坏的；毁灭性的；有害的，消极的

examples.en: the destructive power of modern weapons
examples.zh: 现代武器的破坏力

words.definition: not reacting to or becoming involved in something in an emotional way; apart, divided, isolated, separate; keep apart, draw apart
words.translation: 冷漠的，超然的；分离的，分开的；超然的；分离

examples.en: Try to take a more detached view .
examples.zh: 尽量采取更为客观的态度。

words.definition: to notice or discover something, especially something that is not easy to see, hear etc; explore, perceive
words.translation: 发现；察觉；探测

examples.en: Many forms of cancer can be cured if detected early.
examples.zh: 如果发现得早，许多种癌症都可以治愈。

words.definition: a police officer whose job is to discover information about crimes and catch criminals; tec, hawkshaw
words.translation: 侦探

examples.en: She hired a detective to find out if her husband was having an affair.
examples.zh: 她雇了一个私人侦探调查她丈夫是否有外遇。

words.definition: industry, hardwork
words.translation: 勤奋；勤奋，勤勉；注意的程度

examples.en: Genius is nothing but labor and diligence.
examples.zh: 天才无非是工作和勤奋。

examples.en: We should cultivate the good habits of diligence and frugality.
examples.zh: 我们要养成勤俭节约的好风气。

words.definition: fairly dark or not giving much light, so that you cannot see well; fuzzy, dark, dirty, lowering; breathe upon; fog, mist; simple, turkey, put, idiot, stupid
words.translation: 暗淡的；愚蠢的；暗淡的，昏暗的；模糊的，看不清的；悲观的，怀疑的；使暗淡，使失去光泽；使变模糊；变模糊，变暗淡；笨蛋，傻子

examples.en: in the dim light of the early dawn
examples.zh: 在微弱的晨曦里

examples.en: a dim glow
examples.zh: 昏暗的微光

words.definition: to become or make something become smaller or less; micrify, minify; to cut down, fall off
words.translation: 减少；使减少；使变小；减少，缩小；变小

examples.en: The party’s share of the electorate has diminished steadily.
examples.zh: 支持这个政党的选民比例持续下降。

examples.en: These drugs diminish blood flow to the brain.
examples.zh: 这些药物会减少流向脑部的血液量。

words.definition: something that causes problems, or that makes someone or something less likely to be successful or effective; defect, deficiency, vice, losing, expense
words.translation: 缺点，不利条件；缺点；不利条件；损失

examples.en: Criminal behaviour can be linked to economic disadvantage.
examples.zh: 犯罪行为可能会与经济困难有关。

words.definition: to become impossible to see any longer; blank, vanish away; plough under
words.translation: 消失；失踪；不复存在；使…不存在；使…消失

examples.en: At this point the path seemed to disappear altogether (= disappear completely ) .
examples.zh: 小路到这里好像完全消失了。

words.definition: to reduce the size of your army, navy etc, and the number of your weapons; relax, demilitarize
words.translation: 解除，消除；解除武装；裁军；缓和

examples.en: Getting the rebels to disarm will not be easy.
examples.zh: 要让叛乱分子解除武装并非易事。

words.definition: an area of knowledge or teaching, especially one such as history, chemistry, mathematics etc that is studied at a university; science, punishment, rod, knowledge, payment; coach, drill
words.translation: 学科；[管理]纪律；训练；惩罚；训练，训导；惩戒

examples.en: We're looking for people from a wide range of disciplines.
examples.zh: 我们正在寻找各类学科的人才。

words.definition: to remove the supply of power, gas, water etc from a machine or piece of equipment; separate, split, divorce; trip out, key out
words.translation: 断开；拆开，使分离

examples.en: The family agreed to disconnect her life support system.
examples.zh: 家人同意切断她的生命维持系统。

words.definition: to make something less likely to happen; stem, block, dispute, prohibit
words.translation: 阻止；使气馁

examples.en: Aspirin may discourage tumour growth in some types of cancer.
examples.zh: 阿司匹林可能遏制某些恶性肿瘤的生长。

words.definition: Disengagement is a process by which people gradually stop being involved in a conflict, activity, or organization; separation, secession
words.translation: 分离，疏离感；脱离；分开

examples.en: This policy of disengagement from the European war had its critics.
examples.zh: 从欧战中逐渐撤军的政策遭到了批评。

words.definition: not honest, and so deceiving or cheating people; insincere, deceptive
words.translation: 不诚实的；欺诈的

examples.en: dishonest traders
examples.zh: 奸商

examples.en: People on welfare are wrongly seen as lazy or dishonest.
examples.zh: 靠福利救济的人被误以为懒惰或不老实。

words.definition: remove, fire out; disband, break up
words.translation: 忽视；解散；解雇；开除；让...离开

words.definition: to send someone or something somewhere for a particular purpose; urgent-mail; mission, send along
words.translation: 发送，派遣；派遣；急件；分派

examples.en: Goods are normally dispatched within 24 hours.
examples.zh: 货物一般在24小时内派送。

words.translation: 比例不均地，不成比例地

examples.en: Johnson’s aversion to this tax was part of his reluctance to ask for any sacrifices for the Vietnam War -- except from the disproportionately blue-collar army that was fighting it.
examples.zh: 约翰逊对这项税的反感，部分是因为除了浴血奋战的不成比例的蓝领军人外，他犹豫要不要要求其他人为越战做出一点点牺牲。

words.definition: If you do someone or something a disservice, you harm them in some way; harm, punishment, abuse
words.translation: 帮倒忙，危害；伤害；帮倒忙的行为；不亲切的行为；虐待

examples.en: He said the protesters were doing a disservice to the nation.
examples.zh: 他表示，抗议者们的行为正对国家造成危害。

words.definition: having a special quality, character, or appearance that is different and easy to recognize; unusual, different, apart
words.translation: 与众不同的；有特色的，与众不同的

examples.en: a rock band with a distinctive sound
examples.zh: 音色独特的摇滚乐队

words.definition: to report something in a way that is not completely true or correct; contort, misinterpret; become deformed, to morph
words.translation: 扭曲；使失真；曲解；变形

examples.en: His account was badly distorted by the press.
examples.zh: 他的话被报界严重歪曲。

words.definition: the act of sharing things among a large group of people in a planned way; allocation, assignment
words.translation: 分布，分配；[统计]分布；分配

examples.en: a distribution centre
examples.zh: 经销中心

words.definition: very different from each other; different, unlike, varying, another, dissimilar
words.translation: 各种各样的；不同的；多种多样的；变化多的

examples.en: subjects as diverse as pop music and archaeology
examples.zh: 像流行音乐和考古学这样各不相同的学科

words.definition: a change in the direction or use of something, or the act of changing it; entertainment, transfer, occupation, recreation, metastasis
words.translation: 转移；娱乐；消遣；分散注意力

examples.en: ...the illegal diversion of profits from secret arms sales.
examples.zh: …销售秘密武器所得收益的非法转移。

words.definition: the fact of including many different types of people or things; difference, multiplicity
words.translation: 多样性；差异

examples.en: ...the cultural diversity of Latin America.
examples.zh: …拉丁美洲文化的多样性。

words.definition: to change the direction in which something travels; shift, distract from; transfer, metastasize
words.translation: 转移；使…欢娱；使…转向

examples.en: The high street is closed and traffic is being diverted .
examples.zh: 大街封闭，车辆正改道而行。

words.definition: a part of a company’s profit that is divided among the people with  share s  in the company; bonus, stake
words.translation: 分红，红利；股息；[数]被除数；奖金

examples.en: You may get the dividend, but possibly not the capital appreciation.
examples.zh: 你或许能 得到红利，但是资本可能不会增值。

words.definition: a film or television or a radio programme that gives detailed information about a particular subject; recorded
words.translation: 纪录片；记录的；文件的；记实的

examples.en: ...a TV documentary on homelessness.
examples.zh: …一部关于无家可归现象的电视记录片。

words.definition: a very intelligent sea animal like a fish with a long grey pointed nose; sea hog, porpoise
words.translation: 海豚；[脊椎]海豚

examples.en: By hunting or gathering away from the group, both chimpanzee and dolphin moms ensure that what they find goes to their young.
examples.zh: 黑猩猩和海豚妈妈们远离群体打猎和收集食物，并保证他们所找到的食物都给孩子们。

examples.en: Daniel: Yes, like a dolphin.
examples.zh: 丹尼尔: 嗯，像海豚一样。

words.definition: relating to or happening in one particular country and not involving any other countries; internal, household, home, family; servant
words.translation: 国内的；家庭的；驯养的；一心只管家务的；国货；佣人

examples.en: ...over 100 domestic flights a day to 30 leading U.S. destinations.
examples.zh: …每天飞往美国30个主要目的地的100多个国内航班。

words.definition: to control someone or something or to have more importance than other people or things; possess, contain, regulate, bit, bottle; advantage over, prevail over
words.translation: 主导，主宰；控制；支配；占优势；在…中占主要地位；处于支配地位

examples.en: The industry is dominated by five multinational companies.
examples.zh: 这个行业受五家跨国公司控制。

examples.en: New Orleans dominated throughout the game.
examples.zh: 新奥尔良队自始至终都控制着这场比赛。

examples.en: Her loud voice totally dominated the conversation.
examples.zh: 她的大嗓门完全主导着这场谈话。

words.definition: a person, group etc that gives something, especially money, to help an organization or country; donator
words.translation: 捐赠者；[法]捐赠者；供者；赠送人

examples.en: We urgently need more assistance from donor countries (= countries that give money, food etc to help in poor countries or disaster areas ) .
examples.zh: 我们急需捐赠国的更多援助。

examples.en: An anonymous donor (= whose name is unknown ) has given £500 towards the restoration fund.
examples.zh: 一位匿名捐赠者向重建基金捐了500英镑。

words.definition: a  dormitory; lodging house, lodging quarters
words.translation: 宿舍；宿舍（等于dormitory）

examples.en: But I had no food in my dorm, so I had to go to canteen.
examples.zh: 但是我在宿舍没有东西可吃，所以我只能去餐厅了。

examples.en: So, some can stay in the dorm for an entire month without talking at all with anyone.
examples.zh: 因此，有些学生能待在宿舍里整整一个月不与任何人讲话。

examples.en: If you have a phone in your dorm or apartment, a cell phone, and any other phone numbers, consolidate them into one number with Google Voice.
examples.zh: 如果你有宿舍或公寓的号码、手机号码，还有其他什么电话号码，可以通过谷歌声音把它们集成为一个号码。

words.definition: remarkably, markedly
words.translation: 大幅度地；戏剧性地；戏剧地；引人注目地

words.definition: thoroughly, entirely, completely, fully, strongly
words.translation: 激烈地，猛烈地；彻底地；激烈地

words.definition: to move slowly on water or in the air; tendency, direction, tide, trend, set; extravagate, knock about
words.translation: 漂流；漂流，[电子]漂移；趋势；漂流物；漂泊

examples.en: Smoke drifted up from the jungle ahead of us.
examples.zh: 我们前方的丛林里有烟升起。

words.definition: someone who leaves school or college before they have finished
words.translation: 辍学

examples.en: a high school dropout
examples.zh: 中学退学者

words.definition: a long period of dry weather when there is not enough water for plants and animals to live; shortage, deficiency, need, short of, want
words.translation: 干旱；[气候]干旱；缺乏

examples.en: ...a country where drought and famines have killed up to two million people during the last eighteen years.
examples.zh: …过去18年来干旱和饥荒致死达两百万人的一个国家。

words.definition: to die from being under water for too long, or to kill someone in this way; flood, flow
words.translation: 溺水；淹没；把…淹死

examples.en: Many people drowned when the boat overturned.
examples.zh: 船翻后许多人淹死了。

examples.en: Jane was drowned in the river.
examples.zh: 简在那条河里溺水身亡。

words.definition: a person or animal that lives in a particular place; liver, resident, inhabitant, habitant
words.translation: 居住者；居民，居住者

examples.en: City dwellers suffer higher pollution levels.
examples.zh: 城市居民承受的污染程度更严重。

words.definition: lesion, disfunction; crumble to dust
words.translation: 失灵；功能紊乱；机能障碍；官能不良；功能失调；出现机能障碍；垮掉

words.definition: behaving in a way that is unusual and different from most people; abnormal, odd, curious; fantastic, weirdo
words.translation: 古怪的；古怪的，反常的；古怪的人

examples.en: His eccentric behaviour lost him his job.
examples.zh: 他古怪的行为使他丢了工作。

examples.en: Aunt Nessy was always a bit eccentric.
examples.zh: 内西姑妈总是有点古怪。

words.definition: connected with the way plants, animals, and people are related to each other and to their environment
words.translation: 生态学的

examples.en: an ecological disaster
examples.zh: 生态灾难

words.definition: to prepare a book, piece of film etc for printing or broadcasting by removing mistakes or parts that are not acceptable; copy-edit, redact
words.translation: 剪辑，编辑；[计]编辑；校订

examples.en: The newspaper edits letters before printing them.
examples.zh: 这家报社刊登读者来信前先作校订。

words.definition: when people vote to choose someone for an official position; option, vote, choice
words.translation: 选举；当选；选择权；上帝的选拔

examples.en: The Labour Party won the 2001 election by a huge majority.
examples.zh: 工党在2001年选举中以巨大优势获胜。

examples.en: Elections for the state governorship will be on November 25.
examples.zh: 州长选举将于11月25日举行。

words.definition: to completely get rid of something that is unnecessary or unwanted; avoid, exclude
words.translation: 消除；排除

examples.en: a ruthless dictator who eliminated all his rivals
examples.zh: 铲除所有异己的残酷独裁者
