words.definition: a group of people who have a lot of power and influence because they have money, knowledge, or special skills; essence, flower, regular, prime, distillation
words.translation: 精英；精华；中坚分子

examples.en: a struggle for power within the ruling elite
examples.zh: 统治阶层内部的争权夺利

words.definition: able to express your ideas and opinions well, especially in a way that influences people; meaningful, affecting, significant, moving, speaking
words.translation: 口才好的，雄辩的；意味深长的；雄辩的，有口才的；有说服力的；动人的

examples.en: an eloquent appeal for support
examples.zh: 极具说服力的求助呼吁

words.definition: to appear or come out from somewhere; ray, cast off
words.translation: 出现；浮现；摆脱；暴露

examples.en: The flowers emerge in the spring.
examples.zh: 花儿在春天开放。

words.definition: to say something in a strong way; stress, highlight
words.translation: 强调；强调，着重

examples.en: The report emphasizes the importance of improving safety standards.
examples.zh: 报告强调了改进安全标准的重要性。

examples.en: Logan made a speech emphasizing the need for more volunteers.
examples.zh: 罗根发表演讲，强调需要更多的志愿者。

words.definition: to experience something, especially problems or opposition; confront, bring up against; fell in with, lit on; bring up against, run into
words.translation: 遭遇；遭遇，邂逅；遇到；遭遇，偶然碰见；偶然相遇

examples.en: The doctor had encountered several similar cases in the past.
examples.zh: 那位医生过去曾碰到过好几个类似病例。

words.definition: to give someone the courage or confidence to do something; heart, stimulate, power, hand, second
words.translation: 鼓励；鼓励，怂恿；激励；支持

examples.en: I want to thank everyone who has encouraged and supported me.
examples.zh: 我要感谢每一位鼓励和支持过我的人。

words.definition: very large in amount, size, or number; continuing, straight, running, serial, successive
words.translation: 无限的，没完没了的；无止境的；连续的；环状的；漫无目的的

examples.en: an endless stream of visitors
examples.zh: 川流不息的游客

examples.en: The possibilities are endless.
examples.zh: 有无限的可能性。

examples.en: He’s been in a lot of trouble – drugs, guns, blackmail – the list is endless.
examples.zh: 他麻烦太多了——毒品、枪支、敲诈——说都说不完。

words.definition: to make something happen or force someone to do something; perform, actualize
words.translation: 强迫，迫使；实施，执行；强迫，强制

words.definition: If you engage in an activity, you do it or are actively involved with it; attract, absorb, draw, appropriate, budget; comply, wage
words.translation: 忙于，从事；雇佣；吸引，占用；使参加；使订婚；预定；从事；答应，保证；交战；啮合

examples.en: I have never engaged in drug trafficking.
examples.zh: 我从来没有从事过贩毒。

words.definition: very big in size or in amount; huge, tremendous, massive, macro, vast
words.translation: 巨大的；庞大的，巨大的；凶暴的，极恶的

examples.en: an enormous bunch of flowers
examples.zh: 巨大的花束

examples.en: an enormous amount of money
examples.zh: 巨款

examples.en: The team made an enormous effort.
examples.zh: 该队付出了巨大的努力。

words.definition: to improve the quality of something, especially by adding things to it; fertilize
words.translation: 丰富，使富裕；使充实；使肥沃；使富足

examples.en: Add fertilizer to enrich the soil.
examples.zh: 施上肥料使土壤肥沃。

examples.en: Education can greatly enrich your life.
examples.zh: 教育可以大大充实生活。

words.definition: registration, entry
words.translation: 入学人数；登记；入伍

examples.en: Class enrollment, where each student has all of the course schedule selections, each student having his own bucket in the CGTT.
examples.zh: 班级入学，每个学生都有所有的课程安排选择，每个学生都将自己的选择放在 CGTT 中。

words.definition: feeling or showing a lot of interest and excitement about something; intense, warm, crazy, eager, tropical
words.translation: 热情的；热心的；狂热的

examples.en: an enthusiastic supporter of reform
examples.zh: 改革的热心支持者

words.definition: Entrepreneurship is the state of being an entrepreneur, or the activities associated with being an entrepreneur; entrepreneur spirit
words.translation: 企业管理；企业家精神

examples.en: They, like other necessity entrepreneurs, may have resorted to entrepreneurship due to a lack of better options.
examples.zh: 他们像其他生存型企业家一样，因为没有更好的选择才会诉诸于创业。

words.definition: a large number of cases of a disease that happen at the same time; popular, fashionable, going, ruling, pop; infection, infectious disease
words.translation: 流行病；[医]流行的；传染性的；传染病；风尚等的流行

examples.en: Over 500 people died during last year’s flu epidemic.
examples.zh: 去年流感大暴发期间有五百多人死亡。

words.definition: to completely get rid of something such as a disease or a social problem; destroy, root out
words.translation: 根除；根除，根绝；消灭

examples.en: an attempt to eradicate inflation
examples.zh: 为消除通货膨胀所作的努力

examples.en: This problem has now been completely eradicated.
examples.zh: 这个问题现已彻底杜绝。

words.definition: to build something such as a building or wall; construct, fit, fix, structure, frame; straight, upright; to stand on end, get it up
words.translation: 建立；使竖立；建造；安装；竖立的；笔直的；因性刺激而勃起的；直立；勃起

examples.en: an imposing town hall, erected in 1892
examples.zh: 一座气势宏伟的市政厅，建于1892年

examples.en: Police have erected barriers across the main roads into the town.
examples.zh: 警察在进城的主要道路上设立了路障。

words.definition: erroneous ideas or information are wrong and based on facts that are not correct; false, wrong, improper, incorrect, inaccurate
words.translation: 错误的；不正确的

examples.en: His economic predictions are based on some erroneous assumptions.
examples.zh: 他的经济预测是基于错误假设之上的。

words.definition: if fighting, violence, noise etc erupts, it starts suddenly; out break, blow up
words.translation: 喷出, 爆发；爆发；喷出；发疹；长牙

examples.en: Violence erupted after police shot a student during the demonstration.
examples.zh: 警察向示威人群中的一名学生开枪，暴乱随之发生。

examples.en: A political row erupted over the MP’s comments.
examples.zh: 这名下院议员的评论引发了一场政治论战。

words.definition: extremely important and necessary; elementary, fundamental, basic, necessary, primary; element, principle, entity, necessity, requirement, texture
words.translation: 本质的，必须的；基本的；必要的；本质的；精华的；本质；要素；要点；必需品

examples.en: Window locks are fairly cheap and absolutely essential.
examples.zh: 窗锁相当便宜，绝对有必要安装。

examples.en: Even in small companies, computers are an essential tool.
examples.zh: 即使在小公司里，计算机也是不可或缺的工具。

words.definition: to respect and admire someone or something; assess, honor, expect, evaluate, guess; estimation, respect, regard, worship
words.translation: 尊重；尊敬；认为；考虑；估价

examples.en: Peden was greatly esteemed by the people of Ayrshire.
examples.zh: 佩登深受艾尔郡人的尊敬。

examples.en: He was esteemed as a literary wit.
examples.zh: 他被尊为文学才子。

words.definition: relating to a particular race, nation, or tribe and their customs and traditions; racial, tribal
words.translation: 种族的；人种的

examples.en: The school teaches pupils from different ethnic groups.
examples.zh: 该校教授不同种族的小学生。

examples.en: ethnic Russians in Estonia
examples.zh: 居住在爱沙尼亚的俄罗斯人

examples.en: plans to partition the republic along ethnic lines
examples.zh: 按种族分割该共和国的计划

words.definition: the scientific idea that plants and animals develop and change gradually over a long period of time; unfolding, Monkey to Man
words.translation: 演变；进化；发展；[进化]进化论；进展

examples.en: the theory of evolution
examples.zh: 进化论

words.definition: to make something seem better, larger, worse etc than it really is; enlarge, broaden; put it on, pile it on
words.translation: 夸张；使扩大；使增大；夸大

examples.en: I couldn’t sleep for three days – I’m not exaggerating.
examples.zh: 我三天没睡觉了——一点不夸张。

words.definition: to be more than a particular number or amount; better than, overcome, top, cap, outdo
words.translation: 超过；胜过

examples.en: Working hours must not exceed 42 hours a week.
examples.zh: 工作时间每周不得超过42小时。

examples.en: His performance exceeded our expectations.
examples.zh: 他的表现出乎我们的预料。

words.definition: Exceptional situations and incidents are unusual and only likely to happen infrequently; novel, exquisite
words.translation: 例外的；异常的，例外的

examples.en: A review panel concluded that there were no exceptional circumstances that would warrant a lesser penalty for him.
examples.zh: 一个评估小组作出结论：没有什么例外情况可使他获得从轻惩罚。

words.definition: a larger amount of something than is allowed or needed; immoderation, exorbitance; additional, added, attached, extra, plus
words.translation: 过量，过度；超过，超额；过度，过量；无节制；额外的，过量的；附加的

examples.en: After you apply the oil, wait 20 minutes before wiping off any excess.
examples.zh: 涂上油以后，等20分钟再擦掉多余部分。

words.definition: much more than is reasonable or necessary; extreme, ultra, tall
words.translation: 过度的；过多的，极度的；过分的

examples.en: his excessive drinking
examples.zh: 他的酗酒

examples.en: $15 for two beers seems a little excessive.
examples.zh: 两杯啤酒要15美元，似乎有点过分。

words.definition: a group of people who are in charge of an organization and make the rules; administrative, front-office; manager, gerente
words.translation: 执行官；[计]行政的；经营的；执行的，经营管理的；经理；执行委员会；[计]执行者；经理主管人员

examples.en: the union’s executive
examples.zh: 工会的领导层

words.definition: to use your power, influence etc in order to make something happen; handle, to put to use
words.translation: 施加；运用，发挥；施以影响

examples.en: They exerted considerable influence within the school.
examples.zh: 他们在校内施加了很大的影响力。

examples.en: Environmental groups are exerting pressure on the government to tighten pollution laws.
examples.zh: 环境保护组织在向政府施加压力，要求从严执行环保法律法规。

words.definition: something that is exotic seems unusual and interesting because it is related to a foreign country – use this to show approval; outside, extraneous
words.translation: 异域的，外国的；[物]异国的；[语]外来的；异国情调的

examples.en: exotic birds
examples.zh: 外国的奇异鸟类

examples.en: exotic places
examples.zh: 有异国风情的地方

words.definition: when something increases in size, range, amount etc; inflation, exposition
words.translation: 扩大；膨胀；阐述；扩张物

examples.en: The industry underwent a period of rapid expansion.
examples.zh: 该产业经历了一轮快速扩张。

words.definition: what you think or hope will happen; Prospects, looking forward to, be
words.translation: 期望；期待；预期；指望

examples.en: Having raised expectations (= made people more hopeful ), he went on to help only a few people.
examples.zh: 他唤起了大家的希望，但接着只是帮助了几个人。

examples.en: The show exceeded all expectations (= was much better than expected ).
examples.zh: 这场演出比人们预期的要好得多。

examples.en: The number of people who attended fell short of expectations (= was lower than expected ).
examples.zh: 出席的人数比预期的要少。

words.definition: a long and carefully organized journey, especially to a dangerous or unfamiliar place, or the people that make this journey; velocity, speed
words.translation: 探险，远征；远征；探险队；迅速

examples.en: an expedition to the North Pole
examples.zh: 北极探险

examples.en: another Qomolangma expedition
examples.zh: 又一次珠穆朗玛峰探险

words.definition: the action of spending or using time, money, energy etc; spending, payout
words.translation: 费用，花销；[会计]支出，花费；经费，消费额

examples.en: the expenditure of time and money on your house or garden
examples.zh: 你在房子或花园上所花费的时间和金钱

words.definition: Expertise is special skill or knowledge that is acquired by training, study, or practice; special knowledge, professional knowledge
words.translation: 专业知识；专门知识；专门技术；专家的意见

examples.en: She was not an accountant and didn't have the expertise to verify all of the financial details.
examples.zh: 她不是会计，不具有核查所有这些财政细目的专业知识。

words.definition: to continue for a longer period of time, or to make something last longer; afford, allow, deal, deliver, finger; reach, spread, range, enlarge, push
words.translation: 延伸；延期；扩大；推广；伸出；给予；使竭尽全力；对…估价；伸展；使疏开

examples.en: Management have agreed to extend the deadline.
examples.zh: 管理层已同意延长最后期限。

words.definition: degree, boundary, region, length, spectrum, territory, area
words.translation: 程度；范围；[计量]长度

examples.en: Things are not yet carried to that extent.
examples.zh: 事情还没有发展到那种程度。

examples.en: When the smoke blew away, we could see the extent of the damage.
examples.zh: 浓烟消散后， 我们就能看清破坏的程度了。

examples.en: The extent of human cooperation is unique, but not cooperation itself.
examples.zh: 人类的合作程度，而非合作本身，是独一无二的。

words.definition: when a particular type of animal or plant stops existing; evaporation, disappearance
words.translation: 灭绝；消失；消灭；废止

examples.en: species in danger of extinction
examples.zh: 有灭绝危险的物种

examples.en: They were hunted almost to extinction.
examples.zh: 它们遭受猎杀，几近灭绝。

examples.en: Conservationists are trying to save the whale from extinction.
examples.zh: 生态环境保护工作者正努力挽救鲸类以防止其灭绝。

words.definition: very great in degree; ultra, excessive; terminal, bottom
words.translation: 极端的；极度的；偏激的；尽头的；极端；末端；最大程度；极端的事物

examples.en: Extreme poverty still exists in many rural areas.
examples.zh: 许多农村地区仍处于赤贫状态。

examples.en: extreme cold
examples.zh: 严寒

examples.en: He had extreme difficulty getting hold of the ingredients.
examples.zh: 他费了极大的劲找配料。

words.definition: someone who has seen something such as a crime happen, and is able to describe it afterwards; witness
words.translation: 目击者；[法]见证人

examples.en: One eyewitness said he saw her talking to a man in a blue car.
examples.zh: 一名目击者说他看见她在跟一个坐在蓝色汽车里的男子说话。

words.definition: Facilities are buildings, pieces of equipment, or services that are provided for a particular purpose; equipment, furniture, establishment, plant, fixture
words.translation: 设施；设备；容易；灵巧

examples.en: What recreational facilities are now available?
examples.zh: 什么娱乐设施现在是可用的？

words.definition: all the teachers in a university; ability, capacity, competence, department, power
words.translation: 教工，教员；科，系；能力；全体教员

examples.en: Both faculty and students oppose the measures.
examples.zh: 教师和学生都反对这些措施。

words.definition: to lose colour and brightness, or to make something do this; peter, color fading; discolor; stupid, literal-minded
words.translation: 褪色；凋谢；逐渐消失；使褪色；平淡的；乏味的

examples.en: the fading evening light
examples.zh: 渐暗的暮色

examples.en: a pair of faded jeans
examples.zh: 一条褪了色的牛仔裤

examples.en: The sun had faded the curtains.
examples.zh: 太阳把窗帘晒得褪了色。

words.definition: resulting in someone’s death; important, significant, great, fell, kill
words.translation: 致命的；[生物][医]致命的；重大的；毁灭性的；命中注定的

examples.en: potentially fatal diseases
examples.zh: 潜在致命的疾病

examples.en: If it is not treated correctly, the condition can prove fatal (= be fatal ) .
examples.zh: 如果治疗不当，这种病可能会致命。

words.definition: very great tiredness; tiredness, weariness; wear down; tire
words.translation: 疲惫；[生理][心理][力]疲劳，疲乏；杂役；[生理][心理][力]使疲劳；使心智衰弱；[生理][心理][力]疲劳

examples.en: {"COLLOINEXA":["metal fatigue"]}
examples.zh: 金属疲劳

words.definition: agree, love, uphold, make sure, sustain; affection, keen on
words.translation: 偏爱；赞成；喜欢；像；赐予；证实；喜爱；欢心；好感

words.definition: bravely, courageously
words.translation: 无畏地，大胆地；勇敢地；大胆地

examples.en: He used color fearlessly--they were part of his stories, and an integral part of models' makeup, which was often key in completing the worlds McQueen envisioned.
examples.zh: 他大胆地用着用着色彩——这是他的故事的组成部分，也是模特不可分割的组成部分，而这常是麦昆预想的世界的关键组成部分。

words.definition: done with a lot of energy and strong feelings, and sometimes violence; fell, violent, hard
words.translation: 激烈的；凶猛的；猛烈的；暴躁的

examples.en: fierce fighting in the city
examples.zh: 城里的激烈战斗

words.definition: a number representing an amount, especially an official number; digital, price, value, number, rate; occur, cast, offer, come out; indicate, expect, guess, find, feel
words.translation: 数字；[数]数字；人物；图形；价格；（人的）体形；画像；计算；出现；扮演角色；认为；描绘；象征

examples.en: Government figures underestimate the problem.
examples.zh: 政府的数据对这一问题反映不足。

examples.en: It’s about 30,000 in round figures (= to the nearest 10, 20, 100 etc ).
examples.zh: 凑个整数大约是三万。

words.definition: relating to money, taxes, debts etc that are owned and managed by the government; monetary, financial
words.translation: 财政的；会计的，财政的；国库的

examples.en: a fiscal crisis
examples.zh: 财政危机

examples.en: a fiscal matter
examples.zh: 财政事务

words.definition: smooth and level, without raised or hollow areas, and not sloping or curving; a place for people to live that consists of a set of rooms that are part of a larger building; even, low, level, shallow, blank; positively, emphatically; apartment, plane; even
words.translation: 平的；公寓；平坦的；扁平的；浅的；单调的；平直地；断然地；平地；平面；变平

examples.en: houses with flat roofs
examples.zh: 平顶房

examples.en: a perfectly flat sandy beach
examples.zh: 十分平坦的沙滩

examples.en: The countryside near there is flat as a pancake (= very flat ) .
examples.zh: 那儿附近的乡间地势非常平坦。

words.definition: sapor, palatability
words.translation: 口味；情味，风味；香料；滋味

examples.en: When things had flavor , we knew what we were eating all the while ----and it satisfied us .
examples.zh: 当食物有滋味的时候，我们从头到尾都知道自己吃的是什么，从中得到满足。

examples.en: I know that they have yet to taste anything but when food is described in the right way it creates an imaginary flavor in your mouth.
examples.zh: 我知道他们还没有尝过任何东西，但是，当人们用正确的方法描述食物的时候，会在口中长生一种想象的味道。

examples.en: That flavor comes from the sound.
examples.zh: 那种味道来自说的声音。

words.definition: a mistake, mark, or weakness that makes something imperfect; checking, defect, deficiency, vice, fault; crack, fracture
words.translation: 缺点，瑕疵；瑕疵，裂纹；缺点；一阵狂风；使无效；使破裂，使有缺陷

examples.en: A design flaw (= a mistake or weakness in the way something was made ) caused the engine to explode.
examples.zh: 一个设计缺陷导致了引擎爆炸。

words.definition: to leave somewhere very quickly, in order to escape from danger; lift, disappear, blank; escape, desert
words.translation: 离开；逃走；消失，消散；逃跑，逃走；逃避

examples.en: His attackers turned and fled.
examples.zh: 袭击他的人转身逃走了。

examples.en: Masaari spent six months in prison before fleeing the country .
examples.zh: 正有蹲了六个月监狱，然后逃出了该国。

words.definition: a person, plan etc that is flexible can change or be changed easily to suit any new situation; elastic, pliable
words.translation: 灵活的；[力]柔韧的；易弯曲的

examples.en: We can be flexible about your starting date.
examples.zh: 你具体从哪天开始，我们可以灵活一点。

examples.en: The government needs a more flexible approach to education.
examples.zh: 政府在处理教育问题上需要更加灵活。

words.definition: if something floats, it moves slowly through the air or stays up in the air; execute, to put into practice; fan, swing; drift, caroche
words.translation: 漂浮；使漂浮；实行；浮动；飘动，散播；摇摆；付诸实施；彩车，花车；漂流物；浮舟；浮萍

examples.en: I looked up at the clouds floating in the sky.
examples.zh: 我仰望着天上的浮云。

examples.en: Leaves floated gently down from the trees.
examples.zh: 叶子从树上轻轻飘落。

words.definition: a note at the bottom of the page in a book, which gives more information about something; additional remarks
words.translation: 注脚；脚注；补充说明

examples.en: A footnote is made at the bottom of the page.
examples.zh: 注脚列在书页下端。

examples.en: I noticed that the author of our textbook frequently referred by footnote to these library books.
examples.zh: 我还注意到，从图书馆借来的这些书，恰是课本的著者经常在脚注中提到的。

examples.en: Today, my foremost concern should be to research the folklore of my home country so that I can finish the footnote to my report.
examples.zh: 今天，我最主要关心的应该是研究祖国的民间传说，那样我就可以完成我的报告的脚注了。

words.definition: a description of what is likely to happen in the future, based on the information that you have now; predict, indicate, calculate, shadow; prediction, divination
words.translation: 预报，预测；[气象][通信]预报，预测；预示；预测，[气象][通信]预报；预想

examples.en: The weather forecast is good for tomorrow.
examples.zh: 天气预报说明天是晴天。

words.definition: the way in which something such as a television show or meeting is organized or arranged
words.translation: 形式

examples.en: The courses were run to a consistent format.
examples.zh: 这些课程的编排是有连续性的。

words.definition: very powerful or impressive, and often frightening; powerful, terrible, august, horrible
words.translation: 可怕的；令人敬畏的，令人惊叹的；强大的；令人敬畏的；艰难的

examples.en: The building is grey, formidable, not at all picturesque.
examples.zh: 那幢建筑呈灰色，气势凛然，与漂亮沾不上边。

examples.en: The new range of computers have formidable processing power.
examples.zh: 该系列的新型计算机处理能力惊人。

words.definition: to help a skill, feeling, idea etc develop over a period of time; cultivate, rear, raise, plant, mother
words.translation: 促进；培养；养育，抚育；抱（希望等）

examples.en: The bishop helped foster the sense of a community embracing all classes.
examples.zh: 主教鼓励一种包容各个阶层的社区精神。

words.definition: an organization that gives or collects money to be used for special purposes, especially for  charity  or for medical  research; elements, basis, bed, seed, radical
words.translation: 基金会；基础；[建]地基；根据；创立

examples.en: the British Heart Foundation
examples.zh: 英国心脏病基金会

words.definition: used to show that you are saying what you really think about something; sincerely, truly, simply, honestly, genuinely
words.translation: 坦率地；真诚地，坦白地

examples.en: Frankly, I think the Internet is overrated.
examples.zh: 坦率地说，我认为因特网被高估了。

examples.en: His behaviour was frankly disgraceful.
examples.zh: 他的行为老实说是可耻的。

words.definition: extremely worried and frightened about a situation, so that you cannot control your feelings; crazy, possessed, mad
words.translation: 疯狂的；狂乱的，疯狂的

examples.en: A bird had been locked in and was by now quite frantic.
examples.zh: 一只鸟被关了起来，到现在它都非常狂躁。

words.definition: adding to or replacing something; new, raw; beginning, threshold, opening, conception, start; hardly, just
words.translation: 新颖的，新奇的；新鲜的；清新的；[水文]淡水的；无经验的；开始；新生；泛滥；刚刚，才；最新地

examples.en: I’ll just make some fresh coffee.
examples.zh: 我来重新煮点咖啡。

examples.en: The report provides fresh evidence about the way the business was run.
examples.zh: 报告提供了有关该公司运营方式的新证据。

examples.en: You’ll have to start again on a fresh sheet of paper.
examples.zh: 你得拿张新的纸重新开始。

words.definition: to make someone feel afraid; be nervous of, be fearful of
words.translation: 使害怕；害怕，惊恐

examples.en: Don’t stand so near the edge! You’re frightening me.
examples.zh: 别站得那么靠边！你要把我吓坏了。

examples.en: She was frightened by the anger in his eyes.
examples.zh: 她被他眼中的怒火吓住了。

examples.en: Computers used to frighten me, but not now.
examples.zh: 电脑过去让我感到害怕，但现在不了。

words.definition: the border of a country; boundary, border; borderline
words.translation: 边境；前沿；[数]边界；国境；[数]边界的；开拓的

examples.en: a novel about a family’s struggle on the American frontier
examples.zh: 描写一家人在美国边远地区奋斗的小说

words.definition: if something frustrates you, it makes you feel annoyed or angry because you are unable to do what you want; defeat, discomfit; founder, come to naught; thwarted, unprofitable
words.translation: 使挫败，使沮丧；挫败；阻挠；使感到灰心；失败；受挫；挫败的；无益的

examples.en: The fact that he’s working with amateurs really frustrates him.
examples.zh: 与生手共事着实让他沮丧。

words.definition: accomplish, carry out, come true, implement, meet
words.translation: 实现；履行；满足；使结束（等于fulfil）

examples.en: And that is why we can fulfill our destiny.
examples.zh: 这就是为什么我们能实现我们的命运。

examples.en: What important dream have you yet to realize and fulfill?
examples.zh: 你有什么重要的梦想还没有实现和完成？

words.definition: done with a lot of energy, effort, or speed; acute, stinging
words.translation: 生气的；激烈的；狂怒的；热烈兴奋的；喧闹的

examples.en: Neil set off at a furious pace .
examples.zh: 尼尔狂奔起来。

examples.en: The action is fast and furious .
examples.zh: 行动很迅猛。

words.definition: anxious behaviour or activity that is usually about unimportant things; make a big deal out of, break a butterfly on the wheel; alarmism, hoo-ha; trouble, irk
words.translation: 小题大做；小题大作；忙乱；焦燥；焦急；无事自扰；大惊小怪，大惊小怪的人；使烦恼，使烦忧

examples.en: James said he’d better be getting back or there’d be a fuss .
examples.zh: 詹姆斯说他最好回来，否则就会有人小题大做了。

examples.en: The Steamatic enables you to clean any carpet with the minimum of fuss .
examples.zh: 蒸汽清洁器可以让你轻轻松松地清洁地毯。

words.definition: a large building where people can see famous pieces of art; hall, passage, corridor, underground, subway
words.translation: 美术馆；画廊；走廊；旁听席；地道

examples.en: an exhibition of African art at the Hayward Gallery
examples.zh: 海沃德美术馆的非洲艺术展览

words.definition: a big difference between two situations, amounts, groups of people etc; separation, blank; seam, spring off; jag
words.translation: 差距；间隙；缺口；空白；裂开；使成缺口

examples.en: ...the gap between rich and poor.
examples.zh: …贫富差距。

words.definition: a building for keeping a car in, usually next to or attached to a house; carbarn, carport
words.translation: 车库；[车辆]车库；汽车修理厂；飞机库

examples.en: I’ll just go and put the car in the garage.
examples.zh: 我把车停到车库去。

examples.en: an automatic garage door
examples.zh: 车库自动门

words.definition: the fact of being male or female; sexuality, sexual intercourse
words.translation: 性别；性；性交

examples.en: people of the same gender
examples.zh: 同性别的人

examples.en: Discrimination on grounds of race or gender is forbidden.
examples.zh: 严禁种族歧视和性别歧视。

examples.en: There may be gender differences in attitudes to paid work.
examples.zh: 对待有偿劳动的态度可能存在着性别差异。

words.definition: to produce or cause something; go on, call into being
words.translation: 产生；使形成；发生；[生物]生殖

examples.en: a useful technique for generating new ideas
examples.zh: 能产生新创意的有用技术

examples.en: The program would generate a lot of new jobs.
examples.zh: 这个项目将创造许多新的就业岗位。

words.definition: someone who is generous is willing to give money, spend time etc, in order to help people or give them pleasure; handsome, liberal
words.translation: 慷慨的；慷慨的，大方的；宽宏大量的；有雅量的

examples.en: Dietler is generous with his time and money.
examples.zh: 迪特勒在他的时间和金钱方面慷慨大方。

words.definition: relating to genes or genetics; inherited, hereditary
words.translation: 基因的；遗传的；起源的

examples.en: genetic defects
examples.zh: 遗传性缺陷

examples.en: each person’s genetic make-up
examples.zh: 每个人的遗传特征

examples.en: genetic research
examples.zh: 基因研究

words.definition: a very high level of intelligence, mental skill, or ability, which only a few people have; energy, gift, spirit, soul, mind
words.translation: 天才；天才，天赋；精神

examples.en: The film reveals Fellini’s genius.
examples.zh: 这部影片展现了费里尼的天赋。

examples.en: a work of pure genius
examples.zh: 天才之作

words.definition: a genuine feeling, desire etc is one that you really feel, not one you pretend to feel; actual, sincere, true, real, positive
words.translation: 真的；由衷的；真实的，真正的；诚恳的

examples.en: ‘Did he really?’ Her surprise seemed genuine.
examples.zh: “他真的这样？”她好像是真的惊讶。

words.definition: the study of the rocks, soil etc that make up the Earth, and of the way they have changed since the Earth was formed; geologic map, geognosy
words.translation: 地质学；[地质]地质学；地质情况

examples.en: He was visiting professor of geology at the University of Georgia.
examples.zh: 他曾是佐治亚大学的地质学客座教授。

words.definition: a movement of part of your body, especially your hands or head, to show what you mean or how you feel; motion, sign, stance
words.translation: 姿势，手势；姿态；手势

examples.en: Luke made an obscene gesture with his finger.
examples.zh: 卢克用手指做了一个下流的手势。

words.definition: attractive, exciting, and related to wealth and success; killing, taking, engaging, charming, fascinating
words.translation: 有魅力的，迷人的；迷人的，富有魅力的

examples.en: She led an exciting and glamorous life.
examples.zh: 她生活奢华，充满刺激。

examples.en: the most glamorous neighborhood in the city
examples.zh: 城里最繁华的街区

examples.en: On television, she looks so glamorous.
examples.zh: 她在电视里看上去光彩照人。

words.definition: the importance, honour, and praise that people give someone they admire a lot; honor, accolade; full of oneself, pride
words.translation: 光荣，荣誉；赞颂；自豪，骄傲；狂喜

examples.en: She dreamt of future glory as an Olympic champion.
examples.zh: 她梦想着将来能得到奥运冠军的荣誉。

examples.en: Goran’s moment of glory came when he defeated Rafter.
examples.zh: 戈兰击败拉夫特，迎来了荣耀的一刻。

examples.en: He began the season in a blaze of glory , scoring seven goals in as many games.
examples.zh: 这个赛季一开始他便光芒四射，七场比赛进了七个球。

words.definition: to officially and legally control a country and make all the decisions about taxes, laws, public services etc; manage, possess, conduct, run, regulate
words.translation: 管理；支配；统治；控制

examples.en: the leaders who govern the country
examples.zh: 治理这个国家的领导人

examples.en: The party had been governing for seven months.
examples.zh: 该党执政已经有七个月了。

words.definition: big and very impressive; magnificent, noble; gee
words.translation: 壮丽的，极好的；宏伟的；豪华的；极重要的；大钢琴；一千美元

examples.en: a grand country house
examples.zh: 豪华的乡间大宅

examples.en: The party was a grand affair.
examples.zh: 这个聚会场面隆重。

examples.en: New Yorkers build on a grand scale.
examples.zh: 纽约人喜欢建高楼大厦。

words.definition: to completely understand a fact or an idea, especially a complicated one; control, understanding, comprehension, guiding, hold; see, appreciate, noble, collar; strike, scratch
words.translation: 抓住，理解；抓住；理解；控制；领会；抓

examples.en: At that time, we did not fully grasp the significance of what had happened.
examples.zh: 当时，我们没有完全明白所发生之事的重要性。

examples.en: Some people find the idea of relativity difficult to grasp.
examples.zh: 有些人觉得相对论的概念很难理解。

words.definition: the feeling of being grateful
words.translation: 感激

examples.en: Tears of gratitude filled her eyes.
examples.zh: 她眼里充满感激的泪水。

words.definition: food and other goods that are sold by a grocer or a supermarket
words.translation: 杂货店

examples.en: They run a small grocery store.
examples.zh: 他们经营一家小食品杂货店。

words.definition: to promise that you will pay back money that someone else has borrowed, if they do not pay it back themselves; assurance, certification, commitment, warranty, pledge; assure, undertake, swear for
words.translation: 保证；[金融]保证；[法]担保；保证人；保证书；[经]抵押品

examples.en: The bank will only lend me money if my parents guarantee the loan.
examples.zh: 只有我父母作担保，银行才会给我贷款。

words.definition: to protect a person, place, or object by staying near them and watching them; vigilance, alertness; keep one's eye on the ball, keep one's eyes peeled; watching, shield
words.translation: 保护；守卫；警戒；护卫队；[安全]防护装置；警惕；保卫；监视

examples.en: The Sergeant told Swift to guard the entrance.
examples.zh: 中士叫斯威夫特守着入口。

examples.en: a lioness guarding her cubs
examples.zh: 守护着幼狮的母狮

words.definition: an attempt to judge a quantity by guessing it; estimate, gauge
words.translation: 大概估计，瞎猜估计；瞎猜；估计

examples.en: Could you give us a guesstimate of the numbers involved?
examples.zh: 你能给我们大致估计一下相关数字吗？

words.definition: doing something from habit, and unable to stop doing it; used, frequent, confirmed
words.translation: 习惯的；惯常的；习以为常的

examples.en: James took his habitual morning walk around the garden.
examples.zh: 詹姆斯又像往常习惯的那样绕花园作晨间散步去了。

words.definition: a small gun that you hold in one hand when you fire it; betsy, pistol
words.translation: 手枪

examples.en: Stumbling through the smoke, the pilot emerged from the forward compartment, fumbled for the handgun at his belt.
examples.zh: 烟雾间出现了飞行员跌跌撞撞的身影，他的手笨拙地摸索着腰带上的手枪。

examples.en: Police recovered an illegal handgun from the car, initially raising questions about whether Mr. Duggan had fired on one of the officers.
examples.zh: 警方从那辆出租车里找回一支非法手枪，曾一开始令外界怀疑杜干是否曾向一名警察开枪。

examples.en: One of the criminals immediately shoved a .38 caliber handgun to my head, ordered me to the cooler, pushed me down on the floor, and pumped a bullet into the back of my head - execution style.
examples.zh: 其中一个匪徒迅速掏出一把口径为38毫米的手枪用力指著我的头，勒令我走到冷冻机旁，然后把我推倒在地，像执行死刑般从后面朝我头部开了一枪。

words.definition: the part of a door that you use for opening it; shank, grip; operate, feel, exert, work, cope with
words.translation: 把手；[建]把手；柄；手感；口实；处理；操作；运用；买卖；触摸

examples.en: Then he turned the handle and went in.
examples.zh: 然后他转动把手走了进去。

words.definition: something that makes your life difficult or unpleasant, especially a lack of money, or the condition of having a difficult life; affliction, bitterness
words.translation: 艰难；困苦；苦难；艰难险阻

examples.en: an economic policy that caused great hardship for many people
examples.zh: 造成许多人贫困的经济政策

examples.en: Many students are suffering severe financial hardship.
examples.zh: 许多学生经济非常困难。

words.definition: harsh conditions are difficult to live in and very uncomfortable; severe, grinding, crude, tight, hard
words.translation: 严酷的，严峻的；严厉的；严酷的；[声]刺耳的；粗糙的；刺目的

examples.en: The hostages are being held in harsh conditions.
examples.zh: 人质被拘押在恶劣环境中。

examples.en: a young girl suddenly exposed to the harsh realities of life
examples.zh: 骤然暴露于残酷现实生活中的小女孩

words.definition: if an egg hatches, or if it is hatched, it breaks, letting the young bird, insect etc come out; incubation; engineer, scheme; incubate
words.translation: 孵化；[船][航]舱口；[动]孵；策划

examples.en: The eggs take three days to hatch.
examples.zh: 这些蛋要三天时间才能孵化。

words.definition: something that may be dangerous, or cause accidents or problems; risk; risk, throw, venture, adventure
words.translation: 危险；赌运气；冒…的危险，使遭受危险；[安全]危险，冒险；冒险的事

examples.en: That pile of rubbish is a fire hazard (= something that is likely to cause a fire ).
examples.zh: 那堆垃圾是火灾隐患。

words.definition: vacillate, stand at; stand at, hang back
words.translation: 犹豫；踌躇，犹豫；不愿；有疑虑，不愿意

examples.en: So if someone asks you out, never hesitate.
examples.zh: 如果有人叫你出去玩，千万别犹豫！

examples.en: I hesitate.
examples.zh: 我犹豫。

examples.en: I hesitate in this work.
examples.zh: 我在这个作品中有所犹豫。

words.definition: to make it difficult for something to develop or succeed; slow, impede; latter, back, rear
words.translation: 阻碍；打扰；后面的

examples.en: His career has been hindered by injury.
examples.zh: 由于受伤，他的事业受到了阻碍。

examples.en: policies that will hinder rather than help families
examples.zh: 对家庭有害无益的政策

words.definition: friendly behaviour towards visitors; complaisance, gallantry
words.translation: 友好；好客；殷勤

examples.en: Thanks for your hospitality over the past few weeks.
examples.zh: 感谢你几周来的热情款待。

words.definition: to provide the place and everything that is needed for an organized event; lots of, sea, hundred, master, thousands of; to chair, preside over; pack, troop
words.translation: 主持；[计]主机；主人；主持人；许多；当主人招待；群集；做主人

examples.en: Which country is going to host the next World Cup?
examples.zh: 哪个国家将主办下一届世界杯？

words.definition: angry and deliberately unfriendly towards someone, and ready to argue with them; adverse, enemy, opposed; opposition, antagonism
words.translation: 有敌意的；敌对的，敌方的；怀敌意的；敌对

examples.en: Southampton fans gave their former coach a hostile reception .
examples.zh: 南安普敦队的球迷对球队的前任教练很不友善。

examples.en: Carr wouldn’t meet Feng’s stare, which was openly hostile .
examples.zh: 卡尔不愿意面对冯公然敌视的目光。

examples.en: his hostile attitude
examples.zh: 他敌对的态度

words.definition: all the people who live together in one house; domestic, family, daily, everyday, routine; family, race
words.translation: 家庭，一家人；家庭的；日常的；王室的；家庭；一家人

examples.en: A growing number of households have at least one computer.
examples.zh: 越来越多的家庭拥有至少一台电脑。

examples.en: Families are classified by the occupation of the head of the household (= the person who earns the most money and is most respected in a house ) .
examples.zh: 家庭按一家之主的职业来分类。

words.definition: A humanistic idea, condition, or practice relates to humanism
words.translation: 人文的

examples.en: Religious values can often differ greatly from humanistic morals.
examples.zh: 宗教价值观常常和人文主义道德观相去甚远。

words.definition: funny and enjoyable; funny, witty
words.translation: 幽默的；诙谐的，幽默的；滑稽的，可笑的

examples.en: humorous stories
examples.zh: 诙谐的故事

examples.en: The film has some mildly humorous moments.
examples.zh: 那部电影中有些略显幽默的片段。

words.definition: an idea that is suggested as an explanation for something, but that has not yet been proved to be true; tentative
words.translation: 假设，假说；假设

examples.en: One hypothesis is that the victim fell asleep while driving.
examples.zh: 一种假设是受害人开车时睡着了。

words.definition: to recognize and correctly name someone or something; confirm, recognize, ascertain; cotton, square
words.translation: 认出，识别；确定；[计]识别；使参与；把…看成一样；认同；一致

examples.en: He was too far away to be able to identify faces.
examples.zh: 他离得太远，没法看面孔认出谁是谁。

examples.en: The police took fingerprints and identified the body.
examples.zh: 警方采集了指纹，对尸体作了身份确认。

words.definition: inwardly
words.translation: 意识形态上地；思想上；意识形态上

words.definition: a set of beliefs on which a political or economic system is based, or which strongly influence the way people behave
words.translation: 意识形态

examples.en: the ideologies of fascism and terrorism
examples.zh: 法西斯主义和恐怖主义的意识形态

examples.en: a new ideology based on individualism
examples.zh: 基于个人主义的新思想体系

words.definition: to behave as if you had not heard or seen someone or something; neglect, pass sb by
words.translation: 忽视；驳回诉讼；不理睬

examples.en: The phone rang, but she ignored it.
examples.zh: 电话铃响了，但她只当没听见。

examples.en: Sam rudely ignored the question.
examples.zh: 萨姆粗鲁地对这个问题不予理睬。

words.definition: a lack of a fair or correct balance between two things, which results in problems or unfairness; instability, disbalance
words.translation: 不平衡；[医]不平衡；不安定

examples.en: a hormonal imbalance
examples.zh: 内分泌失调

words.definition: extremely large; huge, tremendous, enormous, massive, macro
words.translation: 巨大的；巨大的，广大的；无边无际的；非常好的

examples.en: People who travel by rail still read an immense amount.
examples.zh: 人们坐火车旅行时仍然会读很多书。

examples.en: Regular visits from a social worker can be of immense value to old people living alone.
examples.zh: 对于独居老人来说社工的经常探望很重要。

words.definition: very much; extensively, vastly
words.translation: 非常，极大地；极大地；无限地；广大地；庞大地

examples.en: Champagne wines became immensely popular in the 18th century.
examples.zh: 香槟酒在18世纪十分流行。

examples.en: We enjoyed the play immensely.
examples.zh: 我们很喜欢这出戏。

words.definition: someone who enters another country to live there permanently; emigratory; migration, transplantation
words.translation: 移民；移民的；迁入的；移民，侨民

examples.en: an illegal immigrant
examples.zh: 非法移民

examples.en: a new wave of immigrants from the Middle East
examples.zh: 来自中东的一股新兴的移民浪潮

words.definition: an event that is imminent, especially an unpleasant one, will happen very soon; upcoming, forthcoming
words.translation: 即将来临的；迫近的

examples.en: A new trade agreement is imminent.
examples.zh: 一项新的贸易协定即将签署。

words.definition: the effect or influence that an event, situation etc has on someone or something; affect, influence, reach, work on, strike; charge at; effect, impression, influence, infection, affection
words.translation: 影响；[力]撞击；冲突；压紧；[力]冲击；产生影响；效果；[物]碰撞；[力]冲击力

examples.en: They say they expect the meeting to have a marked impact on the future of the country.
examples.zh: 他们说期望这次会议对国家的未来产生显著的影响。

words.definition: to force someone to have the same ideas, beliefs etc as you; do with, trade on; force, levy tax
words.translation: 强加于；利用；欺骗；施加影响；强加；征税；以…欺骗

examples.en: Parents should beware of imposing their own tastes on their children.
examples.zh: 父母应该提防把自己的兴趣强加给孩子。

words.definition: to put someone in prison or to keep them somewhere and prevent them from leaving; prison, jail
words.translation: 监禁；[法]关押；使…下狱

examples.en: The government imprisoned all opposition leaders.
examples.zh: 政府把反对派领导人全部监禁起来。

examples.en: She was imprisoned within his strong arms.
examples.zh: 她被他强壮的手臂搂着。

words.definition: not good enough, big enough, skilled enough etc for a particular purpose; deficient, unhappy, wrong, inappropriate, improper
words.translation: 不足的；不充分的，不适当的

examples.en: inadequate resources
examples.zh: 资源缺乏

examples.en: The new air conditioning system proved inadequate.
examples.zh: 新的空调系统不够好。

words.definition: something that encourages you to work harder, start a new activity etc; motivation, stimulus, reason, excitement, needle; stimulative, hortatory
words.translation: 刺激；动机；激励的；刺激的

examples.en: As an added incentive, there’s a bottle of champagne for the best team.
examples.zh: 给最优秀的队发一瓶香槟作为额外的鼓励。

words.definition: the number of times something happens, especially crime, disease etc; infection, impression, effect, influence, affection
words.translation: 发生率；影响；[光]入射；影响范围

examples.en: The incidence of breast cancer increases with age.
examples.zh: 乳腺癌的发病率随着年龄的增长而上升。

words.definition: If you refer to someone's incompetence, you are criticizing them because they are unable to do their job or a task properly; disability, inability
words.translation: 无能；无资格，不胜任；无能力；不适当；不熟练

examples.en: The incompetence of government officials is appalling.
examples.zh: 政府官员的无能令人吃惊。

words.definition: a standard by which the level of something can be judged or measured; finger, indicatrix; to point out, to indicate
words.translation: 指数；指标；[图情]索引；指针；指出；编入索引中

examples.en: ...the consumer price index.
examples.zh: …消费价格指数。

words.definition: to show that a particular situation exists, or that something is likely to be true; forecast, index, image, shadow, figure
words.translation: 表明；指出；预示；象征

examples.en: The study indicates a connection between poverty and crime.
examples.zh: 研究显示贫穷和犯罪有关联。

words.definition: to be a clear sign that a particular situation exists or that something is likely to be true; symbolic, emblematic
words.translation: 指示的；象征的；表示…的

examples.en: This behaviour is indicative of her whole attitude, I’m afraid.
examples.zh: 这一行为恐怕已表明了她的总体态度。

words.definition: If you accuse someone of being indifferent to something, you mean that they have a complete lack of interest in it; neutral, insignificant
words.translation: 冷漠的；漠不关心的；无关紧要的；中性的，中立的

examples.en: People have become indifferent to the suffering of others.
examples.zh: 人们已经变得对别人的痛苦漠不关心。

words.definition: randomly, wilfully
words.translation: 不加选择地，不加区分地；不加选择地；任意地

examples.en: Thatis, should you agree to share your private information with other people moreor less indiscriminately?
examples.zh: 就是说，你应该同意把你的私人信息或多或少地不加选择地分享给其他人么？

examples.en: SSL indiscriminately encrypts all data with the same key strength, which can be unnecessary or even undesirable for some applications.
examples.zh: SSL 不加选择地用同一密钥强度加密所有数据，对某些应用程序而言，这是不必要甚至是不合要求的。

words.definition: someone or something that is indispensable is so important or useful that it is impossible to manage without them; obbligato
words.translation: 必不可少的；不可缺少的；绝对必要的；责无旁贷的

examples.en: Mobile phones have become an indispensable part of our lives.
examples.zh: 移动电话已经成为我们生活中的必需品。

words.definition: to let someone have or do whatever they want, even if it is bad for them; meet, fulfill, fill, please, baby; luxuriate, to satisfy
words.translation: 放纵；满足；纵容；使高兴；使沉迷于…；沉溺；放任

examples.en: His mother spoiled him, indulging his every whim.
examples.zh: 他母亲对他纵容娇惯，百依百顺。

words.definition: someone who is industrious works hard; diligent, hard-working
words.translation: 勤奋的；勤勉的

examples.en: She was an industrious and willing worker.
examples.zh: 她是个勤劳肯干的工人。

words.definition: something that is ineffective does not achieve what it is intended to achieve; useless, invalid
words.translation: 无效的；无效的，失效的；不起作用的

examples.en: an ineffective marketing campaign
examples.zh: 一场毫无成效的营销活动

words.definition: certain to happen and impossible to avoid; certain, necessary, automatic
words.translation: 不可避免的；必然的，不可避免的

examples.en: A further escalation of the crisis now seems inevitable.
examples.zh: 危机的进一步升级现在看来已不可避免。

words.definition: something that is inexhaustible exists in such large amounts that it can never be finished or used up; unexhaustible, exhaustless
words.translation: 用不完的，无穷无尽的；用不完的；不知疲倦的

examples.en: She has an inexhaustible supply of funny stories.
examples.zh: 她有讲不完的有趣故事。

examples.en: a man of inexhaustible energy
examples.zh: 精力无穷的人

words.definition: a baby or very young child; baby, minor; earlier, young, baby, minor, tender
words.translation: 婴儿；幼儿；未成年人；婴儿的；幼稚的；初期的；未成年的

examples.en: An infant’s skin is very sensitive.
examples.zh: 幼儿的皮肤非常敏感。

words.definition: to give someone a disease; affect, contract, catch, disease, communicate
words.translation: 感染；[医]感染，传染

examples.en: People with the virus may feel perfectly well, but they can still infect others.
examples.zh: 带有这种病毒的人可能毫无症状，却仍可能传染他人。

words.definition: a continuing increase in prices, or the rate at which prices increase; expansion, bulking
words.translation: 通货膨胀；膨胀；[金融]通货膨胀；夸张；自命不凡

examples.en: Inflation is now at over 16%.
examples.zh: 通货膨胀率现已超过16%。

words.definition: having a lot of influence and therefore changing the way people think and behave; mighty, predominant
words.translation: 有影响力的；有影响的；有势力的

examples.en: He had influential friends.
examples.zh: 他有一些有影响力的朋友。

examples.en: a highly influential art magazine
examples.zh: 一本极有影响力的艺术杂志

words.definition: to breathe in air, smoke, or gas; inbreathe, to breathe in; air intake, to breathe in
words.translation: 吸入；猛吃猛喝；吸气

examples.en: It is dangerous to inhale ammonia fumes.
examples.zh: 吸入氨气是很危险的。

examples.en: Myra lit another cigarette and inhaled deeply  (= breathed in a lot of smoke ).
examples.zh: 迈拉又点上一支烟，深深地吸了一口。

words.definition: to receive money, property etc from someone after they have died; succeed to, take sth over
words.translation: 继承；遗传而得

examples.en: inherited wealth
examples.zh: 继承的财富

words.definition: the ability to make decisions and take action without waiting for someone to tell you what to do; pioneering spirit; autonomous, active, spontaneous
words.translation: 主动性；主动权；首创精神；主动的；自发的；起始的

examples.en: I wish my son would show more initiative.
examples.zh: 我希望我的儿子能表现得再主动一些。

examples.en: Don’t keep asking me for advice. Use your initiative.
examples.zh: 别老是要我给你出主意，发挥一下你自己的决断能力吧。

examples.en: Lt. Carlos was not obeying orders. He acted on his own initiative (= he was not told what to do ).
examples.zh: 卡洛斯中尉没有服从命令，而是自作主张。

words.definition: a situation in which people are treated very unfairly and not given their rights; wrong, iniquity
words.translation: 不公正；[法]不公正；不讲道义

examples.en: The movie deals with injustices suffered by Native Americans.
examples.zh: 这部电影讲述印第安人受到的不公正待遇。

examples.en: He had developed a deep sense of social injustice.
examples.zh: 他深深感到社会的不公。

words.definition: a new idea, method, or invention; reformation, renovation, renewal
words.translation: 创新，革新；新方法

examples.en: We must encourage innovation if the company is to remain competitive.
examples.zh: 公司要想保持竞争力，就必须鼓励革新。

words.definition: to encourage someone by making them feel confident and eager to do something; stimulate, lift, wake, spirit, effect
words.translation: 鼓励；激发；鼓舞；启示；产生；使生灵感

examples.en: We need someone who can inspire the team.
examples.zh: 我们需要一个能鼓舞团队士气的人。

examples.en: Inspired by the sunny weather, I decided to explore the woods.
examples.zh: 阳光明媚的天气令人振奋，我决定到森林里寻幽探胜。

words.definition: happening or produced immediately; immediate, urgent, emergency, hot, pressing; moment, breath, second
words.translation: 立即的；紧急的；紧迫的；瞬间；立即；片刻

examples.en: an instant success
examples.zh: 马到成功

examples.en: a system that provides instant access to client information
examples.zh: 能立即查到客户信息的系统

examples.en: The women took an instant dislike to one another.
examples.zh: 这些女人立刻就彼此厌恶起来。

words.translation: 本能地

examples.en: What do we instinctively do?
examples.zh: 出于本能，我们会怎么做？

examples.en: He thought how like her expression was then, to what it had been when she looked round at the Doctor - that night - and instinctively dropped her hand and turned away.
examples.zh: 他想，她现在的表情跟她那天夜里环视四周，最后望着医生时的表情是多么相像啊，于是他就本能地放下她的手，走开了。

examples.en: We answer this question instinctively and quite quickly because we have some intuitive sense of the whole experience.
examples.zh: 我们本能而迅捷地回答这个问题，因为对于整个经历，我们有一些直觉的感受。

words.definition: a large organization that has a particular kind of work or purpose; system, convention
words.translation: 机构；[管理]制度；建立；（社会或宗教等）公共机构；习俗

examples.en: powerful institutions such as world banks
examples.zh: 诸如世界银行之类的强大机构

examples.en: the Institution of Electrical Engineers
examples.zh: 电机工程师学会

words.definition: not enough, or not great enough; short, deficient, lacking, wanting; shortage, short of, lack, scarcity
words.translation: 不足的；不足的，不充足的；不足

examples.en: Insufficient resources have been devoted to the health service.
examples.zh: 用于医疗保健服务的资源不足。

words.definition: the quality of being honest and strong about what you believe to be right; truth, honesty, full, righteousness, completeness
words.translation: 正直；[数]完整；诚实；廉正

examples.en: I have always regarded him as a man of integrity.
examples.zh: 我一直把他当作一个正直诚实的人。

words.definition: an intelligent person has a high level of mental ability and is good at understanding ideas and thinking clearly; wise, bright, clever, smart, understanding
words.translation: 聪明的；智能的；理解力强的

examples.en: a group of highly intelligent (= very intelligent )students
examples.zh: 一组聪明异常的学生

examples.en: Sontag was once famously described as the most intelligent woman in America.
examples.zh: 桑塔格曾被称为美国最聪明的女人，这是众人皆知的事。

words.definition: warmly, consumingly
words.translation: 强烈地；紧张地；热情地

examples.en: I do not feel it intensely in my genitals alone, but I do feel it there as well as the rest of my body and…in my mouth…”.
examples.zh: 使用男性阳具我都没有这种强烈的感觉，但是在那里及身体的其他部位..还有嘴巴..我却感觉到了。

examples.en: By 2011 debris in the center of the ring, which is about a light-year in diameter, was blazing more intensely as the supernova entered a new stage of stellar demise.
examples.zh: 到2011年为止，因为这个超新星进入了星球消亡的新阶段，所以这环物质中心直径大约是一光年的碎片燃烧的更加强烈了。

words.definition: if people interact with each other, they talk to each other, work together etc; entr'acte
words.translation: 互动；幕间剧；幕间休息

examples.en: While the other children interacted and played together, Ted ignored them.
examples.zh: 当其他孩子们相互交往、一起玩耍时，泰德却不理他们。

words.definition: a process by which two or more things affect each other; reciprocity, mutual effect
words.translation: 互动；[数][物]相互作用；交互作用

examples.en: But you only get the maximum benefit if you implement all of them, because their power comes from their interaction.
examples.zh: 但您只能在实现所有方法的情况下获得最大收益，因为它们的力量来自它们之间的交互。

examples.en: But you only get the maximum benefit if you implement all of them, because their power comes from their interaction.
examples.zh: 但您只有在实现所有方法的情况下才能获得最多的收益，因为它们的力量来自于它们之间的相互作用。

examples.en: The real power of the concept comes not from any one of these devices; it emerges from the interaction of all of them.
examples.zh: 这个概念的很正力量并不来自于这些设备的任何一个；它来自于这些设备之间的交互。

words.definition: an act of interfering; conflict, disturbance, war, obstacle, collision
words.translation: 干涉；[通信][物][医]干扰，冲突

examples.en: Industrial relations should be free from state interference.
examples.zh: 劳资关系应不受政府干预。

words.definition: the way in which someone explains or understands an event, information, someone’s actions etc; explanation, translation, construction, account
words.translation: 解释，理解；[计]解释；[语]翻译；演出

examples.en: One possible interpretation is that they want you to resign.
examples.zh: 一种可能的解释是，他们想要你辞职。

examples.en: It’s difficult to put an accurate interpretation on (= explain ) the survey results.
examples.zh: 对调查结果难以作出确切的解释。

examples.en: What exactly the author meant by that statement is open to interpretation (= able to be understood or explained in different ways ).
examples.zh: 作者这句话的确切含义可有各种理解。

words.definition: between different races of people
words.translation: 种族间的

examples.en: interracial marriage
examples.zh: 种族间的通婚

words.definition: to become involved in an argument, fight, or other difficult situation in order to change what happens; influence in, meddle in
words.translation: 干涉；调停；插入

examples.en: The army will have to intervene to prevent further fighting.
examples.zh: 军队将不得不干预以阻止进一步的战斗。

words.definition: the act of becoming involved in an argument, fight, or other difficult situation in order to change what happens; prevention, violation
words.translation: 干涉；介入；调停；妨碍

examples.en: government intervention to regulate prices
examples.zh: 政府介入控制物价

words.definition: something that is intriguing is very interesting because it is strange, mysterious, or unexpected; colorful, funny, killing, taking; brewing
words.translation: 有趣的；迷人的；引起…的兴趣；策划阴谋；私通（intrigue的ing形式）

examples.en: The magazine carries an intriguing mixture of high fashion, gossip and racing.
examples.zh: 这本杂志内容丰富有趣，有关时尚、花边新闻和赛马的内容都有。

words.definition: when the army of one country enters another country by force, in order to take control of it; violence, aggression, infringement
words.translation: 入侵；入侵，侵略；[医]侵袭；侵犯

examples.en: the annual invasion of teenagers for the Glastonbury Festival
examples.zh: 每年前来参加格拉斯顿伯里音乐节的青少年的涌入

words.definition: a situation that is unusual or amusing because something strange happens, or the opposite of what is expected happens or is true; hit, satire; ferrous
words.translation: 讽刺；反语；具有讽刺意味的事；铁的；似铁的

examples.en: Life is full of little ironies.
examples.zh: 生活中充满了小小的讽刺。

words.definition: not useful or not relating to a particular situation, and therefore not important; inconnected, unrelated
words.translation: 无关的；不相干的；不切题的

examples.en: We’re focussing too much on irrelevant details.
examples.zh: 我们过于关注不相干的细节。

examples.en: Students viewed Latin as boring and irrelevant.
examples.zh: 学生认为拉丁语无聊且无关紧要。

words.definition: to make someone feel annoyed or impatient, especially by doing something many times or for a long period of time; stimulate, fan, anger, motivate, needle
words.translation: 激怒；刺激，使兴奋

examples.en: It really irritates me when he doesn’t help around the house.
examples.zh: 家里的事情他一点都不帮忙，真让我恼火。

words.definition: when one group, person, or thing is separate from others; insulation, segregation
words.translation: 隔绝，隔离；[电子]隔离；孤立；[电]绝缘；[化学]离析

examples.en: Because of its geographical isolation, the area developed its own unique culture.
examples.zh: 由于地理上的隔绝，该地区发展了自己独特的文化。

examples.en: The mansion sits in splendid isolation on top of the hill (= it is far from everything and looks impressive ).
examples.zh: 宅邸位于山顶，远离尘嚣。

examples.en: a patient’s isolation period
examples.zh: 病人的隔离期

words.definition: relating to the law, judges, or their decisions; just, candid
words.translation: 司法的；公正的，明断的；[法]法庭的；审判上的

examples.en: ...an independent judicial system.
examples.zh: …一个独立的司法体系。

words.definition: a group of 12 ordinary people who listen to the details of a case in court and decide whether someone is guilty or not; quick-fix, lash-up
words.translation: 陪审团；应急的

examples.en: the members of the jury
examples.zh: 陪审团成员

examples.en: The jury found him not guilty.
examples.zh: 陪审团裁定他无罪。

examples.en: the right to trial by jury
examples.zh: 由陪审团进行审理的权利

words.definition: actions, reactions, decisions etc that are justifiable are acceptable because they are done for good reasons; explainable, excusable
words.translation: 理所应当的；可辩解的，有道理的；可证明为正当的

examples.en: justifiable anger
examples.zh: 情有可原的愤怒

examples.en: Are these experiments morally justifiable?
examples.zh: 这些实验合乎道德准则吗？

words.definition: having an acceptable explanation or reason; adjusted, oriented
words.translation: 正当的；调整（justify的过去分词）；证明…正当

examples.en: In the Chief Constable’s view, the use of force was fully justified.
examples.zh: 在警察局局长看来，使用武力是完全正当的。

words.definition: a keen sense of smell or keen sight or hearing is an extremely good ability to smell etc; acute, intense, eager, pointed, burning; elegy, dirge
words.translation: 浓厚的；敏锐的；敏锐的，敏捷的；渴望的；强烈的；热心的；锐利的；痛哭，挽歌

examples.en: Dogs have a very keen sense of smell.
examples.zh: 狗的嗅觉十分灵敏。

examples.en: She has a keen eye for (= is good at noticing ) talent.
examples.zh: 她擅于发掘人才。

words.definition: to take someone somewhere illegally by force, often in order to get money for returning them; spirit, abduct
words.translation: 绑架；诱拐；拐骗

examples.en: Police appealed for wit­nesses after a woman was kidnapped at gunpoint.
examples.zh: 一名妇女遭到持枪绑架，警方呼吁目击者挺身而出。

words.definition: to not have something that you need, or not have enough of it; ask, claim; fail, low in; shortage, short of, deficiency, need, drought
words.translation: 缺少；缺乏；不足；没有；需要

examples.en: Alex’s real problem is that he lacks confidence.
examples.zh: 亚历克斯的真正问题是缺乏信心。

words.definition: to move or develop more slowly than others; backwardness, prisoner; trail, take the dust of; file over, titubate; finishing, last, eventual, rearmost, dernier
words.translation: 落后；迟延；防护套；囚犯；桶板；落后于；押往监狱；加上外套；[电子]滞后；缓缓而行；蹒跚；最后的

examples.en: Western banks still lag behind financial institutions in most other regions of the country.
examples.zh: 西部地区的银行仍然落后于这个国家其他大部分地区的金融机构。

words.definition: to make a new product, book etc available for sale for the first time; release, send, project, drive, let go; proceed, start in; emission, shot, sending, projection, loose
words.translation: 发布，推出；[航]发射（导弹、火箭等）；发起，发动；使…下水；开始；下水；起飞；[航]发射；发行，投放市场；汽艇

examples.en: The company hopes to launch the new drug by next October.
examples.zh: 公司希望于明年10月前推出这种新药。

words.definition: an area of ground in a garden or park that is covered with short grass; grass, meadow
words.translation: 草坪；[建]草地

examples.en: I spent all morning mowing the lawn (= cutting the grass ).
examples.zh: 我整个上午都在修剪草坪。

examples.en: a carefully tended lawn
examples.zh: 受到细心呵护的草坪

words.definition: someone who is not trained in a particular subject or type of work, especially when they are being compared with someone who is; layperson, lay people
words.translation: 门外汉；外行；俗人；一般信徒

examples.en: To the layman (= laymen in general ) all these plants look pretty similar.
examples.zh: 对外行的人来说，这些植物看起来都很相似。

examples.en: If you don’t understand what the doctor says, ask to have it explained in layman’s terms (= in simple language ).
examples.zh: 如果你听不懂医生的话，就请他用通俗易懂的语言来解释一下。

words.definition: programming, exposure, disposal, showing, design
words.translation: 陈列；布局；设计；安排

words.definition: an old, well-known story, often about brave people, adventures, or magical events; explanation, notes, romance, illustration
words.translation: 传奇；说明；[测]图例；刻印文字

examples.en: Local legend has it that (= says that ) the island was the original Garden of Eden.
examples.zh: 当地传说这个岛就是伊甸园的原型。

words.definition: a law or set of laws; lawmaking, lex
words.translation: 立法；法律

examples.en: This is a very important piece of legislation (= law ).
examples.zh: 这是一条非常重要的法规。

words.definition: someone who has the power to make laws or belongs to an institution that makes laws; Moses, lawmaker
words.translation: 立法者；[法]立法者

examples.en: ...an attempt to get U.S. legislators to change the system.
examples.zh: …让美国立法者改变体制的一次努力。

words.definition: in order to make sure that something will not happen
words.translation: 以免

examples.en: She turned away from the window lest anyone see them.
examples.zh: 她转身离开窗边，免得有人看见他们。

words.definition: a group of people who try to persuade a government that a particular law or situation should be changed; sala, salle
words.translation: 游说；大厅；休息室；会客室；游说议员的团体

examples.en: the anti-foxhunting lobby
examples.zh: 反对猎狐的游说团体

examples.en: a powerful environmental lobby group
examples.zh: 一个有影响力的环保游说团体

words.definition: very expensive, beautiful, and comfortable; abundant, super, full, extravagant
words.translation: 奢侈的，豪华的；奢侈的；丰富的；放纵的；特级的

examples.en: a luxurious 30-room villa
examples.zh: 一栋有30个房间的豪华度假别墅

words.definition: to make something seem bigger or louder, especially using special equipment; praise, celebrate, bless; enlarge, zoom up
words.translation: 放大；赞美；夸大；有放大能力

examples.en: At the Sheffield arena, the speakers were magnified ten times on a giant screen.
examples.zh: 在谢菲尔德体育馆，演讲者在一个巨大的屏幕上被放大了十倍。

examples.en: A public address system magnifies all the little noises and coughs.
examples.zh: 扩音系统会放大任何细小的噪音和咳嗽声。

words.definition: the repairs, painting etc that are necessary to keep something in good condition; conservation, keep
words.translation: 维修；维护，维修；保持；[经]生活费用

examples.en: the cost of repairs and maintenance
examples.zh: 维修保养费

examples.en: The theatres were closed on Saturday and Sunday for routine maintenance .
examples.zh: 戏院周六和周日关闭进行例行维护。

examples.en: Engineers are carrying out essential maintenance work on the main line to Cambridge.
examples.zh: 机修工正在对通往剑桥的干线进行必要的养护。

words.definition: most of the people or things in a group; plurality, multitude
words.translation: 大多数；多数；成年

examples.en: The Labour Party won a huge majority at the last general election.
examples.zh: 工党在上次大选中以巨大的票数优势获胜。

words.definition: shopping arcade
words.translation: 商场；购物商场；[建]林荫路；铁圈球场

examples.en: In the winter I head for the mall.
examples.zh: 在冬日里,我前往这个购物商场。

examples.en: If you see something you like at the mall, walk away.
examples.zh: 如果在商城里看见某件你喜欢的东西，（别买）走开。

words.definition: to show a feeling, attitude etc; indicate, prove, demonstrate, reveal, make clear; occur, make clear, figure, offer, come out; passenger list; apparent, obvious, distinct, transparent, decided
words.translation: 表明；证明，表明；显示；显示，出现；[贸易]载货单，货单；旅客名单；显然的，明显的；明白的

examples.en: The shareholders have manifested their intention to sell the shares.
examples.zh: 股东们表明了要出售股票的意图。

words.definition: to use machines to make goods or materials, usually in large numbers or amounts; machining, make, work, fabrication; process, make
words.translation: 生产，制造；制造；产品；制造业；加工；捏造

examples.en: the company that manufactured the drug
examples.zh: 生产这种药的公司

examples.en: manufactured goods
examples.zh: 工业品，制成品

words.definition: relating to the sea and the creatures that live there; nautical, sea-born; shipping industry, bluejacket
words.translation: 海洋的；船舶的；[海洋]海生的；海产的；航海的，海运的；海运业；舰队；水兵；（海军）士兵或军官

examples.en: the enormous variety of marine life
examples.zh: 海洋生物繁多的种类

examples.en: the effects of oil pollution on marine mammals
examples.zh: 石油污染对海洋哺乳动物的影响

examples.en: marine biology
examples.zh: 海洋生物学

words.definition: obviously, clearly, broadly, remarkably, dramatically
words.translation: 显著地；明显地；引人注目地

examples.en: The relations between our two countries have improved markedly in every aspect.
examples.zh: 我们两国的关系在各方面都有了显著的发展。

examples.en: Bankers say that they have got tougher but they have still tightened lending standards less markedly than their counterparts in the euro area as a whole.
examples.zh: 银行业主说他们已经紧缩了信用，但是整体上他们对借贷标准的收紧并没有像欧洲其他地区的同行那样明显。

words.definition: something that covers all or part of your face, to protect or to hide it; if a smell, taste, sound etc is masked by a stronger one, it cannot be noticed because of the stronger one; blind, face-piece; dissimulate, make sb up; belie, disguise
words.translation: 面具；掩饰 掩盖；口罩；掩饰；戴面具；化装；使模糊

examples.en: a surgical face mask
examples.zh: 外科手术口罩

examples.en: He was attacked and robbed by two people wearing masks .
examples.zh: 他被两个蒙面人袭击并抢劫。

words.definition: cloth used for making clothes, curtains etc; crucial, important, considerable, big, major; stuff, ingredient
words.translation: 材料；重要的；[物]物质的，实质性的；肉体的；[材]材料，原料；[经]物资；布料

examples.en: curtain material
examples.zh: 窗帘布

examples.en: scraps of material
examples.zh: 碎布料

examples.en: a cape made of a soft material
examples.zh: 用柔软布料制成的披肩

words.definition: to happen or appear in the way that you expected; embody, reify; come true, deliver
words.translation: 实现；使具体化，使有形；使突然出现；使重物质而轻精神；实现，成形；突然出现

examples.en: Problems were expected, but they never materialized.
examples.zh: 估计会有问题，但一直没有发生。

examples.en: The money we had been promised failed to materialize .
examples.zh: 答应给我们的钱并没有兑现。

words.definition: to be important, especially to be important to you, or to have an effect on what happens; substance, event, consideration, circumstance, occurrence, scene; to be related, make a difference
words.translation: 重要；要紧；[物]物质；原因；事件；有关系

examples.en: If I have to stay late at work tonight, it won’t matter because we can go out another night.
examples.zh: 如果今晚我必须工作到很晚的话，那也没关系，我们可以改天晚上再出去。

examples.en: Does it matter what I think?
examples.zh: 我怎么想重要吗？

examples.en: Do you think it matters that the cups and saucers don’t match?
examples.zh: 你觉得茶杯与杯托不相配要紧吗？

words.definition: the quality of behaving in a sensible way like an adult; ripeness, adultness
words.translation: 成熟；[生物]成熟；[会计][金融]到期；完备

examples.en: Beth shows a maturity way beyond her 16 years.
examples.zh: 贝丝表现出一种远远超出她16岁年龄的成熟。

examples.en: One day you’ll have the maturity to understand.
examples.zh: 有一天等你长大后你就明白了。

words.definition: an action, especially an official one, that is intended to deal with a particular problem; extent, degree, survey, dimension, size; sound, scale, estimate; take stock of, weigh up
words.translation: 措施；测量；程度；尺寸；估量；权衡

examples.en: New safety measures were being demanded after last night’s horrific train crash.
examples.zh: 昨晚发生严重的火车相撞事故后，民众要求制定新的安全措施。

examples.en: The new bridge was erected as a temporary measure to replace the one which was destroyed by floods.
examples.zh: 建这座新桥是为了临时代替被洪水毁坏的那座桥。

words.definition: part of a machine or a set of parts that does a particular job; theory, element, technique, skill, machinery
words.translation: 机制；原理，途径；进程；机械装置；技巧

examples.en: the brake mechanism
examples.zh: 刹车装置

examples.en: a clock mechanism
examples.zh: 钟表机件

words.definition: if something solid melts or if heat melts it, it becomes liquid; flux, fuse; oil, soften up; fusion, burnoff
words.translation: 融化；熔化，[化学]溶解；渐混；使融化；使熔化；使软化；使感动；熔化；熔化物

examples.en: It was warmer now, and the snow was beginning to melt.
examples.zh: 现在天气暖和了，雪开始融化。

examples.en: Melt the butter in a saucepan.
examples.zh: 把黄油放在深平底锅里化开。

words.definition: a short official note to another person in the same company or organization; minute, notandum
words.translation: 备忘录

examples.en: I sent him a memo reminding him about the meeting.
examples.zh: 我发给他一个通知，提醒他开会的事。

words.definition: very good, enjoyable, or unusual, and worth remembering; obvious, prominent, marked, noted, outstanding
words.translation: 值得纪念的；显著的，难忘的

examples.en: We want to make this a truly memorable day for the children.
examples.zh: 我们想让今天成为孩子们永远难忘的日子。

words.definition: to talk or write about something or someone, usually quickly and without saying very much or giving details; indicate to, make reference to; reference, allusion
words.translation: 提及；提到，谈到；提及，论及；说起；提及，说起

examples.en: Was my name mentioned at all?
examples.zh: 我的名字被提到过吗？

examples.en: Some of the problems were mentioned in his report.
examples.zh: 其中的一些问题在他的报告里提到了。

examples.en: (= it is important enough to mention ) that they only studied a very small number of cases.
examples.zh: 必须说明的是他们仅研究了几个个案。

words.definition: to be good, important, or serious enough for praise or attention; an advantage or good feature of something; asset, importance, virtue, price, value; to be worth, be deserving of
words.translation: 值得；优点；优点，价值；功绩；功过

examples.en: The results have been encouraging enough to merit further investigation.
examples.zh: 结果令人振奋，值得进一步调查研究。

examples.en: It’s a fascinating book which merits attention.
examples.zh: 这是本引人入胜的书，值得关注。

words.definition: if birds or animals migrate, they travel regularly from one part of the world to another; to move, to shift; transplant
words.translation: 移民，迁徙；移动；随季节而移居；移往；使移居；使移植

examples.en: People migrate to cities like Jakarta in search of work.
examples.zh: 人们移居到雅加达这样的城市找工作。

words.definition: a very important event in the development of something; landmark, milliarium
words.translation: 里程碑；[交]里程碑，划时代的事件

examples.en: He said the launch of the party represented a milestone in Zambian history.
examples.zh: 他说该党的成立代表着赞比亚历史上的一个里程碑。

words.definition: very small in degree or amount, especially the smallest degree or amount possible; lowest, bottommost
words.translation: 最低的，最小限度的；最低的；最小限度的

examples.en: The storm caused only minimal damage.
examples.zh: 暴风雨只造成了轻微破坏。

examples.en: The cost to taxpayers would be minimal.
examples.zh: 纳税人的支出将是最少的。

examples.en: This is a practical course, with only a minimal amount of theory.
examples.zh: 这是实践课程，只有少量理论。

words.definition: the work or industry of getting gold, coal etc out of the earth
words.translation: 矿产

examples.en: ...traditional industries such as coal mining and steel making.
examples.zh: …像采煤和炼钢这样的传统工业。

words.definition: small and not very important or serious, especially when compared with other things; secondary, supporting, peripheral, less; infant, pupil
words.translation: 次要的，小的；未成年的；次要的；较小的；小调的；二流的；未成年人；小调；副修科目

examples.en: We have made some minor changes to the program.
examples.zh: 我们对那个程序做了一些小改动。

examples.en: a relatively minor error
examples.zh: 相对较小的错误

examples.en: a minor road
examples.zh: 小路

words.definition: a small group of people or things within a much larger group; ethnic minorities, nonage
words.translation: 少数，少数民族；少数民族；少数派；未成年

examples.en: Gaelic is still spoken in Ireland by a tiny minority.
examples.zh: 爱尔兰仍有极少数人在说盖尔语。

words.definition: something very lucky or very good that happens which you did not expect to happen or did not think was possible; phenomenon, wonder
words.translation: 奇迹；奇迹，奇迹般的人或物；惊人的事例

examples.en: It’s a miracle you weren’t killed!
examples.zh: 你没有死真是奇迹！

examples.en: By some miracle, we managed to catch the plane.
examples.zh: 我们奇迹般地赶上了飞机。

examples.en: the economic miracle of the 1950s
examples.zh: 20世纪50年代的经济奇迹

words.definition: very bad luck, or something that happens to you as a result of bad luck; disaster, evil, tragedy, grief
words.translation: 不幸地；不幸；灾祸，灾难

examples.en: It seems the banks always profit from farmers’ misfortunes.
examples.zh: 银行似乎总是从农民的不幸中获益。

words.definition: to not understand the correct meaning of something that someone says or does, or of facts that you are considering; mistake, read into
words.translation: 误解；曲解，误解

examples.en: Some parts of the report could be misinterpreted.
examples.zh: 报告的某些部分可能会被误解。

words.definition: the ability to move easily from one job, area, or social class to another; maneuverability, manoeuvrability
words.translation: 活动；[物][通信]移动性；机动性；[电子]迁移率

examples.en: It improves the strength and mobility of joints.
examples.zh: 它能提高关节的力量和灵活性。

words.definition: to make something such as a system or building more modern
words.translation: 现代化

examples.en: They need more funds to modernize the country’s telephone system.
examples.zh: 他们需要更多的资金将本国的电话系统现代化。

examples.en: a tastefully modernized old farmhouse
examples.zh: 雅致而现代化的旧农舍

words.definition: slightly wet, especially in a way that is pleasant or suitable; wet, humid; dampness, humidification
words.translation: 潮湿的；[气象][物]潮湿的；多雨的；含泪的；[气象][物]潮湿

examples.en: Make sure the soil is moist before planting the seeds.
examples.zh: 播种之前要确保土壤湿润。

examples.en: a rich, moist chocolate cake
examples.zh: 香浓软润的巧克力蛋糕

examples.en: warm moist air
examples.zh: 温暖湿润的空气

words.definition: if a company or government has a monopoly of a business or political activity, it has complete control of it so that other organizations cannot compete with it; cornerer
words.translation: 垄断；[经]垄断；垄断者；[贸易]专卖权

examples.en: a monopoly in copper trading
examples.zh: 对铜交易的垄断

words.definition: the number of deaths during a particular period of time among a particular type or group of people; Deaths, death rate
words.translation: 死亡率；[医]死亡数，死亡率；必死性，必死的命运

examples.en: Mortality from heart disease varies widely across the world.
examples.zh: 心脏病死亡率世界各地差异很大。

words.definition: a hotel for people who are travelling by car, where you can park your car outside your room
words.translation: 汽车旅馆

examples.en: The gas station just neighbours to the motel.
examples.zh: 加油站就在汽车旅馆的附近。

examples.en: I also have to get back to the motel. The manager took my passport last night, and now he and the passport are nowhere to be found.
examples.zh: 我也必须回到汽车旅馆去，因为旅馆经理昨天晚上拿走了我的护照，到现在为止他本人和我的护照都不知所踪。

words.definition: incentive, reason, boost
words.translation: 激励，刺激；动机；积极性；推动

words.definition: to increase gradually in amount or degree; enhance, boost, jack, hot, gain; climb, arise, raise, go up; peak, foundation plate
words.translation: 增加；爬上；使骑上马；爬；上升；山峰；底座；乘骑用马

examples.en: Tension here is mounting , as we await the final result.
examples.zh: 我们等待着最终结果，这里的气氛也越来越紧张。

examples.en: Casualties on both sides of the battle have continued to mount.
examples.zh: 交战双方的伤亡人数继续增加。

words.definition: to feel very sad and to miss someone after they have died; grieve over, grieve for
words.translation: 哀悼；忧伤；服丧

examples.en: Hundreds of people gathered to mourn the slain president.
examples.zh: 成百上千人聚集在一起悼念遇刺的总统。

words.definition: relating to or belonging to the government of a town or city; civic, communalistic
words.translation: 政府的；[建][经]市政的，市的；地方自治的

examples.en: the municipal waste dump
examples.zh: 城市垃圾场

examples.en: municipal elections
examples.zh: 市级选举

words.definition: to make something narrower or to become narrower; nice, limited, finite, exact, precision; neck, channel, sound; straiten
words.translation: 变窄，缩小；狭窄的，有限的；勉强的；精密的；度量小的；海峡；狭窄部分，隘路；变窄

examples.en: He narrowed his eyes and gazed at the horizon.
examples.zh: 他眯起眼睛凝望着地平线。

examples.en: The track divided into two and narrowed.
examples.zh: 小道分成两条并且变窄了。

words.definition: when something is necessary; need, want, demand, requirement for
words.translation: 必须，必要性；需要；[数]必然性；[经]必需品

examples.en: I’m afraid it’s become a matter of economic necessity.
examples.zh: 恐怕这已成了一个经济需求的问题。

words.definition: having very little food or money; poor, indigent
words.translation: 贫穷的；贫困的；生活艰苦的

examples.en: a needy family
examples.zh: 贫困家庭

words.definition: to fail to look after someone or something properly; ignore, be forgetful of; omission, oversight
words.translation: 忽视；疏忽，忽视；忽略；怠慢

examples.en: She smoked and drank, neglected the children, and left the clothes unmended.
examples.zh: 她抽烟喝酒，既不照顾孩子，也不缝补衣服。

examples.en: a neglected garden
examples.zh: 疏于打理的花园

examples.en: The building has been badly neglected.
examples.zh: 这栋大楼严重疏于维护。

words.definition: official discussions between the repre­sentatives of opposing groups who are trying to reach an agreement, especially in business or politics; treaty, alienation
words.translation: 协商；谈判；转让；顺利的通过

examples.en: The trader was obstinate in the negotiation.
examples.zh: 这个商人在谈判中拗强固执。

words.definition: approach, proximity
words.translation: 附近；街坊；接近

examples.en: What happened in the factory is being whispered about the neighborhood.
examples.zh: 工厂里发生的事正在附近居民中私下传说。

words.definition: the state of not supporting either side in an argument or war; fence-sitter, indifference
words.translation: 中立；中性；中立立场

examples.en: Net neutrality, or not?
examples.zh: 网络中立或不?

examples.en: Some of the nations declared neutrality.
examples.zh: 有的国家宣布中立。

examples.en: Yet in our view, the notion of “search neutrality” threatens innovation, competition and, fundamentally,your ability as a user to improve how you find information.
examples.zh: 但在我们看来“搜索中立”这个概念威胁创新，竞争和本质上的，你作为一个用户去提高你寻找信息的能力。

words.definition: a very frightening dream; paroniria, oneirodynia; terrible, horrible, awesome, fearful, dire
words.translation: 噩梦；恶梦；梦魇般的经历；可怕的；噩梦似的

examples.en: a recurring nightmare
examples.zh: 一再出现的噩梦

words.definition: to officially suggest someone or something for an important position, duty, or prize; install, constitute, name, place, specify
words.translation: 提名；推荐；任命；指定

examples.en: This week one of them will be nominated by the Democratic Party for the presidency of the United States.
examples.zh: 本周他们中的一人将被民主党提名为美国总统职位的候选人。

words.definition: an idea, belief, or opinion; concept, idea, eye, construct, sight
words.translation: 想法，观点；概念；见解；打算

examples.en: She had no notion what he meant.
examples.zh: 她根本不明白他是什么意思。

words.definition: many, multiple, hundred, plenty
words.translation: 无数的；许多的，很多的

words.definition: food that is nutritious is full of the natural substances that your body needs to stay healthy or to grow properly; alible, nourishing
words.translation: 有营养的；有营养的，滋养的

examples.en: Wholemeal bread is more nutritious than white bread.
examples.zh: 全麦面包比白面包更有营养。

examples.en: Nuts and fruit make nutritious snacks.
examples.zh: 坚果和水果是有营养价值的零食。

examples.en: The cookbook contains many simple yet highly nutritious meals.
examples.zh: 那本烹饪书里有许多简单却营养价值很高的食谱。

words.definition: when someone is very fat in a way that is unhealthy; hypertrophy, dilatancy
words.translation: 肥胖；肥大，[内科]肥胖

examples.en: So, what of the future of obesity in America?
examples.zh: 那么，未来美国的肥胖状况会怎么发展呢？

examples.en: Dr.Watson is great on exercise as a cure for obesity.
examples.zh: 沃森医生把运动看做是治疗肥胖症的良方。

examples.en: What is obesity?
examples.zh: 什么是肥胖？

words.definition: something that you are trying hard to achieve, especially in business or politics; impersonal, accusatival; intention, purpose, sake, target, goal
words.translation: 目标，目的；[医]客观的；目标的；[语]宾格的；目的；目标；[光]物镜；[语]宾格

examples.en: He vowed to achieve certain objectives before the end of his presidency.
examples.zh: 他立誓要在他的总统任期结束之前实现某些目标。

examples.en: the best way to accomplish your objectives
examples.zh: 完成目标的最佳方法

examples.en: The degree program has two main objectives.
examples.zh: 该学位课程有两个主要目标。

words.definition: if you are obliged to do something, you have to do it because the situation, the law, a duty etc makes it necessary; pressure, enforce
words.translation: 迫使；强制；赐，施恩惠；责成

examples.en: The storm got worse and worse. Finally, I was obliged to abandon the car and continue on foot.
examples.zh: 暴风雨越来越猛烈。最终，我被迫弃车徒步前行。

words.definition: something that makes it difficult to achieve some­thing; interference, let, bar, disturbance, dam
words.translation: 阻碍；障碍，干扰；妨害物

examples.en: The tax puts obstacles in the way of companies trying to develop trade overseas.
examples.zh: 这项税收为想在海外发展贸易的公司设置了障碍。

examples.en: Women still have to overcome many obstacles to gain equality.
examples.zh: 妇女要获得平等仍需克服重重障碍。

examples.en: We want to remove all obstacles to travel between the two countries.
examples.zh: 我们想要消除在这两个国家之间旅行的所有障碍。

words.definition: to happen; happen, exist, proceed, figure, offer
words.translation: 发生；出现；存在

examples.en: A third of accidental deaths occur in the home.
examples.zh: 有三分之一的意外死亡发生在家里。

examples.en: The explosion occurred at 5.30 a.m.
examples.zh: 爆炸发生在清晨5点30分。

words.definition: crime, guilt
words.translation: 冒犯；犯罪，过错；进攻；触怒；引起反感的事物

examples.en: His words gave great offense to everybody present.
examples.zh: 他的发言冲犯了在场的所有人。

examples.en: These efforts have led to a growing confidence among the public that corruption is a serious punishable offense in Albania.
examples.zh: 这些努力增强了公众的信心，即人们相信，腐败在阿尔巴尼亚是严重犯罪，能够受到惩罚。

words.definition: to disagree with something such as a plan or idea and try to prevent it from happening or succeeding; combat, sit down on; object, sit down on
words.translation: 反对；对抗，抗争

examples.en: Congress is continuing to oppose the President’s health care budget.
examples.zh: 国会继续反对总统的医疗保健预算。

words.definition: strong disagreement with, or protest against, something such as a plan, law, or system; recusation, objection to sth
words.translation: 反对；反对派；在野党；敌对

examples.en: He is confident in his ability to overcome all opposition with his personal charm.
examples.zh: 他自信有能力以个人魅力来化解一切反对力量。

examples.en: The proposals have aroused the opposition of teachers.
examples.zh: 这些建议引起了教师们的反对。

examples.en: Strong opposition resulted in rejection of the bill.
examples.zh: 在强烈反对下这项议案遭到否决。

words.definition: believing that good things will happen in the future; rose-colored, rosy
words.translation: 乐观的；乐观主义的

examples.en: Andrew took a more optimistic view.
examples.zh: 安德鲁抱有更为乐观的想法。

words.definition: relating to farming or gardening methods of growing food without using artificial chemicals, or produced or grown by these methods; fundamental, ultimate, radical, underlying
words.translation: 有机的；[生物][有化]有机的；组织的；器官的；根本的

examples.en: Organic farming is better for the environment.
examples.zh: 有机耕作对环境更有利。

examples.en: organic gardening
examples.zh: 有机园艺

words.definition: to find exactly where you are by looking around you or using a map; adapt, condition, suit, season; east; eastern; to the east
words.translation: 使适应，使确定方向；使适应；确定方向；使朝东；东方；东方诸国；东方的；向东

examples.en: She looked at the street names, trying to orient herself.
examples.zh: 她看看街名，试图确定自己的方位。

words.definition: the final result of a meeting, discussion, war etc – used especially when no one knows what it will be until it actually happens; product, result, conclusion, event, feedback
words.translation: 结果；结果，结局；成果

examples.en: People who had heard the evidence at the trial were surprised at the outcome.
examples.zh: 在审判过程中听过证词的人都对此结果感到吃惊。

words.definition: if something is outdated, it is no longer considered useful or effective, because something more modern exists; ancient, demoded
words.translation: 过时的；旧式的

examples.en: outdated teaching methods
examples.zh: 不合时宜的教学方法

examples.en: a factory with outdated equipment
examples.zh: 设备陈旧的工厂

examples.en: His writing style is now boring and outdated.
examples.zh: 他的写作风格如今已显得乏味而过时了。
