examples.en: Our research has only recently begun to yield important results.
examples.zh: 直到最近我们的研究才开始取得重要成果。

words.definition: to put something down in a particular place; a part of the cost of something you are buying that you pay some time before you pay the rest of it; fund, saving, covers, sludge, precipitation; trust in, trust with; settle, to precipitate
words.translation: 存放；存款；[金融]保证金；[地质][电]沉淀物；[地质]使沉积；[电]沉淀

examples.en: The female deposits her eggs directly into the water.
examples.zh: 雌性把卵直接产在水中。

words.definition: someone whose job is to welcome and deal with people arriving in a hotel or office building, visiting a doctor etc; greeter, dest clerk
words.translation: 接待员；传达员

examples.en: You tell the receptionist that you are expecting a call from this client and to put them through.
examples.zh: 你告诉传达员你正在等待一个来自这个客户的电话，并允许将他们接进来。

words.definition: a very small piece of something; grain, granule
words.translation: 粒子，微粒；颗粒；[物]质点；极小量；小品词

examples.en: dust particles
examples.zh: 尘埃

words.definition: to supply or provide something; afford, prepare, serve, tender, lend
words.translation: 提供；供应；装备

examples.en: Will these finds furnish more information on prehistoric man?
examples.zh: 这些发现是否能提供更多有关史前人类的资料？

words.definition: fine, skillfully
words.translation: 复杂地，精心设计地；精巧地；苦心经营地

examples.en: He elaborately devised a new computer.
examples.zh: 他精心设计了一台新电脑。

words.definition: an infectious illness can be passed from one person to another, especially through the air you breathe; catching, epidemic
words.translation: 感染的，传染的；[内科]传染的；传染性的；易传染的

examples.en: infectious diseases
examples.zh: 传染性疾病

examples.en: Flu is highly infectious.
examples.zh: 流感传染性很强。

words.definition: to find out what illness someone has, or what the cause of a fault is, after doing tests, examinations etc; tell, figure out; judge of, pass upon
words.translation: 诊断；断定；判断

examples.en: How did they diagnose you?
examples.zh: 他们怎么给你的诊断的？

examples.en: What tools do you need to help you diagnose the problem, and where do you get them?
examples.zh: 您需要什么工具来帮助您诊断问题，可以从哪里获得这些工具？

examples.en: Evidently this springs from some defect in their nature, but it is one not altogether easy either to diagnose of to cure.
examples.zh: 这种情形显然源于他们本性上的某种缺陷，但是这种缺陷既不容易诊断也不容易治疗。

words.definition: someone who is unable to walk properly because their legs are damaged or injured - now considered offensive; break, to weaken; disablement, lameness; disabled, spavined
words.translation: 残疾，跛子；削弱；使跛；[医]使残废；[医]跛子；残废；跛的；[医]残废的

examples.en: She has gone from being a healthy, fit, and sporty young woman to being a cripple.
examples.zh: 她从一个健康、强壮、爱好体育运动的年轻姑娘变成了一个残疾人。

words.definition: behaving in an angry threatening way, as if you want to fight or attack someone; invasive, enterprising
words.translation: 挑衅的；侵略性的；好斗的；有进取心的；有闯劲的

examples.en: Jim’s voice became aggressive.
examples.zh: 吉姆的声音凶了起来。

examples.en: Teachers apparently expect a certain amount of aggressive behaviour from boys.
examples.zh: 老师显然料到男孩子多少会有些好勇斗狠的行为。

words.definition: named, described etc in a way that seems very suitable; properly, well, adequately, appropriately, befittingly
words.translation: 适当地；适宜地

examples.en: The aptly named Skyline Restaurant provides spectacular views of the city below.
examples.zh: 天际餐厅名副其实，可以俯瞰城市美景。

words.definition: if people assimilate, or are assimilated into a country or group, they become part of that group and are accepted by the people in that group; absorb, drink in; drink in, suck up
words.translation: 同化；吸收；使同化；把…比作；使相似

examples.en: There is every sign that new Asian-Americans are just as willing to assimilate.
examples.zh: 各种迹象表明新的亚裔美籍人简直一样愿意被同化。

words.definition: always behaving in the same way or having the same attitudes, standards etc – usually used to show approval; united, corresponding, uniform, matching, solid
words.translation: 一致的；始终如一的，[数]一致的；坚持的

examples.en: She’s the team’s most consistent player.
examples.zh: 她是该队中表现最为稳定的选手。

words.definition: to officially stop something from continuing, especially for a short time; wait, phase back
words.translation: 暂停；使暂停；延缓，推迟；使悬浮

examples.en: Sales of the drug will be suspended until more tests are completed.
examples.zh: 这种药品在完成进一步检验之前将暂停销售。

examples.en: Talks between the two countries have now been suspended.
examples.zh: 两国间的对话现已中止。

words.translation: 创造力

examples.en: They suppress the ingenuity of our people and businesses.
examples.zh: 它们抑制我们的人民和企业的创造力。

words.definition: Someone who is reserved keeps their feelings hidden; cold, saving, retained
words.translation: 保留意见的；矜持的；保留的，预订的；缄默的，冷淡的；包租的

examples.en: He was unemotional, quiet, and reserved.
examples.zh: 他不动感情、安静而矜持。

words.definition: unbiased information, opinions, advice etc is fair because the person giving it is not influenced by their own or other people’s opinions; judicial, just
words.translation: 公正的；无偏见的

examples.en: We aim to provide a service that is balanced and unbiased.
examples.zh: 我们的目标是提供一种公平公正的服务。

examples.en: an unbiased observer
examples.zh: 一名公正的观察员

words.definition: when you get rid of something; transactions, settlement, treating, handling, governance
words.translation: 支配；处理；清理；安排

examples.en: bomb disposal experts
examples.zh: 拆弹专家

words.definition: junior, lower; lessness, subordinate
words.translation: 比……差；差的；自卑的；[植]下级的，下等的；下级；次品

examples.en: I felt very inferior among all those academics.
examples.zh: 与那些大学教师在一起，我自惭形秽。

words.definition: to become firm, steady, or unchanging, or to make something firm or steady
words.translation: 使稳固，使安定

examples.en: The patient’s condition has now stabilized.
examples.zh: 病人的情况现已稳定下来了。

examples.en: an attempt to stabilize the economy
examples.zh: 稳定经济的努力

words.definition: the ability of the land or soil to produce good crops; productivity, pregnancy
words.translation: 多产，肥沃；多产；[土壤]肥沃；[生物][生理][农经]生产力；丰饶

words.definition: cold and without any pleasant or comfortable features; raw, wild, flat, frozen, blank
words.translation: 荒凉的；阴冷的；荒凉的，无遮蔽的；黯淡的，无希望的；冷酷的；单调的

examples.en: a bleak January afternoon
examples.zh: 一月里一个阴冷的下午

examples.en: The landscape was bleak.
examples.zh: 景色一片凄凉。

words.definition: if your  spirits (= the way you are feeling, for example happy, sad etc )  or hopes soar, you begin to feel very happy or hopeful; rise, tower, rear; flying high, upsurge
words.translation: 高飞；高耸；往上飞舞；高涨

examples.en: Adam’s smile sent her spirits soaring .
examples.zh: 亚当的微笑让她飘飘然了。

words.definition: a tendency to believe that good things will always happen
words.translation: 乐观

examples.en: There are grounds for cautious optimism.
examples.zh: 有理由保持谨慎乐观。

words.definition: determination to be successful, rich, powerful etc; careerism, aspiration; pursue / pursuit, go after
words.translation: 野心，报复；野心，雄心；抱负，志向；追求；有…野心

examples.en: He was young and full of ambition.
examples.zh: 他年轻，而且雄心勃勃。

words.definition: dealing with problems in a sensible practical way instead of strictly following a set of ideas; practical, actual, effective, real, positive
words.translation: 务实的，讲求实际的；实际的；实用主义的；国事的

examples.en: Williams took a more pragmatic approach to management problems.
examples.zh: 威廉斯在管理问题上采用的是一种更务实的做法。

words.definition: to reach an agreement in which everyone involved accepts less than what they wanted at first; harm, meet someone halfway; meet someone halfway, come to terms with; accommodation, reconciliation
words.translation: 妥协；危害；让步；妥协，和解；折衷

examples.en: She admitted that she was unable to compromise.
examples.zh: 她承认自己无法作出妥协。

words.definition: permanent; permanent, ceaseless, loud
words.translation: 永久的；不断的；四季开花的；无期限的

examples.en: the perpetual snows of the mountaintops
examples.zh: 山顶的终年积雪

words.definition: not necessary or important and so easy to get rid of
words.translation: 可有可无的

examples.en: Part-time workers are considered dispensable.
examples.zh: 兼职工作人员被认为是可有可无的。

words.definition: the crime of physically attacking someone; attack, attempt, push; hit, come at; descend on, set at
words.translation: 攻击；袭击；动武

examples.en: a case of robbery and assault
examples.zh: 一宗抢劫袭击案

examples.en: Several soldiers have been charged with assault .
examples.zh: 几名士兵被控侵犯人身。

words.definition: to go beyond the usual limits of something; overcome, exceed, top, cap, surpass
words.translation: 超越；胜过，超越

examples.en: The desire for peace transcended political differences.
examples.zh: 对和平的渴望超越了政治分歧。

words.definition: a quality that is inherent in something is a natural part of it and cannot be separated from it; internal, native, intrinsic, immanent
words.translation: 固有的；内在的；与生俱来的

examples.en: Every business has its own inherent risks.
examples.zh: 每笔生意本身都有风险。

words.definition: if something baffles you, you cannot understand or explain it at all; puzzle, set back; confusion, checkboard
words.translation: 使迷惑，困惑；使…困惑；使…受挫折；用挡板控制；[建][机][电子]挡板；困惑

examples.en: The question baffled me completely.
examples.zh: 这个问题把我彻底难倒了。

words.definition: a mark that is difficult to remove, especially one made by a liquid such as blood, coffee, or ink; poison, pollute; tainture, jaup
words.translation: 污渍，污点；沾污；败坏；给…着色；污点；瑕疵；[试剂][生物]着色剂

examples.en: Remove stains by soaking in a mild solution of bleach.
examples.zh: 用温和的漂白溶液浸泡以去除污渍。

words.definition: your peers are the people who are the same age as you, or who have the same type of job, social class etc; pore, stare at; prince, noble, nobility
words.translation: 同龄人；凝视，盯着看；窥视；贵族；同等的人

examples.en: American children did less well in math than their peers in Japan.
examples.zh: 美国儿童的数学成绩不如日本的同龄儿童。

examples.en: Staff members are trained by their peers.
examples.zh: 员工由同事培训。

words.definition: to separate one person, group, or thing from other people or things; segregate, seclude; cordon off, to stand alone; shielded, insular
words.translation: 使隔离；[生物]使隔离；使孤立；使绝缘；[生物]隔离；孤立；[生物]隔离的；孤立的

examples.en: The town was isolated by the floods.
examples.zh: 洪水使该镇与外界隔绝。

examples.en: The US has sought to isolate Cuba both economically and politically.
examples.zh: 美国一直想在经济和政治上孤立古巴。

words.definition: when a law or a system is officially ended; destoolment, abrogation
words.translation: 废除；[法]废除；废止

examples.en: The abolition of slavery in Brazil and the Caribbean closely followed the pattern of the United States.
examples.zh: 巴西和加勒比海地区对奴隶制的废除很大程度上遵循了美国的模式。

words.definition: the system of having slaves; Enslaved, bondage
words.translation: 奴隶制度；奴役；奴隶身分

examples.en: attempts to abolish slavery
examples.zh: 废除奴隶制的努力

words.definition: the written form of a speech, play, film etc; play book
words.translation: 脚本，剧本；脚本；[图情]手迹；书写用的字母

examples.en: They write all their own scripts.
examples.zh: 他们所有的剧本都是自己写的。

examples.en: a film script
examples.zh: 电影剧本

words.definition: a book or piece of writing before it is printed; scripture, autograph; handwritten
words.translation: 手稿；[图情]手稿；原稿；[图情]手写的

examples.en: Unfortunately, parts of the original manuscript have been lost.
examples.zh: 遗憾的是，部分原始手稿丢失了。

words.definition: a particular quality in someone’s character; quality, tang, identity, sort, distinction
words.translation: 特点；特性，特点；[心理]品质；少许

examples.en: The study found that some alcoholics had clear personality traits showing up early in childhood.
examples.zh: 这项研究发现一些酗酒者早在孩童时就表现出明显的个性特征。

words.definition: to change what you are doing so that you are not following an expected plan, idea, or type of behaviour; out of contact, break away; diverge
words.translation: 偏离；脱离；越轨；使偏离

examples.en: They stopped you as soon as you deviated from the script.
examples.zh: 你一偏离剧本，他们就会叫停。

words.definition: very large or greater, more important etc than any other; inundatory, preponderant; drowning
words.translation: 压倒性的；势不可挡的；压倒；淹没（overwhelm的ing形式）；制服

examples.en: There is overwhelming evidence that smoking damages your health.
examples.zh: 有难以辩驳的证据表明吸烟有损健康。

examples.en: An overwhelming majority of the members were against the idea.
examples.zh: 占压倒性多数的成员反对这项主张。

examples.en: The proposal has been given overwhelming support.
examples.zh: 这一提议得到了压倒性多数的支持。

words.translation: 接连着地，继续地

words.definition: to form a picture of someone or something in your mind; imagine, picture, think of
words.translation: 想象；形象，形象化；想像，设想

examples.en: I tried to visualize the house while he was describing it.
examples.zh: 我一边听他描述，一边想象那房子的样子。

words.translation: 未被充分代表的

words.definition: to hit your fingers lightly on something, for example to get someone’s attention; percuss; pat; water faucet, rotary swivel
words.translation: 轻敲, 导出；轻敲；轻打；装上嘴子；轻拍；轻击；轻叩；水龙头

examples.en: He tapped the table nervously with his fingers.
examples.zh: 他紧张地用手指轻轻地敲打桌子。

words.definition: to make a fire or light stop burning or shining; silence, go out
words.translation: 熄灭；使消亡；压制；偿清

examples.en: Please extinguish all cigarettes.
examples.zh: 请把香烟都熄灭了。

examples.en: Firemen were called to extinguish the blaze.
examples.zh: 有人打电话叫消防队员来扑灭大火。

words.definition: containing poison, or caused by poisonous substances; poisonous, virous
words.translation: 有毒的；[内科][毒物]有毒的；中毒的

examples.en: fumes from a toxic waste dump
examples.zh: 有毒废料堆产生的毒气

examples.en: a highly toxic pesticide
examples.zh: 毒性很强的杀虫剂

words.definition: A postdoctoral student has completed his or her doctorate and is doing further study or research
words.translation: 博士后的

examples.en: Most postdoctoral work is funded by the research councils.
examples.zh: 大部分的博士后的工作都是由研究会资助的。

words.definition: to say that something or someone is good, or suggest them for a particular purpose or job; present, put in a good word; put in a good word, advise
words.translation: 推荐；推荐，介绍；劝告；使受欢迎；托付；建议

examples.en: I recommend the butter chicken - it’s delicious.
examples.zh: 我推荐黄油焗鸡，非常好吃。

examples.en: Can you recommend a good lawyer?
examples.zh: 你能介绍一位好律师吗？

words.definition: a discussion in which people who are affected by or involved in something can give their opinions; forum, seminar
words.translation: 商议；咨询；磋商；[临床]会诊；讨论会

examples.en: They retired to another room for private consultation.
examples.zh: 他们退到另一房间秘密磋商。

examples.en: This is a critical question that we must answer together through consultation and coordination.
examples.zh: 这是一个我们必须通过磋商和协调共同回答的关键问题。

words.definition: to find out the facts about something; condition, conclude; identify, drop, finish, judge
words.translation: 决定；判决；使…下定决心；确定；判决，终止

examples.en: Investigators are still trying to determine the cause of the fire.
examples.zh: 调查人员仍在设法弄清失火的原因。

words.definition: spoken or written in secret and intended to be kept secret; classified, secret
words.translation: 机密的；[管理]机密的；表示信任的；获信任的

examples.en: a confidential government report
examples.zh: 一份机密的政府报告

examples.en: Doctors are required to keep patients’ records completely confidential .
examples.zh: 医生必须对病人的病历完全保密。

examples.en: The information will be regarded as strictly confidential (= completely confidential ) .
examples.zh: 这一信息将被视为绝对机密。

words.definition: the subjects that are taught by a school, college etc, or the things that are studied in a particular subject
words.translation: 课程

examples.en: Languages are an essential part of the school curriculum.
examples.zh: 语言是学校课程中必不可少的部分。

examples.en: curriculum planning
examples.zh: 课程安排

words.definition: a restaurant, often in a factory, college etc, where you choose from foods that have already been cooked and carry your own food to a table; self-service restaurant
words.translation: 自助餐厅

examples.en: the school cafeteria
examples.zh: 学校餐厅

words.definition: to make something look neater by cutting small pieces off it; shear, arrange, crop; cut to the bone, cut down to; status, shear, regularity; ordered, regular, straight, soigne
words.translation: 修剪；整理；装点；削减；整齐；情形；整齐的

examples.en: Pete was trimming the lawn around the roses.
examples.zh: 皮特在修剪玫瑰丛周围的草坪。

examples.en: I have my hair trimmed every six weeks.
examples.zh: 我每六周剪一次头发。

words.definition: to officially force someone to leave a school or organization; remove, oust
words.translation: 开除，驱逐；驱逐；开除

examples.en: More than five-thousand high school students have been expelled for cheating.
examples.zh: 五千多名中学生因考试作弊而被开除。

words.definition: When a substance is refined, it is made pure by having all other substances removed from it; improve, polish up
words.translation: 精炼；使……文雅；精炼，提纯；改善；使…文雅

examples.en: Oil is refined to remove naturally occurring impurities.
examples.zh: 油经过提炼去除天然生成的杂质。

words.definition: the act of killing yourself; Dutch act, self-destruction; self-destruct; kill oneself, take one's own life
words.translation: 自杀；自杀行为；自杀者；自杀的

examples.en: More people commit suicide at Christmas than at any other time.
examples.zh: 圣诞节期间自杀的人比其他任何时候都多。

examples.en: My mother attempted suicide on many occasions.
examples.zh: 我母亲多次试图自杀。

examples.en: He apparently left a suicide note (= letter explaining his reasons for killing himself ) on his desk.
examples.zh: 他显然在桌上留了封绝笔信。

words.definition: manual work involves using your hands or your physical strength rather than your mind; handmade, mechanic; guide, handbook, notebook
words.translation: 手工的；体力的；手册，指南

examples.en: People in manual occupations have a lower life expectancy.
examples.zh: 干体力活的人预期寿命较短。

words.definition: relating to the alphabet; abecedarian
words.translation: 按字母表顺序的；字母的；[计]依字母顺序的

examples.en: The files are arranged in alphabetical order .
examples.zh: 这些文件按字母顺序排列。

words.definition: if a plant or a flower blooms, its flowers appear or open; youth, flower, green; flower; blossom out, come into blossom
words.translation: 开花，茂盛；[植]花；青春；旺盛；使开花；使茂盛；开花；茂盛

examples.en: The roses bloom every few days.
examples.zh: 玫瑰每隔几天开花。

examples.en: These dots were markers that enabled them to measure every change in the size and shape of the flower as it went from bud to bloom.
examples.zh: 这些点作为记号可以使他们测量到百合花从花蕾到开花过程中大小和形状的每一次变化。

words.definition: a substance that is put on the soil to make plants grow; manure
words.translation: 肥料；[肥料]肥料；受精媒介物；促进发展者

examples.en: ...farming without any purchased chemical, fertilizer or pesticide.
examples.zh: …不使用任何购买的化学品、肥料或杀虫剂的耕作。

words.definition: a piece of farm equipment used to turn over the earth so that seeds can be planted; till, plow; open circuit, clear the way for; cultivated land, arable land
words.translation: 犁；[农机]犁；耕；用犁耕田；开路；耕地（等于plow）

examples.en: There are new tractors and new ploughs in the machinery lot.
examples.zh: 机器设备场里有新拖拉机和新耕犁。

words.definition: if a group or organization affiliates to or with another larger one, it forms a close connection with it; associated company; receive, take on sb; participate in, take part in, go through
words.translation: 使隶属于；联号；隶属的机构等；使附属；接纳；使紧密联系；参加，加入；发生联系

examples.en: He wanted to affiliate with a U.S. firm because he needed expert advice in legal affairs.
examples.zh: 他想成为一家美国公司的会员，因为他需要法律事务方面的专家意见。

words.definition: dangerous, especially to people’s health or safety; risky, jeopardous
words.translation: 危险的；有危险的；冒险的；碰运气的

examples.en: the disposal of hazardous waste
examples.zh: 有害废弃物的处理

words.definition: happening immediately; momentary, flashy
words.translation: 即时的，瞬间的；瞬间的；即时的；猝发的

examples.en: modern methods of instantaneous communication
examples.zh: 现代的即时通信方法

words.definition: being part of the nature or character of someone or something; essential, inherent, interior, constitutional
words.translation: 本质的，固有的；[物][生物]本质的，固有的

examples.en: the intrinsic interest of the subject
examples.zh: 该话题本身的趣味

words.definition: a statement that seems impossible because it contains two opposing ideas that are both true
words.translation: 悖论

examples.en: The paradox is that fishermen would catch more fish if they fished less.
examples.zh: 悖论就是: 如果渔夫减少捕鱼，反而会打到更多的鱼。

words.definition: feeling that you want to thank someone because of something kind that they have done, or showing this feeling; pleasant, lovely, thankful
words.translation: 感激的；感谢的；令人愉快的，宜人的

examples.en: Our grateful thanks go to all who participated.
examples.zh: 我们衷心感谢所有参与者。

examples.en: She gave me a grateful look.
examples.zh: 她感激地看了我一眼。

words.definition: to make small changes to something in order to improve it and make it more suitable or effective; alter, dizen; alter, touch up
words.translation: 改变；修改，修饰；更改；修改

examples.en: The feedback will be used to modify the course for next year.
examples.zh: 这些反馈意见将用于修改明年的课程。

examples.en: The regulations can only be modified by a special committee.
examples.zh: 这些法规只能由特别委员会来修改。

words.definition: agreement about something; grant, comply, engage; agreement, accordance, unity, identity, yes
words.translation: 同意；赞成；答应；（意见等的）一致

examples.en: The chairman was elected by common consent (= with most people agreeing ) .
examples.zh: 主席是大家一致推选出来的。

examples.en: divorce by mutual consent
examples.zh: 双方均同意的离婚

words.definition: an intuitive idea is based on a feeling rather than on knowledge or facts; instinctive, presentative
words.translation: 直觉的；[心理]直觉的；凭直觉获知的

examples.en: He seemed to have an intuitive awareness of how I felt.
examples.zh: 他好像凭直觉就知道我的感受。

words.definition: a set of poles and boards that are built into a structure for workers to stand on when they are working on the outside of a building; false work, lding
words.translation: 脚手架；搭脚手架的材料

examples.en: Workers have erected scaffolding around the base of the tower below the roadway.
examples.zh: 工人们已经在车行道下的塔基四周竖起了脚手架。

words.definition: to be more successful than someone or something else; overcome, exceed, cap, transcend
words.translation: 胜过；做得比……好

examples.en: Stocks generally outperform other investments.
examples.zh: 股票总体上要优于其他投资。

words.definition: If you can discern something, you are aware of it and know what it is; recognize, identify; see clearly, tell from
words.translation: 识别；领悟，认识；看清楚，辨别

examples.en: You need a long series of data to be able to discern such a trend.
examples.zh: 你需要一大串数据才能认清这一趋势。

words.definition: a problem or complaint that a person or organization brings to a court of law to be settled; litigation, suit, law
words.translation: 诉讼；诉讼（尤指非刑事案件）；诉讼案件

examples.en: The dispute culminated last week in a lawsuit against the government.
examples.zh: 这场针对政府诉讼案的争论在上星期达到了高潮。

words.definition: an official decision, especially one made by a court; popular, widespread, primary, major, central; governance, disposal, dominance
words.translation: 裁定；统治的；主要的；支配的；流行的，普遍的；统治，支配

examples.en: Goodwin tried to have the court ruling overturned.
examples.zh: 古德温试图推翻法院的裁决。

words.definition: to choose someone or something for a particular job or purpose; specify, ticket, name, appoint; assigned, named, appointed
words.translation: 指定，委派；指定；指派；标出；把…定名为；指定的；选定的

examples.en: Some of the rooms were designated as offices.
examples.zh: 其中一些房间是被指定用作办公室的。

words.definition: approval, holding, support, authorization, adhesion
words.translation: 支持；认可，支持；[金融]背书；签注（文件）

examples.en: There should be no suggestion of endorsement of the product or the company by WHO.
examples.zh: 世卫组织不得对任何产品或公司提供支持建议。

words.definition: food or drink that is tasteless is unpleasant because it has no particular taste; milk-and-water, flavourless
words.translation: 没有味道的；[食品]无味的；无鉴赏力的

examples.en: a tasteless outfit
examples.zh: 一套没有品位的衣服

words.definition: extremely clever or skilful; excellent, prominent, outstanding, splendid, gorgeous
words.translation: 才华横溢的；极好的；灿烂的，闪耀的；杰出的；有才气的

examples.en: I think that’s a brilliant idea .
examples.zh: 我觉得那是个绝妙的主意。

examples.en: a brilliant performance
examples.zh: 精湛的演出

examples.en: a brilliant young musician
examples.zh: 一位才华横溢的年轻音乐家

words.definition: cloth used for making clothes, curtains etc; cloth, organization, formation, construction, textile
words.translation: 布料；[纺]织物；布；组织；构造；建筑物

examples.en: our new range of fabrics and wallpapers
examples.zh: 我们新的织物和墙纸系列

words.definition: teaching or relating to the skills you need to do a particular job; professional, occupational
words.translation: 职业的；职业的，行业的

examples.en: vocational qualifications
examples.zh: 职业资格

words.definition: the skill or work of a carpenter; woodware
words.translation: 木工业；木器；木工手艺；[木]木工业

examples.en: The carpentry and soldier demand constraints are similar.
examples.zh: 木工和士兵的需求约束是类似的。

examples.en: Oh wait, that is for carpentry, but nonetheless it works here as well!
examples.zh: 哦，等等，这是对木工而言的！ 没错，但是它在这里也很适用！

examples.en: A train requires 1 hour of finishing labor and 1 hour of carpentry labor.
examples.zh: 一辆火车需要 1 小时的修整工劳动和 1 小时的木工劳动。

words.definition: to let fresh air into a room, building etc; air, bill
words.translation: 使通风；给…装通风设备；宣布

examples.en: Ventilate the room properly when stripping paint.
examples.zh: 在刮漆的时候要适当地使房间通风。

words.definition: to be a very good example of an idea or quality; objectify, reify
words.translation: 体现；体现，使具体化；具体表达

examples.en: She embodies everything I admire in a teacher.
examples.zh: 她具备了我所钦佩的教师该具备的一切素质。

words.definition: something that is tedious continues for a long time and is not interesting; dreary, dreich
words.translation: 冗长的；沉闷的；冗长乏味的

examples.en: The work was tiring and tedious.
examples.zh: 这工作既累人又枯燥。

words.definition: the process of taking away an amount from a total, or the amount that is taken away; conclusion, consequence
words.translation: 扣款；[会计]扣除，减除；[数]推论；减除额

examples.en: After deductions for tax etc, your salary is about £700 a month.
examples.zh: 扣除税款等之后，你的月薪大约有700英镑。

words.definition: if a price or amount fluctuates, it keeps changing and becoming higher and lower; wave motion, shake; destabilize
words.translation: 波动；涨落；动摇；使波动；使动摇

examples.en: Insect populations fluctuate wildly from year to year.
examples.zh: 昆虫的数量每年变化很大。

words.definition: contemporaneously, synchronously
words.translation: 同步地，同时地；同时地

examples.en: If they have multiple test cases that will be run on the same platforms, they can select multiple configurations simultaneously and apply the configurations to several of them in batch mode.
examples.zh: 如果他们拥有多个将要运行在同一个平台上的测试用例的话，那么他们能够同时选择多个配置，并且将这些配置批量应用到平台上。

words.definition: a job or activity in which you make things with your hands, and that you usually need skill to do; to make something using a special skill, especially with your hands; technology, hand, ship, workmanship
words.translation: 手艺；精巧地制作；工艺；太空船

examples.en: traditional rural crafts
examples.zh: 传统的乡村手工艺

examples.en: arts and crafts
examples.zh: 手工艺

words.definition: To facilitate an action or process, especially one that you would like to happen, means to make it easier or more likely to happen; promote, boost, further
words.translation: 使便利；促进；帮助；使容易

examples.en: The new airport will facilitate the development of tourism.
examples.zh: 新机场将促进旅游业的发展。

words.definition: to become worse; go ill, change for the worse; go ill, exasperate
words.translation: 恶化；恶化，变坏

examples.en: Ethel’s health has deteriorated.
examples.zh: 埃塞尔的健康状况恶化了。

examples.en: America’s deteriorating economy
examples.zh: 美国日渐恶化的经济

words.definition: to make something happen faster or sooner; crowd, soup; hurry up, get a move on
words.translation: 加速；使赶紧；催促；赶快；急忙

examples.en: Their departure was hastened by an abnormally cold winter.
examples.zh: 那个冬天异常寒冷，所以他们提前走了。

words.definition: to limit all or most of your study, business etc to a particular subject or activity; specialise in, elaborate on; technicalize, elaborate on
words.translation: 专业从事；专门从事；详细说明；特化；使专门化；使适应特殊情况

words.definition: release, emancipation
words.translation: 解放；释放，解放

examples.en: They pant after liberation.
examples.zh: 他们渴望解放。

examples.en: All his life was submerged in the liberation of the people.
examples.zh: 他的一生全部献身于人民的解放事业。

examples.en: They consecrated their lives to the liberation of their motherland.
examples.zh: 他们把生命献给了祖国的解放事业。

words.definition: when someone tries to get, achieve, or find something in a determined way; profession, employment, career, calling, job
words.translation: 追求；追赶，追求；职业，工作

examples.en: The quarterback sprinted toward the end zone with Jansen in hot pursuit (= following closely behind ) .
examples.zh: 那名四分卫快速冲向底线区，詹森穷追不舍。

words.definition: to complain or say that you are disappointed about something; regret; sigh, suspire
words.translation: 抱怨；惋惜；为…恸哭；叹息

examples.en: He was bemoaning the fact that lawyers charge so much.
examples.zh: 他抱怨律师收费太高。

words.definition: if an animal or plant evolves, it changes gradually over a long period of time; go way, to develop; grow, expand, advance
words.translation: 进化；发展，进化；使逐步形成；推断出；发展，进展；逐步形成

examples.en: Animals have evolved camouflage to protect themselves from predators.
examples.zh: 动物进化形成了伪装，以保护自身不被捕食性动物所捕食。

words.definition: smoothly, glibly
words.translation: 流利地；通畅地

examples.en: She can speak English fluently.
examples.zh: 她能流利地说英语。

examples.en: I can't speak English fluently as I am out of practice.
examples.zh: 我不能流利地说英语， 因为我已荒疏了。

examples.en: We should train our students to speak English fluently and accurately.
examples.zh: 我们应培养学生流利而准确地讲英语。

words.definition: a short piece of writing about a particular subject, that is done at school; synthetic, songwriting
words.translation: 作文；作文，作曲；[材]构成；合成物

examples.en: I had to write a composition about the Royal visit.
examples.zh: 我得写一篇关于皇室出访的作文。

words.definition: the literal meaning of a word or expression is its basic or original meaning; written, word-for-word
words.translation: 字面的；文字的；逐字的；无夸张的

examples.en: In many cases, the people there are fighting, in a literal sense, for their homes.
examples.zh: 多数情况下，那里的人们实际上都是在为他们的家园而战斗。

words.definition: an honorary title, rank, or university degree is given to someone as an honour; laureate
words.translation: 荣誉的；名誉的；道义上的

examples.en: Brown received an honorary doctorate from Seoul University.
examples.zh: 布朗获得了首尔大学的荣誉博士学位。

words.definition: to throw something with a lot of force, especially because you are angry; let drop
words.translation: 猛投；丢下；用力投掷；愤慨地说出

examples.en: Demonstrators were hurling bricks through the windows.
examples.zh: 示威者在向窗里掷砖块。

examples.en: He hurled a chair across the set, smashing lamps and vases.
examples.zh: 他抓起一把椅子扔向片场的那头，把灯和花瓶都砸得粉碎。

words.definition: to officially give someone a title etc, especially as a reward for something they have achieved; afford, award, allow, grant, deal; arrange, treat
words.translation: 授予；给予；协商

examples.en: The constitution also confers large powers on Brazil's 25 constituent states.
examples.zh: 宪法还授予巴西25个成员州极大的权力。

words.definition: arrantly
words.translation: 臭名昭著地；众所周知地；声名狼藉地；恶名昭彰地

examples.en: Derrida famously, notoriously, said "there is nothing outside the text," right? What he meant by that, of course, is that there's nothing but text.
examples.zh: 德里达著名地，恶名昭彰地，说道，文本之外什么都没有“,是吧，当然，他意思就是说，需要考虑的只有文本。

words.definition: verification, confirmation, authorization
words.translation: 证实；[数]确认；批准；生效

examples.en: In this example, the validation fails.
examples.zh: 在这个示例中，验证失败。

examples.en: In the next tip in this series, we'll examine the other side of validation: exception handling.
examples.zh: 在本系列的下一篇技巧文章中，我们将研究验证的另一方面：异常处理。

words.definition: to risk losing or spoiling something important; harm, compromise
words.translation: 危害，危及；危害；使陷危地；使受危困

examples.en: large-scale military offensives which could jeopardize the UN peace process
examples.zh: 可能会破坏联合国和平进程的大规模军事进攻

words.definition: used when reporting something that people say is true, although it has not been proved
words.translation: 据说

examples.en: a sports car, allegedly stolen in Manchester
examples.zh: 据说是在曼彻斯特被偷的一辆跑车

words.definition: using a lot of energy and strength or determination; male, live, energetic, mighty
words.translation: 积极的；精力充沛的；有力的

examples.en: Your dog needs at least 20 minutes of vigorous exercise every day.
examples.zh: 你的狗每天需要进行至少20分钟的剧烈运动。

examples.en: Environmentalists have begun a vigorous campaign to oppose nuclear dumping in the area.
examples.zh: 环保人士已经发动了一场积极的运动，反对在该地区倾倒核废物。

examples.en: a vigorous debate
examples.zh: 一场激烈的辩论

words.definition: a copy of a valuable object, painting etc that is intended to deceive people
words.translation: 假货

examples.en: The painting was judged a fake.
examples.zh: 这幅画被鉴定为赝品。

examples.en: Jones can spot a fake from 20 feet away.
examples.zh: 琼斯在20英尺开外就能认出假货。

words.definition: someone who competes in a contest; competitor, rival
words.translation: 参赛者；竞争者；争辩者

examples.en: Later he applied to be a contestant on the television show.
examples.zh: 之后他报了名做该电视秀的参赛者。

words.definition: an article on a particular subject or by a particular writer that appears regularly in a newspaper or magazine; pillar, tier
words.translation: 专栏；纵队，[数]列；圆柱，柱形物

examples.en: He writes a weekly column for ‘The Times’.
examples.zh: 他每周为《泰晤士报》写一篇专栏文章。

words.definition: done in a hurry, especially with bad results; brief, rushed
words.translation: 匆忙的；轻率的；草率的；性怠的

examples.en: He soon regretted his hasty decision.
examples.zh: 他很快就对自己仓促作出的决定感到后悔了。

examples.en: a hasty breakfast
examples.zh: 匆忙吃下的一顿早餐

words.definition: to stay somewhere a little longer, especially because you do not want to leave; hang about, wander about; spend, while away
words.translation: 逗留，徘徊；徘徊；苟延残喘；磨蹭；消磨；缓慢度过

examples.en: I spent a week at Kandersteg and could happily have lingered on.
examples.zh: 我在坎德施泰格逗留了一个星期，本来还可以开开心心地多待几天。

words.definition: money, property etc that you receive from someone who has died; heritage, legacy
words.translation: 继承；遗产；[法]继承；[遗]遗传

examples.en: Lucinda has to fight for her life and her inheritance in this gripping novel.
examples.zh: 在这部扣人心弦的小说里，露辛达不得不为自己的生命与所继承的遗产进行抗争。

words.definition: relating to ordinary life rather than  spiritual  or religious ideas; lay, mundane; mundanely, carnally
words.translation: 世间的，尘世的；世俗的；世间的；尘世的；世俗地；世故地

examples.en: He seemed very calm and far removed from worldly concerns.
examples.zh: 他显得非常淡定，完全没有俗世的忧虑。

words.definition: the length, height, width, depth, or  diameter  of something; measurement, size
words.translation: 尺寸；维；[数]维；次元；容积

examples.en: a rectangle with the dimensions 5cm × 2cm
examples.zh: 长五厘米、宽两厘米的长方形

words.definition: someone who is eligible for something is able or allowed to do it, for example because they are the right age; qualified, applicable, becoming, shaped, likely; acceptee
words.translation: 适合的；胜任的；合格的，合适的；符合条件的；有资格当选的；合格者；适任者；有资格者

examples.en: Stephen was regarded as an eligible bachelor.
examples.zh: 斯蒂芬被认为是一个钻石王老五。

words.definition: continuing to exist for a long time or for all the time in the future; eternal, constant, steady, lasting, perpetual
words.translation: 永久的；永久的，永恒的；不变的

examples.en: He gave up a permanent job in order to freelance.
examples.zh: 他放弃了固定工作，为的是当一名自由职业者。

examples.en: a permanent change in your eating habits
examples.zh: 饮食习惯的永久改变

examples.en: The blindness that the disease causes will be permanent.
examples.zh: 这种疾病引起的失明是永久性的。

words.definition: to learn words, music etc so that you know them perfectly; retain, keep in mind
words.translation: 熟记；记住，背熟；记忆

examples.en: He studied his map, trying to memorize the way to Rose's street.
examples.zh: 他研究了地图，努力记住去罗丝家那条街的路。

words.definition: a judgment about how good, useful, or successful something is; appraisal, valuation, assessment, estimate, judgement
words.translation: 评价；[审计]评估；估价；求值

examples.en: We need to carry out a proper evaluation of the new system.
examples.zh: 我们要对新系统进行合理的评估。

examples.en: They took some samples of products for evaluation.
examples.zh: 他们抽取了一些产品样本以作评估。

words.translation: 教育；文化

words.definition: an enviable quality, position, or possession is good and other people would like to have it
words.translation: 值得羡慕的

examples.en: Now he was in the enviable position of not having to work for a living.
examples.zh: 现在他已不必为生计而工作，着实令人羡慕。

words.definition: involving two political parties, especially parties with opposing views
words.translation: 两党的

examples.en: a bipartisan committee
examples.zh: 一个由两党代表组成的委员会

words.definition: to correct or make small changes to something that is written or spoken; modify, to make better; go straight, straighten up
words.translation: 修订；修改；改善，改进；改正，改善；改过自新

examples.en: The law was amended to include women.
examples.zh: 该法律经修改把女性也包括在内。

examples.en: The defendant later amended his evidence.
examples.zh: 被告后来修改了证词。

examples.en: ‘Steve stole it – or rather borrowed it,’ he amended.
examples.zh: “史蒂夫偷的——应该说是借的。”他改口道。

words.definition: to translate spoken words from one language into another; say, bring sb to do sth; account, translate
words.translation: 解释；口译；说明；翻译

examples.en: They spoke good Spanish, and promised to interpret for me.
examples.zh: 他们西班牙语说得很好，答应替我翻译。

words.definition: to find information, especially on a computer; make use of, fashion, employ, border, exercise; opening, admittance
words.translation: 取得，获取；使用；[计]存取；接近；进入；使用权；[电]通路

examples.en: Users can access their voice mail remotely.
examples.zh: 用户可以远程获取语音邮件。

words.definition: If you champion a person, a cause, or a principle, you support or defend them; title, first; encourage, second, back, carry, hand; classical, royal
words.translation: 支持，拥护；冠军；拥护者；战士；支持；拥护；优胜的；第一流的

examples.en: He passionately championed the poor.
examples.zh: 他曾热情地捍卫穷人。

words.definition: to sail along a river or other area of water; man, drive, guide; put, sail
words.translation: 航行，驾驶；驾驶，操纵；使通过；航行于；航行，航空

examples.en: The river is too dangerous to navigate.
examples.zh: 这河道太危险，不适宜航行。

words.definition: if two things intertwine, or if they are intertwined, they are twisted together（; ply with, keep at; wind, pursue
words.translation: 交织，纠缠；纠缠；编结；缠绕

examples.en: Their destinies are intertwined.
examples.zh: 他们的命运交织在一起。

words.definition: to work together with a person or group in order to achieve something, especially in science or art; team, work together
words.translation: 合作；勾结，通敌

examples.en: Much later he collaborated with his son Michael on the English translation of a text on food production.
examples.zh: 后来他和儿子迈克尔合作，把一个有关食品生产的文本翻译成英语。

words.definition: to judge how good, useful, or successful something is; value, score, rate, prize; to assess, to appraise
words.translation: 评价；估价；求…的值

examples.en: You should be able to evaluate your own work.
examples.zh: 你应该能够评估自己的工作。

examples.en: We need to evaluate the success of the campaign.
examples.zh: 我们要评估一下这次运动是否成功。

examples.en: It can be difficult to evaluate the effectiveness of different treatments.
examples.zh: 要对各种治疗方法的效果作出评估会很难。

words.definition: an area of activity, interest, or knowledge, especially one that a particular person, organization etc deals with; province, territory, world, industry, kingdom, universe, field
words.translation: 领域；域名；产业；地产

examples.en: Looking after the house was viewed as a woman’s domain.
examples.zh: 料理家务被认为是女性的份内之事。

words.definition: to gradually get more and more money, possessions, knowledge etc over a period of time; store up; scrape up
words.translation: 积累；累积；积聚；积攒

examples.en: It is unjust that a privileged few should continue to accumulate wealth.
examples.zh: 少数特权阶级继续积聚财富，这是不公平的。

words.definition: continuing to exist or happen, especially for longer than is usual or desirable; fixed, consistent, set
words.translation: 坚持不懈的，持续的；固执的，坚持的；持久稳固的

examples.en: persistent rumours
examples.zh: 持续流传的谣言

examples.en: persistent headaches
examples.zh: 持续头疼

examples.en: a persistent problem
examples.zh: 长期问题

words.definition: to talk too proudly about your abilities, achievements, or possessions; braggadocio, self-praise; blow one's own born, blow one's own trumpet, blow one's own horn
words.translation: 自夸；值得夸耀的事物，引以为荣的事物；自吹自擂

examples.en: ‘I wouldn’t be afraid,’ she boasted.
examples.zh: “我才不怕呢。”她吹嘘道。

words.definition: to think that something is true, although you do not have definite proof; undertake, adopt, accept, shoulder, sustain; attitudinize, put on the dog
words.translation: 假定，认为；承担；假定；采取；呈现；装腔作势；多管闲事

examples.en: I think we can safely assume (=  it is almost certain  ) that interest rates will go up again soon.
examples.zh: 我想我们几乎可以肯定，利率很快会再次上调。

examples.en: When it got to midnight and Paul was still not back, I began to assume the worst (=  think that the worst possible thing had happened  ) .
examples.zh: 到午夜时保罗还没回来，我就开始往最坏的地方想了。

words.definition: a forthcoming event, meeting etc is one that has been planned to happen soon; upcoming, imminent; oncoming
words.translation: 即将来临的；来临

examples.en: the forthcoming elections
examples.zh: 即将到来的选举

examples.en: Keep an eye on the noticeboards for forthcoming events .
examples.zh: 请注意布告牌上的活动预告。

words.definition: enigmatically, uncannily
words.translation: 神秘地；故弄玄虚地；难以理解地

examples.en: So what can we do to get more of this marvelous, mysteriously restorative sleep stage?
examples.zh: 那么，我们能做些什么才能恢复这个奇妙而神秘的恢复性睡眠阶段？

examples.en: The animal was heavier than Gerard had expected, shifting its weight mysteriously from one corner of the box to another as he carried it out into the snow and set it on the seat beside him.
examples.zh: 这个动物要比杰拉德想象的要重些，当勃兹曼顶着雪走出来并把它放在杰拉德座位旁边时，箱子里动物的重量神秘的从箱子的一角偏向另一角。

words.definition: to give a child everything they want, or let them do whatever they want, often with the result that they behave badly; harry, dote upon; prey upon, take a turn for the worse; prize, award, inferior
words.translation: 溺爱；糟蹋；掠夺；变坏；腐败；次品；奖品

examples.en: She’s an only child, but they didn’t really spoil her.
examples.zh: 她是独生女，不过他们也没有娇惯她。

examples.en: His mother and sisters spoil him rotten (= spoil him very much ) .
examples.zh: 他母亲和姐姐把他给宠坏了。

words.definition: someone or something that emphasizes the good qualities of another person or thing; make up a loss, make sth up
words.translation: 补充；补足，补助

examples.en: The green wallpaper is the perfect complement to the old pine of the dresser.
examples.zh: 绿色墙纸是旧松木梳妆台的完美衬托。

words.translation: 沉浸的，身临其境的

words.definition: related to the process of knowing, understanding, and learning something; recognitive, epistemic
words.translation: 认知的；认知的，认识的

examples.en: cognitive psychology
examples.zh: 认知心理学

words.definition: a question that you ask as a way of making a statement, without expecting an answer; theatrical, hyperbolic
words.translation: 修辞的；修辞学的；夸张的

examples.en: a speech full of rhetorical phrases
examples.zh: 充满华丽辞藻的演讲

words.definition: to damage something or make it not as good as it should be; hurt, break, blast
words.translation: 损害；削弱；减少

examples.en: The illness had impaired his ability to think and concentrate.
examples.zh: 这种疾病损害了他的思维能力和注意力。

words.definition: having enough skill or knowledge to do something to a satisfactory standard; able, capable, efficient, sufficient, adequate
words.translation: 能胜任的，有能力的；胜任的；有能力的；能干的；足够的

examples.en: A competent mechanic should be able to fix the problem.
examples.zh: 一名合格的机修工应该能够解决这个问题。

words.definition: to gradually make someone or something less strong or effective; destroy, founder
words.translation: 暗中削弱；破坏，渐渐破坏；挖掘地基

examples.en: economic policies that threaten to undermine the health care system
examples.zh: 可能会损害医疗保健制度的经济政策

words.definition: variance, disparity
words.translation: 不兼容；[免疫][数]不相容；不协调；不一致

examples.en: A standardized programming model should be introduced to avoid technology incompatibility problems.
examples.zh: 应该引入标准化编程模型来避免技术不兼容性问题。

examples.en: In a time when there is so much dispute about the compatibility or incompatibility of science with religion, it may be a good idea to revisit what Newton and Einstein had to say about God.
examples.zh: 在这个科学与宗教到底相容还是不相容众说纷纭的时候 还是让我们重新审视一下牛顿和爱因斯坦怎么说主吧。

examples.en: A major number indicates a potential incompatibility between library versions.
examples.zh: 主版本号表明程序库版本之间的潜在不兼容性。

words.definition: seeming to have a particular quality, although this is not true or real; surface, external, facial, shallow; person, garment
words.translation: 表面的；肤浅的；表面文章；外表；浅薄的人

examples.en: Beneath his refined manners and superficial elegance lay something treacherous.
examples.zh: 在他温文尔雅、貌似高贵的举止下隐藏着某种奸诈。

words.definition: to put someone or something in danger of being hurt, damaged, or destroyed; jeopard, imperil
words.translation: 使……危险；危及；使遭到危险

examples.en: Smoking during pregnancy endangers your baby’s life.
examples.zh: 孕期吸烟会危及胎儿生命。

words.definition: something that people do often, especially a particular way of doing something or a social or religious custom; tradition, convention, usage, exercise; exercise, bring to pass; execute, exercise
words.translation: 做法；实践；练习；惯例；[劳经]实习；实行

examples.en: religious beliefs and practices
examples.zh: 宗教信仰和习俗

examples.en: dangerous working practices
examples.zh: 危险的工作方法

words.definition: to discover the meaning of a message written in a  code (= a set of secret signs or letters ); encode
words.translation: 解码；[计][通信]译码，解码

examples.en: The software decodes the information embedded in the satellite broadcasts.
examples.zh: 这种软件能够解读衞星广播中的信息。

words.definition: the process of entering another country in order to live there permanently; settling, transmigration
words.translation: 移民；外来移民；移居

examples.en: He called for a common European policy on immigration.
examples.zh: 他要求欧洲国家实施共同的移民政策。

words.definition: an inescapable fact or situation is one that you cannot avoid or ignore; inevitable, unavoidable, unescapable
words.translation: 不可避免的；逃脱不了的

examples.en: She didn’t want to confront the inescapable fact that she would have to sell the house.
examples.zh: 她不想面对必须卖掉房子这一无法逃避的事实。

examples.en: The inescapable conclusion is that he was murdered by someone in his own family.
examples.zh: 必然的结论就是: 他是被自己的家人谋杀的。

words.definition: completely – used especially to emphasize that something is very bad, or that a feeling is very strong; totally, entirely, completely, absolutely, thoroughly, fully, strictly
words.translation: 完全地，彻底地；完全地；绝对地；全然地；彻底地，十足地

examples.en: You look utterly miserable.
examples.zh: 你看起来很痛苦。

words.definition: not living; dead, lifeless
words.translation: 无生命的；[医]无生命的；无生气的

examples.en: an inanimate object
examples.zh: 无生命的物体

words.definition: irreversible damage, change etc is so serious or so great that you cannot change something back to how it was before; non-reversible, nonreversing
words.translation: 不可逆的；不可取消的；不能取消的；不能翻转的

examples.en: Fossil fuels have caused irreversible damage to the environment.
examples.zh: 矿物燃料已对环境造成了不可挽回的破坏。

words.definition: too great to be calculated; thousand, million, countless, infinite, innumerable
words.translation: 不可估量的，无法计算的；无数的；不可计算的；不可预料的

examples.en: Her contribution to our work is incalculable.
examples.zh: 她对我们工作的贡献极大。

words.definition: to move up and down as you move forward, especially in a vehicle; tumor, knub; hit, impact on, crash; to run into, to hit; suddenly, heavily, strong, sharp, hard
words.translation: 颠簸；肿块，隆起物；撞击；碰撞，撞击；颠簸而行；碰，撞；突然地，猛烈地

examples.en: A police car bumped down the track.
examples.zh: 一辆警车颠簸着行驶在小路上。

words.definition: an event at which a large group of people meet to protest or to support something in public; authentication, certification, proof, evidence, march
words.translation: 展示；游行；示范；证明；示威游行

examples.en: Supporters staged a demonstration outside the US embassy.
examples.zh: 支持者在美国大使馆外举行了示威游行。

examples.en: Police opened fire on a peaceful demonstration.
examples.zh: 警察朝和平示威的人群开了枪。

words.definition: to leave someone or something and no longer help or support them; yield, quit; run out on, walk out on; sands, wold; wild, hungry
words.translation: 放弃，抛弃；遗弃；放弃；逃跑；开小差；逃掉；[地理]沙漠；[农]荒原；应得的赏罚；[地理]沙漠的；荒凉的；不毛的

examples.en: Helen was deserted by her husband.
examples.zh: 海伦被丈夫遗弃了。

examples.en: Many of the party’s traditional voters deserted it at the last election.
examples.zh: 许多长期支持该党的选民在上一次选举中抛弃了它。

examples.en: The price rise caused many readers to desert the magazine.
examples.zh: 价格上涨导致许多读者放弃了这本杂志。

words.definition: a place where criminals are kept as part of their punishment, or where people who have been charged with a crime are kept before they are judged in a law court; prison, big house; prison, imprison
words.translation: 监狱；[法]监狱；监牢；拘留所；监禁；下狱

examples.en: He’s been in jail for three months already.
examples.zh: 他已经入狱三个月。

words.definition: comfortable, pleasant, easy
words.translation: 舒适的；舒适的，惬意的

examples.en: Come over to the fire and cozy up a bit.
examples.zh: 到火炉这边来会感到舒适一点。

examples.en: “It is extremely expensive, but at least I have a cozy bed, ” he said.
examples.zh: 他说：“这房子真是太贵了，但至少我有一张舒适的床了。”

words.definition: a public room in a hotel or other building, that is used by many people as a place to relax; retiring room, lobby; lig, knock around; hack around, fiddle around
words.translation: 休息室；[建]休息室；闲逛；躺椅；（英）酒吧间；懒洋洋地躺卧；闲混；虚度光阴

examples.en: the television lounge
examples.zh: 电视放映室

words.definition: to admire and love someone very much; respect, church, praise, exercise; honor, love, regard; go to church
words.translation: 崇拜，喜爱；崇拜；礼拜；尊敬；爱慕；拜神；做礼拜

examples.en: He absolutely worships her.
examples.zh: 他太崇拜她了。

words.definition: feeling ill when you travel in a boat, because of the movement of the boat in the water
words.translation: 晕船的

examples.en: It was quite rough at times, and she was seasick.
examples.zh: 海上有时波涛汹涌，她就晕船。

words.definition: influence in, meddle in; impact, collide with
words.translation: 干涉，妨碍；干涉；妨碍；打扰；冲突；介入

examples.en: Don't interfere in other's private concerns.
examples.zh: 不要干涉别人的私事。

examples.en: When others interfere, it always makes trouble.
examples.zh: 别人一干涉， 麻烦就来了。

words.definition: a nervous worried feeling that makes it impossible for you to relax; strain, intensity, stress; stress, wind up
words.translation: 紧张；张力，拉力；紧张，不安；电压；使紧张；使拉紧

examples.en: The tension was becoming unbearable, and I wanted to scream.
examples.zh: 这种紧张变得难以忍受，我真想大声尖叫。

words.definition: when something changes from one form or state to another; conversion, switching, changing
words.translation: 过渡；转变；[分子生物]转换；变调

examples.en: Making the transition from youth to adulthood can be very painful.
examples.zh: 从青少年过渡到成年有时是一个非常痛苦的过程。

examples.en: a society that is in transition
examples.zh: 一个正在转型的社会

examples.en: the period of transition to full democracy
examples.zh: 向全面民主的过渡时期

words.definition: unexpectedly, fortuitously
words.translation: 偶然地，意外地；意外地；偶然地

examples.en: She accidentally erased the tape.
examples.zh: 她意外地抹去了录了音的磁带。

words.definition: a lot of physical or mental effort; effort, use, trial, pain, struggle
words.translation: 运用；发挥；努力

examples.en: The afternoon’s exertions had left us feeling exhausted.
examples.zh: 下午太劳累了，我们感到精疲力竭。

examples.en: mental exertion
examples.zh: 费心思

words.definition: to give information, knowledge, wisdom etc to someone; afford, allow, deal, reveal, extend
words.translation: 传授，教授；给予（尤指抽象事物），传授；告知，透露

examples.en: She had information that she couldn’t wait to impart.
examples.zh: 她得到了消息，迫不及待地想告诉别人。

words.definition: to cause a reaction or feeling, especially a sudden one; fan, egg, anger
words.translation: 激怒；驱使；煽动；惹起

examples.en: The novel has provoked fierce debate in the US.
examples.zh: 那部小说在美国引发了激烈的争论。

words.definition: something that you think is true although you have no definite proof; conception, perhaps, if
words.translation: 假设；假定；设想；担任；采取

examples.en: You would be making an assumption that's not based on any fact that you could report.
examples.zh: 你会做出不以你能报道的任何事实为依据的一种假设。

words.definition: a series of numbers or letters that represent a mathematical or scientific rule; criterion, expressions
words.translation: 公式；[数]公式，准则；[化工]配方；婴儿食品

examples.en: the formula for calculating distance
examples.zh: 计算距离的公式

examples.en: Sugar is represented by the simple formula CHO.
examples.zh: 糖以简单的分子式CHO表示。

words.definition: If one thing overlaps another, or if you overlap them, a part of the first thing occupies the same area as a part of the other thing. You can also say that two things overlap.; repeat, segistration
words.translation: 重叠；重复

examples.en: When the bag is folded, the bottom overlaps one side.
examples.zh: 把包折叠起来时，其底部与一边就重合了。

examples.en: Overlap the slices carefully so there are no gaps.
examples.zh: 把薄片小心地叠放在一起，那样就没有间隙。

words.definition: to become very successful or very strong and healthy; succeed, flower
words.translation: 繁荣，兴旺；茁壮成长

examples.en: plants that thrive in tropical rain forests
examples.zh: 在热带雨林蓬勃生长的植物

examples.en: a business which managed to thrive during a recession
examples.zh: 在经济萧条时期也能顺利发展的一家企业

words.definition: a chronic disease or illness is one that continues for a long time and cannot be cured; long time, standing, extended
words.translation: 长期的；慢性的；[医]慢性的；习惯性的

examples.en: chronic arthritis
examples.zh: 慢性关节炎

examples.en: chronic asthma
examples.zh: 慢性哮喘

examples.en: chronic heart disease
examples.zh: 慢性心脏病

words.definition: a situation in which you have a lot of problems that seem to be caused by bad luck; disaster, tragedy, evil, grief
words.translation: 逆境；不幸；灾难；灾祸

examples.en: his courage in the face of adversity
examples.zh: 他面对逆境的勇气

words.definition: to be in a difficult or painful situation for a long time without complaining; resist, tough, abide; resist, abide
words.translation: 忍受；忍耐；容忍；持续

examples.en: It seemed impossible that anyone could endure such pain.
examples.zh: 似乎谁都不可能忍受这样的疼痛。

words.definition: to state firmly that something is true; maintain, say, submit, stay, advocate
words.translation: 主张，断言；维护，坚持；断言；主张；声称

examples.en: French cooking, she asserted, is the best in the world.
examples.zh: 她坚称法国菜是世界上最好的。

words.definition: to bite food several times before swallowing it; mastication, quid; masticate; consider, pore, reflect
words.translation: 咀嚼；深思；咀嚼物；嚼碎，咀嚼；细想，深思

examples.en: This meat’s so tough I can hardly chew it!
examples.zh: 这肉太老了，我几乎嚼不动！

words.definition: truck, weigh
words.translation: 权衡，交易；权衡；折衷；（公平）交易（等于trade-off）

examples.en: However, these elements of risk can be mitigated by spending more effort developing the queries; as with many development options, there is a tradeoff between query complexity and query stability.
examples.zh: 但是，可以多花些精力来开发查询，从而减轻这些风险元素；正如许多开发选择一样，在查询的复杂性与查询的稳定性之间会有一个权衡。

words.definition: someone who knows a lot about a particular subject, and who writes about it or discusses it on the television or radio; news analyst, narrator
words.translation: 评论员；评论员，解说员；实况播音员；时事评论者

examples.en: political commentators
examples.zh: 政治评论员

words.definition: a bad habit; defect, deficiency, fault, disadvantage, abuse; in place of, in stead of; vise; deputy, auxiliary
words.translation: 恶意，恶习；恶习；缺点；[机]老虎钳；卖淫；代替；钳住；副的；代替的

examples.en: Smoking is my only vice.
examples.zh: 吸烟是我唯一的恶习。

words.definition: If you attribute something to an event or situation, you think that it was caused by that event or situation; particularity, idiosyncracy; ascribe to
words.translation: 归因于；属性；特质；归属；把…归于

examples.en: Women tend to attribute their success to external causes such as luck.
examples.zh: 女性往往把她们的成功归因于外因，如运气。

words.definition: vivid memories, dreams, descriptions etc are so clear that they seem real; telling, live, bright
words.translation: 生动的；鲜明的；鲜艳的

examples.en: I’ve got vivid memories of that summer.
examples.zh: 我对那年夏天记忆犹新。

examples.en: He had a vivid picture of her in his mind.
examples.zh: 他的脑海中清晰地留着她的形象。

words.definition: to make a computer, machine, or piece of software better and able to do more things; promote, prefer; rise, raise, updates, ascension; upward, up
words.translation: 升级；[计]使升级；提升；改良品种；[计]升级；上升；上坡；向上的

examples.en: Helicopters have been upgraded and modernized.
examples.zh: 直升机已经升级并且装上现代化设备。

words.definition: You use prospective to describe someone who wants to be the thing mentioned or who is likely to be the thing mentioned; expected, due, future; outlook, expectation
words.translation: 未来的，预期的；未来的；预期的；预期；展望

examples.en: The story should act as a warning to other prospective buyers.
examples.zh: 这篇报道应该可以对其他可能的购买者起到警告作用。

words.definition: a particular system - used especially when talking about a previous system, or one that has just been introduced; government, power
words.translation: 制度，管理体制；政权，政体；社会制度；管理体制

examples.en: The authorities moved him to the less rigid regime of an open prison.
examples.zh: 当局把他移送到管理相对宽松的不设防监狱。

words.definition: an urgent request for something important; attract, clamour for; asking, request, motion, charm
words.translation: 请求，呼吁, 上诉；呼吁，恳求；[法]上诉；诉诸，求助；有吸引力，迎合爱好；（体育比赛中）诉诸裁判；呼吁，请求；吸引力，感染力；诉诸裁判

examples.en: The girl’s family have made a public appeal for help to try and catch her killer.
examples.zh: 那名遇害女孩的家人吁请公众协助捉拿凶手。

words.definition: to make cloth, a carpet, a basket etc by crossing threads or thin pieces under and over each other by hand or on a loom; pleach, complect; cloth, web
words.translation: 织布，编织；[纺]编织；编排；使迂回前进；织物；[纺]织法；编织式样

examples.en: hand-woven scarves
examples.zh: 手织围巾

examples.en: Only a few of the women still weave.
examples.zh: 只有数量很少的妇女还在编织。

examples.en: traditional basket weaving
examples.zh: 传统的编篮技术

words.definition: to use a needle and thread to make or repair clothes or to fasten something such as a button to them; seam, oversew; needle work
words.translation: 缝上，缝纫；缝合，缝上；缝纫；缝纫，缝

examples.en: I learned to sew at school.
examples.zh: 我在学校学会了缝纫。

words.definition: a short sleep, especially during the day; beauty sleep, lie-down; caulk off, neglect of
words.translation: 小睡；小睡，打盹儿；细毛；孤注一掷；疏忽

examples.en: an afternoon nap
examples.zh: 午睡

words.definition: to make a boat move across water using  oar s; hong, range, line, rank, sound; boat, lock horns
words.translation: 划船；行，排；街道；吵闹；争吵

examples.en: Jenny used to row at college (= as a sport ) .
examples.zh: 珍妮以前在大学里经常参加划船运动。

words.definition: a type of aircraft with large metal blades on top which turn around very quickly to make it fly; copter, whirlybird, verticraft
words.translation: 直升飞机；[航]直升飞机

examples.en: You can helicopter to the island.
examples.zh: 你可以乘坐直升机去那个岛。

examples.en: The helicopter is staying over our heads.
examples.zh: 那架直升机就在我们头顶的上方。

examples.en: They were succoured from the fire by the rescue helicopter.
examples.zh: 他们被援救的直升机从大火中解救了出来。

words.definition: to get control of a country by fighting; defeat, master; overcome, win the day
words.translation: 征服；战胜，征服；攻克，攻取；胜利；得胜

examples.en: The Normans conquered England in 1066.
examples.zh: 诺曼人于 1066 年征服英格兰。

examples.en: Egypt was conquered by the Persian king Kambyses.
examples.zh: 埃及被波斯国王冈比西斯征服。

words.definition: a  memo; note, minute
words.translation: 备忘录；便笺

examples.en: ...a memorandum from the Department of Defense on its role.
examples.zh: …一份来自国防部的有关其角色的备忘录。

words.definition: the clarity of a piece of writing, law, argument etc is its quality of being expressed clearly; transparency, perspicuousness
words.translation: 清晰，清楚；清楚，明晰；[化学]透明

examples.en: Letters may be edited for length and clarity.
examples.zh: 信件可能要加以修改以求篇幅合适，意思明了。

examples.en: a lack of clarity in the law on property rights
examples.zh: 产权法律含糊不清

words.definition: someone whose job is making and repairing wooden objects; squareman, woodworker; to make
words.translation: 木匠；木匠，木工；制作

examples.en: He is a carpenter by profession.
examples.zh: 他以木工为业。

examples.en: At an early age, I was apprenticed to a carpenter.
examples.zh: 我小时候曾给木匠当过学徒。

examples.en: That carpenter wanted to become a lawyer， but he was advised to stick to his last.
examples.zh: 那个木匠想当律师， 但别人劝他安分守己地干他自己的老本行。

words.definition: someone who plays drums; travelling salesman, commercial traveler
words.translation: 鼓手；旅行推销员；跑街

examples.en: He was a drummer in a rock band.
examples.zh: 他是一支摇滚乐队的鼓手。

words.definition: the practice of treating one person or group differently from another in an unfair way; distinction, differentiation
words.translation: 歧视；区别，辨别；识别力

examples.en: laws to prevent discrimination
examples.zh: 防止歧视的法律

words.definition: not having enough knowledge or information; dark, empty, ignorant, innocent
words.translation: 无知的，未受过教育的；无知的；未被通知的；未受教育的；不学无术的

examples.en: Parents were left anxious, uninformed, and isolated.
examples.zh: 家长们忧心忡忡，不知道情况到底如何，感到孤立无援。

examples.en: uninformed criticism from uninformed journalists
examples.zh: 来自不了解情况的新闻记者的毫无根据的批评

words.definition: to give someone the official right to do or have something
words.translation: 使具有资格

examples.en: If the warranty is limited, the terms may entitle you to a replacement or refund.
examples.zh: 如果保修单有限制，这些条款可让你有权换货或退款。

words.definition: to copy the way someone behaves, speaks, moves etc, especially in order to make people laugh; simulate, model after
words.translation: 模仿；模仿，仿效；仿造，仿制

examples.en: She was a splendid mimic and loved to imitate Winston Churchill.
examples.zh: 她是个出色的模仿者，喜欢模仿温斯顿·丘吉尔。

words.definition: in a less important position than someone else; inferior, underling; dependent, secondary, supporting, minor, peripheral
words.translation: 次要的，从属的；下属，下级；部属，属下；从属的；次要的

examples.en: a subordinate officer
examples.zh: 下级官员

words.definition: to stop people from opposing the government, especially by using force; control, restrain, stay
words.translation: 镇压，压制；抑制；镇压；废止

examples.en: The uprising was ruthlessly suppressed.
examples.zh: 起义受到了残酷的镇压。

words.definition: the position and power of being a king or queen; emperor, crown, sovereignty
words.translation: 王位；王座；君主；王权

examples.en: He is next in line to the throne (= will become king when the present ruler dies ) .
examples.zh: 他是第一王位继承人。

examples.en: In 1913, George V was on the throne (= was ruling ) .
examples.zh: 1913年乔治五世在位。

words.definition: sports such as running and jumping
words.translation: 体育运动

examples.en: ...students who play intercollegiate athletics.
examples.zh: …参加大学校际体育运动的学生们。

words.definition: someone who trains a person or team in a sport; drilling, mentors; discipline, supervise
words.translation: 教练；旅客车厢；[车辆]长途公车；四轮大马车；训练；指导

examples.en: a tennis coach
examples.zh: 网球教练

examples.en: the Norwegian national coach
examples.zh: 挪威国家队教练

words.definition: the variety of plants and animals in a particular place; biological diversity
words.translation: 生物多样性；[生物]生物多样性

examples.en: the biodiversity of the rainforest
examples.zh: 热带雨林中的生物多样性

words.definition: if a room, building etc can accommodate a particular number of people or things, it has enough space for them; adapt, contain, suit, accept, serve; adjust, adapt to something
words.translation: 适应，容纳；容纳；使适应；供应；调解；适应

examples.en: He bought a huge house to accommodate his library.
examples.zh: 他买了一座大房子来放他的藏书。

examples.en: The ballroom can accommodate 400 people.
examples.zh: 那个舞厅可容纳400人。

words.definition: someone’s ultimate aim is their main and most important aim, that they hope to achieve in the future; final, organic, fundamental, radical, underlying; telos, fundamental principle
words.translation: 最终的；[物]极限的；根本的；终极；根本；基本原则

examples.en: The ultimate outcome of the experiment cannot be predicted.
examples.zh: 试验的最后结果无法预测。

words.definition: an invasive disease spreads quickly and is difficult to stop; aggressive, attacking
words.translation: 入侵的；侵略性的；攻击性的

examples.en: invasive bladder cancers
examples.zh: 扩散性膀胱癌

words.definition: to emphasize the fact that something is important or true; emphasize, stress, highlight; bobbin thread, bottom-line
words.translation: 强调；划线于…下；底线，[计]下划线

examples.en: The Labour Department figures underscore the shaky state of the economic recovery.
examples.zh: 劳工部的数字突出显示了经济复苏的不稳定。

words.definition: continuing, or continuing to develop; advancing, unremitting, uninterrupted; behavior, dealing, advancement, going, progress
words.translation: 持续的，不间断的；不间断的，进行的；前进的；前进；行为，举止

examples.en: their ongoing search for a new director
examples.zh: 他们仍在寻找一个新主任

examples.en: ongoing negotiations
examples.zh: 还在进行的谈判

examples.en: The discussions are still ongoing.
examples.zh: 讨论仍在继续。

words.definition: always wanting more food, money, power, possessions etc than you need; eager, hungry, anxious, desired, sick
words.translation: 贪婪的；贪吃的；渴望的

examples.en: a greedy and selfish society
examples.zh: 一个贪婪自私的社会

examples.en: He looked at the gold with greedy eyes.
examples.zh: 他贪婪地看着这些金子。

examples.en: Have you eaten them all, you greedy pig?
examples.zh: 你把那些全吃了？你这贪吃的猪！

words.definition: to become smaller in size, importance, or value, or make something do this; to cut down, fall off
words.translation: 减少；减轻；变小

examples.en: Gradually her anxiety lessened.
examples.zh: 她的焦虑慢慢减轻了。

words.definition: if you incur a cost, debt, or a fine, you have to pay money because of something you have done; invite, court, secure, spell, trigger
words.translation: 引起，导致；招致，引发；蒙受

examples.en: And operational downtime caused by reliability or performance problems can incur opportunity costs if customers are unable to access your system or the business is unable to do its work.
examples.zh: 并且如果顾客不能访问你的系统或业务不能进行工作，那么由可靠性或性能问题引起的运作停工就会招致机会成本。

words.definition: Something that is an integral part of something is an essential part of that thing; whole, complete, full, intact; proportion, part, portion, percent, fraction
words.translation: 完整的；[数]积分的；完整的，整体的；[数]积分；部分；完整

examples.en: Rituals, celebrations, and festivals form an integral part of every human society.
examples.zh: 仪式、庆典和节日是每个人类社会不可缺少的组成部分。

words.definition: to combine, or to join things together to form one thing; conflate, incorporate with; incorporate with, coalesce
words.translation: 合并；使合并；吞没；融合

examples.en: The company plans to merge its subsidiaries in the US.
examples.zh: 该公司计划合并其在美国的几家子公司。

words.definition: inadvertently
words.translation: 无意地；非故意地；非存心地

examples.en: I brushed up against him unintentionally.
examples.zh: 我无意中碰了他一下。

examples.en: But then there are the things he taught me unintentionally, like when he arrived home from work for the last time and crawled up the stairs.
examples.zh: 但后来有些事情发生了，那些他无意中教我的事情，就如当他最后一次下班回家爬上楼梯的情景。

examples.en: In fact, before I even start building the project, all unit tests are run to ensure that the integrity of the application code has not been unintentionally compromised.
examples.zh: 实际上，在我每次开始构建项目之前，都将运行所有的单元测试，以确保应用程序代码的完整性没遭到无意破坏。

words.definition: grave problems, situations, or worries are very great or bad; important, serious, significant, great, cracking; death, end; brand, heart, engrave
words.translation: 严重的；重大的；严肃的；黯淡的；墓穴，坟墓；死亡；雕刻；铭记

examples.en: Matthew’s life is in grave danger .
examples.zh: 马修的生命危在旦夕。

examples.en: The report expressed grave concern over the technicians’ lack of training.
examples.zh: 报告中对技术人员缺乏培训深表忧虑。

examples.en: I have grave doubts about his ability.
examples.zh: 我十分怀疑他的能力。

words.definition: having an extremely close friendship; private, close, perfect, chamber; confidant, alter ego; bill, message
words.translation: 亲密的；私人的；精通的；有性关系的；知己；至交；暗示；通知；宣布

examples.en: an intimate friend of Picasso’s
examples.zh: 毕加索的一个密友

examples.en: an intimate relationship
examples.zh: 亲密的关系

examples.en: She’s on intimate terms with people in government.
examples.zh: 她与政府官员关系密切。

words.definition: to make something less painful or difficult to deal with; moderate, relax
words.translation: 减轻，缓解；减轻，缓和

examples.en: measures to alleviate poverty
examples.zh: 扶贫措施

words.definition: very easy to notice; obvious, prominent, marked, noted, outstanding
words.translation: 显著的；显而易见的

examples.en: The notice must be displayed in a conspicuous place.
examples.zh: 通告一定要贴在显眼的地方。

examples.en: a bird with conspicuous white markings
examples.zh: 一种长有醒目白斑的鸟

examples.en: I felt very conspicuous in my red coat.
examples.zh: 我穿着红外套，感觉自己十分显眼。

words.definition: land that is owned or controlled by a particular country, ruler, or military force; domain, province, world, extent, boundary, region, kingdom
words.translation: 领域，领土；领土，领域；范围；地域；[地理]版图

examples.en: Hong Kong is a Chinese territory.
examples.zh: 香港是中国的领土。

words.definition: to take the place or position of something or someone; shift, replace by
words.translation: 取代；置换；转移；把…免职；排水

examples.en: Coal has been displaced by natural gas as a major source of energy.
examples.zh: 作为一种主要能源，煤的地位已为天然气所取代。

examples.en: immigrants who displace US workers in the job market
examples.zh: 在就业市场上取代美国工人的移民

words.definition: irregardless
words.translation: 不管，不顾；不管；不顾；不注意

examples.en: The fields give high and stable yields regardless of climatic circumstances.
examples.zh: 不管天气条件如何， 这块地总是保持稳产高产。

examples.en: The new tax laws were rammed through regardless of the opposition of the majority of the people.
examples.zh: 不顾大多数人民的反对，新的税法强行通过了。

words.definition: If you say that there has been duplication of something, you mean that someone has done a task unnecessarily because it has already been done before; reproduction, repeat, replication
words.translation: 复制品；[印刷][遗]复制；副本；成倍

examples.en: There could be a serious loss of efficiency through unnecessary duplication of resources.
examples.zh: 不必要的资源重复会导致严重的效率损耗。

words.definition: if you overturn something, or if it overturns, it turns upside down or falls over on its side; destroy, throw down; tip, throw down; capsizal, turn-round
words.translation: 推翻；倾覆；破坏；周转；破灭

examples.en: Leslie jumped to her feet, overturning her chair.
examples.zh: 莱斯莉一跃而起，碰倒了椅子。

examples.en: His car overturned, trapping him inside.
examples.zh: 他的汽车发生侧翻，把他困在了里面。

words.definition: exactly the same, or very similar; self, same
words.translation: 相同的；[数]同一的；完全相同的

examples.en: four identical houses
examples.zh: 四幢一模一样的房子

words.definition: much smaller than normal; petty, small-scale; contracted drawing, microcosm
words.translation: 微型的；微型的，小规模的；缩图；微型画；微型图画绘画术

examples.en: miniature roses
examples.zh: 微型玫瑰

examples.en: a miniature railway
examples.zh: 微型铁路

examples.en: He looked like a miniature version of his father.
examples.zh: 他看上去像是他父亲的微缩版。

words.definition: something that is tempting seems very good and you would like to have it or do it; attractive, absorbing; enticing
words.translation: 吸引人的；诱惑人的；引诱（tempt的ing形式）

examples.en: a tempting job offer
examples.zh: 一个诱人的工作机会

examples.en: That pie looks tempting.
examples.zh: 那馅饼看上去很诱人。

words.definition: when people of different races, sexes, or religions are kept apart so that they live, work, or study separately; separation, insulation, isolation
words.translation: 隔离；隔离，[遗]分离；种族隔离

examples.en: The Supreme Court unanimously ruled that racial segregation in schools was unconstitutional.
examples.zh: 最高法院一致裁定学校实施的种族隔离措施违反宪法。

words.definition: the amount by which two or more things are different or by which they change; differentiation, shift, change, diversification, turn
words.translation: 不同；[生物]变异；变化；不一致；分歧；[数]方差

examples.en: a price variance of 5%
examples.zh: 5%的价格差异

words.definition: If you refer to someone's inaction, you disapprove of the fact that they are doing nothing; inertia, dullness
words.translation: 不作为；不活动；迟钝

examples.en: He is bitter about the inaction of the other political parties.
examples.zh: 他为其他政党的不作为感到愤愤不平。

words.definition: to protect something and prevent it from changing or being damaged; save, hold; confiture, glazed fruit
words.translation: 保留，保护；保存；将…做成蜜饯；使守恒；果酱；蜜饯

examples.en: We must conserve our woodlands for future generations.
examples.zh: 我们必须为子孙后代保护林地。

examples.en: efforts to conserve fish stocks
examples.zh: 保护鱼类资源的努力

words.definition: if an agreement or official document is renewable, you can make it continue for a further period of time after it ends; reproducible, updatable
words.translation: 可再生的；可更新的；可继续的

examples.en: It’s a six-month lease but it’s renewable.
examples.zh: 租期六个月，但是可以续签。

examples.en: a renewable visa
examples.zh: 可延期的签证

words.definition: to eagerly accept a new idea, opinion, religion etc; involve, contain; hug, cuddle; hug
words.translation: 采纳，接受；拥抱；信奉，皈依；包含

examples.en: We hope these regions will embrace democratic reforms.
examples.zh: 我们希望这些地区会乐意接受民主改革。

examples.en: Most West European countries have embraced the concept of high-speed rail networks with enthusiasm.
examples.zh: 大多数西欧国家都表现出极大的兴趣，欣然接受修建高速铁路网的想法。

words.definition: Someone's or something's counterpart is another person or thing that has a similar function or position in a different place; repeat, coppy
words.translation: 对等物；副本；配对物；极相似的人或物

examples.en: As soon as he heard what was afoot, he telephoned his German and Italian counterparts to protest.
examples.zh: 他一听到在进行中的事，马上就给德国和意大利相应人员打电话抗议。

words.definition: a person, group, or organization that you compete with in sport, business, a fight etc; equal, comparative, opponent, match, adversary; match, compete against; contest, cope, struggle to; competitive, vying
words.translation: 对手；[劳经]竞争者；与…竞争；比得上某人；[劳经]竞争；[劳经]竞争的

examples.en: This gives the company a competitive advantage over its rivals.
examples.zh: 这使该公司与其对手相比具有一项竞争优势。

examples.en: He finished 39 seconds ahead of his main rival .
examples.zh: 他比主要对手早39秒到达终点。

examples.en: She was 2 minutes faster than her nearest rival .
examples.zh: 她比紧随其后的对手快两分钟。

words.definition: having a very strong effect or felt very strongly; burning, stressed, sharp, warm, hot
words.translation: 激烈的，强烈的；强烈的；紧张的；非常的；热情的

examples.en: Young people today are under intense pressure to succeed.
examples.zh: 如今的年轻人面临要出人头地的巨大压力。

examples.en: the intense heat of the desert
examples.zh: 沙漠的炽热

examples.en: The pain was so intense I couldn’t sleep.
examples.zh: 疼得我都睡不着觉。

words.definition: having a strong desire to have or achieve something; coveted
words.translation: 渴望的；有雄心壮志的；（生活形态等）梦寐以求的

examples.en: aspirational young women
examples.zh: 有抱负的年轻女性

words.definition: to completely change the appearance, form, or character of something or someone, especially in a way that improves it; influence, fashion, vary, innovate; veer from, to change
words.translation: 转变；改变，使…变形；转换；[数][电]变换，改变；转化

examples.en: Increased population has transformed the landscape.
examples.zh: 人口的增加使景观发生了变化。

words.definition: the way you hold something tightly, or your ability to do this; governance, disposal, purchase, handle, ruling; squeeze, clamp; clutch at, take hold
words.translation: 抓住；紧握；柄；手提包；支配；夹紧

examples.en: Hold the microphone in a firm grip and keep it still.
examples.zh: 紧紧握住麦克风不要让它动。

examples.en: She felt her wrist caught in a vice-like grip .
examples.zh: 她觉得手腕像是卡在铁钳里被牢牢地抓住了。

examples.en: Don’t loosen your grip on the rope or you’ll fall.
examples.zh: 抓住绳索别松手，不然你会掉下去。

words.definition: if a story unfolds, or if someone unfolds it, it is told; crack, assume, open up; expand, develop
words.translation: 展开；打开；呈现；显露

examples.en: As the story unfolds, we learn more about Max’s childhood.
examples.zh: 随着故事的展开，我们对马克斯的童年有了更多的了解。

words.definition: based on strong beliefs or ideas, especially political or economic ideas; think, ideaistic
words.translation: 意识形态的；思想的

examples.en: The party is split by ideological differences.
examples.zh: 意识形态上的差异造成该政党分裂。

words.definition: to remove unwanted substances from water, air etc by passing it through a special substance or piece of equipment; sink in, seep into; strainer, percolator; penetrate, lauter
words.translation: 过滤；滤过；渗入；慢慢传开；[电子][光]滤波器；[轻][核][化工]过滤器；筛选；滤光器；[轻][核][化工]过滤；渗透；用过滤法除去

examples.en: The water in the tank is constantly filtered.
examples.zh: 鱼缸里的水在不停地被过滤。

examples.en: The ozone layer filters harmful UV rays from the sun.
examples.zh: 臭氧层过滤掉有害的太阳紫外线。

words.definition: a word that is used instead of a noun or noun phrase, such as ‘he’ instead of ‘Peter’ or ‘the man’
words.translation: 代词

examples.en: Now if we could only figure out the pronoun problem.
examples.zh: 现在我们可以解决这个代词问题了。

words.definition: the study of the nature and meaning of existence, truth, good and evil, etc; Weltbild, Anschauung
words.translation: 哲学；哲理；人生观

examples.en: Emma studies philosophy at university.
examples.zh: 埃玛在大学攻读哲学。

words.definition: to make something much clearer and easier to understand; say, lamp, elucidate, clarify; light up, to shine
words.translation: 阐释，阐明；阐明，说明；照亮；使灿烂；用灯装饰

examples.en: The report illuminated the difficult issues at the heart of science policy.
examples.zh: 报告阐明了科学方针核心部分的难点。

words.definition: how likely it is that something will or will not happen; distinction, differential, contrast
words.translation: 可能性；几率；胜算；不平等；差别

examples.en: (= it is likely ) that he will commit the same crime again.
examples.zh: 他可能还会犯同样的罪行。

examples.en: (= how likely is it ) that they will mess up?
examples.zh: 他们失败的可能性有多大？

examples.en: a new company that has beaten the odds and succeeded (= it was not likely to succeed, but it did )
examples.zh: 战胜逆境而取得成功的一家新公司

words.definition: to admit, especially to the police, that you have done something wrong or illegal; accept, recognize, agree, acknowledge, grant; accept, recognize
words.translation: 承认；坦白；忏悔；[法]供认

examples.en: Occasionally people confess to crimes they haven’t committed just to get attention.
examples.zh: 偶尔人们会承认自己并未犯过的罪行，那只是为了引人注意。

examples.en: Torture was used and Fian confessed.
examples.zh: 酷刑用过之后菲安就招供了。

words.definition: to make someone think and behave exactly as you want them to, by skilfully deceiving or influencing them; man, guide, work, handle
words.translation: 操纵；操作；巧妙地处理；篡改

examples.en: He was one of those men who manipulated people.
examples.zh: 他是那种要摆布别人的人。

examples.en: You have the constant feeling you are being manipulated.
examples.zh: 你总感觉自己是被人控制着的。

words.definition: a regular repeated pattern of sounds or movements; meter, cadence
words.translation: 节奏；韵律

examples.en: Drums are basic to African rhythm.
examples.zh: 非洲音乐节奏少不了鼓。

examples.en: complicated dance rhythms
examples.zh: 复杂的舞蹈节奏

words.definition: to use violence or threats to take control of a plane, vehicle, or ship; rob of, spoliate; chantage, extortion
words.translation: 劫持；抢劫；揩油；威逼；敲诈

examples.en: The airliner was hijacked by a group of terrorists.
examples.zh: 该航班被一帮恐怖分子劫持。

words.definition: to clean the dust, dirt etc from the floor or ground, using a brush with a long handle; clean off, broom; clean, do out; extent, boundary, region, spectrum, territory, area
words.translation: 扫除，清除；扫除；猛拉；掸去；扫，打扫；席卷；扫视；袭击；打扫，扫除；范围；全胜

examples.en: Bert swept the path in front of the house.
examples.zh: 伯特清扫了屋前的小路。

words.definition: to stop taking part in an activity, belonging to an organization etc, or to make someone do this; beat a retreat, bug out; leave, split
words.translation: 撤销，撤退；撤退；收回；撤消；拉开；离开

examples.en: calls for Britain to withdraw from the European Union
examples.zh: 要求英国退出欧盟的呼声

words.definition: hot bright burning gas that you see when something is on fire; passion, fire, warmth; set on fire
words.translation: 火焰；[化工]火焰；热情；光辉；焚烧；泛红

examples.en: Flames poured out of the windows of the building.
examples.zh: 火焰从大楼窗口冒出来。

examples.en: They rushed past us with buckets of water and tried to douse the flames .
examples.zh: 他们提着一桶桶水跑过我们身边去灭火。

examples.en: They sat around the campfire, watching the flickering flames .
examples.zh: 他们围坐在篝火旁，看着跳动的火焰。

words.definition: a very small piece of burning material produced by a fire or by hitting or rubbing two hard objects together; A FRAME, scintilla; stimulate, launch, lift, drive, spirit; offer, coruscate
words.translation: 火花；[电]火花；朝气；闪光；发动；鼓舞；求婚；闪烁；[电]发火花

examples.en: sparks from the fire
examples.zh: 火里飞出的火星

examples.en: The scrape of metal on metal sent up a shower of sparks .
examples.zh: 金属之间互相摩擦，迸出一串火星。

words.definition: possibility, probability, potential, maybe, chance
words.translation: 可行；可行性；可能性

examples.en: But this is only at an early stage of feasibility study.
examples.zh: 但是这仅仅处于可行性研究的初期阶段。

examples.en: We then know if the idea is worth taking on to the next stage which is the feasibility study.
examples.zh: 这样我们就会知道这个想法是否值得进行到下一步，也就是可行性研究。

examples.en: If you are planning any major changes in your business this year, you should also do a feasibility study.
examples.zh: 如果计划在今年对你的事业做出任何重大的改变，你也应该做一些可行性研究。

words.definition: If something fascinates you, it interests and delights you so much that your thoughts tend to concentrate on it; enthrall, beguile; be carried away
words.translation: 使着迷；使着迷，使神魂颠倒；入迷

examples.en: Politics fascinated Franklin's father.
