examples.zh: 政治让富兰克林的父亲着迷。

words.definition: all the people who work on a ship or plane; team, group, personnel, suit
words.translation: 机组人员；队，组；全体人员，全体船员

examples.en: The plane crashed, killing two of the crew and four passengers.
examples.zh: 飞机坠毁，造成两名机组人员和四名乘客死亡。

examples.en: a crew member
examples.zh: 一名机组人员

words.definition: increasing gradually as more of something is added or happens; accumulated
words.translation: 积累的；累积的

examples.en: Learning is a cumulative process.
examples.zh: 学习是个逐渐积累的过程。

words.definition: making you feel embarrassed so that you are not sure what to do or say; testing, embarrassed
words.translation: 尴尬的，棘手的，笨拙的；尴尬的；笨拙的；棘手的；不合适的

examples.en: I hoped he would stop asking awkward questions .
examples.zh: 我希望他不要再问令人难堪的问题。

examples.en: There was an awkward moment when she didn’t know whether to shake his hand or kiss his cheek.
examples.zh: 她不知道是该跟他握手还是亲他的脸颊，一时很尴尬。

examples.en: an awkward silence
examples.zh: 令人尴尬的沉默

words.definition: the state of not being known or remembered; nebulosity, shadowiness
words.translation: 默默无闻；朦胧；阴暗；晦涩；身份低微；不分明

examples.en: Now, on the eve of the bicentenary of the independence movements, he sets out to rescue San Martín from his relative obscurity.
examples.zh: 今天，在那场独立运动二百周年纪念前夕，他再度出手以挽救相对默默无闻的圣·马丁。

examples.en: At this time he knew nothing of Wells’s and Matthew’s accounts of natural selection; indeed, both accounts languished in obscurity until after the “Origin” was published.
examples.zh: 此时他对马修和威尔士关于自然选择的阐述一无所知；事实上，直到《物种的起源》发表这两人一直默默无闻。

examples.en: The obscurity of JTS is in some sense due to its own success: because it hides the details of transaction management so effectively, we don't hear or say very much about it.
examples.zh: 在某种意义上，JTS 的默默无闻恰恰是它的成功：因为它非常有效地隐藏了事务管理的很多细节，因此，我们没有听说过或者谈论过很多关于它的内容。

words.definition: a small piece of metal, cloth, or plastic with a picture or words on it, worn to show rank, membership of a group, support for a political idea etc; marks, bedge
words.translation: 标记, 徽章；[轻]徽章；证章；标记

examples.en: We were each handed a badge with our name on it.
examples.zh: 我们每个人都拿到一个徽章，上面有我们的名字。

words.definition: a clear difference or separation between two similar things; quality, identity, character, tang, discrimination
words.translation: 区分；区别；差别；特性；荣誉、勋章

examples.en: There are obvious distinctions between the two wine-making areas.
examples.zh: 这两个酿酒区之间有明显的不同。

words.definition: to develop something such as a plan or a set of rules, and decide all the details of how it will be done; programme, mark out
words.translation: 制定，规划；规划；用公式表示；明确地表达

examples.en: By visualizing where you want to be, you start helping your mind formulate ways to achieve that next goal in your life.
examples.zh: 通过把你想达到的程度形象化，你就开始帮助自己的头脑制定目标——为了达到你生活中的下一个目标。

examples.en: With so much content floating around these days, if you want your writing to be read then you've got to take up an interesting topic, thoughtfully formulate your thoughts, and back up your argument.
examples.zh: 每天面对这么多漂浮在你身边的信息和内容，如果您希望您的文字被别人阅读，那么你可要找一个有趣的话题，花店功夫制定您的想法，并支持你的论点。

words.definition: relating to money, especially all the money in a particular country; financial, fiscal
words.translation: 货币的；财政的

examples.en: the government’s tight monetary policy
examples.zh: 政府从紧的货币政策

examples.en: objects of little monetary value
examples.zh: 不值钱的物件

words.definition: to describe or show someone or something in a particular way, according to your opinion of them; represent, play, trace, figure
words.translation: 描述；描绘；扮演

examples.en: Romantic artists portrayed nature as wild and powerful.
examples.zh: 浪漫主义艺术家描绘的大自然是狂野而强大的。

examples.en: The President likes to portray himself as a friend of working people.
examples.zh: 总统喜欢以工薪阶层的朋友自居。

words.definition: when someone is unfriendly and full of anger towards another person; hatred, enmity
words.translation: 敌意；[心理]敌意；战争行动

examples.en: The last decade has witnessed a serious rise in the levels of racism and hostility to black and ethnic groups.
examples.zh: 过去的10年里，种族主义及对黑人和少数民族的敌意变得更加严重了。

words.definition: a robust person is strong and healthy; healthy, crude, gross, fine, rough
words.translation: 强健的；健康的；[生物]粗野的；粗鲁的

examples.en: a robust man of six feet four
examples.zh: 一个身高六英尺四英寸的壮汉

words.definition: the act of taking control of something without asking permission; grant, embezzlement
words.translation: 挪用；[财政]拨款

examples.en: Other charges include fraud and illegal appropriation of land.
examples.zh: 其他指控包括诈骗和非法占用土地。

words.definition: the cutting or burning down of all the trees in an area
words.translation: 砍伐森林

examples.en: the deforestation of the tropics
examples.zh: 热带森林的毁坏

words.definition: to confuse someone or make them feel slightly anxious because they do not understand something; baffle, discomfit; contemplate; enigma, difficult problem
words.translation: 迷惑；使…困惑；使…为难；苦思而得出；冥思苦想；谜；难题

examples.en: a question that continues to puzzle scientists
examples.zh: 一直困扰科学家的问题

examples.en: He was puzzled by the reactions to his remark.
examples.zh: 他对自己的话引起的反应感到困惑不解。

examples.en: What puzzles me is why his books are so popular.
examples.zh: 令我不解的是，他的书为什么如此受欢迎。

words.definition: when large numbers of people go to live in another area or country, especially in order to find work; removal, move, shift, motion, transplantation
words.translation: 迁徙，移居；[动][地质]迁移；移民；移动

examples.en: What does this migration not do?
examples.zh: 这种迁移不能做什么？

examples.en: Because of this and other differences in the two versions, we recommend that you test the maps after migration.
examples.zh: 由于这两个版本之间的种种差异，我们建议您在完成迁移后对映射进行测试。

words.definition: to limit something; chain, bound, force, provoke, enforce
words.translation: 限制；驱使；强迫；束缚

examples.en: Poor soil has constrained the level of crop production.
examples.zh: 贫瘠的土地限制了农作物的产量。

examples.en: Women’s employment opportunities are often severely constrained by family commitments.
examples.zh: 女性的就业机会常常受到家庭责任的严重限制。

words.definition: to go somewhere secretly and quietly in order to avoid being seen or heard; steal; informer, confidential informant; under-the-table
words.translation: 溜走；偷偷地做；偷偷取得；鬼鬼祟祟的人；偷偷摸摸的行为；告密者；暗中进行的

examples.en: Sometimes he would sneak out of his house late at night to be with me.
examples.zh: 有时候他会在深夜偷偷溜出他的家来陪伴我。

words.definition: the difference between what it costs a business to buy or produce something and what they sell it for; profit, gain, brink, suburb
words.translation: 利润；[心理]边缘；[会计]利润，余裕；[印刷]页边的空白

examples.en: Margins are low and many companies are struggling.
examples.zh: 利润很少，很多公司都在苦苦挣扎。

examples.en: Within 10 years they had a gross profit margin of 50%.
examples.zh: 10年里他们的毛利率达到了50%。

words.definition: the act of separating something into two or more different parts, or the way these parts are separated or shared; ministry, department, sector, segmentation, dom
words.translation: 分歧；师（军队）；[管理]部门；分割；[数]除法

examples.en: the traditional division of labour (= the way that particular tasks are shared ) between husband and wife
examples.zh: 夫妻之间传统的分工

words.definition: a special advantage that is given only to one person or group of people; franchise, peculiar
words.translation: 特权；[计]特权；优待；基本权利

examples.en: He had no special privileges and was treated just like every other prisoner.
examples.zh: 他不享受特权，待遇和任何其他犯人一样。

words.definition: relating to an empire or to the person who rules it; august, sovereign
words.translation: 帝国的；[纸]帝国的；皇帝的；至高无上的；威严的

examples.en: Britain’s imperial expansion in the 19th century
examples.zh: 19世纪英帝国的扩张

words.definition: fairness in the way people are treated; judge, right, judicature
words.translation: 公平；司法，法律制裁；正义；法官，[法]审判员

examples.en: Children have a strong sense of justice.
examples.zh: 儿童有很强的正义感。

examples.en: His people came to him demanding justice.
examples.zh: 他的手下来找他，寻求公正。

words.definition: someone who disagrees with a plan, idea, or system and wants to try to stop or change it; equal, anti, comparative, rival, match; contrary, adverse, against
words.translation: 反对者；对手；敌手；对立的；敌对的

examples.en: Norris twice knocked down his opponent in the early rounds of the fight.
examples.zh: 诺里斯在拳击赛的头几个回合中，曾两度击倒他的对手。

words.definition: to press something so hard that it breaks or is damaged; crunch, become deformed; pile, crowd, pack; compression, comminution
words.translation: 压碎，压榨；压碎；弄皱，变形；使…挤入；挤；被压碎；粉碎；迷恋；压榨；拥挤的人群

examples.en: His leg was crushed in the accident.
examples.zh: 他的腿在事故中被压断。

examples.en: Two people were crushed to death in the rush to escape.
examples.zh: 两个人在逃生过程中被踩死。

words.definition: to control and use the natural force or power of something; keep on top; saddlery, coat of mail
words.translation: 管理，控制；治理；套；驾驭；披上甲胄；马具；甲胄；挽具状带子；降落伞背带

examples.en: We can harness the power of the wind to generate electricity.
examples.zh: 我们可以利用风力发电。

words.definition: to have complete control over something so that other people cannot share it or take part in it; corner, forestall
words.translation: 垄断；独占；拥有…的专卖权

examples.en: The company has monopolized the soft drinks market.
examples.zh: 该公司垄断了软饮料市场。

examples.en: He monopolized the conversation all evening.
examples.zh: 整个晚上都是他一个人在说话。

words.definition: very big, fast, powerful etc; huge, enormous, massive, macro, vast
words.translation: 巨大的；极大的，巨大的；惊人的

examples.en: Suddenly, there was a tremendous bang, and the whole station shook.
examples.zh: 突然一声巨响，整个车站都晃动了。

examples.en: She was making a tremendous effort to appear calm.
examples.zh: 她竭力表现出平静的样子。

examples.en: She praised her husband for the tremendous support he had given her.
examples.zh: 她称赞丈夫给了她巨大支持。

words.definition: extremely important and necessary for something to succeed or exist; dynamic, life-or-death
words.translation: 重要的；至关重要的；生死攸关的；有活力的

examples.en: The work she does is absolutely vital.
examples.zh: 她所做的工作至关重要。

examples.en: It is vital to be honest with your children.
examples.zh: 对自己的孩子坦诚十分重要。

examples.en: The tourist industry is of vital importance to the national economy.
examples.zh: 旅游业对国家的经济至关重要。

words.definition: extremely important and needing to be done or dealt with immediately; necessary, urgent, essential, emergency, instant; necessity, instruction, need, request, order
words.translation: 必须的,必要的；必要的，势在必行的；命令的；紧急的；需要；命令；祈使语气；规则

examples.en: It is imperative that politicians should be good communicators.
examples.zh: 政治家应该是很好的沟通者，这很重要。

words.definition: happening at the beginning; premier, original
words.translation: 初步的，最初的；[数]最初的；字首的

examples.en: an initial investment of £5,000
examples.zh: 5,000英镑的初始投资

examples.en: The initial response has been encouraging.
examples.zh: 最初的反应情况很乐观。

words.definition: to take someone’s attention away from something by making them look at or listen to something else; shift, divert from
words.translation: 分心，分散注意；转移；分心

examples.en: Try not to distract the other students.
examples.zh: 尽量不要让其他学生分心。

words.definition: making you believe that something is true or right; persuasive, potent; defogging
words.translation: 令人信服的；有说服力的；使相信；使明白（convince的现在分词）

examples.en: convincing evidence of his guilt
examples.zh: 证明他有罪的有力证据

words.definition: to ask for information or advice from someone because it is their job to know something; look up, speak together; take advice, seek advice
words.translation: 咨询；查阅；商量；向…请教；请教；商议；当顾问

examples.en: If symptoms persist, consult a doctor without delay.
examples.zh: 如果症状持续的话，马上咨询医生。

words.definition: very severe pain; unhappiness, vexation
words.translation: 痛苦；苦恼；极大的痛苦；临死的挣扎

examples.en: the agony of arthritis
examples.zh: 关节炎的剧烈疼痛

words.definition: to not do something that you want to do; deny oneself, forbear from; repeat, iteration
words.translation: 抑制，避免；节制，克制；避免；制止；叠句，副歌；重复

examples.en: Although I advise that you refrain from decoding XML documents with ad hoc routines, I have no qualms about writing.
examples.zh: 虽然我建议您避免使用特殊的例程解码 XML 文档，但是对于写入 XML 没有这样的疑虑。

words.definition: interesting and exciting; exciting, infusive
words.translation: 令人兴奋的；毛骨悚然的；颤动的

examples.en: a thrilling 3-2 victory
examples.zh: 比分为3比2的激动人心的胜利

words.definition: precociously
words.translation: 早熟地，过早地；过早地；早熟地

examples.en: That causes your test to terminate prematurely, too, of course.
examples.zh: 当然，那也将导致你的测试过早地终止。

examples.en: Yet as any programmer knows, it would be a mistake to optimise prematurely.
examples.zh: 正如任何程序员所知道的那样，过早地优化可能是一个错误。

words.definition: careful to do everything that it is your job or duty to do; serious, earnest
words.translation: 有良心的，认真负责的；认真的；尽责的；本着良心的；小心谨慎的

examples.en: A conscientious teacher may feel inclined to take work home.
examples.zh: 一个认真负责的教师可能会想着把工作带回家去做。

examples.en: a conscientious and hard-working student
examples.zh: 勤勉刻苦的学生

words.definition: to involve something as a necessary part or result; charge, inflict on
words.translation: 使需要，使必须；必需，使承担；限定继承

examples.en: A new computer system entails a lot of re-training.
examples.zh: 使用新的计算机系统需要大量的再培训。

examples.en: Some foreign travel is entailed in the job.
examples.zh: 做这份工作有时要到国外出差。

words.definition: to illegally copy something, especially something printed or written, to make people think that it is real; furnace, smelter; trump up, to fake; doctor, trump up
words.translation: 铸造；伪造；熔炉，锻铁炉；铁工厂；做锻工；[机]锻造

examples.en: Someone stole my credit card and forged my signature.
examples.zh: 有人偷了我的信用卡，并假冒我的签名。

examples.en: a forged passport
examples.zh: 假护照

words.definition: to talk about something in a way that makes it seem more important, serious etc than it really is; put it on, pile it on
words.translation: 夸张；夸大的叙述

examples.en: To say that all motorists speed in residential areas is overstating the case.
examples.zh: 说所有驾驶员都在住宅区内超速行驶是言过其实了。

examples.en: The importance of a child’s early years cannot be overstated (= is very important ).
examples.zh: 儿童幼年期的重要性怎么强调也不为过。

words.definition: responsible for the effects of your actions and willing to explain or be criticized for them; responsible, liable
words.translation: 应负责的，有责任的；有责任的；有解释义务的；可解释的

examples.en: The hospital should be held accountable for the quality of care it gives.
examples.zh: 医院应当对医护质量负责。

words.definition: expecting that bad things will happen in the future or that something will have a bad result; world-weary, futilitarian
words.translation: 悲观的；悲观的，厌世的；悲观主义的

examples.en: a pessimistic view of life
examples.zh: 对人生的悲观看法

words.definition: after an event in the past; after, since
words.translation: 随后；随后，其后；后来

examples.en: The book was subsequently translated into 15 languages.
examples.zh: 该书后来被译成 15 种语言。

examples.en: Subsequently, the company filed for bankruptcy.
examples.zh: 随后，该公司申请了破产。

words.definition: chop, cab; rent, lease out; chop
words.translation: 黑客攻击；砍，劈；出租马车；砍；出租

words.definition: legal responsibility for something, especially for paying money that is owed, or for damage or injury; duty, debt, tendency, burden, trust
words.translation: 责任；债务；[法][经]责任；倾向

examples.en: The company had assets of $138 million and liabilities of $120.5 million.
examples.zh: 该公司有1.38亿美元资产和1.205亿美元的负债。

words.definition: when you change something from one form, purpose, or system to a different one; transformation, reforming, switching, exchange, changing
words.translation: 转变；转换；变换；[金融]兑换；改变信仰

examples.en: ...the conversion of disused rail lines into cycle routes.
examples.zh: …把废弃的铁路改变成自行车道。

words.definition: a very thin, pointed steel tube at the end of a syringe, which is pushed into your skin to put a drug or medicine into your body or to take out blood; stimulus, incentive, index, finger, excitement; sew; stimulate, fan, motivate, activate
words.translation: 指针，针；[轻]针；指针；刺激；针状物；缝纫；做针线；用针缝

examples.en: She carried hypodermic needles and syringes in her bag.
examples.zh: 她包里带着皮下注射针和针筒。

examples.en: Drug users are at risk when they share needles.
examples.zh: 吸毒者共用注射针很危险。

words.definition: corruption, regression, degradation
words.translation: 恶化，退化；恶化；[生物]退化；堕落

examples.en: A reading over 50 indicates an expansion of activity in the manufacturing sector, while one below 50 suggests a deterioration.
examples.zh: 这一指数高于50表明制造业处于扩张状态，低于50时则反映制造业状况在恶化。

examples.en: But underlying inflationary pressure is still extremely weak and is likely to remain so, particularly given the rapid and ongoing deterioration in the labour market.
examples.zh: 但潜在的通胀压力仍是非常微弱，特别是考虑到迅速而持续恶化的就业市场，这种状况很可能会持续下去。

words.definition: if something bad that has happened is your fault, you should be blamed for it, because you made a mistake or failed to do something; error, deficiency, defect, mistake, trouble; mistake, err in; carp at, trip up
words.translation: 过失；故障；[地质]断层；错误；缺点；毛病；（网球等）发球失误；弄错；产生断层；（通常用于疑问句或否定句）挑剔

examples.en: I’m really sorry - it’s all my fault.
examples.zh: 我真的很抱歉——都是我的错。

examples.en: I didn’t sleep well that night, but it was my own fault .
examples.zh: 那天晚上我没有睡好，但这是我自己的问题。

words.definition: if radio or television signals are relayed, they are received and sent, especially so that they can be heard on the radio or seen on television; take sth over; realy, supersedure; retransmit
words.translation: 接替，转播；转播；接替；[电]继电器；接替，接替人员；驿马；使接替；分程传递

examples.en: The broadcasts were relayed by satellite.
examples.zh: 这些电视节目通过卫星进行转播。

words.translation: 收缩(shrink过去式)

examples.en: But it contained one very interesting piece of data: in 2008, for the first time in sixteen years, the finance and insurance industry shrank.
examples.zh: 但是，这份报告里有一项非常耐人寻味的数据：在2008年，金融保险业出现近十六年来的首次萎缩。

examples.en: The physician who lives in the Chicago area invested heavily in stocks, only to cringe as the value of his portfolio shrank 42% over the last decade.
examples.zh: 这位医生住在芝加哥地区，将大量投资投入到股票上，只有在他的投资价值于过去十年缩水42%的事实才令他退缩。

examples.en: Canada's economy shrank at an annual rate of 5.4% in the first quarter, its biggest decline since 1991, but less than economists had feared.
examples.zh: 加拿大经济第一季度以每年5.4%的速度萎缩。这是自1991年以来最大的萎缩，但是没有经济学家害怕的严重。

words.definition: to send out electronic signals, messages etc using radio, television, or other similar equipment; release, send, communicate, project, let go
words.translation: 传播，传导；传输；传播；发射；传达；遗传

examples.en: The US Open will be transmitted live via satellite.
examples.zh: 美国公开赛将通过卫星现场直播。

examples.en: The system transmits information over digital phone lines.
examples.zh: 这一系统通过数字电话线路传输信息。

words.definition: You use incidentally to introduce a point that is not directly relevant to what you are saying, often a question or extra information that you have just thought of; passingly, accidentally
words.translation: 顺便地，附带；顺便；偶然地；附带地

examples.en: "I didn't ask you to come. Incidentally, why have you come?"
examples.zh: “我没有叫你来。顺便问一下，你为什么来呢？”

words.definition: in a way that is clearly different, important, or unusual; especially, remarkably, prominently
words.translation: 显著地，尤其；显著地；尤其

examples.en: Emigration has notably increased over the past five years.
examples.zh: 在过去五年中，移居国外的人明显增加。

examples.en: Notably absent from his statement was any hint of an apology.
examples.zh: 他的话里显然没有丝毫道歉的意思。

words.definition: If something exists or happens worldwide, it exists or happens throughout the world; universal
words.translation: 世界范围地，全世界；全世界的

examples.en: His books have sold more than 20 million copies worldwide.
examples.zh: 他的书在全世界卖出了两千多万本。

words.definition: precision, stiffness
words.translation: 严格；严厉；精确；苛刻；僵硬

examples.en: We are not so much testing as proposal-thinning, and we can add rigor such as traceability and other documentation as the leading architectural candidates emerge.
examples.zh: 我们不像细化提议那样做太多测试，随着最主要的架构候选的出现，我们可以添加严密，如可溯性和其他文档。

examples.en: The towers, not only ground the buildings with their visual weight, but they also contribute to the rigor of rhythmic play needed in such expansive internal spaces and environment.
examples.zh: 这些塔楼不仅利用其视觉上的厚重感将建筑物固定在地面上，还有助于生成这种开阔的内部空间和环境所需的严谨的韵律感。

words.definition: to get used to a new situation, job, or way of life
words.translation: 重新调整，再调整

examples.en: It takes time to readjust after a divorce.
examples.zh: 离婚后需要时间重新适应。

words.definition: to deliberately make something such as a feeling or an activity last longer; drag on, drag out
words.translation: 延长；拖延

examples.en: I was trying to think of some way to prolong the conversation.
examples.zh: 我在想方设法拖长这次谈话。

words.definition: If you redefine something, you cause people to consider it in a new way
words.translation: 重新定义

examples.en: Feminists have redefined the role of women.
examples.zh: 女权主义者们已重新定义了女性角色。

words.definition: causing a lot of disagreement, because many people have strong opinions about the subject being discussed; disputed, questioned
words.translation: 受到争议的；有争议的；有争论的

examples.en: the controversial issue of welfare reform
examples.zh: 福利改革这一有争议的话题

examples.en: a highly controversial (= very controversial ) plan to flood the valley in order to build a dam
examples.zh: 一个把山谷淹掉来建造水坝的极具争议的计划

examples.en: He is a controversial figure (= person who does controversial things ) in the art world.
examples.zh: 他是艺术界极具争议的人物。

words.definition: regression, corruption, degradation, deterioration
words.translation: 退化，变质；[生物]退化；[医]变性；堕落；恶化

examples.en: Instead, if you do not use your mental faculties, you accelerate the degeneration of cells and the loss of your cognitive abilities.
examples.zh: 相反，要是你不经常使用你的精神能力，你就会加速这些细胞的退化甚至会导致你的认知能力的丧失。

words.definition: very unkind and cruel, and deliberately behaving in a way that is likely to upset or hurt someone; vicious, poisonous
words.translation: 恶毒的；恶意的；蓄意的；怀恨的

examples.en: a malicious girl
examples.zh: 恶毒的女孩

words.definition: to become wider, or to make something wider; broaden
words.translation: 拓宽，变宽；变宽

examples.en: They’re widening the road.
examples.zh: 他们正在拓宽马路。

examples.en: The river widens and splits.
examples.zh: 这条河有变宽的河段，也有分流的河段。

words.definition: the degree to which an area is filled with people or things; specific mass
words.translation: 密度；[物]密度

examples.en: areas of high population density
examples.zh: 人口密度高的地区

words.definition: relating or belonging to a very large city; suzerain; archbishop
words.translation: 大都市的；大主教辖区的；宗主国的；大城市人；大主教；宗主国的公民

examples.en: a metropolitan area of South Australia
examples.zh: 南澳大利亚的一个都市区

words.definition: important; obvious, excellent, remarkable, brilliant, marked
words.translation: 卓越的，突出的；突出的，显著的；杰出的；卓越的

examples.en: a prominent Russian scientist
examples.zh: 杰出的俄罗斯科学家

examples.en: The World Cup will have a prominent place on the agenda.
examples.zh: 世界杯赛将占据议程表的重要位置。

words.definition: popularity, rifeness
words.translation: 流行，普遍；流行；普遍；广泛

examples.en: However, no study on the prevalence of infertility has been conducted in this area.
examples.zh: 但是，在这个地区不曾进行过任何关于不孕症流行情况的研究。

examples.en: The prevalence of these widgets means they can report on almost all your browsing activity, which can then be linked to databases full of the social data you intentionally share.
examples.zh: 这些小工具的流行意味着它们能上报几乎所有的你的浏览行为，通过这些行为就能链接到你主动共享出来，满是你社交信息的数据库。

words.definition: packed or put together firmly and closely; stipulation, covenant; close, brief
words.translation: 紧密的，紧凑的；合同，契约；小粉盒；[数]紧凑的，紧密的；简洁的

examples.en: The bushes grew in a compact mass.
examples.zh: 灌木长成茂密的一片。

words.definition: a connection between two ideas, facts etc, especially when one may be the cause of the other; relationship, associations, relevance
words.translation: 相关，关联；[数]相关，[理物]关联；相互关系

examples.en: ...the correlation between smoking and disease.
examples.zh: …吸烟和疾病之间的关联。

words.definition: to make or produce something that is not real but has the appearance or feeling of being real; pattern, come, imitate; affected, assumed
words.translation: 模拟，模仿；模仿；假装；冒充；模仿的；假装的

examples.en: a machine that simulates conditions in space
examples.zh: 一台模拟太空环境的机器

examples.en: Interviews can be simulated in the classroom.
examples.zh: 可以在教室里模拟面试。

words.definition: the ability to keep increasing, developing, or being more successful; impetus, quantity of motion
words.translation: 动力，势头；势头；[物]动量；动力；冲力

examples.en: incentives to maintain the momentum of European integration
examples.zh: 保持欧洲一体化发展势头的激励措施

examples.en: Governments often lose momentum in their second term of office.
examples.zh: 政府往往会在第二届任期中丧失冲劲。

words.definition: a piece of equipment that is fixed inside a house or building and is sold as part of the house; equipment, furniture, facility, plant
words.translation: 固定装置；设备；固定于某处不大可能移动之物

examples.en: light fixtures
examples.zh: 照明设备

words.definition: a suggestion, or something that is suggested or considered as a possible thing to do; sentence, theme, subject, offer
words.translation: 提议，主题；[数]命题；提议；主题；议题

examples.en: He telephoned Stuart with a proposition.
examples.zh: 他打电话给斯图尔特提了个建议。

examples.en: I’ve got a proposition to put to you.
examples.zh: 我要向你提个建议。

words.definition: the branch of mechanics concerned with the forces that change or produce the motions of bodies; mechanics, kinetics
words.translation: 动力学；[力]动力学，力学

examples.en: And our goal is to find out the time, the dynamics of this problem.
examples.zh: 我们的目的是找出时间，找出这个问题的动力学。

examples.en: We know the dynamics of outsourcing.
examples.zh: 我们了解外包的动力。

examples.en: Both are believed to have important roles in sea ice dynamics, but how important they are remains unclear.
examples.zh: 认为这两者在海冰动力学方面都有重要的作用，但是他们尚不清楚是多么重要。

words.definition: your family origins, especially your nationality or relationship to someone important who lived a long time ago; reduction, birth, decline, fall, blood
words.translation: 血统, 后裔；[航]下降；[遗]血统；袭击

examples.en: The authors show how this was triggered by his belief in the common descent of all humans.
examples.zh: 作者表明，这张图是如何由他的信仰引发出来的，达尔文相信全人类属于共同的血统。

words.definition: the connection or involvement that someone or something has with a political, religious etc organization; alliance, union, association, league, federation
words.translation: 隶属关系，单位团体；友好关系；加入；联盟；从属关系

words.definition: Your perception of something is the way that you think about it or the impression you have of it; consciousness, viewpoint, sense, feel, insight
words.translation: 看法；意识；知觉；[生理]感觉；洞察力；获取

examples.en: He is interested in how our perceptions of death affect the way we live.
examples.zh: 他对我们的死亡观如何影响我们的生活方式感兴趣。

words.definition: if liquid, gas etc permeates something, it enters it and spreads through every part of it; filter, penetrate; smoke, shed
words.translation: 渗透；渗透，透过；弥漫；透入；散布

examples.en: The smell of diesel oil permeated the air.
examples.zh: 空气里充斥着柴油的气味。

words.translation: 招聘者

examples.en: If that doesn't work, do a Web search on the term "recruiter" or "HR director" along with the name of your employer of choice.
examples.zh: 如果这招无效的话，那就在网站上输入你可选择的雇主名单加上“招聘人员”或“人力资源部经理”一起搜索。

examples.en: If you feel the recruiter can't meet the challenge, you may need to raise the issue with the head of recruiting or human resources.
examples.zh: 如果你觉得招聘人员无法完成这一挑战，你可能就得把问题提交给招聘或人力资源部门的负责人了。

examples.en: Therefore, if recruiting is a major function, it may be in the company's best interest to have a professional recruiter and another employee to handle all the other functions.
examples.zh: 因此，如果招聘是一个重要的职能，符合该公司的最大利益的做法是，有专业的招聘人员和另一名雇员来处理所有其他职能。

words.definition: to make a liquid weaker by adding water or another liquid; watery, attenuant; break, deliquate; thin
words.translation: 稀释，冲淡；稀释的；淡的；稀释；冲淡；削弱；变稀薄；变淡

examples.en: diluted fruit juice
examples.zh: 稀释的果汁

words.definition: to put several things, problems etc in order of importance, so that you can deal with the most important ones first
words.translation: 优先

examples.en: You need to prioritize your tasks.
examples.zh: 你需要按照轻重缓急安排自己的工作。

words.definition: having a special advantage or a chance to do something that most people cannot do
words.translation: 有特权的

examples.en: Kylie feels fortunate to be in such a privileged position because of her successful TV career.
examples.zh: 凯莉觉得由于成功的电视生涯而使自己处于这样优越的地位真是幸运。

words.definition: Placemark, checkpost
words.translation: 有重大意义或影响的；[航]陆标，地标；[建]里程碑；[地理][测]地界标；划时代的事

words.definition: extracurricular activities are not part of the course that a student is doing at a school or college; leisure, sparetime
words.translation: 课外的；业余的；婚外的

examples.en: Each child had participated in extracurricular activities at school.
examples.zh: 每个孩子都参加了学校的课外活动。

words.definition: the lack of something that you need in order to be healthy, comfortable, or happy; removal, losing, expense, disadvantage, cost
words.translation: 剥夺，匮乏；剥夺；损失；免职

examples.en: Sleep deprivation can result in mental disorders.
examples.zh: 缺乏睡眠会引起精神紊乱。

words.definition: To cater to a group of people means to provide all the things that they need or want; humor, meet the demand
words.translation: 迎合；投合，迎合；满足需要；提供饮食及服务

examples.en: We cater to an exclusive clientele.
examples.zh: 我们满足一个特殊客户群的需求。

words.definition: to make a small hole in or through something, using an object with a sharp point; cut through, transpierce; come into, go into, get into, enter into
words.translation: 刺穿；洞察；响彻；深深地打动；进入；透入

examples.en: Steam the corn until it can easily be pierced with a fork.
examples.zh: 把玉米蒸到用叉子可以轻易扎透。

examples.en: Rose underwent emergency surgery after a bullet pierced her lung.
examples.zh: 罗丝被子弹射穿肺部，接受了紧急手术。

words.definition: to be even better or greater than someone or something else; overcome, top, exceed, cap, transcend
words.translation: 超过；超越；胜过，优于；非…所能办到或理解

examples.en: He had surpassed all our expectations .
examples.zh: 他超越了我们所有的预期。

examples.en: The number of multiple births has surpassed 100,000 for the first time.
examples.zh: 多胎产首次突破了 10 万例。

words.definition: something that you are trying to achieve, such as a total, an amount, or a time; goal, object, end, cause, aim
words.translation: 目标；把…作为目标；靶子

examples.en: There is no target date for completion of the new project.
examples.zh: 这个新的项目何时完工没有预定日期。

examples.en: The government may fail to meet (= achieve ) its target of recycling 25% of domestic waste.
examples.zh: 政府可能达不到回收利用25%的生活垃圾的目标。

examples.en: Jiang set annual growth targets of 8–9%.
examples.zh: 江确定了8%至9%的年增长目标。

words.definition: very willing to do something; rapid, fast, forward, express, quick; cash, real money; quickly, rapidly, in advance, previously, fast; prime
words.translation: 乐意的，愿意的；准备好；现成的；迅速的；情愿的；快要…的；现款；预备好的状态；迅速地；预先；使准备好

examples.en: She was ready and willing to work hard.
examples.zh: 她工作积极肯干。

words.translation: 二选一地；非此即彼

words.definition: long
words.translation: 慢性地；持久地；长期地；习惯性地

words.definition: configuration, mechanics, texture, structure; design, construct, engineer, style, project
words.translation: 设计，建造；[建][计]框架；结构；[电影]画面；设计；建造；陷害；使…适合

examples.en: Newman played a central role in framing the new law.
examples.zh: 纽曼在拟定新法的过程中发挥了主要作用。

words.definition: If you are mournful, you are very sad; sad, threnetical
words.translation: 悲哀的；令人惋惜的

examples.en: He looked mournful, even near to tears.
examples.zh: 他看上去很悲伤，几乎要掉泪了。

words.definition: to plant and take care of a particular crop; rear, foster, plant, nurse
words.translation: 培养；陶冶；耕作

examples.en: We cultivated maize and watermelons.
examples.zh: 我们种植玉米和西瓜。

words.definition: something that is extremely important because everything else depends on it; elements, basis, bed, radical, sole
words.translation: 基石；基础；柱石；地基

examples.en: Research is the cornerstone of the profession.
examples.zh: 研究是该职业的基石。

words.definition: If something is legalized, a law is passed that makes it legal; vote, legitimise
words.translation: 合法化；使合法化；公认；法律上认为…正当

examples.en: Divorce was legalized in 1981.
examples.zh: 离婚在1981年被合法化了。

words.definition: rigid methods, systems etc are very strict and difficult to change; strict, precise, wooden, accurate, mathematical
words.translation: 严格的；僵硬的，死板的；坚硬的；精确的

examples.en: rigid and authoritarian methods of education
examples.zh: 死板、专断的教育方法

words.definition: to state that something is correct or true, especially after some kind of test; seal of, give evidence of
words.translation: 保证，证明；证明；保证

examples.en: The accounts were certified by an auditor.
examples.zh: 这些账目经审计员核实过。

words.definition: the curved path travelled by an object which is moving around another much larger object such as the Earth, the Sun etc; path, track, railway, trajectory; serpentuate, circle round
words.translation: 轨道；[天][航]轨道；[昆]眼眶；势力范围；生活常规；盘旋；绕轨道运行

examples.en: Mars and Earth have orbits which change with time.
examples.zh: 火星和地球的轨道随着时间而发生改变。

words.definition: astronomical prices, costs etc are extremely high; tremendous, infinite
words.translation: 天文数字的；[天]天文的，天文学的；极大的

examples.en: Houses in the subdivision are going for astronomical prices.
examples.zh: 该小区里的房子在以天价出售。

words.definition: voluntarily, mechanically
words.translation: 自动地；不经思考地；机械地；无意识地

words.definition: the state of existing; presence, being, entity, life, is
words.translation: 存在，生存；[计]存在，实在；生存，生活；存在物，实在物

examples.en: Scientists have many theories about how the universe first came into existence (= started to exist ).
examples.zh: 关于宇宙的起源，科学家有多种理论。

words.definition: If you describe someone as intolerant, you mean that they do not accept behaviour and opinions that are different from their own; provincial, unendurable
words.translation: 无法容忍的；无法忍受的；偏狭的

examples.en: ...intolerant attitudes toward non-Catholics.
examples.zh: …对非天主教徒的不宽容态度。

words.definition: a job or profession; profession, employment, career, calling, pursuit, entertainment
words.translation: 职业；[劳经]职业；占有；消遣；占有期

examples.en: Please state your name, address and occupation.
examples.zh: 请写明你的姓名、地址和职业。

examples.en: professional and managerial occupations
examples.zh: 专业及管理工作

examples.en: manual occupations
examples.zh: 体力工作

words.definition: Slightly means to some degree but not to a very large degree
words.translation: 轻微地

examples.en: His family then moved to a slightly larger house.
examples.zh: 他的家后来搬到了一间稍微大一点儿的房子。

examples.en: Each person learns in a slightly different way.
examples.zh: 每个人学习的方式都略有不同。

words.definition: to develop and use minerals, forests, oil etc for business or industry; develop, mine; merit, feat
words.translation: 开发，开采；开发，开拓；剥削；开采；勋绩；功绩

examples.en: the urgent need to exploit the resources of the Irish Sea
examples.zh: 开发爱尔兰海资源的迫切需要

words.definition: a word used especially in letters or speeches to introduce the subject you are writing or talking about; concerning, about, in the case of, with reference to, in relation to
words.translation: 关于；关于，至于

examples.en: Regarding your recent inquiry, I have enclosed a copy of our new brochure.
examples.zh: 关于你最近的咨询，我随信附上一本我们最新的手册。

words.definition: all the animals and plants in a particular area, and the way in which they are related to each other and to their environment; ecological constellation, ecological systems
words.translation: 生态系统；[生态]生态系统

examples.en: ...the forest ecosystem.
examples.zh: …森林生态系统。

words.definition: well known or famous, especially because of some special quality or ability; famous, obvious, prominent, marked, outstanding
words.translation: 著名的；显著的；附有乐谱的

examples.en: a noted author
examples.zh: 著名作家

words.definition: involve, contain, absorb, comprise; merge, mix together; amalgamative, pooled
words.translation: 合并；体现；包含，吸收；把……合并；混合；组成公司；合并的；一体化的；组成公司的

examples.en: It allows you to harness existing technologies and incorporate them into one application.
examples.zh: 它允许您利用现有的技术并将它们合并到同一个应用程序中。

examples.en: The next step is to generate the report and then incorporate it as an affiliated document of the master document.
examples.zh: 紧接着的步骤就是产生这个报告，然后将它作为主文档的附属文档与主文档合并。

words.definition: an interactive computer program, television system etc allows you to communicate directly with it, and does things in reaction to your actions; coactive
words.translation: 互相作用的，互相影响的；[计]交互式的；相互作用的

examples.en: interactive computer systems
examples.zh: 交互式电脑系统

examples.en: the museum’s interactive exhibits
examples.zh: 博物馆的互动展品

words.definition: not like anything known before, and unusual or interesting; patent, exquisite; story, fiction
words.translation: 新颖的；新奇的；异常的；小说

examples.en: Protesters found a novel way of demonstrating against steeply rising oil prices.
examples.zh: 抗议者们找到一种新奇的示威方式来反对石油价格的飙升。

words.definition: Someone's mismanagement of a system or organization is the bad way they have dealt with it or organized it; maladministration, poor management
words.translation: 管理不当；[管理]管理不善；处置失当

examples.en: His gross mismanagement left the company desperately in need of restructuring.
examples.zh: 他处理事务的严重不当使得公司急需重组。

words.definition: not based on clear thought or reason; unreasonable, reasonless; surd
words.translation: 不合理的，不理性的；不合理的；无理性的；荒谬的；[数]无理数

examples.en: an irrational fear of flying
examples.zh: 对飞行非理性的恐惧

examples.en: He’s becoming increasingly irrational.
examples.zh: 他变得越来越不可理喻了。

words.definition: not based on facts or reason; gratuitous
words.translation: 无理由的，无根据的；无理由的

examples.en: Fortunately my suspicions proved groundless .
examples.zh: 幸好我的猜疑后来证明是没有根据的。

examples.en: Mr Kay’s lawyer said the accusations were groundless.
examples.zh: 凯先生的律师说这是无端的指控。

words.definition: to change the way in which something such as a government, business, or system is organized; adjust, coordinate
words.translation: 调整，重建；调整；重建；更改结构

examples.en: proposals to radically restructure Britain’s electronics industry
examples.zh: 彻底整顿英国电子行业的提议

words.definition: something that helps a process to develop more quickly or more strongly; incentive, animation, excitement, needle, irritation
words.translation: 刺激；[医]刺激；[电子]激励；刺激物

examples.en: Tax cuts provided the stimulus which the slow economy needed.
examples.zh: 减税为不景气的经济带来了其所需的刺激。

words.definition: a plan, idea, or method that is feasible is possible and is likely to work; possible, working, potential, viable
words.translation: 可行的；可能的；可实行的

examples.en: a feasible solution
examples.zh: 可行的解决方法

words.definition: a film or television programme that is based on a book or play; orientation, reorganization
words.translation: 适应；改编；改编本，改写本

examples.en: Branagh won two awards for his screen adaptation of Shakespeare's Henry the Fifth.
examples.zh: 布拉纳因他对莎士比亚的《亨利五世》的荧幕改编而获了两次奖。

words.definition: an organization that has a particular purpose such as scientific or educational work, or the building where this organization is based; found, construct, father, initiate; academy, college, union, school
words.translation: 研究所，学会，学院；开始（调查）；制定；创立；提起（诉讼）；学会，协会；学院

examples.en: research institutes
examples.zh: 研究所

words.definition: the scientific study of the chemistry of living things; biological chemistry
words.translation: 生物化学；[生化]生物化学

examples.en: ...the effects of air pollutants on the biochemistry of plants or animals.
examples.zh: …大气污染物对植物或动物生化过程的影响。

words.definition: someone who starts a new business or arranges business deals in order to make money, often in a way that involves financial risks; contractor, enterpriser
words.translation: 企业家；承包人；主办者

examples.en: “You have to be an optimist to be an inventor or entrepreneur, ” he concludes.
examples.zh: 要成为一位发明家或企业家，你必须得是个乐天派。

examples.en: If any of you end up being entrepreneur, which I hope you will be, what do you have in store for yourself, and what does that journey look like?
examples.zh: 如果你们当中任何一个人成了企业家，这也是我希望你们做到的，你自己会有什么样的储备，那样的一段旅程又将是什么样的？

examples.en: How would you define personal growth as an entrepreneur?
examples.zh: 你会如何定义,一个企业家的个人成长？

words.definition: if a problem or difficult situation arises, it begins to happen; occur, raise, figure, offer, come out
words.translation: 出现；上升；起立

examples.en: A crisis has arisen in the Foreign Office.
examples.zh: 外交部出现了危机。

examples.en: More problems like those at the nuclear power plant are certain to arise.
examples.zh: 核电厂肯定还会出现那样的问题。

words.definition: to move up through the air; raise, arise, go up, climb; scale, climb
words.translation: 上升；登高；追溯；攀登，上升

examples.en: The plane ascended rapidly.
examples.zh: 飞机迅速爬升。

words.definition: two or more different things that exist together or are used or put together; combined with, alliance, unity, union, association
words.translation: 组合，结合；结合；[数]组合；联合；[化学]化合

examples.en: a combination nightclub and café
examples.zh: 夜总会兼咖啡馆

words.definition: clearly known, seen, or stated
words.translation: 一定的，确切的

examples.en: It’s impossible for me to give you a definite answer.
examples.zh: 我不可能给你明确的答复。

examples.en: We need to record sufficient data to enable definite conclusions to be reached.
examples.zh: 我们需要记录足够的数据，才能得出明确的结论。

examples.en: He’d shown definite signs of resigning himself to the situation.
examples.zh: 他明显表现出安于这种状况的样子。

words.definition: to save something or someone from being harmed or destroyed; maintain, save, secure, corn, sustain; conservation area, conservation district
words.translation: 保存，保护；保存；保护；维持；腌；禁猎；保护区；禁猎地；加工成的食品

examples.en: We must encourage the planting of new trees and preserve our existing woodlands.
examples.zh: 我们必须鼓励栽种新树木，同时也要保护现有的林地。

words.definition: procedure, routine, plan, scheme, project
words.translation: 计划，安排；[计]程序；计划；大纲
近似，接近

words.definition: A lobbyist is someone who tries actively to persuade a government or council that a particular law should be changed or that a particular thing should be done; proselytizer
words.translation: 游说者；说客；活动议案通过者

examples.en: He only pursues writing-only careers like novelist, journalist or copyrighter, when instead, he could have looked into being a minister, public relations assistant, editor or government lobbyist.
examples.zh: 他只追求纯写作的职业，比如小说家、记者或剧作家，而实际上，他也可以找代理人、公共关系助手、编辑或政府说客之类的工作。

words.definition: if you are redundant, your employer no longer has a job for you; spare, unnecessary, surplus, waste, superfluous
words.translation: 过剩的；失业的，被解雇的；[计]多余的，过剩的；被解雇的，失业的；冗长的，累赘的

examples.en: Seventy factory workers were made redundant in the resulting cuts.
examples.zh: 在继而发生的裁员中，70名工厂工人被解雇。

words.definition: a person or company that provides insurance; insurance company, insurance carrier
words.translation: 保险公司；承保人；[保险]保险公司

examples.en: This alternative would have to operate as any other insurer, on the basis of the premiums it collects.
examples.zh: 这个选项如同其他的保险公司一样，依靠它收取的保费生存。

examples.en: At some moments in this crisis it has shown the way—by agreeing to supply dollars to countries that needed them, and by guaranteeing the contracts of European banks when it rescued a big insurer.
examples.zh: 在这次危机的某些时刻，美国显示出了这一做法，同意提供美元给需要的国家，而且当欧洲的银行在援救一个大保险公司的时候，担保它们的合约。

examples.en: In between these visits, at the request of the hospital manager, I am constantly on the phone to my travel insurance party, as neither hospital nor insurer seems to accept what the other is saying.
examples.zh: 在那些探视者来访的间隙，按照医院经理的要求，我不断地和我的保险公司打电话，因为无论是医院还是保险公司似乎都不认同对方所说的情况。

words.definition: to think something is better, more important etc than it really is
words.translation: 高估

examples.en: He tends to overestimate his own abilities.
examples.zh: 他往往高估自己的能力。

examples.en: The importance of training in health and safety cannot be overestimated (= is extremely important ).
examples.zh: 对健康和安全方面的培训极为重要。

words.definition: farmland
words.translation: 农田；植作物之农地

examples.en: In addition to property damage, the floods have affected some of the nation's most fertile cropland, and are expected to have an impact on already rising food prices, especially for crops like corn.
examples.zh: 除了财产损失之外，洪水还影响了美国一部分最肥沃的耕地，并预计对已经不断增加的粮食价格有所影响，尤其是像玉米这样的农作物。

examples.en: But it is "crucial" that farmers are not encouraged to use productive cropland to grow biofuel crops, it says.
examples.zh: 但是该报告说，关键在于不要鼓励农民使用富饶的农田种植生物燃料作物。

examples.en: Fly ash uranium sometimes leaches into the soil and water surrounding a coal plant, affecting cropland and, in turn, food.
examples.zh: 浮尘中含有的铀有时会溶入煤电厂周围的土壤和水体中，影响农田，进而影响食物。

words.definition: watering
words.translation: 灌溉；[农工]灌溉；[临床]冲洗；冲洗法

examples.en: Rivers and lakes provide us with water transport and irrigation.
examples.zh: 江河湖泽给我们以舟楫和灌溉之利。

examples.en: In the United States, by contrast, 41% goes for agriculture, almost all of it for irrigation.
examples.zh: 与之相比，美国全年41%的水投向了农业，并几乎全都用在了灌溉上。

words.definition: to make a place or substance dirty or harmful by putting something such as chemicals or poison in it; soil, mud, spot, dirty, poison
words.translation: 污染，弄脏

examples.en: Drinking water supplies are believed to have been contaminated.
examples.zh: 据信饮用水已受到污染。

words.definition: harmful substances that are untreated have not been made safe
words.translation: 未经处理的

examples.en: untreated sewage
examples.zh: 未经处理过的污水

words.definition: the protection of public health by removing and treating waste, dirty water etc; hygiene of environment, environmental health
words.translation: 卫生环境，卫生设备；[医]环境卫生；卫生设备；下水道设施

examples.en: Overcrowding and poor sanitation are common problems in prisons.
examples.zh: 过度拥挤和卫生状况差是监狱里的普遍问题。

words.definition: if a sound echoes, you hear it again because it was made near something such as a wall or hill; reflect, mirror, repeat; aftersound, bounceback
words.translation: 随声附和，发出回声；反射；重复；回音；效仿

examples.en: The sound of an engine echoed back from the thick forest.
examples.zh: 从茂密的森林里传来引擎的回声。

words.definition: an exact copy of something that you can use in the same way; repeat, double; repeat, reproduction, counterpart; reproductive, copied; print off, to copy
words.translation: 副本，复制品；[印刷][专利]复制；使加倍；副本；[印刷][专利]复制品；[印刷][专利]复制的；二重的；重复

examples.en: She kept both the duplicate and the original.
examples.zh: 她把复制本和原本都保留着。

words.definition: to move someone or something to a more important level or rank, or make them better than before; promote, upgrade, prefer
words.translation: 提升，举起；使高兴；提升；举起；振奋情绪等；提升…的职位

examples.en: Language has elevated humans above the other animals.
examples.zh: 语言使人类高于其他动物。

words.definition: to make the meaning of something clearer by giving examples; clarify, elucidate; give an example, cite an example
words.translation: 阐明，说明；阐明，举例说明；图解；举例

examples.en: Let me give an example to illustrate the point.
examples.zh: 让我举个例子来说明这一点。

examples.en: She illustrated her discussion with diagrams.
examples.zh: 她用图表来说明她的论述。

words.definition: to ask someone for information; question, query
words.translation: 询问；查究；问明；询价

examples.en: ‘Why are you doing that?’ the boy inquired.
examples.zh: “你为什么这么做？”男孩问道。

examples.en: Toby would have liked to inquire further (= ask more questions ).
examples.zh: 托比本想问更多的问题。

words.definition: if a belief, custom, situation etc prevails, it exists among a group of people at a certain time; obtain, win
words.translation: 流行，普遍；盛行，流行；战胜，获胜

examples.en: A similar situation prevails in Canada.
examples.zh: 同样的情况在加拿大也普遍存在。

words.definition: to fasten something or someone in place with one or more straps; restrict, hold in; belt, band, strip
words.translation: 用带帮助；用带捆绑；用皮条抽打；约束；带；[机]皮带；磨刀皮带；鞭打

examples.en: soldiers with grenades strapped to their belts
examples.zh: 腰带上绑着手榴弹的士兵

words.definition: a turbulent situation or period of time is one in which there are a lot of sudden changes; angry, chaotic, troubled, confused
words.translation: 动荡的，骚乱的；骚乱的，混乱的；狂暴的；吵闹的

examples.en: the turbulent times of the French Revolution
examples.zh: 法国大革命的动荡时期

examples.en: He has had a turbulent political career.
examples.zh: 他的政治生涯动荡不定。

words.definition: an organized attempt to change the government or leader of a country, using violence; resistance, insurgency
words.translation: 叛逆；叛乱；反抗；谋反；不服从

examples.en: an armed rebellion
examples.zh: 武装叛乱

words.definition: lofty mountains, buildings etc are very high and impressive; high, tall, senior, advanced, superior
words.translation: 崇高的；高的；高级的；高傲的

examples.en: He stayed at the Four Seasons Hotel, from whose lofty heights he could see across New York.
examples.zh: 他住在四季酒店，从酒店高处可以看到纽约的全景。

words.definition: to give something to someone or do something, because it is your duty or because someone expects you to; introduce, present, prefer, file, advance; cosmetic brush
words.translation: 给予；致使；提出；实施；着色；以…回报；打底；交纳；粉刷

examples.en: an obligation to render assistance to those in need
examples.zh: 为有困难的人提供援助的义务

examples.en: a bill of $3,200 for services rendered
examples.zh: 一张3,200美元服务费的账单

words.definition: used materials or substances that are recyclable can be recycled
words.translation: 可回收利用的

examples.en: recyclable cardboard packaging
examples.zh: 可回收利用的纸板包装材料

words.definition: something you do in order to deceive someone; scheme, fraud; sell, paint, hang, dress oneself, fox; kid, fool with; deceptive, acrobatic
words.translation: 骗局，诡计；诡计；恶作剧；窍门；花招；骗局；欺诈；欺骗；哄骗；装饰；打扮；戏弄；[电影]特技的；欺诈的；有决窍的

examples.en: Pretending he doesn’t remember is an old trick of his.
examples.zh: 假装不记得是他的老花招了。

examples.en: He didn’t really lose his wallet - that’s just a trick.
examples.zh: 他并没有真的丢了钱包——这只是一个骗局。

words.definition: an official document that says that someone is allowed to do a certain job, that something is of good quality etc; authentication, demonstration, assurance, commitment, proof
words.translation: 证明，保证；[法]证明，保证；检定

examples.en: We successfully completed the certification for open water diving.
examples.zh: 我们成功地拿到了开放水域潜水证书。

words.definition: existing or accepted in a particular place or at a particular time; popular, general, fashionable, going, common; winning
words.translation: 流行的；一般的，最普通的；占优势的；盛行很广的；盛行，流行（prevail的现在分词形式）；获胜

examples.en: The prevailing mood of public opinion remained hostile.
examples.zh: 公众仍普遍持敌对情绪。

examples.en: the prevailing economic conditions in Northern Ireland
examples.zh: 北爱尔兰普遍的经济状况

words.translation: (mislead过去式)误导

examples.en: He noted that a Scientologist hearing this would feel, with some justification, that he had misled his auditors about his progress.
examples.zh: 他指出，山达基信徒听到这些之后，会有一些理由，感觉他在关于进展方面误导了听析师。

examples.en: Sometimes he may be “misinformed, ” or “misled by others, ” but he is never, ever, wrong.
examples.zh: 他间或可能会“信息有误”或是“被他人误导”，但他永远不会有错。

examples.en: I defy any one to assign an incident wherein reason will not direct us what we are to say or do in company, if we are not misled by pride or ill nature.
examples.zh: 如果我们不被骄傲之情和坏脾气给误导，我相信理智将在社交活动，他人交往中对我们的言行举止做出正确的指引。 这一事实无可辩驳。

words.definition: the removal or destruction of something; removing, erasure
words.translation: 消除，淘汰；消除；淘汰；除去

examples.en: If you need to remove an agent you will have to do it by a process of elimination.
examples.zh: 如果您需要删除代理，将必须通过消除进程的方式进行此工作。

examples.en: I recommend that you be relentless in the elimination of the backlog of defects and feature enhancements.
examples.zh: 我建议你在消除积压的缺陷和不断膨胀的特征时毫不留情。

examples.en: In all, the new president selected 150 individual programs for cuts or elimination.
examples.zh: 总而言之,新的总统150个人项目选择削减或者消除。

words.definition: not having the right knowledge, experience, or education to do something; rejected, off-specification
words.translation: 不合格的，不胜任的；不合格的；无资格的；不胜任的

examples.en: unqualified staff
examples.zh: 不合格的员工

words.definition: subconscious feelings, desires etc are hidden in your mind and affect your behaviour, but you do not know that you have them; unconsious
words.translation: 下意识的，潜意识的；[心理]潜意识的；下意识的

examples.en: a subconscious fear of failure
examples.zh: 对失败下意识的恐惧

words.definition: not having the ability or skill to do a job properly; unable, weak, unhappy, inadequate, wrong
words.translation: 无能力的，不胜任的；不合适的；不适当的；无力的

examples.en: an incompetent manager
examples.zh: 不称职的经理

examples.en: weak incompetent leadership
examples.zh: 软弱不称职的领导

words.definition: to treat a person or group differently from another in an unfair way; tell from, distinguish from
words.translation: 歧视；区别；辨别

examples.en: He is incapable of discriminating between a good idea and a terrible one.
examples.zh: 他没能力在一个好主意和一个坏主意之间进行区分。

words.definition: beautiful, attractive, or graceful; graceful, exquisite
words.translation: 高雅的，雅致的；高雅的，优雅的；讲究的

examples.en: a tall, elegant young woman
examples.zh: 身材高挑、举止优雅的年轻女子

examples.en: You can dine in elegant surroundings.
examples.zh: 你可以在雅致的环境中进餐。

words.definition: a long loose piece of clothing worn for special ceremonies by judges, teachers, lawyers, and members of universities; cope, robe
words.translation: 长袍；长袍，长外衣；礼服；睡袍；法衣

examples.en: The new ball gown was a great success.
examples.zh: 那件新款长礼服非常成功。

words.definition: a woman at the time she gets married or just after she is married; judy, colleen
words.translation: 新娘；姑娘，女朋友

examples.en: Guests toasted the bride and groom with champagne.
examples.zh: 客人们以香槟为新娘新郎敬酒。

words.definition: a set of clothes worn by an actor or by someone to make them look like something such as an animal, famous person etc; clothing, wear, garment, apparel
words.translation: 服装；[服装]服装，装束；戏装，剧装

examples.en: the film’s lavish costumes and spectacular sets
examples.zh: 影片中奢华的戏装和壮观的场景

examples.en: Hallowe’en costumes
examples.zh: 万圣节前夕化装服

words.definition: to buy and sell goods, services etc as your job or business; commerce, profession, employment, career, pursuit; traffic, exchange, truck
words.translation: 做买卖；交换；贸易，[贸易]交易；[劳经]行业；职业；[贸易]交易，买卖；以物易物

examples.en: They had to travel into town to trade the produce from their farm.
examples.zh: 他们不得不到镇上去出售他们农场的产品。

examples.en: We traded necklaces.
examples.zh: 我们交换了项链。

words.definition: to buy and sell illegal drugs; afford, allow, extend, deliver, part; manage, debate, cope with; policy, business, trade, truck
words.translation: 买卖毒品；处理；给予；分配；发牌；讨论；对待；做生意；[贸易]交易；（美）政策；待遇；份量

examples.en: Many users end up dealing to support their habit.
examples.zh: 许多吸毒者最后都是靠做毒品买卖来供自己吸毒。

words.definition: to take a long walk in the mountains or countryside; trip, arise, raise, go up, climb; enhance, raise; walking tour, excursion
words.translation: 作长途徒步旅行；远足；徒步旅行；上升；提高；拉起；使…高涨；涨价

examples.en: He wants to hike round the world.
examples.zh: 他打算徒步旅行环游世界一周。

words.definition: the process of doing something, especially in order to achieve a particular thing; movement, function, doing, campaign, working
words.translation: 行动；活动；功能；战斗；情节

examples.en: The government must take action (=do something) now to stop the rise in violent crime.
examples.zh: 政府现在必须采取行动遏止暴力犯罪的上升。

words.definition: happening or existing because of something
words.translation: 作为结果而发生的

examples.en: She is still trying to get over the attack and the resultant injuries.
examples.zh: 她仍在努力从袭击以及由此造成的伤害中恢复过来。

words.definition: happening as a result of a particular event or situation; outcome, product, result, event, harvest; resulting
words.translation: 作为结果的；必然的；结果；随之发生的

examples.en: the rise in inflation and consequent fall in demand
examples.zh: 通货膨胀的加剧和随之而来的需求下降

words.definition: someone who writes music; writer, author, pen
words.translation: 作曲家；作家，著作者；设计者

examples.en: ...music by Strauss, Mozart, Beethoven, and other great composers.
examples.zh: …施特劳斯、莫扎特、贝多芬及其他伟大作曲家创作的音乐。

words.definition: If you say that a person is slaving over something or is slaving for someone, you mean that they are working very hard; bondman, mameluke; labor, work like a dog
words.translation: 作苦工；奴役；奴隶；从动装置；苦干；拼命工作

examples.en: When you're busy all day the last thing you want to do is spend hours slaving over a hot stove.
examples.zh: 当你忙碌了一整天后，你最不愿意做的事就是花好几个钟头在灼热的火炉边辛苦地劳作。

words.definition: if a person or animal grunts, they make short low sounds in their throat; oink; harrumph
words.translation: 作呼噜声；咕哝；呼噜声；发哼声

examples.en: Grunting with effort, she lifted me up.
examples.zh: 她哼哧着费力地把我抱起来。

words.definition: bear, stand; stomach, go, stand, tough, tolerate; stay, hold, stomach
words.translation: 忍受；遵守；忍受，容忍；停留；持续

examples.en: I can't abide people with no sense of humour.
examples.zh: 我讨厌和没有幽默感的人打交道。

examples.en: You'll have to abide by the rules of the club.
examples.zh: 你必须遵守俱乐部的规定。

words.definition: to think that someone or something is important; importance, significance, price, stress, weight; score, rate, prize
words.translation: 尊重，重视；估价；[数]值；[经]价值；价格；重要性；确切涵义；评价；重视

examples.en: Shelley valued her privacy.
examples.zh: 谢利很重视自己的隐私。

examples.en: We decided to get the house valued.
examples.zh: 我们决定给房子估一估价。

words.definition: the ability to behave in a calm controlled way even in a difficult situation; sanctity, nobility
words.translation: 庄重；尊严；体面；高贵

examples.en: We do this because we believe in the dignity and value of every person.
examples.zh: 我们这样做是因为我们相信每个人的尊严和价值。

examples.en: They have to be treated well, with dignity.
examples.zh: 必须善待申请人，让人有尊严。

examples.en: This award must be shared with everyone who strives for justice and dignity.
examples.zh: 我一定要与所有为正义和尊严奋斗的人分享此奖。

words.definition: furthest from the middle; outmost, farthermost
words.translation: 最外面的，最远的；最外面的；最远的

examples.en: the outermost stars
examples.zh: 最远的恒星

words.definition: the best or most suitable for a particular purpose or in a particular situation
words.translation: 最优的，最适宜的

examples.en: optimum conditions for growth
examples.zh: 最适宜生长的条件

words.definition: at the beginning; originally, firstly, primarily
words.translation: 最初，开始；最初，首先；开头

examples.en: Stan initially wanted to go to medical school.
examples.zh: 斯坦最初想进医学院。

examples.en: Initially, I thought I would only stay there a year.
examples.zh: 起初，我以为我只会在那儿待一年。

words.definition: Makeup consists of things such as lipstick, eye shadow, and powder which some women put on their faces to make themselves look more attractive or which actors use to change or improve their appearance; recruitment, renewal
words.translation: 化妆品；性格；构造；组成；补充；补考

examples.en: Normally she wore little makeup, but this evening was clearly an exception.
examples.zh: 通常她很少化妆，可今晚显然是个例外。

examples.en: There was some fatal flaw in his makeup, and as time went on he lapsed into long silences or became off-hand.
examples.zh: 他性格中有某种致命的缺陷，随着时间的推移，他要么陷入长时间沉默要么行为随便。

examples.en: The ideological makeup of the unions is now radically different from what it had been.
examples.zh: 这些协会的意识形态构成如今与过去大相径庭。

words.definition: something that prevents movement or progress; piece, mass, barrier, bottleneck; stem, dispute, prohibit, discourage; batched, wholescale
words.translation: 阻塞；障碍物；[计]块；[建]街区；大厦；阻止；限制；成批的，大块的；交通堵塞的

examples.en: a major block to progress
examples.zh: 进步的重大阻碍

words.definition: If you say that a person or a news report damns something such as a policy or action, you mean that they are very critical of it; condemn, denounce; accuse of, brush down; one point, tittle; abhorrent, dad-burned; extremely, badly, highly, greatly, too; dang
words.translation: 谴责；罚…下地狱；一点；诅咒；可恶的；非常；讨厌

examples.en: ...a sensational book in which she damns the ultraright party.
examples.zh: …她谴责极右党派的一本耸人听闻的书。

words.definition: more than enough; abundant, sufficient, competent, full, plenty
words.translation: 足够的；宽敞的；丰富的

examples.en: There'll be ample opportunity to relax, swim and soak up some sun.
examples.zh: 将会有充足的机会来放松、游泳和接受一些阳光。

words.definition: to be enough; content, gratify; serve, be in a position
words.translation: 足够；使满足；足够…用；合格；有能力

examples.en: A light lunch will suffice.
examples.zh: 简单的午餐就够了。

words.definition: a legal agreement which allows you to use a building, car etc for a period of time, in return for rent; tenancy agreement, rental agreement; rent, hire out
words.translation: 租约，契约，租契；租约；租期；[租赁]租赁物；租赁权；出租；租得

examples.en: The landlord refused to renew his lease.
examples.zh: 房东拒绝和他续签租约。

examples.en: The 99-year lease expired in 1999.
examples.zh: 99年期的租约于1999年到期。

examples.en: Do you understand all the terms of the lease?
examples.zh: 租约条款你都理解吗？

words.definition: to pay a company for the use of their aircraft, boat etc; license; license, patent, permit
words.translation: 包租（飞机、船等）；特许；[车辆][航]包租；发给特许执照；宪章；执照；特许状

examples.en: We chartered a boat to take us to some of the smaller islands.
examples.zh: 我们包了一条船带我们到一些较小的岛上去。

words.definition: the main building or offices used by a large company or organization; command, main office
words.translation: 总部；指挥部；司令部

examples.en: the headquarters of the United Nations
examples.zh: 联合国总部

words.definition: a large pipe or wire carrying the public supply of water, electricity, or gas; core, body, chief, heart, essential; primary, major, central, ruling, great
words.translation: 总管道，干线；主要部分，要点；体力；[材]总管道；主要的，最重要的；全力的

examples.en: The report found that many of Yorkshire’s water mains needed replacing.
examples.zh: 报告中说约克郡的很多自来水总管道需要更换。

examples.en: a burst gas main
examples.zh: 破裂的煤气总管道

words.definition: You use overall to indicate that you are talking about a situation in general or about the whole of something; entire, all, corporate, total, universal; outright; jeans, jea
words.translation: 总的；全部的；全体的；一切在内的；全部地；总的说来；工装裤；罩衫

examples.en: ...the overall rise in unemployment.
examples.zh: …失业人数的总体上升。

words.definition: an attitude that shows you have too high an opinion of your own abilities or importance; ego, pretentiousness; have vision of, fantasize
words.translation: 自负，自高自大；自负；狂妄；幻想

examples.en: The conceit of the woman!
examples.zh: 这个自负的女人！

words.definition: ultraviolet light cannot be seen by people, but is responsible for making your skin darker when you are in the sun; extraviolet
words.translation: 紫外（线）的；[光]紫外的；紫外线的

examples.en: The sun's ultraviolet rays are responsible for both tanning and burning.
examples.zh: 太阳的紫外线是皮肤晒黑和晒伤的原因。

words.definition: to give a college, hospital etc a large sum of money that provides it with an income; gift, put
words.translation: 资助；赋予；捐赠；天生具有

examples.en: The ambassador has endowed a $1 million public-service fellowships programme.
examples.zh: 大使资助了一个100万美元的公共服务奖学金项目。

examples.en: You are endowed with wealth, good health and a lively intellect.
examples.zh: 你天生赋有财富、健康，和敏锐的智力。

words.definition: Datum is the singular form of data; feedback, quantitative data
words.translation: 资料；数据；已知数；[数]已知数

words.definition: belonging to the  middle class; capital; middle-class
words.translation: 中产阶级的；庸俗的；资产阶级的；资本家；九点活字；中产阶级的人；追求物质享受和社会地位者；贪图享受的

examples.en: She came from a bourgeois family.
examples.zh: 她来自一个中产阶级家庭。

examples.en: bourgeois morality
examples.zh: 中产阶级的道德准则

examples.en: the backlash against bourgeois materialism
examples.zh: 对世俗的物质主义的鞭挞

words.definition: a bird with a long beak that it uses to make holes in trees; peckerwood, Marc Dorcel, hickwall
words.translation: 啄木鸟；[鸟]啄木鸟

examples.en: A woodcutter and a woodpecker lived in the forest.
examples.zh: 森林里居住着一个樵夫和一个啄木鸟。

examples.en: Of course, it took years for the Army to hit on a workable strategy for the woodpecker — a lesson that is informing its conservation work today.
examples.zh: 当然，拿出一套对保护啄木鸟行之有效的方案，军方花了几年的功夫 ---- 这对于今天的生态保护工作不失为是一个教训。

examples.en: Savour the silence, if that's what nature serves up, or thrill to the tap-tap of the woodpecker.
examples.zh: 如果这是大自然奉上的一份佳肴，给这份宁静加点作料吧，或是因为啄木鸟的叩击声而兴奋起来吧。

words.definition: If something crashes somewhere, it moves and hits something else violently, making a loud noise; collision, precipitation, impact; fall of, fall to pieces; hit, impact on; quickie
words.translation: （发出巨响的） 猛撞；碰撞；崩溃；坠落；破碎；撞碎；[航]坠毁；闯；突然倒台；速成的

examples.en: The door swung inwards to crash against a chest of drawers behind it.
examples.zh: 门摆向里面，砰的一声猛力撞上了门后的五斗橱。

examples.en: My words were lost as the walls above us crashed down, filling the cellar with brick dust.
examples.zh: 随着上面的墙体轰隆一声倒塌下来，地窖里充满砖灰，我吓得说不出话来。

words.definition: a particular state or condition; path, method, direction, orientation, approach, aspect, system; greatly, large
words.translation: （特定的）状态，状况；方法；[交]道路；方向；行业；习惯；大大地；远远地

examples.en: My family was in a bad way financially.
examples.zh: 我家当时经济窘迫。

examples.en: The chicken’s nice and crispy – just the way I like it.
examples.zh: 这鸡肉很脆，正是我喜欢的口味。

examples.en: It’s worth thinking how you can improve the way things are.
examples.zh: 你应该想想如何让现状变得更好。

words.definition: extremely good; wonderful, excellent, famous, grand, great
words.translation: 壮丽的；超等的；极好的；华丽的；宏伟的

examples.en: The food was superb.
examples.zh: 食物好吃极了。

words.definition: a small object that you keep in your house because it is beautiful rather than useful; decoration, adornment; paint, hang, modify, bedeck
words.translation: 装饰物；[建][服装]装饰；教堂用品；[建][服装]装饰，修饰

examples.en: a shelf covered with books and ornaments
examples.zh: 摆满书籍和装饰品的架子

words.definition: pretty or attractive, but not always necessary or useful; ornamental
words.translation: 装饰的；可作装饰的；装饰性的；装潢用的

examples.en: a decorative panel above the door
examples.zh: 门楣上的饰板

words.definition: Something that is ornamental is attractive and decorative; decorative, illuminative; decoration, trimming
words.translation: 装饰的；装饰的，装饰性的；观赏植物；装饰品

examples.en: ...an ornamental fountain.
examples.zh: …一个装饰性喷泉。

words.definition: a load of goods sent by sea, road, or air, or the act of sending them; loading
words.translation: 装载的货物；装货

examples.en: The goods are ready for shipment.
examples.zh: 货物已经准备好装运。

words.definition: When food or drink is canned, it is put into a metal container and sealed so that it will remain fresh.; tin, debe
words.translation: 装罐头；[食品]罐头，一罐；金属容器

examples.en: ...fruits and vegetables that will be canned, skinned, diced, or otherwise processed.
examples.zh: …将要经过装罐、去皮、切块或其他加工程序的水果和蔬菜。

words.definition: to arrange something in an attractive way; An array of objects is a collection of them that is displayed or arranged in a particular way.; series of, clothes, thread, garment, ranging; dress oneself, rank, form
words.translation: （美观地）排列；陈列；数组，阵列；排列，列阵；大批，一系列；衣服；排列，部署；打扮

examples.en: make-up arrayed on the bathroom counter
examples.zh: 盥洗台上摆放整齐的化妆品

examples.en: We visited the local markets and saw wonderful arrays of fruit and vegetables.
examples.zh: 我们参观了当地的市场，看到了漂亮地摆放着的水果蔬菜。

words.definition: the force or power that makes something turn around a central point, especially in an engine; torgue, turning moment
words.translation: 转（力）矩，扭（力）矩；转矩，[力]扭矩；项圈，金属领圈

examples.en: In rotation, force becomes torque, mass becomes moment of inertia, and acceleration becomes angular acceleration.
examples.zh: 在旋转时，力变成力矩，质量变成转动惯量，加速度变成角加速度。

examples.en: The Tesla’s rapid acceleration comes from the ability of an electric motor to deliver its maximum amount of torque at whatever speed the motor is turning.
examples.zh: 特斯拉之所以拥有如此优异的加速性能，其原因在于电动马达无论在什么速度下都可以为车辆提供最大的扭矩。

words.definition: a small area of a theatre or court that is separate from where other people are sitting; case, balcony; spar
words.translation: （法庭的）专席；[包装]箱，盒子；包厢；一拳；拳击

examples.en: the jury box
examples.zh: 陪审团席

words.definition: A workshop is a period of discussion or practical work on a particular subject in which a group of people share their knowledge or experience; plant, proseminar
words.translation: 专题讨论会；[工业]车间；研讨会；[工经]工场；讲习班

examples.en: Trumpeter Marcus Belgrave ran a jazz workshop for young artists.
examples.zh: 鼓手马库斯马贝尔格瑞夫为年轻艺术家们举办了一场爵士乐研讨会。

words.definition: protected by a patent; A patent is an official right to be the only person or company allowed to make or sell a new product for a certain period of time.; apparent, novel, transparent, decided; license, permit
words.translation: 专利的；专利；[专利]专利的；新奇的；显然的；[专利]专利权；执照；专利品

examples.en: a patent lock
examples.zh: 专利锁

examples.en: He held a number of patents for his many innovations.
examples.zh: 他为他的许多革新申请了几项专利。

words.definition: to hold something tightly because you do not want to lose it; control, hand, grasp, guiding, hold; grasp, noble, collar
words.translation: 抓住，掌握，攫；[机]离合器；控制；手；紧急关头；抓住；紧握

examples.en: She was clutching a bottle of champagne.
examples.zh: 她手里紧紧抓着一瓶香槟酒。

words.definition: to build or use a nest; soil, eyrie; nidificate
words.translation: 筑巢，为…筑巢；巢，窝；安乐窝；温床；筑巢；找鸟巢

examples.en: They say eagles used to nest in those rocks.
examples.zh: 他们说以前常有老鹰在那些岩石中筑巢。

words.definition: to make pieces of money from metal; invent, to create; piece, specie
words.translation: 铸造（硬币）；铸造（货币）；杜撰，创造；硬币，钱币

words.definition: very careful to notice what is happening, and to make sure that everything is all right
words.translation: 注意的，警惕的

examples.en: The entrances are guarded by watchful security staff.
examples.zh: 入口处由警惕的保安人员把守。

examples.en: His eyes were watchful.
examples.zh: 他目光警惕。

words.definition: to put liquid, especially a drug, into someone’s body by using a special needle; breathe into, inflood
words.translation: 注射；注满；喷射；注入

examples.en: His son was injected with strong drugs.
examples.zh: 他的儿子被注射了强效的药。

words.definition: the process of keeping or putting something in a special place while it is not being used; warehouse, repository
words.translation: 贮藏；保管；[计]存储；[建][经]仓库；[贸易]贮藏所

examples.en: the storage of highly radioactive material
examples.zh: 高放射性材料的存放

examples.en: storage costs
examples.zh: 保管费用

words.definition: mainly; largely, basically, mainly, mostly, primarily
words.translation: 主要，大抵；主要地；大部分

examples.en: The money is principally invested in stocks and shares.
examples.zh: 这笔钱主要投资于股票。

examples.en: He was principally a landscape painter.
examples.zh: 他主要是风景画画家。

examples.en: We met principally to discuss the future of the school.
examples.zh: 我们开会主要是为了商讨学校的前途。

words.definition: a long narrow part of a plant that supports leaves, fruits, or flowers; stem, tracking, handle; trail, follow up on; move in on
words.translation: 主茎，叶柄；（植物的）茎，秆；（支持叶子、果实和花的）[植]梗，[生物]柄；追踪；高视阔步；追踪，潜近；高视阔步地走；潜近，偷偷接近

examples.en: celery stalks
examples.zh: 芹菜茎

words.definition: to be in charge of a formal event, organization, ceremony etc; to chair, run the show; manage, conduct, run, direct, control
words.translation: 主持；主奏；主持，担任会议主席；管理

examples.en: I shall be pleased to preside at your meetings.
examples.zh: 我很高兴主持你们的会议。

examples.en: Mr Justice Waller, presiding judge for the northeast
examples.zh: 沃勒法官，东北地区的首席法官

words.definition: to make someone leave a place or building by using force; to spray, spray on
words.translation: 逐出，排斥；喷射；驱逐，逐出

examples.en: The demonstrators were ejected from the hall.
examples.zh: 示威者被赶出大厅。

examples.en: Two engines cut out and the plane started to eject fuel as it lost height.
examples.zh: 两个发动机突然熄火，飞机在下降的同时开始喷出燃料。

words.definition: a tall tropical plant with hollow stems that is used for making furniture; Abo
words.translation: 竹；竹杆，竹棍；竹制的；土著居民的

examples.en: ...huts with walls of bamboo.
examples.zh: …竹墙小屋。

words.definition: small things that you wear for decoration, such as rings or necklaces
words.translation: 珠宝，珠宝饰物

examples.en: She wears a lot of gold jewelry.
examples.zh: 她戴了许多金首饰。

words.definition: wrinkles are lines on your face and skin that you get when you are old; if you wrinkle a part of your face, or if it wrinkles, small lines appear on it; rugosity, plication; crease; frounce
words.translation: 皱纹；使起皱纹；起皱

examples.en: Her face was a mass of wrinkles.
examples.zh: 她的脸上布满皱纹。

examples.en: Alex wrinkled up her nose at the smell.
examples.zh: 闻到那股味道，亚历克丝皱起了鼻子。

words.definition: relating to, forming, or characteristic of an axis; axile
words.translation: 轴的；轴向的

examples.en: Angular momentum is an axial vector quantity.
examples.zh: 角动量是一种轴矢量。

words.definition: the imaginary line around which a large round object, such as the Earth, turns; sheft, spindle
words.translation: 轴，轴线；轴；轴线；轴心国

examples.en: The Earth rotates on an axis between the north and south poles.
examples.zh: 地球绕着南北两极之间的地轴自转。

words.definition: relating to the surrounding area; on all sides; environmental, surrounding; mise en scene
words.translation: 周围的，包围着的；周围的；外界的；环绕的；周围环境

examples.en: ...ambient sounds of children in the background.
examples.zh: ...背景处环绕着孩子们的声音。

examples.en: ambient temperature/light/conditions
examples.zh: 周围的温度/光线/环境

words.definition: happening a number of times, usually at regular times; regular, stated, time, cyclical
words.translation: 周期的；一定时期的；定期的

examples.en: periodic home visits by nurses
examples.zh: 护士的定期上门探访

examples.en: Periodic checks are taken to ensure that high standards are maintained.
examples.zh: 进行周期性检查以确保高标准得以维持。

words.definition: a date on which something special or important happened in a previous year
words.translation: 周年纪念日

examples.en: Jack and Kim celebrated their twentieth wedding anniversary in January.
examples.zh: 1月，杰克和金庆祝了他们的结婚20周年纪念日。

words.definition: in the outer area of something, or relating to this area; secondary, supporting, minor
words.translation: 外围的的；末梢的；[昆][计]外围的；次要的

examples.en: the city’s peripheral suburbs
examples.zh: 这座城市的市郊

examples.en: the peripheral nervous system
examples.zh: 周围神经系统

words.definition: the border around an enclosed area such as a military camp; circumference, campimeter
words.translation: 周（边）；周长；[数]周长；周界；[眼科]视野计

examples.en: ...the perimeter of the airport.
examples.zh: …机场周边。

examples.en: Calculate the perimeter of the rectangle.
examples.zh: 计算这个长方形的周长。

words.translation: 重要人物

examples.en: She wasn't anybody before she got that job.
examples.zh: 她在获得那个职位之前不过是个无名之辈。

words.definition: (of people or their actions or behavior) that you can trust and rely on; honest, reliable, tried, safe, sure
words.translation: 可靠的；责任重大的；[法]负责的，可靠的；有责任的

examples.en: You can leave the children with Billy – he’s very responsible.
examples.zh: 你可以把孩子交给比利，他非常可靠。

examples.en: a responsible job/position
examples.zh: 责任重大的工作/岗位

words.definition: importance; outcome, product, result, significance, event, conclusion
words.translation: 重要（性），重大意义；结果；重要性；推论

examples.en: I don’t suppose it is of any consequence now.
examples.zh: 现在我觉得这事一点都无所谓了。

words.definition: happy and friendly and usually loud; devout, stuggy; guys
words.translation: 热情友好的；丰盛的；衷心的；健壮的；精神饱满的；朋友们；伙伴们

examples.en: a hearty laugh
examples.zh: 开怀大笑

examples.en: The men ate a hearty breakfast.
examples.zh: 男士们吃了一顿丰盛的早餐。

words.definition: a part of an atom that has no electrical charge
words.translation: 中子

examples.en: Each atomic cluster is made up of neutrons and protons.
examples.zh: 每个原子团簇是由中子和质子组成的。

words.definition: mid, medium, middle, secondary; medium, intermediary agent
words.translation: 中间体；调解人；[化学]中间的，中级的；[化学][生化]中间物；媒介

words.definition: a very small piece of matter with a positive electrical  charge  that is in the central part of an atom; merron, uron
words.translation: 质子，氕核；[物]质子

examples.en: When a neutron inside an atom decays, it produces a proton, an electron, and a neutrino.
examples.zh: 原子内的一个中子衰变后会产生一个质子、一个电子和一个中微子。

words.definition: relating to the quality or standard of something rather than the quantity
words.translation: 质的；定性的

examples.en: There are qualitative differences in the way children of different ages and adults think.
examples.zh: 不同年龄的儿童和成人在思维方式上有着质的差异。

words.definition: to invent a story, piece of information etc in order to deceive someone; manufacture, make, doctor
words.translation: 捏造；制作；制造；伪造；装配

examples.en: The police were accused of fabricating evidence.
examples.zh: 警方被控捏造证据。

examples.en: The discs are expensive to fabricate.
examples.zh: 这些磁盘的生产成本很高。

words.definition: a piece of information or story that someone has invented in order to deceive people; assembly, manufacture, machining, make, fishing
words.translation: 捏造；制作；制造，建造；装配；伪造物

examples.en: Her story was a complete fabrication from start to finish.
examples.zh: 她的叙述从头到尾都是编造出来的。

words.definition: someone who does a job willingly without being paid; to offer to do something without expecting any reward, often something that other people do not want to do
words.translation: 志愿者；志愿

examples.en: Most of the relief work was done by volunteers.
examples.zh: 大部分救援工作都由志愿人员完成。

examples.en: I volunteered my services as a driver.
examples.zh: 我主动提出来当司机。

words.definition: to speak to someone severely about something they have done wrong; charge, restrain; reprehension, impugnment
words.translation: 指责，非难，斥责；指责，非难；制止；使相形见绌；非难，指责；谴责，鞭策

examples.en: The president rebuked the House and Senate for not passing those bills within 100 days.
examples.zh: 总统谴责参众两院未在100天内通过那些法案。

words.definition: to mean something; bid, bespeak
words.translation: 指示，意味着；表示，指示

examples.en: What does the word ‘curriculum’ denote that ‘course’ does not?
examples.zh: curriculum一词的哪些含义是course没有的？

words.definition: someone who teaches a sport or practical skill; mentor, guider
words.translation: 指导者，教员；指导书；教员；指导者

examples.en: a driving instructor
examples.zh: 驾驶教练

examples.en: ski instructors
examples.zh: 滑雪教练

words.definition: relating to a country that controls and rules other countries, usually ones that are far away
words.translation: 殖民地的，殖民的

examples.en: the struggle against colonial rule
examples.zh: 反抗殖民统治的斗争

examples.en: Britain was the largest colonial power .
examples.zh: 英国曾是最大的殖民强国。

words.definition: a particular type of work that you feel is right for you; profession, employment, career, calling, pursuit, occupation
words.translation: 职业，行业；[劳经]职业；天职；天命；神召

examples.en: At 17 she found her true vocation as a writer.
examples.zh: 17岁时她找到了自己真正的使命——当一名作家。

words.definition: important, interesting, excellent, or unusual enough to be noticed or mentioned; famous, obvious, remarkable, prominent, marked; personality, lion, celebrity
words.translation: 值得注意的；著名的；值得注意的，显著的；名人，显要人物

examples.en: The town is notable for its busy open-air market.
examples.zh: 该城镇因其热闹的露天市场而出名。

words.definition: someone whose job is to weave cloth
words.translation: 织布工，编织者

examples.en: basket weavers
examples.zh: 编篮子的人

words.definition: something that is used to strengthen or support something, or to make it stiff; to make something stronger by supporting it
words.translation: 支柱；拉紧，撑牢

examples.en: She had to wear a brace after the accident.
examples.zh: 出事以后她只得使用支架。

examples.en: Wait until we’ve braced the ladder.
examples.zh: 等我们把梯子支撑住再说。

words.definition: to formally support a suggestion made by another person in a meeting; moment, breath, instant; encourage, back, carry, champion, support of; additional, attached, supporting, minor, peripheral; next
words.translation: 支持；[计量]秒；第二名；瞬间；二等品；第二的；次要的；附加的；第二；其次；居第二位

examples.en: Any proposal must be seconded by two other members of the committee.
examples.zh: 任何提案须有委员会其他两位委员附议。

words.definition: a direction or angle that is shown by a  compass; relationship, connection, behavior, link, concern; swallowing
words.translation: 方位；（机器的）承座；轴承；忍受；[机]轴承；关系；[矿业][测][天]方位；举止；忍受（bear的ing形式）

examples.en: learning to take a compass bearing
examples.zh: 学习用罗盘辨别方向

examples.en: An oil seal was replaced, along with both front wheel bearings.
examples.zh: 换了一个油封和两个前轮轴承

words.definition: someone’s political beliefs and opinions; department of political science
words.translation: 政纲，政见，策略；政治，政治学；政治活动；政纲

examples.en: I assume her politics must be fairly conservative.
examples.zh: 我猜她的政治观点一定相当保守。

words.definition: the main ideas and aims of a political party, especially the ones that they state just before an election; flatform, hathpace
words.translation: 政纲，党纲，宣言；[计][矿业]平台；月台，[铁路]站台；坛；[家具]讲台

examples.en: a strong women’s rights platform
examples.zh: 强硬的妇女权利政纲

examples.en: the Labour party platform
examples.zh: 工党纲领

words.definition: a statement, document etc that says that something is definitely true; verification, authentication, certification, demonstration, evidence
words.translation: 证实，确定；确认；[审计]确认；证实；证明；批准

examples.en: There has still been no official confirmation of the report.
examples.zh: 这则报道仍未得到官方证实。

words.definition: a formal meeting with a very important person; reader, interview
words.translation: 正式会见；拜会；观众；听众；读者；接见

examples.en: He was granted an audience with the Pope.
examples.zh: 他获准觐见教皇。

words.definition: having no mistakes; properly, exactly, right
words.translation: 正确地，恰当地；正确地；得体地

examples.en: The writer expresses himself correctly in English.
examples.zh: 作家用英语正确地表达自己的意思。

examples.en: If you can use a word correctly and effectively, you comprehend it.
examples.zh: 你如果能正确和有效地使用一个字，你就了解它了。
