examples.zh: 满是漂亮衣服的壁橱

words.definition: a very thin book with paper covers, that gives information about something; booklet, tract
words.translation: 小册子

examples.en: a political pamphlet
examples.zh: 政治宣传册

words.definition: when someone or something becomes impossible to see or find; extinction, evaporation
words.translation: 消失，消散；失踪；消失；不见

examples.en: Police are investigating the woman’s disappearance.
examples.zh: 警方正在调查这名女子的失踪。

words.definition: an activity that you do for pleasure or amusement; entertainment, pleasure, sport, occupation, amusement
words.translation: 消遣，娱乐活动；娱乐；消遣；休养

examples.en: His only recreations are drinking beer and watching football.
examples.zh: 他唯一的消遣就是喝啤酒和看足球比赛。

examples.en: the provision of recreation facilities
examples.zh: 提供娱乐设施

words.definition: someone who buys and uses products and services; user, customer, client, guest
words.translation: 消费者，用户；[经][生态]消费者；用户，顾客

examples.en: Consumers will soon be paying higher airfares.
examples.zh: 不久消费者就要支付更高的机票价了。

examples.en: It will offer a wider choice of goods for the consumer (= consumers in general ).
examples.zh: 它将为消费者提供更多的商品选择。

examples.en: Consumer demand led to higher imports of manufactured goods.
examples.zh: 消费者需求促使制造商品的进口量增加了。

words.definition: a feeling of sadness that makes you think there is no hope for the future; recession, disappointment
words.translation: 消沉；不景气萧条期；沮丧；[地理]洼地；[经]不景气；忧愁

examples.en: Lucy’s mood was one of deep depression.
examples.zh: 露西的情绪极度消沉。

examples.en: the devastating effects of economic depression
examples.zh: 经济萧条的灾难性影响

words.definition: a round piece of metal that you use instead of money in some machines; marks, sign; symbolic, emblematic; indicate, image, figure
words.translation: 辅币；象征；表征；代币；记号；象征的；表意的；作为对某事的保证的；代表

examples.en: slot-machine tokens
examples.zh: 自动贩卖机使用的代用币

examples.en: Please accept this gift as a small token of our appreciation.
examples.zh: 区区薄礼，略表谢意，还请笑纳。

words.definition: the hard smooth yellowish-white substance from the tusks of an  elephant; ivoire, oyster white; milky, opalescent
words.translation: 象牙（质）；乳白色；[脊椎]象牙；长牙；乳白色的；[轻]象牙制的

examples.en: an ivory chess set
examples.zh: 一副象牙国际象棋

examples.en: an ivory silk wedding gown
examples.zh: 乳白色真丝婚纱

words.definition: towards a place or position that is in front of you; to send letters, goods etc to someone when they have moved to a different address; earlier, rapid, fast, ahead, ready; on, antrorsely; facilitate, promote, boost, freight, ship; stricker, vanguard
words.translation: 向前；向将来；转递；向前的；早的；迅速的；向前地；促进；转寄；运送；前锋

examples.en: He leaned forward , his elbows resting on the table.
examples.zh: 他身体前倾，胳膊肘撑在桌子上。

examples.en: I felt that at last I could begin to look forward .
examples.zh: 我觉得自己终于可以开始向前看了。

examples.en: Would you make sure that you forward my mail promptly?
examples.zh: 请您一定及时转寄我的信，好吗？

words.definition: towards the south
words.translation: 向南方

examples.en: We followed the coast southwards.
examples.zh: 我们沿海岸向南走。

words.definition: the type of activity or subject that a person or organization seems most interested in and gives most attention to; aspect, way, quarter, guiding, adaptation
words.translation: 定位；方向；[测]定向；适应；情况介绍；向东方

examples.en: The company needs to develop a stronger orientation towards marketing its products.
examples.zh: 公司需要针对其产品的营销设定一个更为明确的目标。

examples.en: How can we get students to adopt a serious orientation to learning?
examples.zh: 我们怎样才能让学生对学习采取认真的态度呢？

words.definition: to call to someone in order to greet them or try to attract their attention; precipitation, blast; welcome, rah
words.translation: 向…欢呼，招呼；[气象]冰雹；致敬；招呼；一阵；万岁；欢迎

examples.en: She leaned out of the window and hailed a passerby.
examples.zh: 她探出窗户向一个路人大喊。

words.definition: to have a strong desire for something, especially something that is difficult or impossible to get; rare, aspire
words.translation: 渴望，向往；思念，想念；怀念；同情，怜悯

examples.en: Hannah yearned for a child.
examples.zh: 汉娜渴望有个孩子。

words.definition: a type of powder or seed, taken from plants, that you put into food you are cooking to give it a special taste; flavor, little, touch
words.translation: 香料，调味品；香料；情趣；[食品]调味品；少许

examples.en: herbs and spices
examples.zh: 香草和香料

words.definition: a religious person who travels a long way to a holy place; palmer, rover; range, roam about
words.translation: 香客，朝圣者；朝圣者；漫游者；（美）最初的移民；去朝圣；漫游

examples.en: pilgrims visiting a holy shrine
examples.zh: 祭拜圣庙的朝圣者

words.definition: having a pleasant smell; sweet, good, bright, aromatic
words.translation: 香的，芬芳的；芳香的；愉快的

examples.en: fragrant flowers
examples.zh: 芳香的花朵

words.definition: a substance that has a pleasant smell when you burn it; court, joss stick
words.translation: 香，熏香；香气；香；奉承

examples.en: a church filled with the smell of incense
examples.zh: 充满焚香气味的教堂

examples.en: lighted incense sticks
examples.zh: 点燃的棒香

words.definition: not varying; the same in all parts and at all times; consistently, coincidentally
words.translation: 相同地；一贯；一致地

examples.en: The principles were applied uniformly across all the departments.
examples.zh: 这些原则统一适用于所有部门。

examples.en: The quality is uniformly high.
examples.zh: 质量一律很高。

words.definition: the fact of being or looking similar to sb/sth; image, conformity, likeness
words.translation: 相似，相似性；相似；相似之处；相似物；肖像

examples.en: The resemblance between Susan and her sister was remarkable.
examples.zh: 苏珊和她的姐姐十分相像。

words.definition: something that seems similar between two situations, processes etc; similarity, parallelism
words.translation: 相似，类似；比拟；类比；类推；类似

examples.en: analogies between human and animal behaviour
examples.zh: 人类行为与动物行为的类同

examples.en: She drew an analogy between childbirth and the creative process.
examples.zh: 她将分娩和创造过程进行类比。

words.definition: involving two people or groups who agree to help each other or behave in the same way to each other; mutual, au pair
words.translation: 相互的；互利的；[贸易]互惠的；[数]倒数的，彼此相反的

examples.en: He spoke of the necessity for a reciprocal relationship that would be useful for all sides.
examples.zh: 他谈及需要建立对各方都有益的互惠关系。

examples.en: Such treaties provide reciprocal rights and obligations.
examples.zh: 此类协议规定了相互之间的权利与义务。

words.definition: to happen at the same time as something else, especially by chance; cotton, square, identify, accord
words.translation: 相巧合；相符合；一致，符合；同时发生

examples.en: When our vacations coincided, we often holidayed together.
examples.zh: 我们的假期要是凑巧赶在一起，我们常常会一同去度假。

examples.en: The interests of the US and those of the islanders may not coincide.
examples.zh: 美国的利益和这些岛民的利益可能并不一致。

words.definition: opposite in amount or position to sth else; contrary, counter, backward, conversely
words.translation: 相反地；倒转地

examples.en: We regard health as inversely related to social class.
examples.zh: 我们认为健康状况与社会地位成相反关系。

words.definition: the action of spending a lot of time or energy on sth; commitment, dedication, loyalty
words.translation: 献身，热诚，专心；献身，奉献；忠诚；热爱

examples.en: her devotion to duty
examples.zh: 她对职责的忠诚

examples.en: Her devotion to the job left her with very little free time.
examples.zh: 她全身心投入工作，几乎没有闲暇。

words.definition: consisting of lines, or in the form of a straight line; longitudinal, thready
words.translation: 线的；长度的；[数]线的，线型的；直线的，线状的

examples.en: a linear diagram
examples.zh: 线形图

examples.en: linear measurements
examples.zh: 长度量度

words.definition: judging and dealing with situations in a practical way according to what is actually possible rather than what you would like to happen; living, breathing
words.translation: 现实的；现实主义的；逼真的；实在论的

examples.en: It’s just not realistic to expect a promotion so soon.
examples.zh: 这么快就想升职根本不现实。

examples.en: You need to be realistic about the amount you can do in a day.
examples.zh: 你对自己一天能完成多少工作量要现实一点。

words.definition: unusual or interesting enough to be easily noticed; prominent, obvious, marked, tremendous, noted; beating
words.translation: 显著的，惊人的；显著的，突出的，惊人的；打击的；[劳经]罢工的；打（strike的ing形式）

examples.en: a striking contrast between wealth and poverty
examples.zh: 显著的贫富差异

examples.en: The most striking feature of those statistics is the high proportion of suicides.
examples.zh: 那些统计数据最显著的特征是高自杀率。

words.definition: using a microscope
words.translation: 显微镜的；微观的，极小的

examples.en: The cells were identified through microscopic analysis.
examples.zh: 那些细胞通过显微镜分析被识别出来。

examples.en: a microscopic speck of dust
examples.zh: 微小的尘粒

words.definition: easy to notice; transparent, decided, patent
words.translation: 显然的；表面上的

examples.en: The difference in quality was immediately apparent .
examples.zh: 质量的差异显而易见。

examples.en: He left suddenly, for no apparent reason .
examples.zh: 不知什么原因，他突然离开了。

words.definition: clearly; obviously, clearly, easily, strictly, no doubt
words.translation: 显然，清楚地；明显地；无疑地，确实地

examples.en: Speak clearly and distinctly.
examples.zh: 说话要清楚明白。

examples.en: He distinctly remembered the day his father left.
examples.zh: 他清晰地记得父亲离开的那一天。

words.definition: salted or smoked meat from the back or sides of a pig, often served in narrow thin pieces; cured meat, salted meat
words.translation: 咸猪肉，熏猪肉；[食品]咸肉；腌肉；熏猪肉

examples.en: bacon and eggs
examples.zh: 咸猪肉煎蛋

words.definition: information that is passed from one person to another about other people’s behaviour and private lives, often including unkind or untrue remarks; essay, quidnunc; chat about, make conversation
words.translation: 闲谈；碎嘴子；漫笔；小道传闻；随笔；爱说长道短的人；闲聊；传播流言蜚语

examples.en: What’s the latest gossip ?
examples.zh: 最近有些什么传闻？

examples.en: She had no time for idle gossip.
examples.zh: 她没有时间说长道短。

words.definition: to go on a walk in the countryside for pleasure; essay, travel; range, wander off
words.translation: 闲逛，漫步；漫谈，闲聊；漫步；漫游；随笔；闲逛；漫谈；蔓延

examples.en: There’s plenty to discover as you ramble around this little island.
examples.zh: 漫步这个小岛，你会有很多新发现。

examples.en: He had lost track of what he was saying and began to ramble.
examples.zh: 他忘了自己的话题,便开始瞎扯起来。

words.definition: to happen or exist before something or someone, or to come before something else in a series; take over the lead, keep ahead
words.translation: 先于…，领先；领先，在…之前；优于，高于；领先，在前面

examples.en: a type of cloud that precedes rain
examples.zh: 下雨前出现的一种云

examples.en: Lunch will be preceded by a short speech from the chairman.
examples.zh: 午餐开始之前主席会发表一段简短的讲话。

words.definition: the thing that you think is most important and that needs attention before anything else; precedence, preference to sth
words.translation: 先，前；优先，重点；[通信][计]优先；优先权；[数]优先次序；优先考虑的事

examples.en: The club’s priority is to win the League.
examples.zh: 该俱乐部首先考虑的是要赢得联赛。

examples.en: After several burglaries in the area, security is now a high priority (= very important and needing attention soon ) .
examples.zh: 该地区发生了几宗入室盗窃案以后，治安成了当务之急。

examples.en: With so little money available, repairs must remain a low priority (= not important and not needing attention soon ) .
examples.zh: 可用的钱这么少，只好暂时放下维修事宜了。

words.definition: blast, flood; have a bath
words.translation: 下阵雨，使湿透；淋浴；（倾泻般出现的）一阵，一大批；[气象]阵雨；[气象]下阵雨

words.definition: a very thin  candle; candlewick; drop away; cone, drop away
words.translation: 细小的蜡烛；微光；细蜡烛，烛芯；逐渐变弱；锥形物；逐渐减少；使成锥形

examples.en: small boys holding lighted tapers
examples.zh: 拿着点燃的细蜡烛的小男孩

words.definition: small and unimportant; cheap, trivial
words.translation: 细小的；器量小的；琐碎的；小气的；小规模的

examples.en: petty squabbles
examples.zh: 小口角

examples.en: How can she be so petty?
examples.zh: 她怎么会那么小心眼？

words.definition: involving a very small difference or detail; precision, exact, narrow, kind, benign
words.translation: 细微的，微妙的；精密的；美好的；细微的；和蔼的

examples.en: a nice point of law
examples.zh: 法律上的微妙难断之处

words.definition: a very thin thread or wire; hairline rule, leptonema
words.translation: 细丝；长丝；灯丝；[电子]灯丝；细线；单纤维

examples.en: an electric filament
examples.zh: 灯丝

words.definition: the singular of bacteria; microbe, bacilus
words.translation: 细菌；[微]细菌；杆菌属

examples.en: The bacterium Streptococcus pneumoniae causes about a third of some 3,000 annual meningitis cases.
examples.zh: 在每年约3000起脑膜炎病例中，1/3左右是由一种叫“肺炎链球菌”的细菌引起的。

words.definition: a very small living thing that can make you ill; seed, plantule; burgeon, spring up
words.translation: 细菌，病原菌；幼芽；[植]胚芽，萌芽；[微]细菌；萌芽

examples.en: Put disinfectant down the toilet to kill any germs.
examples.zh: 在抽水马桶里投放消毒剂杀菌。

examples.en: germ cells containing DNA
examples.zh: 含DNA的生殖细胞

words.definition: done according to a system or plan, in a thorough, efficient or determined way; organically, methodically
words.translation: 系统地，有规则地；有系统地；有组织地

examples.en: The search was carried out systematically.
examples.zh: 搜查已按照部署执行。

words.definition: a complete range of opinions, people, situations etc, going from one extreme to its opposite; extent, boundary, region, territory, area
words.translation: 系列，范围；波谱；[光]光谱；频谱；范围；余象

examples.en: The two articles here represent opposite ends of the spectrum.
examples.zh: 这里的两篇文章代表了两个极端的观点。

examples.en: the electromagnetic spectrum
examples.zh: 电磁（波）谱

words.definition: to fasten something by tying a lace; tie, gymp
words.translation: 系带，用带子束紧；[纺]花边；鞋带；饰带；少量烈酒

examples.en: Lace up your shoes or you’ll trip over.
examples.zh: 把鞋带系好，否则你会绊倒的。

words.definition: to fasten a package, box etc with sticky tape; magnetictape, mylar; sound recording, make a record
words.translation: 系，捆；胶带；[计]磁带；带子；卷尺；录音；用带子捆扎；用胶布把…封住

words.definition: an exciting event or set of events, or the quality of being exciting
words.translation: 戏剧性事件；戏剧性

examples.en: Maggie’s life is always full of drama.
examples.zh: 玛吉的生活总是充满了戏剧性。

examples.en: accidents, burst pipes, and other domestic dramas
examples.zh: 意外事故、水管爆裂及其他家庭生活中的戏剧性事件

words.definition: a building or place with a stage where plays and shows are performed; drama, stage, cinema
words.translation: 剧场，戏院；电影院，[建]戏院；戏剧；阶梯式讲堂

examples.en: an open-air theatre (= a theatre that is outside )
examples.zh: 露天剧场

examples.en: the Mercury Theater
examples.zh: 水星剧院

words.definition: entertainment that is intended to make people laugh
words.translation: 喜剧；喜剧场面

examples.en: a career in stand-up comedy
examples.zh: 单口喜剧表演职业

words.definition: the way that words are used in a language; employment, utilization, tradition, use, convention
words.translation: 习惯用法；使用；[语]用法；惯例

examples.en: a book on modern English usage
examples.zh: 关于现代英语用法的书

words.definition: to stop a fire from burning; conclude, go out; die, cool, go out
words.translation: 熄灭，扑灭；压制；熄灭，[机]淬火；解渴；结束；冷浸；熄灭；平息

examples.en: a desperate bid to quench the raging flames
examples.zh: 为扑灭熊熊大火而不顾一切的努力

words.definition: a process in which something takes in liquid, gas, or heat; merger, assimilation
words.translation: 吸收；专注；全神贯注，专心致志

examples.en: the body’s absorption of iron
examples.zh: 身体对铁质的吸收

examples.en: I don’t understand James’ absorption with military history.
examples.zh: 我不明白詹姆斯为何对军事史那么着迷。

words.definition: the amount of food, drink etc that you take into your body; ventilation opening
words.translation: 吸入；输入能量；摄取量；通风口；引入口；引入的量

examples.en: Try to reduce your intake of fat.
examples.zh: 尽量减少脂肪的摄入量。

examples.en: a high intake of carbohydrates
examples.zh: 碳水化合物的大量摄入

words.definition: in relation to your body rather than your mind or emotions
words.translation: 身体上；体格上

examples.en: She is young and physically fit.
examples.zh: 她年轻而且身体健康。

examples.en: Do you find him physically attractive?
examples.zh: 你觉得他长得帅吗？

examples.en: I felt physically sick at the thought.
examples.zh: 一想到那个我就觉得身体不舒服。

words.definition: large and strongly made; massive, extensive, macro, much, volume; essence, entity, principle, texture, interior
words.translation: 大而坚固的；大量的；实质的；内容充实的；本质；重要材料

examples.en: a substantial piece of furniture
examples.zh: 一件又大又结实的家具

words.definition: 英文释义 an object that is separate from other objects; person, lots of, wealth, ocean, sea, organization, community
words.translation: 物体；身体；主体；大量；团体；主要部分

examples.en: Keep the caps on the bottles to prevent foreign bodies entering them (= objects that should not be there )
examples.zh: 瓶子要盖好，以免异物进入。

examples.en: heavenly bodies (= stars, planets, etc.)
examples.zh: 天体（恒星、行星等）

examples.en: an operation to remove a foreign body (= sth that would not usually be there) from a wound
examples.zh: 从伤口摘除异物的手术

words.definition: a formal lunch or a formal word for lunch
words.translation: 午宴，午餐，便宴

examples.en: Earlier this month, a luncheon for former U.N. staff was held in Vienna.
examples.zh: 本月早些时候在维也纳为前联合国工作人员举行了午宴。

examples.en: a charity luncheon
examples.zh: 慈善午餐会

words.definition: lack of knowledge or information about something; darkness, unwisdom
words.translation: 无知，无学，愚昧；无知，愚昧；不知，不懂

examples.en: Excuse my ignorance, but how does it actually work?
examples.zh: 请原谅我的无知，它究竟是如何运作的？

words.definition: too small or unimportant to consider or worry about; indifferent, small-beer
words.translation: 无意义的；低微的；无关紧要的

examples.en: You realize that your problems are insignificant in comparison.
examples.zh: 要知道，你的问题相对来说微不足道。

words.definition: used when saying that something is almost certain to happen or be true; easily, no doubt, probably, clearly, possibly; established, fixed, defined, certain, positive
words.translation: 无疑地；很可能；确定地；大概，多半；无疑的；确定的

examples.en: Doubtless there would be lots of rumours.
examples.zh: 无疑会谣言四起。

words.definition: an indefinite action or period of time has no definite end arranged for it; fuzzy, huge, dark, infinite, unsure
words.translation: 无限期的；不确定的；无限的；模糊的

examples.en: The next day the union voted to begin an indefinite strike.
examples.zh: 第二天工会投票表决决定开始无限期罢工。

examples.en: The picture has been loaned for an indefinite period to the National Gallery.
examples.zh: 那幅画长期出借给国家美术馆。

words.definition: extremely; with no limit; extremely, most, rare
words.translation: 无限地，无边地；无限地；极其

examples.en: Human beings are infinitely adaptable.
examples.zh: 人类的适应力是无限的。

words.definition: without any limit; limitless, interminate
words.translation: 无限的；不定的；[数]无限制的；无限量的；无条件的

examples.en: The system can support an unlimited number of users.
examples.zh: 该系统可以支持无限多的用户。

examples.en: unlimited access to information
examples.zh: 无限制查阅资料

examples.en: The ticket offers unlimited travel on the London underground for seven days.
examples.zh: 凭本票可在七日内无限次乘坐伦敦地铁。

words.definition: something that has no end; huge, tremendous, thousand, million, boundless; Mugen, immenseness
words.translation: 无限；无穷（大）；无限的，[数]无穷的；无数的；极大的；[数]无穷大；无限的东西（如空间，时间）

words.definition: not afraid of anything; bold, audacious
words.translation: 无畏的，大胆的；无畏的；大胆的

examples.en: These dogs are absolutely fearless.
examples.zh: 这些狗什么都不怕。

examples.en: a fearless explorer
examples.zh: 一个无畏的探险者

words.definition: very many, or too many to be counted; thousand, countless, million, infinite
words.translation: 无数的，数不清的

examples.en: She’s served on innumerable committees.
examples.zh: 她在多个委员会担任委员。

words.definition: not consisting of anything that is living; anorganic, unorganic
words.translation: 无生物的；无机的；[无化]无机的

examples.en: inorganic matter
examples.zh: 无机物

words.definition: so determined to get what you want that you do not care if you have to hurt other people in order to do it; cruel, relentless
words.translation: 无情的，冷酷的；无情的，残忍的

examples.en: a ruthless dictator
examples.zh: 无情的独裁者

examples.en: They have shown a ruthless disregard for basic human rights.
examples.zh: 他们冷酷地无视基本人权。

words.definition: not able to do something; unable, powerless
words.translation: 无能力的；无资格的；不能的；不能胜任的

examples.en: He seemed incapable of understanding how she felt.
examples.zh: 他似乎不能理解她的感受。

examples.en: Seventy-five percent of the electorate believe his party is incapable of government.
examples.zh: 75%的选民都认为他领导的政党无能力执政。

words.definition: unusually good and special; distinct, individual, one, sole, picturesque
words.translation: 无可匹敌的；极好的；独特的，稀罕的；[数]唯一的，独一无二的

examples.en: a unique opportunity to study these rare creatures
examples.zh: 研究这些珍稀动物的难得机会

words.definition: having no mistakes; perfect, ideal, full, indefective
words.translation: 无过失的；无缺点的；完美的

examples.en: a faultless performance
examples.zh: 完美的表现

words.definition: from or relating to a country that is not your own; external, diplomatic
words.translation: 外国的，国外的；外国的；外交的；异质的；不相关的

examples.en: foreign students
examples.zh: 外国学生

examples.en: Can you speak any foreign languages?
examples.zh: 你会讲外语吗？

words.definition: the number 0; absence, nothing
words.translation: 无，零；[数]零；没有

examples.en: A billion is 1 with 9 noughts after it.
examples.zh: 十亿是1后面加9个零。

words.definition: dirt, especially a lot of it; griminess, squalidity
words.translation: 污秽，污物；淫猥；污秽；肮脏；猥亵；不洁

examples.en: a mound of filth and rubbish
examples.zh: 一堆脏东西和垃圾

examples.en: I don’t know how you can watch that filth!
examples.zh: 我不知道你怎么会看那种淫秽的东西！

words.definition: a small soft creature that moves very slowly and has a hard shell on its back; pachyderm, schnook
words.translation: 蜗牛；行动缓慢的人；[无脊椎]蜗牛；迟钝的人

examples.en: Traffic was moving at a snail’s pace.
examples.zh: 车辆移动的速度慢得像蜗牛。

words.definition: a low continuous sound; to sing a tune by making a continuous sound with your lips closed; groaning, zoom; uh-uh, um
words.translation: 嗡嗡声；哼曲子；哼声；杂声；哼；嗯

examples.en: the distant hum of traffic
examples.zh: 远处嘈杂的车流声

examples.en: He began to hum a tune.
examples.zh: 他开始哼唱一支曲子。

words.definition: polite words or good wishes, especially when used to express praise and admiration; to say something nice to someone in order to praise them; praise, regard; speak well of, pay a tribute to
words.translation: 致意，问候；赞美，祝贺；恭维；称赞；问候；致意；道贺

examples.en: Compliments of the season! (= for Christmas or the New Year)
examples.zh: 谨致节日的祝贺！（圣诞节或新年时的贺词）

examples.en: She complimented him on his excellent German.
examples.zh: 她夸奖他德语棒极了。

words.definition: to ask someone questions in order to get information about something such as a crime; issue, doubt, query; dispute, wonder, query; wonder, query
words.translation: 问，询问，讯问；[数]问题，疑问；询问；疑问句；怀疑；审问

examples.en: Two men have been arrested and questioned.
examples.zh: 已有两名男子被捕并受到盘问。

examples.en: Joseph questioned the doctors closely (= asked them a lot of questions ).
examples.zh: 约瑟夫问了医生很多问题。

words.definition: not knowing how to read or write; someone who has not learned to read or write; letterless, unlettered; unschooled, analphabetic
words.translation: 文盲的；文盲；不识字的；没受教育的

examples.en: A large percentage of the population is illiterate.
examples.zh: 文盲人口占有相当高的比例。

examples.en: a subclass of illiterates
examples.zh: 文盲阶层

words.definition: paper for writing letters, usually with matching envelopes; writing materials, letter pad
words.translation: 信笺，信纸；文具；[轻]文具；信纸

examples.en: a letter on hotel stationery
examples.zh: 用酒店信纸写的信

examples.en: envelopes and other office stationery
examples.zh: 信封及其他办公文具

words.definition: a disease that causes death and spreads quickly to a large number of people; disaster, trouble, headache; harry, worry, trouble, tear, devil
words.translation: 瘟疫；鼠疫（尤指腺鼠疫）；[医]瘟疫；灾祸；麻烦；讨厌的人；折磨；使苦恼；使得灾祸

examples.en: drops in population levels due to plagues and famines
examples.zh: 瘟疫和饥荒造成的人口水平下降

examples.en: The plague caused 100,000 deaths in London alone in the 1600s.
examples.zh: 17 世纪，鼠疫仅在伦敦一地就造成了10万人死亡。

words.definition: femininity, gentilesse
words.translation: 温和，柔和；软弱；温柔；柔和

examples.en: deceitful softness
examples.zh: 虚伪的温柔

words.definition: if an animal grazes, or if you graze it, it eats grass that is growing; grass, feed, raw, range; brush burn; pasturage
words.translation: 喂草；放牧（牲畜）；放牧；擦伤；吃草；轻擦

examples.en: fields where they used to graze their sheep
examples.zh: 他们过去放羊的田野

words.definition: a small area of a country, city etc; situation, site, spot, lie, where
words.translation: 位置，地点，发生地；所在；位置；地点

examples.en: weather reports from several different localities
examples.zh: 来自几个不同地区的天气报告

words.definition: to be in a particular place or position
words.translation: 位于…的

examples.en: The house is situated near the college.
examples.zh: 这幢房子位于学院附近。

examples.en: a farm situated in the valley
examples.zh: 位于山谷里的一个农场

examples.en: The hotel is ideally situated near the seafront.
examples.zh: 酒店的位置理想，靠近海滨。

words.definition: a man who has never been married
words.translation: 未婚男子；学士

examples.en: Gerald was 38, and a confirmed bachelor (=  a man who has decided that he will never marry  ) .
examples.zh: 杰拉德38岁，抱定主意独身。

examples.en: a Bachelor of Arts/Engineering/Science
examples.zh: 文学士；工程学士；理学士

words.definition: not yet paid; unremunerative, uncompensated
words.translation: 未付的；无偿的；[会计]未付款的；[税收]未缴纳的；无报酬的

examples.en: unpaid bills
examples.zh: 未付的账单

examples.en: unpaid work
examples.zh: 无偿劳动

words.definition: the back of a ship; terminal, bottom, extreme; severe, committed, firm, confirmed, tight
words.translation: 艉，船尾；臀部；[船]船尾；末端；严厉的；坚定的

words.definition: a request for an artist, designer, or musician to make a piece of art or music, for which they are paid; council, soviet, brokerage, authorization; depute, authorise
words.translation: 委托，委任；委托状；委员会；[会计]佣金；犯；委任；委任状；使服役；委托制作

examples.en: a commission from the Academy for a new sculpture
examples.zh: 学院要求制作一尊新雕塑的委托

words.definition: The latitude of a place is its distance from the equator.; bourn, circumscription
words.translation: 纬度；黄纬；[地理]纬度；界限；活动范围

examples.en: The birds breed in northern latitudes.
examples.zh: 这些鸟在北纬地区繁殖。

words.definition: the Roman goddess of love
words.translation: 维纳斯；美人

words.definition: the belief that you should live your life according to high standards and principles, even when they are very difficult to achieve; mentalism
words.translation: 唯心主义；理想主义；唯心主义，理想主义；理念论

examples.en: the idealism of the younger generation
examples.zh: 年轻一代的理想主义

examples.en: religious idealism
examples.zh: 宗教的理想主义

words.definition: a tall pole on which the sails or flags on a ship are hung
words.translation: 桅杆

words.definition: an area surrounded by a wall or fence, and used for a particular purpose; attachment, attached sheet
words.translation: 围场，围栏；围绕；附件；[建]围墙；围场

examples.en: the bear enclosure at the zoo
examples.zh: 动物园中的熊园

examples.en: the enclosure of arable land for pasture
examples.zh: 将耕地圈起来用作牧场

words.definition: to disobey or do something against an official agreement, law, principle etc; let, act against
words.translation: 违犯，违背；侵犯；违反；侵犯，妨碍；亵渎

examples.en: 34 protesters were arrested for violating criminal law.
examples.zh: 34名抗议者因违反刑法而被逮捕。

examples.en: regimes that violate human rights
examples.zh: 侵犯人权的政权

words.definition: money put, saved, or given towards something is used to pay for it; at, unto, for, on, to
words.translation: 用于，有助于；朝，向；对于；有助于

examples.en: The money collected will be put towards repairing the church roof.
examples.zh: 募集到的钱款将用于修缮教堂屋顶。

words.definition: to argue in support of sb/sth; excuse for; pray for, cry on
words.translation: 为…辩护，抗辩；借口；为...[法]辩护；托称；恳求；[法]辩护

examples.en: He appeared before the committee to plead his case.
examples.zh: 他出现在委员会上为他的案子辩护。

words.definition: to make a complete list of all the things in a group; directory, content, list
words.translation: 为…编目录；[图情][计]目录；（美）大学情况一览

examples.en: The manuscripts have never been systematically catalogued.
examples.zh: 一直没有系统地为这些手稿编过目录。

words.definition: the central  chip  in a computer, which controls most of its operations; Merced
words.translation: 微信息处理机；[计]微处理器

examples.en: I've got a typerwriter with a microprocessor.
examples.zh: 我有一台装有微处理机的打字机。

examples.en: A microprocessor will check for interrupts at the end of every instruction.
examples.zh: 微处理器将在每一个指令末尾检查有无中断.

words.definition: the smallest part of an element that can exist alone or can combine with other substances to form a molecule
words.translation: 原子

examples.en: carbon atoms
examples.zh: 碳原子

words.definition: the part of mathematics that deals with changing quantities, such as the speed of a falling stone or the slope of a curved line; stone, concrement
words.translation: 微积分；结石；[病理]结石；[数]微积分学

examples.en: We have to factor that into the calculus.
examples.zh: 我们要在微积分学中考虑这些因素。

examples.en: I think I've finally unzipped this calculus problem.
examples.zh: 我认为我最终解出了这道微积分题。

words.definition: a small pale light, especially one that shines for a short time; to shine softly; glimmer, stroboflash; spark, coruscate; flicker
words.translation: 微光；发微光；闪光；瞬息的一现；闪烁；隐约地闪现；使闪烁；使发微光

examples.en: They saw a sudden gleam of light.
examples.zh: 他们看到一道微光一闪而过。

examples.en: The wooden panelling was gleaming with wax polish.
examples.zh: 木嵌板上过蜡显得很光亮。

words.definition: too slight or unimportant to have any effect; bit, inappreciable
words.translation: 微不足道的；微不足道的，[数]可以忽略的

examples.en: The damage done to his property was negligible.
examples.zh: 对他财产造成的损失微不足道。

words.definition: a very short electric wave that is used in cooking food and sending messages by radio, and in radar; wavelet
words.translation: 微波；[物]微波

examples.en: Its molecules can be agitated by microwave energy.
examples.zh: 微波能量可以使其分子随之运动。

words.definition: making you feel great respect or fear; terrible, august, horrible, awesome, fearful; extremely, full, most, rare
words.translation: 威严的；令人崇敬的；可怕的，吓人的；糟糕的，糟透的（口语）；庄严的，威严的；十分，极其

words.definition: the impressive and attractive quality that sth has; authority, crown
words.translation: 雄伟，威严，庄严；陛下；威严；最高权威，王权；雄伟；权威

examples.en: the sheer majesty of St Peter's in Rome
examples.zh: 罗马圣彼得大教堂的雄伟庄严

examples.en: His Majesty the King
examples.zh: 国王陛下

words.definition: a situation in which there are a lot of problems that must be dealt with quickly so that the situation does not get worse or more dangerous; defining moment, critical stage
words.translation: 危机；转折点；危险期；决定性时刻

examples.en: The country now faces an economic crisis .
examples.zh: 该国目前正面临一场经济危机。

examples.en: The Prime Minister was criticized for the way in which he handled the crisis .
examples.zh: 首相处理危机的方式遭到了批评。

examples.en: the current debt crisis
examples.zh: 当前的债务危机

words.definition: great danger, especially of being harmed or killed; risk, hazard, throw, venture, adventure; endanger, jeopard
words.translation: 危机；危险的事物；[安全]危险；冒险；危及；置…于险境

examples.en: a voyage that was fraught with peril
examples.zh: 历尽艰险的旅程

words.definition: rear, aback
words.translation: 往，去，回，向后；向后；向那边

examples.en: She rocked the baby to and fro.
examples.zh: 她来回摇动着婴儿。

words.definition: material made from threads or wires that have been woven together like a net, or a piece of this material; web, trap; joggle
words.translation: 网眼，筛孔，网络；网眼；网丝；圈套；[机]啮合；以网捕捉

examples.en: The windows were covered in wire mesh to keep out flies.
examples.zh: 窗户上装了铁丝纱网，防止苍蝇飞入。

words.definition: a system of lines, tubes, wires, roads etc that cross each other and are connected to each other; net, meshwork
words.translation: 网络；广播网；[计][通信]网络；网状物

examples.en: a high-speed European rail network
examples.zh: 欧洲的高速铁路网

examples.en: You’re listening to the American Armed Forces Network.
examples.zh: 您正在收听的是美军广播电台。

words.definition: a complicated pattern of things that are closely connected to each other; net, cloth, mesh, trap
words.translation: 网，网状物；网；卷筒纸；蹼；织物；圈套

examples.en: a web of streets
examples.zh: 纵横交错的街道

examples.en: We were caught in a tangled web of relationships.
examples.zh: 我们陷入了错综复杂的人际关系网络。

words.definition: determined not to change your mind, even when people think you are being unreasonable; resistant, problem
words.translation: 顽固的；顽强的；难处理的

examples.en: Why are you so stubborn?
examples.zh: 你怎么这么固执？

examples.en: I’ve got a very stubborn streak (= a tendency to be stubborn ) .
examples.zh: 我的个性很固执。

examples.en: Paul can be as stubborn as a mule (= very stubborn ) .
examples.zh: 保尔有时倔得像头驴。

words.definition: to treat someone or something without respect or not in a serious way; cake, bit; fool, kid around; lose, spend, moon, fool away
words.translation: 玩忽；闲混；嬉耍；琐事；蛋糕；少量；开玩笑；嘲弄；浪费；虚度

examples.en: He’s not a man to be trifled with.
examples.zh: 他这个人怠慢不得。

examples.en: men who trifle with women’s affections
examples.zh: 玩弄女性感情的男人

words.definition: the state of being finished; achievement, realization, implementation, execution, finish
words.translation: 完成，结束，完满；完成，结束；实现

examples.en: The house is nearing completion (= almost finished ) .
examples.zh: 房子即将完工。

examples.en: The project has a completion date of December 22nd.
examples.zh: 该项目的完成日期是12月22日。

words.definition: bent, twisted, or not in a straight line; curve, winding, flexural
words.translation: 弯的，歪的；畸形的；弯曲的；歪的；不正当的

examples.en: Your tie’s crooked.
examples.zh: 你的领带歪了。

examples.en: narrow crooked streets
examples.zh: 狭窄曲折的街道

words.definition: the outer covering of seeds, rice, grain etc; crust, outer housing; unshell, decorticate
words.translation: 外壳，豆荚；薄膜；[船]船体；（果实的）[植]外壳；[粮食]去壳

words.definition: relating to or involving the work of diplomats; foreign, experienced
words.translation: 外交的；有策略的；外交上的；老练的

examples.en: Diplomatic efforts to end the fighting began on October 25.
examples.zh: 停战的外交努力于10月25日开始。

words.definition: not familiar because you have not been there before or met the person before; unknown, lay; queerly, anticly
words.translation: 陌生的，不熟悉的；奇怪的；陌生的；外行的；奇怪地；陌生地，冷淡地

examples.en: As a child, she’d been taught never to speak to strange men.
examples.zh: 她从小就受到教育绝对不要和陌生男人说话。

words.definition: a flat square piece of baked clay or other material, used for covering walls, floors etc; glazed brick
words.translation: 瓷砖；贴砖；瓦片；[建]瓷砖，瓦片

examples.en: bathroom tiles
examples.zh: 浴室瓷砖

examples.en: ...a fine building, with a neat little porch and ornamental tiles on the roof
examples.zh: ...一幢精致建筑，有个整洁的小门廊，屋顶上盖着装饰瓦。

words.definition: a unit for measuring electrical power
words.translation: 瓦（特）

examples.en: a 100-watt bulb
examples.zh: 100瓦的灯泡

words.definition: having the shape of an ellipse; oval, omissive
words.translation: 椭圆的；省略的

examples.en: Kepler published his discovery of the elliptical orbits of planets in 1609. 1609
examples.zh: 年开普勒公布他的发现，认为行星轨道为椭圆形。

examples.en: The language is often elliptical and ambiguous.
examples.zh: 语言经常是隐晦和模棱两可的。

words.definition: to pull something heavy with a continuous steady movement; pull, catch, drag; drag one's feet; draw, pull
words.translation: 拖曳；拖运；拖，拉；用力拖拉；努力得到的结果；捕获物；一网捕获的鱼量；拖运距离；[交]拖运；拖拉；改变主意；改变方向

examples.en: the steam locomotive which hauled the train
examples.zh: 拖动火车的蒸汽机车

examples.en: I hauled the door shut behind me.
examples.zh: 我用力拽上了门。

words.definition: one of the two parts on each side of your body between the top of your leg and your waist; bottom, croup
words.translation: 臀部，髋；臀部；[植]蔷薇果；忧郁

examples.en: She stood there with her hands on her hips glaring at him.
examples.zh: 她站在那里，双手叉腰瞪着他。

examples.en: The old lady had fallen and broken her hip.
examples.zh: 那老妇人摔了一跤，髋部骨折。

words.definition: to eat something quickly because you are very hungry; devastate, wrack and ruin
words.translation: 吞食；吞灭，毁灭；毁灭；凝视

examples.en: The boys devoured their pancakes.
examples.zh: 男孩子们狼吞虎咽地把薄煎饼吃了。

examples.en: Her body had been almost entirely devoured by the disease.
examples.zh: 她的身体几乎完全被疾病摧毁。

words.definition: when you stop working, usually because of your age; superannuation
words.translation: 退休，引退；退隐；[劳经]退休，[军]退役

examples.en: She took early retirement (= retired at an earlier age than usual ) last year.
examples.zh: 她去年提前退休了。

examples.en: Dad’s approaching retirement age .
examples.zh: 爸爸快到退休年龄了。

words.definition: a disadvantage of a situation, plan, product etc; defect, deficiency, disadvantage, vice, fault
words.translation: 妨碍；弊端；缺点，不利条件；退税

examples.en: It’s a great city – the only drawback is the weather.
examples.zh: 这是座很不错的城市，唯一的不足就是天气。

words.definition: something that you think is true, based on information that you have; conclusion, reasoning, consequence
words.translation: 推论；推断的结果；推理；[数]推断

examples.en: There were two inferences to be drawn from her letter.
examples.zh: 从她的来信可以得到两种推论。

words.definition: rational thoughts, decisions etc are based on reasons rather than emotions; reasonable, logical, possible, just, legitimate
words.translation: 合理的；适度的；理性的

examples.en: Parents need to be fully informed so they can make a rational decision.
examples.zh: 父母需要充分了解情况，这样才可以作出合理的决定。

examples.en: I’m sure there’s a rational explanation for all this.
examples.zh: 我相信这一切都有合理的解释。

examples.en: It’s impossible to have a rational conversation with him.
examples.zh: 不可能和他进行理性的谈话。

words.definition: the force that drives a vehicle forward; drive, pulsion
words.translation: 推进，推进力；[力]推进；推进力

examples.en: research into liquid hydrogen as a means of propulsion
examples.zh: 对液态氢作为一种动力方式进行的研究

words.definition: to move, drive, or push something forward; stimulate, power
words.translation: 推进，推动；推进；驱使；激励；驱策

examples.en: a boat propelled by a small motor
examples.zh: 由小马达驱动的小船

examples.en: One of our students was unable to propel her wheelchair up the ramp.
examples.zh: 我们有名学生无法把她的轮椅推上坡道。

words.definition: a suggestion to someone that they should choose a particular thing or person that you think is very good; suggestion, advice, proposal, instance
words.translation: 推荐，介绍；建议；推荐；推荐信

examples.en: We chose the hotel on their recommendation (= because they recommended it).
examples.zh: 我们根据他们的推荐选了这家酒店。

examples.en: It's best to find a builder through personal recommendation.
examples.zh: 最好通过私人介绍寻找施工人员。

words.definition: to remove a leader or government from power, especially by force; the defeat and removal from power of a leader or government, especially by force; capsizal, disintegration; floor, fell
words.translation: 推翻；推翻，瓦解；倾覆；瓦解；打倒

examples.en: Rebels were already making plans to overthrow the government.
examples.zh: 反叛者已在密谋颠覆政府。

examples.en: The organization was dedicated to the overthrow of capitalism.
examples.zh: 该组织致力于推翻资本主义。

words.definition: a sudden strong desire to do something without thinking about whether it is a sensible thing to do; stimulus, pulse, incentive, excitement, needle; drive, force, impel
words.translation: 冲动；推动；[心理]冲动；[电子]脉冲；刺激；神经冲动；推动力

examples.en: a sudden impulse to laugh
examples.zh: 突然想笑的冲动

examples.en: It is the passions which provide the main impulse of music.
examples.zh: 激情是音乐创作的主要动力。

words.definition: used to say that you think something is probably true; probably, possibly, maybe
words.translation: 推测起来，大概；大概；推测起来；可假定

examples.en: It’s raining, which presumably means that your football match will be cancelled.
examples.zh: 下雨了，这可能意味着你们的足球比赛要取消。

words.definition: to believe that something is true because of what you have seen or heard; crop, harvest; concentrate, collect, mass, crowd; collection, clustering
words.translation: 推测，推断；收集；收割；使…聚集；使…皱起；聚集；化脓；皱起；衣褶；收获量

examples.en: You two know each other, I gather.
examples.zh: 我想你们俩认识。

words.definition: to push someone or something in a rough or careless way, using your hands or shoulders; squeeze, force one's way; push, jundy
words.translation: 推，（使劲）推；挤；强使；撞；猛推；推

examples.en: He shoved her towards the car.
examples.zh: 他推着她走向汽车。

examples.en: Everyone was pushing and shoving to see the prince.
examples.zh: 大家都推着挤着要看王子。

words.definition: loyalty and general agreement between all the people in a group, or between different groups, because they all have a shared aim; unity, consolidation
words.translation: 团结；休戚相关；团结，团结一致

examples.en: a gesture of solidarity
examples.zh: 团结的表示

examples.en: an appeal for worker solidarity
examples.zh: 呼吁工人们团结

words.definition: a large group of soldiers, usually consisting of several  battalions; lots of, wealth, ocean, sea, mass
words.translation: 团，军团；一大群；团；大量

examples.en: They deserted from their regiment.
examples.zh: 他们从团里开了小差。

examples.en: a regiment of ants
examples.zh: 一大群蚂蚁

words.definition: someone who robs people, especially one of a group of people who attack travellers; tough, robber
words.translation: 土匪，盗匪，歹徒；强盗，土匪；恶棍；敲诈者

examples.en: They travelled 30 miles through bandit country.
examples.zh: 他们走了30英里，穿过强盗横行的乡间。

words.definition: something you use to influence a situation to get the result that you want; Control arm, heaver
words.translation: 途径，工具，手段；[机]杠杆；控制杆

examples.en: Rich countries use foreign aid as a lever to achieve political aims.
examples.zh: 富国利用对外援助作为达到政治目的的手段。

words.definition: If an event overtakes you, it happens unexpectedly or suddenly.; catch up with, to catch up; cut in
words.translation: 突然发生；压倒；赶上；突然来袭；超车

examples.en: Tragedy was shortly to overtake him, however.
examples.zh: 然而，不幸将很快降临到他的头上。

examples.en: Something like panic overtook me...
examples.zh: 一种恐慌的感觉袭裹了我。

words.definition: the front part of a plane, boat , etc; smell, boko; smell, snuff at; ask after
words.translation: 突出部分（如船头等）；鼻子；嗅觉；突出的部分；探问；嗅；用鼻子触；小心探索着前进

examples.en: They went over to the aeroplane and stood near its nose.
examples.zh: 他们朝飞机走了过去并站在靠近机头的地方。

words.definition: having little or no hair on your head; flat, blank, naked
words.translation: 秃头的；无毛的；[地理]秃顶的；光秃的；单调的；无装饰的

examples.en: a bald man
examples.zh: 一名秃顶男子

examples.en: his shiny bald head
examples.zh: 他那亮闪闪的光头

examples.en: Dad started going bald when he was in his thirties.
examples.zh: 爸爸在三十多岁的时候开始谢顶。

words.definition: a piece of equipment that makes a film or picture appear on a screen or flat surface; projection apparatus, diascope
words.translation: 投影仪；探照灯；[仪][光]投影仪；放映机；设计者

examples.en: ...a slide projector.
examples.zh: …幻灯机。

words.definition: feeling unable to stand steadily, for example because you are looking down from a high place or because you are ill; swimming, foolish, stupid; cloud, confuse
words.translation: 头晕眼花的，眩晕的；晕眩的；使人头晕的；昏乱的；心不在焉的；愚蠢的；使头晕眼花；使混乱；使茫然

examples.en: The heat and the champagne made him feel dizzy .
examples.zh: 高温和香槟酒使他感到眩晕。

examples.en: She started to suffer from dizzy spells (= a short period when you feel dizzy ) .
examples.zh: 她开始感到一阵阵的眩晕。

words.definition: to take something that belongs to someone else; scrump, pick pocket; rip-off, cheapie
words.translation: 偷偷地做，窃取；[法]偷窃；剽窃；偷偷地做；便宜货；偷垒

examples.en: Boys broke into a shop and stole £45 in cash.
examples.zh: 男孩们闯进一家商店，盗走了45英镑现金。

words.definition: great suffering that is caused for example by being very poor or very sick; smart, disaster, hurt, evil, grief
words.translation: 痛苦，悲惨，不幸；痛苦，悲惨；不幸；苦恼；穷困

examples.en: What we are witnessing here is human misery on a vast scale.
examples.zh: 我们在这里所目睹的情景是许许多多的人都生活困苦。

examples.en: the misery of unemployment
examples.zh: 失业的痛苦

examples.en: the miseries of war
examples.zh: 战争造成的苦难

words.definition: severe mental or physical suffering; to make someone suffer a lot, especially mentally; harry, pursue, worry, trouble, tear; smart, hurt
words.translation: 痛苦；折磨；折磨，使痛苦；纠缠，作弄；痛苦，苦恼；痛苦的根源

examples.en: She lay awake all night in torment.
examples.zh: 她一晚上都醒着，在痛苦中煎熬。

examples.en: Seth was tormented by feelings of guilt.
examples.zh: 塞思被负罪感折磨着。

words.definition: to beat someone violently, especially in order to punish them; strike, beat upon; thresh
words.translation: 痛打，鞭打，打；打；使逆行；打谷；白忙；猛烈摆动；逆风浪行进；踢水动作

examples.en: My poor brother used to get thrashed for all kinds of minor offences.
examples.zh: 我那可怜的哥哥过去常常因为各种各样的小错而挨打。

words.definition: more powerful, important, or noticeable than other people or things; ruling, predominant
words.translation: 统治的；主因；显性的；[生物]占优势的；[数]支配的，统治的

examples.en: The firm has achieved a dominant position in the world market.
examples.zh: 这家公司在国际市场上占有举足轻重的地位。

words.definition: a collection of information shown in numbers; correlations, numerical statement
words.translation: 统计，统计数字；[统计]统计；统计学；统计资料

examples.en: crime/unemployment, etc. statistics
examples.zh: 犯罪、失业等统计资料

examples.en: According to official statistics the disease killed over 500 people.
examples.zh: 根据官方的统计数字，500多人死于这种疾病。

words.definition: not changing very much in amount, speed, etc.; flat, equivalent, equal, level; actually, really, too, effectively, yet; equate with; flatten out
words.translation: 平稳的，均匀的；[数]偶数的；平坦的；相等的；甚至；即使；还；实际上；使平坦；使相等；变平；变得可比较；成为相等

examples.en: The room is kept at an even temperature.
examples.zh: 这个房间保持恒温状态。

examples.en: Wood burns at a fairly even rate.
examples.zh: 木头以匀速燃烧。

words.definition: the quality of being similar in appearance to someone or something; photo, picture, image, air, conformity
words.translation: 同样；类似，相似；相似，相像；样子，肖像；照片，画像；相似物

examples.en: I can see the family likeness.
examples.zh: 我看出这一家人都长得很像。

words.definition: someone who helps a criminal, especially by helping them hide from the police; not the most important when compared to others; attachment, mating parts; deputy, vice, subsidiary, auxiliary
words.translation: 同谋，帮凶；附属的；配件；附件；[法]从犯；副的；同谋的；[昆]附属的

examples.en: an accessory to murder
examples.zh: 谋杀案的帮凶

examples.en: the accessory muscles of respiration
examples.zh: 副呼吸肌

words.definition: consisting of people or things that are all of the same type; conspecific
words.translation: 同类的；[化学]均匀的；[数]齐次的；[生物]同种的

examples.en: a homogeneous society
examples.zh: 同种族人组成的社会

words.definition: equal in importance or rank in a sentence; paratactic, tantamount; adjust, restructure; sort, concert
words.translation: 同等的；并列的；[物化]同等的；调整；整合；协调

examples.en: coordinate clauses joined by ‘and’
examples.zh: 用 and 连接的并列分句

words.definition: while
words.translation: 同时；然而

words.definition: to formally or officially tell someone about something; message, post, publish
words.translation: 通知，告知；报告；通告，通知；公布

examples.en: You will be notified of any changes in the system.
examples.zh: 系统中有任何变化都会通知你。

examples.en: In August we were notified that our article had been rejected.
examples.zh: 8月份我们接到通知，说我们的文章不予采用。

words.definition: to tell the public about a product or service in order to persuade them to buy it; message, instruct
words.translation: 登广告；通知；为…做广告；使突出

examples.en: They no longer advertise alcohol or cigarettes at sporting events.
examples.zh: 他们不再在体育赛事上做烟酒广告了。

words.definition: the process of sending and receiving letters; accordance, communication, unity, agreement, identity
words.translation: 通信；相关；相似；一致；相当

examples.en: The magazine is unable to enter into any correspondence on medical matters.
examples.zh: 本杂志无法答复有关医学方面的来信。

examples.en: There is a close correspondence between the two extracts.
examples.zh: 这两段摘录如出一辙。

words.definition: when something or someone is liked or supported by a lot of people; prevalence, diffusedness
words.translation: 通俗性；普及，流行；名气；受大众欢迎

examples.en: The president’s popularity has declined considerably.
examples.zh: 总统的支持率大大下降了。

words.definition: a door, gate, or passage that you go through to enter a place; threshold, registration, access, portal
words.translation: 入口，通道；条目；进入；入口；登记；报关手续；对土地的侵占

examples.en: You can leave your umbrella in the entry.
examples.zh: 你可以把伞放在入口处。

examples.en: a dictionary entry
examples.zh: 词典的条目

words.definition: something that is customary is normal because it is the way something is usually done; usual, used, common, accustomed
words.translation: 通常的；照惯例的；习惯的

examples.en: In some cultures it is customary for the bride to wear white.
examples.zh: 在一些文化中，新娘按风俗要穿白色。

words.definition: usually; commonly, normally, currently, generally
words.translation: 通常，大概；通常地；一般地

examples.en: Ordinarily, he didn’t like to go to the movies.
examples.zh: 一般来说他不喜欢去看电影。

examples.en: This is not the price at which the CD is ordinarily sold.
examples.zh: 这不是这张CD平时卖的价格。

words.definition: a chemical compound that consists of  hydrogen and carbon, such as coal or gas
words.translation: 烃，碳氢化合物

examples.en: hydrocarbon emissions
examples.zh: 碳氢化合物的排放

words.definition: when someone calmly accepts a situation that cannot be changed, even though it is bad; compliance, demission
words.translation: 听从，屈从，顺从；辞职；放弃；辞职书；顺从

examples.en: She gave a sigh of resignation.
examples.zh: 她无奈地叹了一口气。

examples.en: He accepted her decision with resignation.
examples.zh: 他无可奈何地接受了她的决定。

words.definition: someone who makes and repairs things made of iron, especially  horseshoes; smith, ironsmith
words.translation: 铁匠，锻工；铁匠；[机]锻工

examples.en: In my youth my father bound me to a blacksmith.
examples.zh: 在我年轻时我父亲立契让我给一名铁匠当学徒。

examples.en: The smith [blacksmith] forges horseshoes with great skill.
examples.zh: 这个铁匠锻制马掌的手艺很高。

examples.en: A hammer, pliers and an anvil - the main tools of a blacksmith.
examples.zh: 铁匠使用的重要工具：一把大锤、一把铁钳和一个大铁墩

words.definition: containing or relating to iron; iron
words.translation: 铁的；亚铁的；[化学]亚铁的；铁的，含铁的

examples.en: ferrous metals
examples.zh: 含铁[黑色]金属

words.definition: to be next to or joined to sth; abut upon, abut against; abut upon, neighbor
words.translation: 贴近，毗连；靠近；毗连，邻接

examples.en: A vacant plot of land adjoins his house.
examples.zh: 有一块空地紧挨着他家。

words.definition: to move by jumping on one foot; jump, clear; jump, ball, dance, spring; jump, dance
words.translation: （人）单足跳；[计][通信]跳跃；跳过；舞会；短途旅行；单脚跳；作短途旅行

examples.en: a little girl hopping and skipping
examples.zh: 一个蹦蹦跳跳的小女孩

words.definition: if a house, room etc overlooks something, it has a view of it, usually from above; forget, examine, survey, review, inspect; inobservancy, negligence
words.translation: 眺望；看漏；宽容；忽略；俯瞰；远眺；检查；高耸于…之上；忽视

examples.en: Our room overlooks the ocean.
examples.zh: 我们的房间可以俯视大海。

examples.en: It is easy to overlook a small detail like that.
examples.zh: 那样的小细节很容易被忽略。

examples.en: She found him entertaining enough to overlook his faults.
examples.zh: 她觉得他很有趣，足以让她包容他的缺点。

words.definition: to make a machine or your body work at a particular speed, temperature etc; possess, define, contain, manage, state
words.translation: 调整，调节，校准；调节，规定；控制；校准；有系统的管理

examples.en: People sweat to regulate their body heat.
examples.zh: 人出汗以调节体温。

words.definition: to change the sound of your voice; regulate, coordinate
words.translation: 调整，调节（声音）；调节；（信号）调制；调整

examples.en: He carefully modulated his voice.
examples.zh: 他仔细地调节了自己的声音。

words.definition: an official agreement or decision that ends an argument, a court case, or a fight, or the action of making an agreement; transactions, disposal, resolution, treatment, handling
words.translation: 调停；（尤指拓荒者居住的）定居点，村落；解决，处理；[会计]结算；沉降；殖民

examples.en: the search for a peaceful settlement of the Northern Ireland conflict
examples.zh: 寻找和平解决北爱尔兰冲突的办法

examples.en: The railway stations created new settlements.
examples.zh: 这些火车站催生了新的定居点。

words.definition: bad behaviour, especially by children, that causes trouble or damage, but no serious harm; harm, trick
words.translation: 调皮，捣蛋，胡闹；恶作剧；伤害；顽皮；不和

examples.en: Now run along, and don’t get into mischief .
examples.zh: 好了，走开，不要捣乱。

examples.en: They’ve got enough toys to keep them out of mischief for a while.
examples.zh: 他们有足够的玩具玩，暂时不会捣蛋。

examples.en: If you can’t see Nick, you can be sure he’s up to some mischief (= behaving badly and causing trouble or damage ) .
examples.zh: 要是看不到尼克，就可以肯定他又在捣什么鬼了。

words.definition: a situation in which two people, ideas, or statements agree with each other; agreement, unity, identity, keeping, consensus; afford, allow, deal, extend, deliver; cotton, identify, square, meet with, correspond with
words.translation: 符合；协议；一致；自愿；使一致；给予

examples.en: These results are in accord with earlier research.
examples.zh: 这些结果和先前的研究一致。

examples.en: the Helsinki accord on human rights
examples.zh: 赫尔辛基人权协定

words.definition: a written set of questions which you give to a large number of people in order to collect information
words.translation: 调查表，征求意见表

examples.en: Teachers will be asked to fill in a questionnaire.
examples.zh: 教师们将被要求填写一份调查问卷。

words.definition: how sweet something tastes or smells; aroma, balminess
words.translation: 甜蜜，芬芳；愉悦，美好；美妙；芳香；可爱

examples.en: the sweetness of the wild rose
examples.zh: 野玫瑰的芬芳

examples.en: a smile of great sweetness
examples.zh: 十分甜蜜的微笑

words.definition: sweet food served after the main part of a meal
words.translation: 甜点心

examples.en: She had homemade ice cream for dessert.
examples.zh: 她吃了些自制冰淇淋当餐后甜点。

words.definition: connected with the Roman Catholic Church; a member of the Catholic Church
words.translation: 天主教的；天主教徒

examples.en: ...the Catholic Church.
examples.zh: …天主教会。

words.definition: the scientific study of the stars and  planet s; uranology
words.translation: 天文学；[天]天文学

examples.en: Do you know anything about astronomy?
examples.zh: 你懂天文学吗?

words.definition: the main subject or idea in a piece of writing, speech, film etc; topic, subject, titles, motive
words.translation: 题目；主题；主旋律；（句子的）主位；词干

examples.en: The book’s theme is the conflict between love and duty.
examples.zh: 本书的主题是爱与责任之间的冲突。

examples.en: Freia’s theme in Wagner’s opera
examples.zh: 瓦格纳歌剧中的弗莱雅主旋律

words.definition: to provide money, especially a lot of money, to pay for something; policy of tightening control over expenditure and credit, cameralistics; fund raising
words.translation: 提供资金；[财政]财政，财政学；[金融]金融；筹措资金

examples.en: The concerts are financed by the Arts Council.
examples.zh: 音乐会由艺术协会出资举办。

words.definition: to give a person or other living thing the food and other substances they need in order to live, grow, and stay healthy; harbor
words.translation: 提供养分，养育；滋养；怀有；使健壮

examples.en: The cream contains vitamin A to nourish the skin.
examples.zh: 这种护肤霜含有滋养肌肤的维生素A。

examples.en: a well nourished baby
examples.zh: 营养良好的婴儿

words.definition: to improve something; raise, cement, boost, muscle, gain
words.translation: 提高，增加；改进；提高；加强；增加

examples.en: Good lighting will enhance any room.
examples.zh: 良好的照明能给房间增色不少。

examples.en: The publicity has enhanced his reputation.
examples.zh: 这次宣传提高了他的声誉。

words.definition: to take a pure form of a substance out of another substance that contains it; cleanse, decontaminate; fine purification, purge
words.translation: 提纯，精炼（金属）；净化；使纯净；变纯净

words.definition: to begin to talk or write about a subject that you want to be considered or a question that you think should be answered; enhance, mother, foster, breed; arise, go up, climb; height, rise, altitude, elevation, upgrade
words.translation: 提出，发起，发出；提高；筹集；养育；升起；上升；高地；加薪

examples.en: He did not raise the subject again.
examples.zh: 他再也没有提起这个话题。

examples.en: I’d like to raise the issue of publicity.
examples.zh: 我想提一提宣传问题。

examples.en: Betty raised the important question of who will be in charge.
examples.zh: 贝蒂提出了一个重要问题，就是将由谁来负责。

examples.en: data input
examples.zh: 数据输入

words.definition: an amount of money given to someone, especially by the government, for a particular purpose; award, let, accept, recognize, agree; accept, see with, to agree with, agree on/upon, be agreeable to; appropriation
words.translation: 拨款；[法][专利]授予；允许；承认；同意；[法][专利]授予物

examples.en: The university gets a government grant.
examples.zh: 这所大学获得政府拨款。

examples.en: Anyone wishing to apply for a grant should write to the Treasurer.
examples.zh: 凡希望申请补助者，请致函财务主管。

words.definition: someone, especially a child, who depends on you for food, clothes, money etc; chamberlaine, parasite
words.translation: 受赡养者；家眷；侍从；食客（等于dependent）

examples.en: Companies with 200 or more workers must offer health benefits to employees and their dependants.
examples.zh: 员工数为200或更多的公司必须为其员工和员工的受扶养人提供健康福利。

words.definition: someone who is not generous and does not like spending money; screw, pinchfist
words.translation: 守财奴，吝啬鬼；守财奴；吝啬鬼；（石油工程上用的）凿井机

examples.en: I'm married to a miser.
examples.zh: 我嫁了个守财奴。

words.definition: a large basket on wheels that you use for carrying bags, shopping etc; pushcart, manual truck; tram
words.translation: 手推车；有轨电车；（美）无轨电车（等于streetear）；（英）有轨电车（等于trolleybus）；空中吊运车；[车辆]乘电车

examples.en: a supermarket trolley
examples.zh: 超市购物手推车

examples.en: He took a northbound trolley on State Street.
examples.zh: 他在州大街坐上了一辆北行的有轨电车。

words.definition: a short book that gives information or instructions about something; manual, guide, notebook
words.translation: 手册，便览，指南；[图情]手册；指南

examples.en: the Fiction Writer’s Handbook
examples.zh: 《小说写作手册》

words.definition: the act or process of adopting a child; acceptance, introduction, receiving
words.translation: 收养；采纳，采取；采用；接受

examples.en: She decided to put the baby up for adoption.
examples.zh: 她决定让人收养那个婴儿。

examples.en: the adoption of new technology
examples.zh: 新技术的采用

words.definition: a formal and very serious promise; pledge, asseveration
words.translation: 誓言，誓约，宣誓；誓言，誓约；诅咒，咒骂

examples.en: The president took the oath of office (= made the official public promises that every president makes when starting their job ) .
examples.zh: 总统宣誓就职。

examples.en: She could not break her oath .
examples.zh: 她不能违背誓言。

words.definition: a serious promise; oath, pledge; plight one's troth, cross my heart
words.translation: 誓言，誓约，许愿；发誓；誓言；许愿；郑重宣告

examples.en: Jim made a vow that he would find his wife’s killer.
examples.zh: 吉姆发誓要找到杀害他妻子的凶手。

words.definition: a serious promise or agreement, especially one made publicly or officially; to make someone formally promise something; assurance, certification, commitment, guarantee, mortgage; undertake, assure, promise
words.translation: 誓言；使发誓；保证，誓言；[经]抵押；抵押品，典当物；保证，许诺；用……抵押；举杯祝……健康

examples.en: a pledge of support for the plan
examples.zh: 支持该计划的誓约

examples.en: Employees were pledged to secrecy.
examples.zh: 员工被要求保证严守秘密。

words.definition: used or happening inside a building; chamber, endocellular
words.translation: 室内的；室内进行的；室内的，户内的

examples.en: an indoor swimming pool
examples.zh: 室内游泳池

examples.en: the world indoor athletics championship
examples.zh: 世界室内田径锦标赛

examples.en: Too much central heating can harm indoor plants.
examples.zh: 中央供暖系统温度太高对室内植物有害。

words.definition: likely to make you healthy; healthy, calculating, sound
words.translation: 对健康有益的；健全的；有益健康的；合乎卫生的；审慎的

examples.en: well-balanced wholesome meals
examples.zh: 营养均衡的健康餐

words.definition: in a way which is not extreme or stays within reasonable limits; reasonably, temperately
words.translation: 适度地，适中；适度地；中庸地；有节制地

examples.en: He drinks moderately.
examples.zh: 他喝酒有节制。

words.definition: right for a particular situation or occasion; an outside part of a piece of equipment that makes it possible to use or handle it; assembly, device, apparatus, installation, unit; adaptive, calculated, matching, well, worthy
words.translation: 适当的；配件；[机]装配，装置；[服装]试穿，试衣；适合的，适宜的；相称的

examples.en: I thought the memorial was a fitting tribute to the President.
examples.zh: 我认为这座纪念碑恰如其分地表达了对总统的敬意。

examples.en: new light fittings
examples.zh: 新款灯具配件

words.definition: the degree to which someone or something is suitable or good enough for a particular situation or purpose; health, adaptability, relevance, wellness
words.translation: 适当，恰当；健康；适当；适合性

examples.en: He questioned McNeil’s fitness for high office.
examples.zh: 他质疑麦克尼尔是否适合身居高位。

examples.en: Running marathons requires a high level of physical fitness.
examples.zh: 跑马拉松需要身体十分强健。

words.definition: the ability to see; sight, imagination, eye, seeing, eyesight; image, envision
words.translation: 视力；眼力，想象力；[生理][眼科]视力；美景；眼力；幻象；想象力；想象；显现；梦见

examples.en: She suffered temporary loss of vision after being struck on the head.
examples.zh: 她头部受撞击以后出现暂时性失明。

examples.en: a leader of vision
examples.zh: 有远见的领袖

words.definition: something that happens; emergence, going on, event, discovery, appearance, circumstance, scene
words.translation: 发生的事；发生；出现；事件；发现

examples.en: Laughter was a rare occurrence in his classroom.
examples.zh: 他的课堂上难得有笑声。

examples.en: Flooding in the area is a common occurrence.
examples.zh: 该地区经常发生水灾。

words.definition: someone who thinks they are better than people from a lower social class – used to show disapproval; tuft-hunter
words.translation: 势利小人；势利小人，势利眼；假内行

examples.en: Stop being such a snob.
examples.zh: 别这么势利眼。

examples.en: I don’t want to sound like a snob, but I thought she was vulgar.
examples.zh: 我不想像个势利小人，但我觉得她就是庸俗。

words.definition: behaving in a way that shows you think you are better than other people because you are from a higher social class or know more than they do; dicty
words.translation: 势利的，谄上欺下的；势利的

examples.en: Her family seems snobbish.
examples.zh: 她家里人好像挺势利的。

words.definition: the power to make other people agree with your opinions or do what you want; effect, infection, impression, affection, incidence; affect, impact of, impact on, reach, fashion
words.translation: 势力，权势；影响；势力；感化；有影响的人或事；改变

examples.en: He used his influence to get his son into medical school.
examples.zh: 他利用权势把儿子弄进了医学院。

examples.en: He denies exerting any political influence over them.
examples.zh: 他否认曾向他们施加过政治影响。

words.definition: to obey a law, rule etc; accord, meet with; accord, reconcile; united, consistent, matching, uniform, corresponding
words.translation: 使遵守；一致；符合；遵照；适应环境；使一致；使顺从；一致的；顺从的

examples.en: The building does not conform with safety regulations.
examples.zh: 例句：这座建筑物不符合安全条例。

examples.en: It did not conform to the usual stereotype of an industrial city.
examples.zh: 这和一座常规的工业城市那种千篇一律的格局不一样。

words.definition: to start using computers and machines to do a job, rather than people; robotize
words.translation: 使自动化；使自动化，使自动操作

examples.en: Cash machines automate two basic functions of a bank – deposits and withdrawals.
examples.zh: 柜员机使银行的两个基本功能——存款和取款自动化了。

words.definition: to make something longer or to become longer; elongate; get long
words.translation: 使延长，变长；使延长；加长；延长；变长

examples.en: Can you lengthen this skirt for me?
examples.zh: 你能不能帮我把这条裙子改长？

examples.en: The days lengthened as summer approached.
examples.zh: 随着夏天来临，白天变长了。

words.definition: to make someone feel ashamed; abashment; discountenance, abash
words.translation: 使羞愧；玷辱；羞耻，羞愧；憾事，带来耻辱的人；使丢脸，使羞愧

examples.en: It shames me to say it, but I lied.
examples.zh: 说出来真难为情，我撒谎了。

examples.en: She had shamed her family name (= done something that made her family lose honour ) .
examples.zh: 她玷污了家族的名声。

words.definition: to make something look or feel clean, new, attractive, cool etc; irrigate
words.translation: 使显得新鲜；使清新；使新鲜；使精神焕发

examples.en: Using a mouthwash freshens the breath.
examples.zh: 使用漱口液可以使口气清新。

examples.en: The rain had freshened the air.
examples.zh: 下雨使空气变得清新了。

words.definition: to be the thing that makes someone or something different or special; tell apart, differentiate; differentiate, tell from
words.translation: 使显出特色，使杰出；区分；辨别；使杰出，使表现突出；区别，区分

examples.en: The factor that distinguishes this company from the competition is customer service.
examples.zh: 使这家公司在竞争中脱颖而出的是其客户服务。

examples.en: The main distinguishing feature of this species is the leaf shape.
examples.zh: 这一品种的主要特征是叶子的形状。

words.definition: if a liquid evaporates, or if heat evaporates it, it changes into a gas; vapor; disappear, blank
words.translation: 使脱水，发散蒸气；使……蒸发；使……脱水；使……消失；蒸发，挥发；消失，失踪

examples.en: Most of the water had evaporated.
examples.zh: 大部分的水都蒸发了。

examples.en: The sun evaporates moisture on the leaves.
examples.zh: 太阳会蒸发叶子上的水分。

words.definition: to fasten a ship or boat to the land or to the bottom of the sea using ropes or an anchor; bend on; wild, cienaga
words.translation: 使停泊；使固定；系住；[地理]沼泽；荒野

examples.en: Two or three fishing boats were moored alongside the pier.
examples.zh: 有两三艘渔船停泊在码头边。

words.definition: to make something as good as you are able to; greatest, ideal, prime, best, full; round off, polish up
words.translation: 使熟练，使改善；完美的；最好的；精通的；使完美；使熟练

examples.en: Mock trials help students perfect their legal skills.
examples.zh: 模拟庭审有助于学生们完善自己的法律技能。

words.definition: to put a lubricant on something in order to make it move more smoothly
words.translation: 使润滑，加润滑油

examples.en: Lubricate all moving parts with grease.
examples.zh: 给所有活动部件加润滑油。

words.definition: to become or to make sb/sth more sympathetic and less severe or critical; comfort, gentle; tender, to alleviate
words.translation: 使软化，变温和；使温和；使缓和；使变柔软；减轻；变柔和；变柔软

examples.en: The government has softened its stance on public spending.
examples.zh: 政府对公共开支问题的态度软化了。

words.definition: to make sb/yourself familiar with or aware of sth; familiarize
words.translation: 使认识，使了解；使熟悉；使认识

examples.en: Have steps been taken to acquaint breeders with their right to apply for licenses?
examples.zh: 已经采取措施让饲养动物者了解他们申请执照的权利了吗？

words.definition: making you feel annoyed or impatient; terrible, boring
words.translation: 使人厌倦的，讨厌的；烦人的，无聊的；令人讨厌的

examples.en: the whole tiresome business of filling out the forms
examples.zh: 填写表格这套烦人事

words.definition: very sad; heartbroken, saddest
words.translation: 使人伤心的；悲伤的；悲伤的，伤心的

examples.en: a sorrowful expression
examples.zh: 悲伤的表情

words.definition: to burn very brightly and strongly; tell the world, go public; flame, brilliance; burn, to shine
words.translation: 使燃烧，燃烧；在树皮上刻路标；公开宣布；火焰，烈火；光辉；情感爆发；燃烧；照耀，发光；激发

examples.en: The room was warm, with a fire blazing in the hearth.
examples.zh: 房间里暖融融的，壁炉里的火熊熊燃烧。

words.definition: to bring sb/sth under control, especially by using force; master, stay, restrain, moderate
words.translation: 使屈服，征服；征服；抑制；减轻

examples.en: Senior government officials admit they have not been able to subdue the rebels.
examples.zh: 高级政府官员们承认他们还没能制服反叛者们。

words.definition: to render submissive; wind, curve; tend, affect; curve, give, winding, inflection
words.translation: 使屈从，屈从；使弯曲；使屈服；使致力；使朝向；弯曲，转弯；屈服；倾向；专心于；弯曲

words.definition: to be acceptable, suitable, or convenient for a particular person or in a particular situation; become, condition, season, adapt to something; litigation, group, team, lawsuit, law; balance, be in order
words.translation: 使配合，彼此协调；适合；使适应；诉讼；组；套装；恳求；合适；相称

examples.en: Whatever your reason for borrowing, we have the loan that suits your needs.
examples.zh: 不管您因何贷款，我们都会有满足您需要的贷款。

examples.en: There are countryside walks to suit everyone.
examples.zh: 有适合每个人的乡村步行路径。

words.definition: (of problems or a difficult situation) to appear and need to be dealt with by sb; front, compare
words.translation: 使面对；使对证；面对；遭遇；比较

examples.en: The problems confronting the new government were enormous.
examples.zh: 新政府面临的难题是巨大的。

examples.en: I confronted him with my suspicions, and he admitted everything.
examples.zh: 我当面向他提出我的怀疑，他什么都承认了。

words.definition: if something paralyses you, it makes you lose the ability to move part or all of your body, or to feel it
words.translation: 使麻痹，使瘫痪

examples.en: Her legs were partly paralysed in the crash.
examples.zh: 在撞车事故中她的双腿部分瘫痪。

words.definition: to make someone go deaf; flood, flow
words.translation: 使聋；淹没

examples.en: He was deafened by the noise from the gun.
examples.zh: 枪声把他震聋了。

words.definition: to force a country or group of people to be ruled by you, and control them very strictly; topic, theme, nation, titles, motive; followed, compliant
words.translation: 使隶属；[图情]主题；科目；[语]主语；国民；服从的；易患…的；受制于…的

examples.en: The Roman Empire subjected most of Europe to its rule.
examples.zh: 罗马帝国把欧洲多数地区置于自己的统治之下。

words.definition: to make someone extremely afraid; gallow, intimidate
words.translation: 使恐怖，使惊吓；恐吓；使恐怖；使害怕

examples.en: Her husband’s violence terrified her.
examples.zh: 丈夫的暴力行为让她感到害怕。

words.definition: to cover or protect something with a material that stops electricity, sound, heat etc from getting in or out; segregant, quarantine
words.translation: 使绝缘，使绝热；隔离，使孤立；使绝缘，使隔热

examples.en: an insulated attic
examples.zh: 隔热[隔音]的阁楼

examples.en: Pipes may need insulating against the cold.
examples.zh: 管道可能需要隔温以防冰冻。

words.definition: to combine two or more things so that they work together; to combine with sth else in this way; become one flesh; complete, absolute, full, total, round; gleichschaltung
words.translation: 使结合，使并入；求积分；取消隔离；成为一体；整合的；完全的；一体化；集成体

examples.en: These programs can be integrated with your existing software.
examples.zh: 这些程序能和你的已有的软件整合成一体。

words.definition: to make things or people follow one after the other in a repeated pattern; (of two things) happening or following one after the other regularly; turn by one's, take one's turn; rotate; rotary, vicissitudinary; refill
words.translation: 使交替；交替的；交替；轮流；使轮流；[物]交替的；轮流的；替换物

examples.en: Alternate cubes of meat and slices of red pepper.
examples.zh: 交替放置肉丁和红辣椒片。

examples.en: alternate layers of fruit and cream
examples.zh: 水果层和奶油层相间

words.definition: to treat someone without respect and make them lose respect for themselves; lower, bemean; sink in the scale, lower down
words.translation: 使降低；使堕落；贬低；使……丢脸；使……降级；使……降解；降级，降低；退化

examples.en: a movie that degrades women
examples.zh: 贬损女性的影片

examples.en: How can you degrade yourself by writing such trash?
examples.zh: 你怎么能写这种垃圾作品来自贬身份呢？

words.definition: to reduce something that is difficult, dangerous, or unpleasant to the smallest possible amount or degree
words.translation: 使减到最小

examples.en: Every effort is being made to minimize civilian casualties.
examples.zh: 正在尽最大努力减少平民伤亡。

examples.en: The rail company is bringing in more trains in an effort to minimize disruption to travellers.
examples.zh: 铁路公司正投入更多的列车来减少旅客的不便。

words.definition: to combine or make one thing combine with another
words.translation: 使混合，混合起来

examples.en: The sounds of laughter and singing mingled in the evening air.
examples.zh: 笑声和歌声交织在夜空中。

examples.en: Her tears mingled with the blood on her face.
examples.zh: 她的泪水和脸上的血混在了一起。

words.definition: to connect similar things; to be connected to or with similar things
words.translation: 使互相联系

examples.en: a series of interconnected lakes
examples.zh: 一连串相互连接的湖泊

examples.en: interconnecting rooms
examples.zh: 相连的房间

examples.en: Our operating system can now interconnect with other networks.
examples.zh: 我们的操作系统现在能和其他网络相连。

words.definition: to cause problems or difficulties for sb; slow, abash
words.translation: 使…陷入困境；使局促不安；使困窘；阻碍

examples.en: The speech was deliberately designed to embarrass the prime minister.
examples.zh: 这个发言是故意为难首相。

words.definition: to be slowly destroyed by a natural chemical process, or to make something do this; fail, flag; recession, downturn, decline, decomposition; corrupt, septicize
words.translation: 使腐朽，使腐烂；衰退，[核]衰减；腐烂，[木]腐朽；使腐烂，使腐败；使衰退，使衰落

examples.en: Her body was already starting to decay.
examples.zh: 她的尸体已经开始腐烂。

examples.en: Most archaeological finds are broken, damaged, or decayed.
examples.zh: 大部分考古发现物都已破裂、损坏或腐烂。

examples.en: decaying organic matter
examples.zh: 腐烂的有机物

words.definition: to compare two things, ideas, people etc to show how different they are from each other; parallel, distinction, differential
words.translation: 使对比；形成对比；对比；差别；对照物

examples.en: an essay comparing and contrasting (= showing how two things are similar and different ) Verdi and Wagner and their operas
examples.zh: 把威尔第和瓦格纳以及他们的歌剧进行比较和对照的一篇文章

examples.en: The snow was icy and white, contrasting with the brilliant blue sky.
examples.zh: 冰冷的白雪和明媚的蓝天交相辉映。

words.definition: to become fully grown or developed; developed, adult, due; age, flower
words.translation: 使成熟，成熟；[农学][地质]成熟的；充分考虑的；到期的；成年人的；[农学][地质]成熟；到期

examples.en: As the fish matures, its colours and patternings change.
examples.zh: 随着发育成熟，这种鱼的颜色和斑纹都会改变。

examples.en: She has matured into a fine writer.
examples.zh: 她已经成长为一名优秀的作家。

words.definition: gelato, reservedness; glacial
words.translation: 使成冰，结冰；[水文][制冷]冰；冰淇淋；矜持；冰的

words.definition: to put too many things or people on or into something; superimposed load, surcharge
words.translation: 使超载；[交][电]超载；负荷过多

examples.en: Be careful not to overload the washing machine.
examples.zh: 注意别让洗衣机负荷过重。

examples.en: The bus was overloaded with tourists and their luggage.
examples.zh: 公共汽车载着满满的游客和行李。

words.definition: to become twisted together, or make something become twisted together, in an untidy mass; dissension, entanglemant; intertangle, entangle; rough and tumble
words.translation: 使缠结，使纠缠；纠纷；混乱状态；使纠缠；处于混乱状态；缠结；乱作一团

examples.en: My hair tangles easily.
examples.zh: 我的头发很容易打结。

examples.en: His parachute became tangled in the wheels of the plane.
examples.zh: 他的降落伞缠在了飞机的轮子上。

words.definition: to make something sweeter, or become sweeter; moderate, gentle
words.translation: 使变甜，变甜；减轻；使变甜；使温和；使悦耳

examples.en: Sweeten the mixture with a little honey.
examples.zh: 往混合料里加点蜂蜜。

words.definition: to become thick, or make something thick; fog, obfuscate; elaborate
words.translation: 使变厚（或粗、密）；使变厚；使模糊；使…变复杂；变浓；变厚；变得模糊；变粗；变复杂

examples.en: The fog was beginning to thicken.
examples.zh: 雾气渐浓。

examples.en: Thicken the soup by adding potatoes.
examples.zh: 加些马铃薯让汤变稠。
