words.definition: the production or sending out of light, heat, gas, etc.; shot, sending, launch, jet, projection
words.translation: 散发；传播；发出物；（光、热等的）[物]发射，散发；喷射；发行

examples.en: the emission of carbon dioxide into the atmosphere
examples.zh: 向大气排放二氧化碳

examples.en: Britain agreed to cut emissions of nitrogen oxide from power stations.
examples.zh: 英国同意减少发电站氮氧化物的排放量。

words.definition: a slow relaxed walk; tour, bummel; roam around, have a walk
words.translation: 散步，溜达，闲逛；漫步；闲逛；巡回演出；散步

examples.en: After dinner, I took a stroll round the city.
examples.zh: 晚饭后，我绕着城溜达了一圈。

words.definition: shaped like a triangle; trigonal, three-cornered
words.translation: 三角的；三者间的；[数]三角的，三角形的；三人间的

examples.en: a triangular roof
examples.zh: 一个三角形的屋顶

examples.en: a triangular sporting competition
examples.zh: 一项由三方参加的体育比赛

words.definition: a small piece of metal, rubber etc that you place over or into a musical instrument to make it sound softer; silent, dumb; sordino, sourdine
words.translation: 弱音器；哑的；沉默的；[电影]无声的；哑巴；闭锁音

examples.en: He was playing his trumpet with a mute.
examples.zh: 他正在吹装了弱音器的小号。

words.definition: the person or thing that someone chooses; (especially of food) of very good quality; chose, selection, option, election, pick; picked, select, chosen
words.translation: 入选者；优等的；选择；选择权；精选品；精选的；仔细推敲的

examples.en: I think London was a good choice as a venue.
examples.zh: 我觉得伦敦是个很好的选址。

examples.en: choice steak
examples.zh: 上等牛排

words.definition: allowing people to do, say, or believe what they want without criticizing or punishing them; kind, good-tempered
words.translation: 容忍的；有耐力的；宽容的；有耐药力的

examples.en: a tolerant society
examples.zh: 宽容的社会

examples.en: trees that are tolerant of salt sea winds
examples.zh: 能耐海风的树木

words.definition: happening as a normal part of a job or process; the usual order in which you do things, or the things you regularly do; procedure, program; daily, everyday, household
words.translation: 日常的；常规；[计]程序；日常工作；例行公事；例行的

examples.en: You mustn’t worry. These are just routine enquiries.
examples.zh: 你不必担心，这只是例行的询问。

examples.en: John’s departure had upset their daily routine.
examples.zh: 约翰的离去打乱了他们的日常生活。

words.definition: to begin to realize the possible effects of a situation; be aware that, be on to; arouse, wake sb. up; waking, wakeful
words.translation: 认识到；觉醒，意识到；醒来；被唤起；唤醒；使觉醒；激起，唤起；醒着的

examples.en: Artists finally awoke to the aesthetic possibilities of photography.
examples.zh: 艺术家终于意识到了摄影的美学潜质。

words.definition: the act of knowing someone or something because you have known or learned about them in the past; identification, discernment
words.translation: 认出，识别；[计][免疫]识别；承认，认出；重视；赞誉；公认

examples.en: He stared at her, but there was no sign of recognition .
examples.zh: 他盯着她看，但似乎没认出她来。

words.definition: official papers or cards, such as your passport, that prove who you are; authentication, recognition
words.translation: 身份证；认出，鉴定；鉴定，[计]识别；认同；身份证明

examples.en: Do you have any identification?
examples.zh: 你有什么身份证明文件吗？

examples.en: His body was taken to Brighton mortuary for identification.
examples.zh: 他的尸体被送到布赖顿停尸所确认身份。

words.definition: being kind to people and forgiving them rather than punishing them or being cruel; kind, humane
words.translation: 仁慈的，宽大的；仁慈的；慈悲的；宽容的

examples.en: Merciful God, save us.
examples.zh: 仁慈的上帝，救救我们吧。

words.definition: someone who is kept as a prisoner by an enemy so that the other side will do what the enemy demands; guarantee, pledge
words.translation: 人质；抵押品

examples.en: The group are holding two tourists hostage (= keeping them as hostages ) .
examples.zh: 这伙人挟持了两名游客作为人质。

examples.en: a family taken hostage at gunpoint
examples.zh: 在枪口下被劫为人质的一家人

words.definition: a black, sticky substance that is used on roofs, the bottoms of ships etc to stop water coming through; slope, throw, lean; throw, cast, camp; extent, degree, resin, putting, measure
words.translation: 沥青；倾斜；投掷；搭帐篷；坠落；投；掷；定位于；用沥青涂；扎营；向前倾跌；音高；程度；[松脂]树脂

examples.en: The timbers of similar houses were painted with pitch.
examples.zh: 类似房屋所用的栋木刷了沥青。

words.definition: the department in a company that chooses people for jobs and deals with their complaints, problems etc; crew, Personnel Department
words.translation: 人事部门；全体人员

examples.en: A copy should then be sent to Personnel for our files.
examples.zh: 然后必须送一份到人事部供我们存档。

examples.en: the personnel department
examples.zh: 人事部

words.definition: people in general; mankind, people, mercy, kindness
words.translation: 人类；人性，人情；[人类]人类；人道；仁慈；人文学科

examples.en: We want a clean healthy environment for all humanity .
examples.zh: 我们希望全人类拥有一个干净健康的生存环境。

examples.en: We must never forget our common humanity.
examples.zh: 我们永远不要忘记共同的人性。

words.definition: someone’s character, especially the way they behave towards other people; being, kidney, lion, individuality
words.translation: 人格，个性；名人；[心理]个性；品格

examples.en: Despite their different personalities, they became the best of friends.
examples.zh: 尽管个性不同，他们还是成了最好的朋友。

examples.en: one of the most well-liked TV personalities
examples.zh: 最受欢迎的电视名人之一

words.definition: relating to or caused by heat; hot, heated, hottest
words.translation: 热的；温热的；[热]热的，热量的

examples.en: thermal energy
examples.zh: 热能

examples.en: thermal springs
examples.zh: 温泉

words.definition: one of the two imaginary lines around the world, either the Tropic of Cancer which is 23.5˚ north of the  equator  , or the Tropic of Capricorn which is 23.5˚ south of the equator; torrid zone, regression line; intertropical, subsolar
words.translation: 回归线；热带地区；[地理]热带；[天]回归线；[地理]热带的

examples.en: the Tropic of Capricorn/the Tropic of Cancer
examples.zh: 南/北回归线

examples.en: plant species found in the tropics
examples.zh: 见于热带地区的植物物种

words.definition: the process of burning; burning, inflammation
words.translation: 燃烧；[热]燃烧，氧化；骚动

examples.en: The energy is released by combustion on the application of a match.
examples.zh: 能量通过点火柴燃烧释放出来。

words.definition: one of the hairs that grow on a man’s face; beared, hige
words.translation: 髯，连鬓胡子；[晶体]晶须；胡须；腮须

examples.en: ...wild, savage-looking fellows, with large whiskers and dirty faces.
examples.zh: …一些狂野、面相凶恶的家伙，留着满脸的络腮胡子，蓬头垢面。

words.definition: to go or gather together somewhere in large numbers; cluster, gang, bunch, qun; concentrate, collect, mass, crowd
words.translation: 群集，聚集；群；棉束（等于floc）；聚集；成群而行

examples.en: People have been flocking to the exhibition.
examples.zh: 看展览的人络绎不绝。

words.definition: the feeling of being sure about something and having no doubts; assurance, damningness
words.translation: 确信，信服，深信；定罪；确信；证明有罪

examples.en: It was a reasonable explanation, but his voice lacked conviction .
examples.zh: 这解释合情合理，只是他的语气不坚定。

examples.en: It took her so much effort to speak that what she said carried great conviction (= showed she felt sure of what she said ) .
examples.zh: 她费了很大的劲在说，因此说出来的话显得很确定。

words.definition: the fact that something is certain to happen; very like a whale, inerrability
words.translation: 确实性，确信，确实；必然；确实；确实的事情

examples.en: the certainty of being caught
examples.zh: 被抓的必然

words.definition: used to emphasize that something is true, especially when this seems surprising; specifically, definitely, particularly, flat, emphatically
words.translation: 确定的，断然；肯定地；明确地；断然地

examples.en: Some holiday destinations are positively dangerous .
examples.zh: 有些度假地真的很危险。

words.definition: to calculate the value of something and express it as a number or an amount
words.translation: 确定…的数量

examples.en: an attempt to quantify the region’s social and economic decline
examples.zh: 对该地区社会和经济衰退进行量化的尝试

words.definition: a lack of something that is necessary; defect, shortage, vice, need, fault
words.translation: 缺乏；不足；缺陷，缺点；不足的数额

examples.en: a deficiency of safe play areas for children
examples.zh: 儿童安全游戏场地的缺乏

words.definition: to persuade someone to do something, especially something that does not seem wise; attract, produce, cause, operate, occasion
words.translation: 劝诱；引起；诱导；引诱；感应

examples.en: Nothing would induce me to vote for him again.
examples.zh: 没有什么能诱使我再投他的票了。

examples.en: Doctors said surgery could induce a heart attack.
examples.zh: 医生们说手术可能导致心脏病。

words.definition: the act of persuading someone to do something; faith, wing
words.translation: 劝说，说服；说服；说服力；信念；派别

examples.en: After a little gentle persuasion , Debbie agreed to let us in.
examples.zh: 好言劝说了几句后，黛比就同意让我们进去了。

examples.en: It had taken a great deal of persuasion to get him to accept.
examples.zh: 费尽了口舌才让他接受。

examples.en: She used all her powers of persuasion (= skill at persuading people ) to convince Tilly that it was the right thing to do.
examples.zh: 她使尽浑身解数，才劝服蒂莉应该那么做。

words.definition: used about someone who has died fairly recently; recent, current, last, nearest; recently, newly, deep, last
words.translation: 去世不久的；晚的；迟的；已故的；最近的；晚；迟；最近；在晚期

examples.en: Billy Hicks, late of this parish
examples.zh: 不久前故去的本教区的比利·希克斯

words.definition: to remove an object from somewhere, especially with difficulty; a short piece of writing, music etc taken from a particular book, piece of music etc; abstract, milk, pop; juice, succus
words.translation: 取出；提取；摘录；[图情]摘录；榨取；汁；[化学][药][化工]榨出物；选粹

examples.en: You’ll have to have that tooth extracted.
examples.zh: 你得把那颗牙拔掉。

examples.en: Oils are extracted from the plants.
examples.zh: 从这些植物中提炼出油。

examples.en: I’ve only seen short extracts from the film.
examples.zh: 我只是看过那部电影的一些小片段。

words.definition: a handle on a piece of equipment, that you can turn in order to move something; to make something move by turning a crank; whim, vagary; irascible, passionate
words.translation: 曲柄；用曲柄转动；[机]曲柄；奇想；易怒的

examples.en: He was idly turning a crank on a strange mechanism strapped to his chest.
examples.zh: 他漫不经心地转着绑在他胸前的一个古怪装置上面的曲柄。

examples.en: Try cranking the engine.
examples.zh: 试试用曲轴发动引擎。

words.definition: to gradually become less or weaker before disappearing completely, or to make something do this; lose, spend; to break up, sow one's wild oats
words.translation: 驱散；消散；浪费；使…消散；放荡

examples.en: As he thought it over, his anger gradually dissipated.
examples.zh: 他想明白后，怒气就渐渐消了。

examples.en: His savings were soon dissipated.
examples.zh: 他的积蓄很快就花完了。

words.definition: having the shape of a sphere; global, ball-shaped
words.translation: 球形的，球面的；[数]球形的，球面的；[天]天体的

examples.en: ...purple and gold spherical earrings.
examples.zh: ...紫色和金色的球形耳环。

words.definition: affecting or including the whole world; spherical, ball-shaped
words.translation: 全球的；总体的；球形的

examples.en: global climate change
examples.zh: 全球气候变化

examples.en: the global economy
examples.zh: 全球经济

words.definition: the planet that is fifth in order from the sun and is the largest in the solar system
words.translation: 木星；丘庇特

examples.en: a space probe on its way to Jupiter
examples.zh: 飞向木星的一个太空探测器

words.definition: a request that is urgent or full of emotion; explanation, asking, request, prayer, excuse
words.translation: 请愿，请求，恳求；恳求，请求；辩解，辩护；借口，托辞

examples.en: Caldwell made a plea for donations.
examples.zh: 考德威尔恳求捐款。

words.definition: a written request signed by a lot of people, asking someone in authority to do something or change something; to ask the government or an organization to do something by sending them a petition; imprecation; demand, apply for; apply for, pray for
words.translation: 请愿；向…请愿；[法][专利]请愿书；祈求；诉状；[专利]请求；恳求

examples.en: Local residents have drawn up a petition to protest the hospital closure.
examples.zh: 当地居民已草拟了一份请愿书，抗议关闭医院。

examples.en: Villagers petitioned the local authority to provide better bus services.
examples.zh: 村民请愿要求地方当局提供更好的公共汽车服务。

words.definition: something you can see; vision, scene, eye, scope, seeing; see, clap eyes on; level, watch; off-the-cuff, improvisatorial
words.translation: 景象；名胜，风景；视力；眼界；见解；看见；瞄准；观看；见票即付的；即席的

examples.en: the sights and sounds of the forest
examples.zh: 森林的景致与声音

examples.en: In the afternoon, you’ll have a chance to relax or see the sights.
examples.zh: 大家下午可以休息，也可以去参观名胜。

words.definition: a woman that a man has a sexual relationship with, even though he is married to someone else; other woman, moll
words.translation: 情妇，情人；情妇；女主人；主妇；女教师；女能人

examples.en: The Prince had shocked society by living openly with his mistress.
examples.zh: 王子和他的情妇公开同居，让社会大为震惊。

words.definition: a building in which Muslims worship
words.translation: 清真寺

examples.en: Would you go to church or the synagogue or the mosque?
examples.zh: 你会去教堂，犹太教会，或者清真寺吗？

words.definition: the practice of keeping yourself or the things around you clean; Seiso, pureness
words.translation: 清洁

examples.en: a high standard of cleanliness
examples.zh: 很高的卫生标准

words.definition: a movement made down towards the ground; tendency, liability, hill, trend, interest
words.translation: 倾斜，点头；斜坡；倾向，爱好

examples.en: She greeted Maggie with an inclination of the head.
examples.zh: 她向玛吉点头打招呼。

words.definition: a series of quick sharp hits or knocks; to hit or knock something quickly several times; tap, reave; strike, knock on; bob, peening
words.translation: 轻敲击声；敲击；抢走；轻敲；敲击致使；使着迷；交谈

examples.en: She was woken by a sharp rap on the door.
examples.zh: 她被一阵急促的敲门声惊醒。

examples.en: She rapped the table with her pen.
examples.zh: 她用笔笃笃地敲桌子。

words.definition: (of people or their actions) doing sth that may not be sensible without first thinking about the possible results; done in this way; hasty, imprudent; quat, tetter
words.translation: 轻率的；鲁莽的；不顾后果的；[皮肤]皮疹；突然大量出现的事物

examples.en: Please Jessie, don’t do anything rash.
examples.zh: 求你了，杰西，不要草率行事。

examples.en: Don’t go making any rash decisions about your future!
examples.zh: 不要对你的未来贸然作决定！

examples.en: It was rather rash of you to lend them your car.
examples.zh: 你把汽车借给他们实在有欠考虑。

words.definition: the dark reddish brown colour of bronze; gunmetal; aeneous
words.translation: 青铜色；[材]青铜；古铜色；青铜制品；青铜色的；青铜制的

examples.en: Her hair shone bronze and gold.
examples.zh: 她的头发闪耀着青铜色和金黄色的光彩。

words.definition: a feeling of great respect and liking for something or someone; envy, envious of
words.translation: 钦佩；赞美，羡慕；赞赏；羡慕；赞美

examples.en: Daniel gazed at her in admiration .
examples.zh: 丹尼尔用爱慕的眼神注视着她。

words.definition: pleasant; pleasant, adaptive, lovely, calculated, grateful
words.translation: 惬意的；同意的；令人愉快的；适合的；和蔼可亲的

examples.en: We spent a most agreeable couple of hours.
examples.zh: 我们非常愉快地度过了几个小时。

examples.en: My parents are quite agreeable to my studying abroad.
examples.zh: 我父母很同意我去国外留学。

words.definition: one of the parts that something such as an object or place is divided into; ministry, region, division, department, area
words.translation: 部分；截面；部门；地区；章节

examples.en: The plane’s tail section was found in a cornfield.
examples.zh: 飞机的尾部在玉米田里找到了。

examples.en: the smoking section (= where you can smoke )
examples.zh: 吸烟区

words.definition: a part of something that is different from or affected differently from the whole in some way; to cut up, divide up; dan, proportion, part, portion, percent; to cut up, deleave
words.translation: 切片，部分；段，节；分割；[计]段；部分

examples.en: segments of the population
examples.zh: 人口中的若干组成部分

words.definition: to make a straight narrow cut in cloth, paper, skin etc; a long straight narrow cut or hole; tear, lancinate; crack, split
words.translation: 切开；狭长的切口；撕裂；使有狭缝；裂缝；投币口

examples.en: They say somebody slit her throat.
examples.zh: 他们说有人割断了她的喉咙。

examples.en: light shining through a slit in the door
examples.zh: 透过门缝照进来的光线

words.definition: strong and healthy and able to bear difficult living conditions; strong, tough, game, brave, steel
words.translation: 强壮的，耐劳的；坚强的；勇敢的；能吃苦耐劳的；鲁莽的

examples.en: hardy mountain goats
examples.zh: 能适应恶劣环境的石山羊

words.definition: that must be done because of a law or a rule; required, obligatory; required routine
words.translation: 强迫的，义务的；义务的；必修的；被强制的；（花样滑冰、竞技体操等的）规定动作

examples.en: the threat of compulsory redundancies
examples.zh: 强制性裁员的威胁

examples.en: Car insurance is compulsory.
examples.zh: 汽车保险是强制性的。

words.definition: something that limits your freedom to do what you want; enforcement, restriction
words.translation: 限制，束缚，约束；[数]约束；局促，态度不自然；强制

examples.en: the constraints of family life
examples.zh: 家庭生活的约束

examples.en: Constraints on spending have forced the company to rethink its plans.
examples.zh: 由于开支受到限制，这家公司不得不重新考虑其计划。

words.definition: very strong and powerful, or very big and impressive; powerful, male, influential, vigorous, energetic; greatly, quite, badly, too, extremely, far, highly; big guns
words.translation: 强大的；巨大的；有力的；强有力的；有势力的；很；极；非常；有势力的人

examples.en: the mighty Mississippi river
examples.zh: 浩荡的密西西比河

examples.en: a mighty army
examples.zh: 强大的军队

words.definition: not thinking about the needs and feelings of other people, especially because you are thinking about what you want; hasty, indiscreet
words.translation: 欠考虑的；自私的；轻率的；考虑不周的；不顾及他人的

examples.en: a selfish and thoughtless man
examples.zh: 自私而不顾他人的人

words.definition: to express strong disapproval of someone or something, especially in public; condemn, denunciate
words.translation: 谴责，声讨；告发；谴责；公然抨击；通告废除

examples.en: The group denounced the failure by the authorities to take action.
examples.zh: 该团体谴责当局没有采取行动。

examples.en: She denounced him to the police.
examples.zh: 她向警方告发了他。

words.definition: having strong religious beliefs, and showing this in the way you behave; religious, good
words.translation: 虔诚的；虔奉宗教的；敬神的；可嘉的；尽责的

examples.en: He was a quiet, pious man.
examples.zh: 他是个文静、虔诚的人。

words.definition: someone who had your job before you started doing it; father, grand old man
words.translation: 前辈，前任者；前任，前辈

examples.en: Kennedy’s predecessor as President was the war hero Dwight Eisenhower.
examples.zh: 肯尼迪总统的前任是战争英雄德怀特·艾森豪威尔。

words.definition: an official mark put on your passport that gives you permission to temporarily enter or leave a foreign country; vise
words.translation: 签证

examples.en: I was still in New York, trying to get a visa to visit Russia.
examples.zh: 我仍在纽约，正在办理去俄罗斯的签证。

words.definition: the fact of not talking much about your abilities or possessions; humility, humbleness
words.translation: 谦逊；端庄；质朴；稳重

examples.en: ‘Anyone else would have done the same thing,’ he said with typical modesty.
examples.zh: 换了谁都会这么做的。”他带着一贯的谦虚说道。

examples.en: There were shrieks of embarrassment as the girls struggled to protect their modesty.
examples.zh: 竭力保持着端庄形象的女孩们发出了尴尬的尖叫。

words.definition: behaving in a polite, kind, and generous way, especially to people of a lower rank; nice, friendly, sweet, delicate, magnificent; oh, my, dear, egad
words.translation: 谦和的；亲切的；高尚的；和蔼的；雅致的；天哪；哎呀

examples.en: Sibyl was the most gracious, helpful, and generous person to work with.
examples.zh: 西比尔非常和蔼，乐于助人，而且为人慷慨，和她共事最愉快。

examples.en: a gracious apology
examples.zh: 落落大方的道歉

words.definition: a unit for measuring electrical power, equal to 1,000 watts
words.translation: 千瓦（特）

examples.en: a prototype system which produces 25 kilowatts of power
examples.zh: 一个生产25千瓦电量的样机

words.definition: appropriate to a particular situation; relevant, relational, correlative
words.translation: 恰当的；有关的；相关的，相干的；中肯的；切题的

examples.en: He asked me a lot of very pertinent questions.
examples.zh: 他问了我许多直接相关的问题。

examples.en: The last point is particularly pertinent to today’s discussion.
examples.zh: 最后一点和今天的讨论关系尤为密切。

words.definition: exactly right for a particular situation or purpose; sensitive, correct, quick, prone, liable
words.translation: 恰当的；聪明的；有…倾向的；灵敏的

examples.en: ‘Love at first sight’ is a very apt description of how he felt when he saw her.
examples.zh: 用“一见钟情”来形容他见到她时的感觉再恰当不过。

examples.en: She had taught him French and he had been an apt student.
examples.zh: 她教过他法语，他一直是个聪慧的学生。

words.definition: a thing such as a knife, spoon etc that you use when you are cooking; vessel, tool
words.translation: 器皿，用具；用具，[轻]器皿

examples.en: kitchen utensils
examples.zh: 厨房用具

words.definition: a tree which grows mainly in northern countries such as Canada. Its leaves have five points and turn red or gold in autumn.; golden brown
words.translation: 槭树，枫树；枫树；淡棕色

examples.en: a maple leaf
examples.zh: 枫叶

words.definition: someone who believes in a particular system of ideas, or who supports a leader who teaches these ideas; Christian, old faithful
words.translation: 信徒，追随者；追随者；信徒；属下

examples.en: Marx and his followers were convinced that capitalism would destroy itself.
examples.zh: 马克思及其支持者确信资本主义将自我毁灭。

words.definition: a piece of equipment that makes very loud warning sounds, used on police cars, fire engines etc
words.translation: 汽笛，警报器

examples.en: the wail of the ambulance sirens
examples.zh: 救护车汽笛的尖啸

examples.en: I heard police sirens in the distance.
examples.zh: 我听到了远处的警笛声。

words.definition: a very wide road for travelling fast over long distances, especially between cities; expressway, freeway
words.translation: 汽车道，快车路；[公路]高速公路，汽车高速公路

examples.en: busy/congested motorways
examples.zh: 繁忙的 / 拥挤的高速公路

examples.en: Join the motorway at Junction 19.
examples.zh: 在19号路口进入高速公路。

words.definition: up to this time; hereunto, erenow
words.translation: 迄今，到目前为止；迄今；至今

examples.en: a species of fish hitherto unknown in the West
examples.zh: 迄今在西方还不为人知的一种鱼

words.definition: an instrument that measures changes in the air pressure and the weather, or that calculates height above sea level; weatherglass
words.translation: 气压计，睛雨表；[气象]气压计；睛雨表；显示变化的事物

examples.en: The barometer is falling (= showing that it will probably rain).
examples.zh: 气压在下降（表示可能要下雨）。

words.definition: to breathe quickly with short noisy breaths, for example because you have been running or because it is very hot; rare, aspire; asthma, wheeziness
words.translation: 气喘；喘息；渴望；气喘吁吁地说出某事；喷气声

examples.en: He came in panting after running up the steps.
examples.zh: 他跑上台阶，气喘吁吁地走了进来。

examples.en: He was panting for breath .
examples.zh: 他上气不接下气。

examples.en: The dog lay panting on the doorstep.
examples.zh: 那条狗躺在门阶上喘着气。

words.definition: a piece of equipment used to lift a heavy weight off the ground, such as a car, and support it while it is in the air; boy, he, man, guy; enhance, boost, mount, hot, gain; dog
words.translation: 起重器；传动装置；[机]千斤顶；[电]插座；男人；增加；提醒；抬起；用千斤顶顶起某物；雄的

examples.en: a hydraulic jack
examples.zh: 液压千斤顶

words.definition: a small cut on someone’s skin; abrasion, brush-burn; hit-and-miss; paw, hent; grasp, strike
words.translation: （某人皮肤上的）划痕，划伤；擦伤；抓痕；刮擦声；乱写；打草稿用的；凑合的；碰巧的；抓；刮；挖出；乱涂；搔；发刮擦声；勉强糊口；退出比赛

examples.en: There were deep scratches all over her face.
examples.zh: 她脸上全是深深的伤痕。

words.definition: one of the crimes that someone is charged with; figure, expect, guess, find, feel; calculation, computation, valuation
words.translation: 起拆理由，罪状；计算；认为；[数]计数；伯爵

examples.en: Davis was found not guilty on all counts .
examples.zh: 戴维斯受到指控的各项罪名均不成立。

words.definition: the main or most important idea that someone is trying to tell people about in a film, book, speech etc; news, prediction, word; inform of, report to; give notice, instruct, advise of
words.translation: 启示，要旨，教训；消息；差使；启示；预言；广告词；报信，报告；[通信]报文；通知

examples.en: The message of the film is that good always triumphs over evil.
examples.zh: 这部电影的主题思想是善良终必战胜邪恶。

examples.en: The result of this legal battle sends an important message to people in similar situations.
examples.zh: 这场诉讼战的结果给情况相似的人们传递了一个重要的信息。

examples.en: It’s perfectly possible to get your message across (= communicate what you want to say ) without being so angry.
examples.zh: 就算不这么生气，你也完全可以把意思说清楚。

words.definition: to give someone more knowledge and greater understanding about something; suggest, channel, wise
words.translation: 启发，开导；启蒙；启发，启蒙；教导，开导；照耀

examples.en: Baldwin enlightened her as to the nature of the experiment.
examples.zh: 鲍德温给她讲解了这个实验的性质。

words.definition: to ask for something in an emotional way
words.translation: 乞求，恳求，哀求

examples.en: ‘Don’t go,’ I implored her.
examples.zh: “不要走。”我哀求她。

words.definition: a man with a high rank in the past who was trained to fight while riding a horse; chevalier, Cavs
words.translation: 骑士，武士；爵士

examples.en: knights in armour
examples.zh: 身披盔甲的骑士

examples.en: He hopes to be made a knight for his work at the Bank of England.
examples.zh: 他希望因为他在英格兰银行的工作而被封为爵士。

words.definition: a wonderful and surprising person or thing; to be very surprised or impressed by sth; phenomenon, miracle, wonder
words.translation: 奇迹；惊奇

examples.en: the marvels of nature/technology
examples.zh: 大自然的 / 技术的奇迹

examples.en: Everyone marvelled at his courage.
examples.zh: 人人对他的勇气都惊叹不已。

words.definition: something that is dishonest or unfair; sell, fox, kid; kid, pull a fast one; fraud, sharp, deception
words.translation: 欺诈；骗取；[法]欺骗；作弊；[法]欺骗，作弊；骗子

examples.zh: 这东西真是骗人，但如果你愿意的话，可以用现成的油酥面团。

words.definition: a magazine, especially one about a serious or technical subject; regular, stated, time, cyclical; magazine, journal, serial
words.translation: 期刊，杂志；[数]周期的；定期的；期刊；杂志

examples.en: The walls would be lined with books and periodicals.
examples.zh: 沿这几面墙将排放书籍和期刊。

words.definition: at the present time; commonly, normally, generally
words.translation: 当前；一般地

examples.en: the products that are currently available
examples.zh: 目前供应的产品

examples.en: He is currently working on his first novel.
examples.zh: 他目前正在创作他的第一本小说。

words.definition: by everyone; generally, everywhere, around, throughout, about
words.translation: 普遍地，一般地；普遍地；人人；到处

examples.en: ...a universally accepted point of view.
examples.zh: …一个被普遍接受的观点。

words.definition: a unit for measuring grain and fruit (equal in volume to 8 gallons); trim up, give shape to
words.translation: 蒲式耳（容量单位）；修整（衣服等）

examples.en: Grains are sold by the bushel.
examples.zh: 谷物论蒲式耳出售。

examples.en: Wheat averages 56 pounds to a bushel.
examples.zh: 小麦平均 56 磅为一蒲式耳。

words.definition: a dried  grape; rasin
words.translation: 葡萄干

examples.en: ...homemade oatmeal with brown sugar and raisins.
examples.zh: …自家煮的放有红糖和葡萄干的麦片粥。

words.definition: a break in a bone or other hard material; to break or crack; to make sth break or crack; cracking, rhexis; crack, come apart at the seams; crack, flaw
words.translation: 破裂；裂痕；破裂，[力]断裂；[外科]骨折；折断；使破裂

examples.en: a fracture of the leg/skull
examples.zh: 腿骨 / 颅骨骨折

examples.en: His leg fractured in two places.
examples.zh: 他的一条腿有两处骨折。

words.definition: without enough money to pay what you owe; to make a person, business, or country bankrupt or very poor; broke, belly-up; put out of business, bust; insolvent
words.translation: 破产的；使破产；[经]破产的；[经]使破产；[经]破产者

examples.zh: 建筑工程尚未竣工，公司就破产了。

examples.en: Johns had been nearly bankrupted through a failed business venture.
examples.zh: 约翰斯因为商业投资失败几近破产。

words.definition: to treat someone cruelly or unfairly over a period of time, especially because of their religious or political beliefs; beset, eat at
words.translation: 迫害，残害；迫害；困扰；同…捣乱

examples.en: The Puritans left England to escape being persecuted.
examples.zh: 清教徒离开了英国以躲避迫害。

words.definition: a slope; pitch, slope, affect; slope, lean; hill, slope, decline, pitch
words.translation: 坡度；倾斜；倾向；易于；使倾斜；使倾向于；斜面；斜坡

examples.en: a steep incline
examples.zh: 陡坡

words.definition: a special type of bottle that you use to keep liquids either hot or cold, for example when travelling; lagena, winebottle
words.translation: 瓶；[分化]烧瓶；长颈瓶，细颈瓶；酒瓶，携带瓶

examples.en: He took out a metal flask from a canvas bag.
examples.zh: 他从帆布袋里拿出了一个金属水瓶。

words.definition: a small nail with a sharp point and a flat top; to attach something to a wall, board etc, using a tack; food, diet, eating; annex, subjoin
words.translation: 平头钉；钉住；[五金]大头钉；粗缝；行动方针；食物；附加；以大头针钉住

examples.en: ...a box of carpet tacks.
examples.zh: …一盒地毯钉。

examples.en: A handwritten note was tacked to the wall.
examples.zh: 一张手写便条钉在墙上。

words.definition: a flat outdoor area next to a building or on a roof, where you can sit outside to eat, relax etc; platform, balcony
words.translation: 平台，阳台，露台；平台；[农]梯田；[建]阳台

examples.en: Some guests recline in deck chairs on the sea-facing terrace.
examples.zh: 有些客人斜躺在朝海露台的躺椅上。

words.definition: anyone who is not a member of the military forces or the police; used to describe people or things that are not military; many-headed; populace, common man
words.translation: 平民；平民的；民用的；百姓的，平民的；平民，百姓

examples.en: Many innocent civilians were killed during the war.
examples.zh: 许多无辜的平民在战争中丧生。

examples.en: It was difficult to return to civilian life after ten years in the military.
examples.zh: 从军十年后重新过平民生活不容易。

words.translation: 平静的；稳定的；安静的，平静的；安宁的

examples.en: a small tranquil village
examples.zh: 宁静的小村庄

words.definition: a problem or situation in which several things must be considered and dealt with; eqs, equivalence
words.translation: 平衡；反应式；[数]方程式，等式；相等；[化学]反应式

examples.zh: 有了孩子以后，婚姻中可能出现新的矛盾。

words.definition: a balance between different people, groups, or forces that compete with each other, so that none is stronger than the others and a situation is not likely to change suddenly; peace, proportion, equalization
words.translation: 平衡，均衡；均衡论；均衡；平静；保持平衡的能力

examples.zh: 政府急切希望不要打乱经济平衡。

words.translation: 平凡的；平常话；老生常谈；司空见惯的事；普通的东西；陈腐的

examples.zh: 镇上的这个地段盗车案屡见不鲜。

examples.en: It is a commonplace to say that Northern Ireland is a backwater in the modern Europe.
examples.zh: 说北爱尔兰是现代欧洲死气沉沉的落后地区已是陈词滥调了。

words.definition: the fact that something happens a lot; periodicity
words.translation: 频繁，屡次；频率；[物]频率；频繁

examples.zh: 商家开张停业惊人地频繁。

examples.en: the frequency of serious road accidents
examples.zh: 重大道路交通事故的发生率

words.definition: (of land or soil) not good enough for plants to grow on it; sterile, unprofitable; waste, wilderness, abandoned land

examples.zh: 很久很久以前，地面还是一片荒漠。

examples.en: He prayed that his barren wife would one day have a child.
examples.zh: 他祈祷自己不孕的妻子有朝一日能怀上宝宝。

words.definition: to make something pale or white, especially by using chemicals or the sun; snow; go white, whiten; decolorant, whitener
words.translation: 漂白，变白；[纺]使漂白，使变白；变白，[纺]漂白；[纺]漂白剂

examples.en: She bleached her hair blonde.
examples.zh: 她把头发漂成了金黄色。

examples.en: The wood had been bleached by the sun .
examples.zh: 木头已被太阳晒得褪了色。

words.definition: a small thin piece that breaks away easily from something else; chip, shell; spark, A FRAME
words.translation: 片，薄片；剥落；成片状剥落；小薄片；火花

examples.en: chocolate flakes
examples.zh: 巧克力薄片

words.definition: a sudden change in the direction that sth is moving in, usually after it has hit sth; the act of causing sth to change direction; differences, deviation
words.translation: 偏斜，歪斜；偏差；偏向；[力]挠曲

examples.en: the deflection of the missile away from its target
examples.zh: 使导弹偏离目标

words.definition: (of an area, a building, a room, etc.) next to or near sth; nearby, neighbor
words.translation: 毗连的；紧接着的；邻近的，毗连的

examples.zh: 我们住在毗连的房间里。

examples.en: the building adjacent to the library
examples.zh: 紧挨着图书馆的建筑

words.definition: a long loose piece of clothing without sleeves that fastens around your neck and hangs from your shoulders; ness, promontory
words.translation: 披肩，斗篷；海角；[地理]海角，岬；披肩

examples.en: ...a woollen cape.
examples.zh: …一件羊毛披肩。

examples.en: Cape Cod
examples.zh: 科德角

words.definition: an argument between two people or groups because they have very different beliefs or opinions – used in news reports; interference, conflict, war, collision, warfare; tang, collide with
words.translation: 冲突，抵触；碰撞声；冲突，不协调；碰撞声，铿锵声；砰地相碰撞，发出铿锵声

examples.en: personality/culture clash (=a situation in which two people or groups do not like each other)
examples.zh: 个性/文化冲突

examples.en: the clash of swords
examples.zh: 剑的撞击声

words.definition: one of the foods that you use to make a particular food or dish; element, factor, material, basic, essential
words.translation: 配料，成分；原料；要素；组成部分

examples.en: Combine all the ingredients in a large bowl.
examples.zh: 把所有食材都放在一个大碗里。

examples.en: The food is home-cooked using fresh ingredients.
examples.zh: 这种食物是用新鲜的食材在家里烹制的。

words.definition: a metal container, like a large bullet, which is full of an explosive substance and is fired from a large gun; configuration, profile, shot; chip, flake off; skin, flay
words.translation: 炮弹，猎枪子弹；[动][机]壳，贝壳；炮弹；外形；剥落；设定命令行解释器的位置；剥皮；炮轰

examples.en: We ran for cover as shells dropped all around us.
examples.zh: 周围炮弹四处飞落，我们奔跑着寻找地方躲避。

examples.en: an exploding mortar shell
examples.zh: 一枚爆炸的迫击炮弹

words.definition: a type of soft rubber with a lot of air in it, used in furniture; bubble, spray, yeast; spume
words.translation: 泡沫塑料；泡沫；水沫；灭火泡沫；起泡沫；吐白沫；起着泡沫流动

examples.en: a foam mattress
examples.zh: 海绵橡胶床垫

examples.en: The sea was covered in foam.
examples.zh: 海面上泛着一层泡沫。

words.definition: a tube that allows gas or liquid to flow around something rather than through it; to go around a town or other busy place rather than through it; ignore, neglect; side road, passby
words.translation: 旁通管；绕过；绕开；忽视；设旁路；迂回；旁路；[公路]支路

examples.en: a triple bypass operation
examples.zh: 接三通管的手术

examples.en: Interstate 8 bypasses the town to the north.
examples.zh: 八号州际公路绕城向北而行。

words.definition: to walk slowly and with difficulty because one leg is hurt or injured; a way of walking in which one leg is used less than normal because it is injured or stiff; weak, soft, tender, ductile; hirple, hilch; claudication, hirple
words.translation: 蹒跚，跛行；跛行；柔软的，无力的；软弱的；跛行，一拐一拐地走；缓慢费力地前进

examples.en: Moreno limped off the field with a foot injury.
examples.zh: 莫雷诺脚上受了伤，一瘸一拐地走出球场。

examples.en: Young walked with a slight limp.
examples.zh: 扬走路有一点跛。

words.definition: to walk or move unsteadily, almost falling over; interlace; titubate, hesitate; titubation, hitchiness; altern, interlaced
words.translation: 蹒跚，使摇晃；蹒跚；使交错；使犹豫；犹豫；交错安排；交错的；错开的

examples.zh: 他好不容易才蹒跚着走回家。

examples.en: She staggered back a step.
examples.zh: 她踉跄着后退了一步。

examples.zh: 老汉醉醺醺地踉跄着站了起来。

words.definition: a small group of people within a larger group, who have different ideas from the other members, and who try to get their own ideas accepted; wing, junta
words.translation: 派别，宗派，小集团；派别；内讧；小集团；纪实小说

examples.zh: 党内的派系斗争

examples.en: the leaders of the warring factions
examples.zh: 交战各派的领导人

words.definition: to stay nervously in the same place, especially because you are waiting for something or are not certain what to do; plane, orbit; vibration, spinning around; brood, hatch
words.translation: 徘徊；傍徨；翱翔；盘旋；盘旋，翱翔；犹豫；孵；徘徊在…近旁

examples.zh: 她的弟弟在后面走来走去，观察着我们。

examples.zh: 盘旋在水面上方的苍蝇

words.definition: the process or system by which water or waste liquid flows away; wastewater, bailing
words.translation: 排水；下水道；[农工][建]排水；排水系统；污水；排水面积

examples.en: A handful of pebbles in the bottom of a flowerpot will help drainage.
examples.zh: 在花盆底下放一把鹅卵石能够帮助排水。

examples.en: a plan to improve the town’s drainage system
examples.zh: 改善城里排水系统的计划

words.definition: to put things in a particular order or position; extent, boundary, region, scope, spectrum, territory, area; reach, parallel with; feed, grass
words.translation: 排列；范围；幅度；排；[地理]山脉；平行，列为一行；延伸；漫游；射程达到；放牧；使并列；归类于；来回走动

examples.en: In the dining room, team photographs were ranged along the wall.
examples.zh: 餐厅里，球队的照片排列在墙上。

words.definition: the loud sound that you make when you hit your hands together many times to show that you enjoyed something; plaud; handclap
words.translation: 拍手喝采声；霹雳声；拍手，鼓掌；轻轻拍打某人；鼓掌；拍手声

examples.en: Come on everyone, let’s give Tommy a clap.
examples.zh: 来吧各位，我们为汤米鼓鼓掌吧。

examples.en: an ear-splitting clap of thunder
examples.zh: 震耳欲聋的雷声

words.definition: a type of animal, such as a snake or lizard , whose body temperature changes according to the temperature around it, and that usually lays eggs to have babies
words.translation: 爬行动物

examples.en: This small reptile, which measures just 10 centimeters long, can swim through the sand dunes at up to 15 centimeters per second.
examples.zh: 这种身长只有10厘米小型爬行动物，可以在沙子中以最快每秒15厘米的速度游动。

words.definition: to accidentally hear what other people are saying, when they do not know that you have heard; happen to hear, listen in on
words.translation: 偶然听到；偷听；无意中听到

examples.en: I overheard part of their conversation.
examples.zh: 我碰巧听到了他们谈话的部分内容。

examples.en: I couldn’t help overhearing your argument.
examples.zh: 我无意中听到了你们的争吵。

words.definition: a unit for measuring electrical resistance
words.translation: 欧姆

words.definition: a woman who invites guests to a meal, a party, etc.; a woman who has people staying at her home; goodwife, mistress
words.translation: 女主人；旅馆女老板；女主人，女老板；女服务员；舞女；女房东

examples.en: Mary was always the perfect hostess.
examples.zh: 玛丽总是最殷勤的女主人。

words.definition: relating to being female; female, negative
words.translation: 女性的；女子气的；[生物]女性的；妇女（似）的；阴性的；娇柔的

examples.en: traditional feminine roles
examples.zh: 传统的女性角色

examples.en: Dianne loved pretty feminine things.
examples.zh: 黛安娜喜爱漂亮有女人味的东西。

words.definition: a woman who serves food and drink at the tables in a restaurant; chambermaid, usherette
words.translation: 女侍者，女服务员；[劳经]女服务员；女侍者

words.definition: a female being who is believed to control the world or part of it, or represents a particular quality; nymph
words.translation: 女神；女神，受崇拜的女性

examples.en: Aphrodite, goddess of love
examples.zh: 爱神阿佛洛狄忒

words.definition: chicken, molly; timid, harehearted
words.translation: 懦怯的，胆小的；懦夫，懦弱的人；胆小的，懦怯的

words.definition: a thin metal container that is fastened to a wall and through which hot water passes to provide heat for a room; heatsink, heating unit
words.translation: 暖气片；散热器；[电]散热器；[建]暖气片；[声][物][核]辐射体

examples.en: a central heating system with a radiator in each room
examples.zh: 每个房间都配有一个散热器的中央供暖系统

examples.en: My car engine overheated because the water had leaked out of the radiator.
examples.zh: 我的汽车引擎过热，原因是散热器漏水。

words.definition: to make a great effort to achieve something; apply oneself, struggle, labor
words.translation: 努力，奋斗，力求；努力；奋斗；抗争

examples.en: I was still striving to be successful.
examples.zh: 我仍在努力争取成功。

examples.en: We must continue to strive for greater efficiency.
examples.zh: 我们必须继续为提高效率而努力。

words.definition: to make something look untidy or dirty; difficulty, disorder, chaos, confusion, corner; destroy, soil, mud, spot, damage; play fast and loose, toy with
words.translation: 弄脏，弄乱，搞糟；混乱；食堂，伙食团；困境；脏乱的东西；弄乱，弄脏；毁坏；使就餐；把事情弄糟；制造脏乱；玩弄

examples.en: He scratched his head and messed his hair even more.
examples.zh: 他挠挠头，把头发弄得更乱了。

words.definition: the changing of something into something that is not true or not acceptable; deformation, transformation
words.translation: 歪曲；畸变；[力]变形；[物]失真；扭曲；曲解

examples.en: a distortion of the facts
examples.zh: 对事实的歪曲

examples.en: modern alloys that are resistant to wear and distortion
examples.zh: 耐磨、防变形的新型合金

words.definition: to become shorter or make something shorter; weaken, fall off; telescope
words.translation: 弄短，缩小，减少；缩短；减少；变短

examples.en: The days are shortening.
examples.zh: 白天变得越来越短了。

words.definition: the planet that is sixth in order from the sun and is surrounded by large rings
words.translation: 土星

examples.en: Saturn is the second biggest planet in the solar system.
examples.zh: 土星是太阳系中的第二大行星。

words.definition: containing a lot of milk; female, delicate
words.translation: 牛奶的；乳白色的；乳状的；柔和的；混浊不清的

examples.en: a cup of milky coffee
examples.zh: 一杯牛奶咖啡

examples.en: A milky mist filled the valley.
examples.zh: 乳白色的薄雾弥漫了山谷。

words.definition: to twist and pull something roughly from the place where it is being held; a twisting movement that pulls something violently; violence, smart, strain, hurt; harry, worry, trouble, tear; rick
words.translation: 拧，扭伤；拧；扳手，[机]扳钳；扭伤；痛苦；歪曲；猛扭；曲解；折磨；猛绞

examples.en: I wrenched the packet from his grasp.
examples.zh: 我用力夺过他攥在手里的纸袋。

examples.en: He grabbed the rope and gave it a wrench.
examples.zh: 他抓住绳子猛地一拉。

words.definition: to tightly twist a wet cloth or wet clothes in order to remove water; screw, harry, worry, trouble, tear; squirm, wriggle; twist, tweak
words.translation: 拧，挤，扭，榨；拧；绞；紧握；使痛苦；折磨；蠕动；扭动；感到痛苦；感到苦恼；挤

examples.en: This jacket’s wringing wet!
examples.zh: 这件上衣湿得都能拧出水来！

words.definition: a hard silver-white metal that is often combined with other metals, for example to make steel. It is a chemical element: symbol Ni; Ni, medio
words.translation: 镍；镍币；[化学]镍；五分镍币

examples.en: a nickel alloy
examples.zh: 镍合金

examples.en: ...a large glass jar filled with pennies, nickels, dimes, and quarters.
examples.zh: …一个装满1分、5分、10分和25分硬币的大玻璃罐。

words.definition: If you are someone's junior, you are younger than they are; inferior, lower
words.translation: 年少者；晚辈；年少的；后进的；下级的

examples.en: She now lives with actor Denis Lawson, 10 years her junior.
examples.zh: 她现在和比她小10岁的演员丹尼斯·劳森同居。

words.definition: once a year; yearly
words.translation: 年年，每年；每年；一年一次

examples.en: The exhibition is held annually.
examples.zh: 这个展览每年举行一次。

words.definition: able to be done; likely to be successful; feasible, usable
words.translation: 能实行的；适用的；可用的；行得通的；可实行的

examples.en: The only practicable course of action is to sell the company.
examples.zh: 唯一可行的做法是把公司卖掉。

examples.en: at the earliest practicable opportunity
examples.zh: 在尽可能早的时机

words.definition: the natural ability, skill, or power that makes a machine, person, or organization able to do something, especially something difficult; talent, ability, competence, performance, property, quality
words.translation: 能力，才能；才能，能力；性能，容量

examples.en: the country’s manufacturing capability
examples.zh: 该国的生产能力

examples.en: I can speak French, but simultaneous translation is beyond my capabilities (= too difficult ).
examples.zh: 我能讲法语，但是同声传译我做不了。

words.definition: a sheltered area of water providing a safe harbour for boats; valley, pot
words.translation: 内海；盆地；流域；水池；[水文]流域；[地理]盆地；盆

examples.en: a yacht basin
examples.zh: 停放游艇的内港

examples.en: the Pacific Basin
examples.zh: 太平洋海盆

examples.en: the Amazon basin
examples.zh: 亚马孙河流域

words.definition: the inner part or inside of something; inside or indoors; essence, principle, texture, entity, inner; inner, domestic, essential, inside, home
words.translation: 内部；内部的；本质；国内的；本质的

examples.en: The interior of the church was dark.
examples.zh: 教堂里很暗。

examples.en: The interior walls are all painted white.
examples.zh: 室内墙壁都粉刷成了白色。

words.definition: to move your fingers on a sensitive part of sb's body in a way that makes them laugh; please, glad, satisfy, content
words.translation: 挠，胳肢；逗乐；使发痒；使高兴；使满足

examples.en: Stop tickling me!
examples.zh: 别挠我痒痒！

examples.en: I was tickled to discover that we'd both done the same thing.
examples.zh: 我高兴地发现我俩在做同样的事。

words.definition: too strange to be believed, or very difficult to believe; tremendous, unbelievable, spectacular, fabulous
words.translation: 难以置信的，惊人的

examples.en: It’s incredible that he survived the fall.
examples.zh: 他跌下去竟然能够生还，真不可思议。

examples.en: It’s incredible how much Tom has changed since he met Sally.
examples.zh: 自从遇见萨莉后，汤姆的变化之大简直令人难以置信。

examples.en: I find it almost incredible that no one noticed these errors.
examples.zh: 没人发现这些错误，真让我无法相信。

words.definition: someone who is difficult never seems pleased or satisfied; hard, tough
words.translation: 难以满足的；困难的；不随和的；执拗的

examples.en: Don’t be so difficult!
examples.zh: 别这么挑剔！

examples.en: a difficult customer
examples.zh: 苛刻的顾客

words.definition: someone who has been forced to leave their country, especially during a war, or for political or religious reasons; asylee, displaced persons
words.translation: 难民，流亡者；难民，避难者；流亡者，逃亡者

examples.en: Refugees were streaming across the border.
examples.zh: 难民正涌过边境。

examples.en: refugee camps
examples.zh: 难民营

words.definition: a very large orange fruit that grows on the ground, or the inside of this fruit; punkin, musky ground
words.translation: 南瓜

examples.en: pumpkin pie
examples.zh: 南瓜饼

words.definition: having qualities considered to be typical of men or of what men do; male, positive; mankind, maleness
words.translation: 男性的；[人类]男性的；阳性的；男子气概的；[人类]男性；阳性，阳性词

examples.en: They’re nice curtains, but I’d prefer something a little more masculine.
examples.zh: 这些窗帘很好，但我更喜欢男性化一点的。

examples.en: She has a very masculine voice.
examples.zh: 她的嗓音非常男性化。

examples.en: Hunting was a typically masculine occupation.
examples.zh: 打猎是典型的男性消遣活动。

words.definition: a man who is a member of a low rank of the British nobility or of a rank of European nobility; tycoon, big boy
words.translation: 男爵；贵族；巨商；大亨；巨头

examples.en: ...their stepfather, Baron Michael Distemple.
examples.zh: …他们的继父迈克尔• 迪斯坦普尔男爵

examples.en: drug barons
examples.zh: 大毒枭

words.definition: the ability to continue doing something difficult or painful over a long period of time; staying power, patience with
words.translation: 耐久力，持久力；忍耐力；忍耐；持久；耐久

examples.en: She was pushed beyond her powers of endurance.
examples.zh: 她被逼得忍无可忍。

examples.en: The marathon is a test of endurance.
examples.zh: 马拉松赛跑是对耐力的考验。

words.definition: a common silver-white metal that usually exists in combination with other substances, for example in salt. It is a chemical element: symbol Na; natrium
words.translation: 钠；[化学]钠（11号元素，符号 Na）

examples.en: ...one level teaspoon of sodium bicarbonate powder.
examples.zh: 一平茶匙碳酸氢钠粉末

words.definition: showing strong interest and attention; goals, purpose, sake, meaning, will; focused, determined, decided, anxious
words.translation: 目不转睛的，热切的；意图；目的；含义；专心的；急切的；坚决的

examples.en: an intent gaze/look
examples.zh: 专注的目光 / 神情

examples.en: His eyes were suddenly intent.
examples.zh: 他的目光突然专注起来。

words.definition: an aim or purpose, or the result you hope to achieve; completion, death, target, goal, object; drop, determine, pass; conclude, bring to a close
words.translation: 目标，目的；结束；目标；尽头；末端；死亡；结束，终止；终结

examples.en: She’ll do anything to achieve her own ends.
examples.zh: 她为了实现自己的目标，什么都会去做。

examples.en: Every task has a clear end in view.
examples.zh: 每一项任务都要有明确的目标。

words.definition: a type of shellfish that can be eaten cooked or uncooked, and that produces a jewel called a pearl; Gigas, ostracean
words.translation: 牡蛎；牡蛎，[无脊椎]蚝；沉默寡言的人

examples.en: He had two dozen oysters and enjoyed every one of them.
examples.zh: 他吃了两打牡蛎，每一个都吃得津津有味。

words.definition: an entertainer who performs magic tricks; conjuror, sorcerer
words.translation: 魔法师；变戏法的人；魔术师，变戏法的人

examples.en: There'll be a magician at the kids' Christmas party.
examples.zh: 孩子们的圣诞聚会上会有一位魔术师。

words.definition: one of several parts of a piece of computer software that does a particular job; component, ActiveX Component ActiveX
words.translation: 模块；组件；[计]模块；[电子]组件；模数

words.definition: that can be understood in more than one way; having different meanings; blurred
words.translation: 模棱两可的；分歧的；模糊不清的；[数]引起歧义的

examples.zh: 部长的声明措辞很含糊。

examples.en: His role in the affair is ambiguous.
examples.zh: 他在这起事件中的角色并不明确。

words.definition: to have a particular physical quality which you become aware of by touching; expect, count, guess, find, make; fish for, poke about; consciousness, sense perception
words.translation: 摸起来；感觉；认为；触摸；试探；觉得；摸索

examples.en: It’s nice fabric - it feels like velvet.
examples.zh: 面料不错——摸上去像丝绒。

examples.en: The water feels warm.
examples.zh: 这水摸着很暖。

words.definition: the things that will happen to someone in the future, especially those that cannot be changed or controlled; fate, lot, fortune, portion
words.translation: 命运，天数；命运，定数，天命

examples.en: Nancy wondered whether it was her destiny to live in England and marry Melvyn.
examples.zh: 南希想知道她生活在英格兰又嫁给梅尔文是不是命运的安排。

examples.en: We are masters of our own destiny.
examples.zh: 我们是自己命运的主人。

words.definition: something very bad that is going to happen, or the fact that it is going to happen; to make someone or something certain to fail, die, be destroyed etc; death, sentence, end, award; fate, determine
words.translation: 厄运，毁灭；注定；厄运；死亡；判决；世界末日；使失败

examples.en: A sense of impending doom (= coming very soon ) gripped her.
examples.zh: 她心头被一种大难临头的感觉所笼罩。

examples.en: The plan was doomed from the start.
examples.zh: 这个计划一开始就注定要失败。

words.definition: to offer to pay a particular price for goods, especially in an auction; tell, tender for; tender for; offer
words.translation: 报价；命令；投标；[贸易]出价；表示；吩咐；[贸易]投标；叫牌；努力争取

examples.en: She bid £100 for a Victorian chair.
examples.zh: 她出价100英镑买一把维多利亚时代的椅子。

examples.en: The queen bade us enter.
examples.zh: 女王吩咐我们进去。

words.definition: fate, engage, budget
words.translation: 命定，注定；预定；注定；命定

words.definition: expressed in a way that is very clear and direct; precise, decided, distinct, specific, express
words.translation: 明晰的；直率的；明确的；清楚的；详述的

examples.en: The contrast could not have been made more explicit.
examples.zh: 这个对比再清楚不过了。

examples.en: explicit knowledge of grammar
examples.zh: 清楚易懂的语法知识

examples.en: The kidnappers gave us explicit instructions not to involve the police.
examples.zh: 绑匪明确告诉我们不许报警。

words.definition: in a way that shows that you are very sure about a decision; positively, flat, emphatically
words.translation: 明确地，坚决地；果断地；断然地；明显；毫无疑问

examples.zh: “这件事我不做。” 玛格丽特坚决地说。

words.definition: the way in which you express your thoughts and ideas; planning, construct, programme, projection
words.translation: 表述方式；构想，规划；[数]公式化；简洁陈述

examples.en: This is a far weaker formulation than is in the draft resolution which is being proposed.
examples.zh: 这是相对于正在被提议的草拟决议要弱得多的一种表述方式。

words.definition: intensity, sunshine, animation
words.translation: 明亮，辉煌，聪明；[光][天]亮度；聪明，活泼；鲜艳；愉快

words.definition: a book, play, or film that is important and has been admired for a long time; admired by many people, and having a value that has continued for a long time; traditional, conventional; chefdoeuvre, scriptures
words.translation: 名著；不朽的；经典的；古典的，传统的；最优秀的；经典著作；大艺术家

examples.en: ‘La Grande Illusion’ is one of the classics of French cinema.
examples.zh: 《大幻影》是法国电影中的经典作品之一。

examples.en: The Coca-Cola bottle is one of the classic designs of the last century.
examples.zh: 可口可乐瓶是上个世纪的经典设计之一。

words.definition: without delay; quickly, rapidly, fast, ready
words.translation: 敏捷地，迅速地；迅速地；立即地；敏捷地

examples.en: A reply came very promptly.
examples.zh: 马上就有了答复。

words.definition: when a situation or subject needs to be dealt with carefully because it is secret or may offend people
words.translation: 敏感（性）；灵敏性

examples.en: It’s a matter of great political sensitivity.
examples.zh: 这件事在政治上非常敏感。

examples.en: The sensitivity of the detector can be increased.
examples.zh: 这种探测器的灵敏度还可以提高。

words.definition: a painting, sign, description etc that shows something; presentation, statement, deputy, behalf of, ambassador
words.translation: 描写；陈述；代表；[经]代表；表现；表示法

examples.en: The clock in the painting is a symbolic representation of the passage of time.
examples.zh: 画上的时钟象征着光阴的流逝。

examples.en: A group of students made representations to the college about the poor standard of the accommodation.
examples.zh: 一群学生就恶劣的住宿条件同校方交涉。

examples.en: Minority groups need more effective parliamentary representation.
examples.zh: 少数族群需要办事更为高效的议会代表。

words.definition: a place where plants and trees are grown and sold; soil, nest
words.translation: 苗圃；[林]苗圃；托儿所；温床

examples.en: The garden, developed over the past 35 years, includes a nursery.
examples.zh: 这个有35年历史的园子里有一个苗圃。

words.definition: the act of removing someone from a position of power; mineral deposit, orebed
words.translation: 免职，罢免；[地质]沉积物；矿床；革职

examples.en: the deposition of the King
examples.zh: 废黜国王

words.definition: to attract sb strongly and make them feel very interested, excited, etc.; bemuddle, bewilder
words.translation: 迷住；用魔法迷惑；使迷惑；施魔法

examples.en: I was enchanted by the way she smiled.
examples.zh: 她微笑时的样子让我着迷。

examples.en: ...Celtic stories of cauldrons and enchanted vessels.
examples.zh: …凯尔特人关于神锅和魔法器皿的故事。

words.definition: a belief that some objects or actions are lucky or unlucky, or that they cause events to happen, based on old ideas of magic; aberglaube, fetish
words.translation: 迷信，迷信行为；迷信

examples.en: the old superstition that walking under a ladder is unlucky
examples.zh: 认为从梯子下面穿过不吉利的古老迷信

words.definition: if something perplexes you, it makes you feel confused and worried because it is difficult to understand; bepuzzle, confuse
words.translation: 迷惑，困惑，难住；使困惑，使为难；使复杂化

examples.en: Shea’s symptoms perplexed the doctors.
examples.zh: 谢伊的症状令医生们困惑。

words.definition: to confuse someone; bemuddle, enchant
words.translation: 迷惑，把…弄糊涂；使迷惑，使不知所措

examples.en: He was bewildered by his daughter’s reaction.
examples.zh: 他被女儿的反应弄糊涂了。

words.definition: to try to bite sb/sth; pull cut; bite, gnaw at; splutter; sudden, unannounced
words.translation: 猛咬；突然折断；突然折断，拉断；啪地关上；咬；厉声说；咯嗒一声关上；劈啪声；突然的

examples.en: The dog started snapping at my heels.
examples.zh: 这条狗开始咬我的鞋跟。

examples.en: A twig snapped under my feet.
examples.zh: 一根细枝在我脚下嚓一声断开了。

words.definition: to pull something suddenly and roughly; ass, nong; sweep, hoick

words.definition: the ability to understand things and to think intelligently; brain, understanding, mind, mentality, head
words.translation: 理智，智力，才智；智力，理解力；知识分子；思维逻辑领悟力；智力高的人

examples.en: He combined a formidable intellect with a talent for speaking.
examples.zh: 他不但智力超群，而且口才出众。

words.definition: used to describe the way you would like things to be, even though this may not be possible
words.translation: 理想地；理论上

examples.en: Ideally, your car should have high-security locks.
examples.zh: 最理想的情况是，你的车应该配有高度安全的车锁。

examples.en: Fruit and vegetables should ideally be organically grown.
examples.zh: 水果和蔬菜最理想的应该是有机种植。

words.definition: very informal, sometimes offensive language that is used especially by people who belong to a particular group, such as young people or criminals; jargon, dialect
words.translation: 俚语；行话，黑话；行话

examples.en: schoolboy slang
examples.zh: 学生俚语

words.definition: polite behaviour and respect for other people
words.translation: 礼貌，谦恭

examples.en: It’s a matter of common courtesy to acknowledge letters.
examples.zh: 确认收到来信是起码的礼貌。

words.definition: the time when day is just starting to become night; morning, dark; lowering, dingy
words.translation: 黄昏；黎明，黄昏；薄暮；衰退期；朦胧状态；昏暗的，微明的；暮年的

examples.en: romantic walks along the beach at twilight
examples.zh: 黄昏时分浪漫的海边漫步

words.definition: an atom which has been given a positive or negative force by adding or taking away an electron
words.translation: 离子

words.definition: a short journey arranged so that a group of people can visit a place, especially while they are on holiday; skewing, short trip
words.translation: （尤指集体）远足，短途旅行；偏移；远足；短程旅行；离题；游览圆

examples.en: Included in the tour is an excursion to the Grand Canyon.
examples.zh: 这次旅游包括大峡谷观光。

words.definition: looking or sounding very serious; frozen, cruel
words.translation: 严厉的；冷酷的；糟糕的；残忍的

examples.en: ‘I’ll survive,’ he said with a grim smile.
examples.zh: “我死不了。”他阴笑着说。

examples.en: The police officers were silent and grim-faced.
examples.zh: 警察默不作声，神情严肃。

words.definition: a transparent block of glass that breaks up white light into different colours
words.translation: 棱镜；棱柱（体）

examples.en: Light is refracted when passed through a prism.
examples.zh: 光通过棱镜时产生折射。

words.definition: A troublesome situation or issue is full of complicated problems or difficulties.; tight, evil, rank, unpleasant
words.translation: 困难的；麻烦的；讨厌的；使人苦恼的

examples.en: The economy has become a troublesome issue for the Conservative Party.
examples.zh: 经济状况已成为保守党的一大难题。

words.definition: a thing that is similar to another thing; similar; parallel, akin
words.translation: 类似物；类似情况；对等的人；类似的；相似物的；模拟计算机的

examples.en: Scientists are attempting to compare features of extinct animals with living analogues.
examples.zh: 科学家正试图把已灭绝动物的特征与现存类似动物相比较。

words.definition: the state of being like sb/sth but not exactly the same; analogy, kinsmanship
words.translation: 类似，相似；类似点；类似；[数]相似点

examples.en: She bears a striking similarity to her mother.
examples.zh: 她跟她母亲十分相像。

examples.en: a study of the similarities and differences between the two countries
examples.zh: 对这两个国家的异同点的研究

words.definition: the side of an animal’s or person’s body, between the ribs and the hip; side, profile plane
words.translation: 肋，肋腹；侧面；[军]侧翼；侧腹

examples.en: He put his hand on the dog's flank.
examples.zh: 他把手放在狗的胁腹上。

examples.en: They continued along the flank of the mountain.
examples.zh: 他们沿着山的侧面继续前进。

words.definition: to understand something that is complicated or difficult; involve, see, contain, absorb, read
words.translation: 了解，理解，领会；理解；包含；由…组成

examples.en: She cannot comprehend the extent of the disaster.
examples.zh: 她无法理解这场灾难的严重程度。

examples.en: I did not fully comprehend what had happened.
examples.zh: 我没有完全理解发生了什么事。

words.definition: using more of something than you should, especially money, time, or effort; luxury, dissipative
words.translation: 浪费的；浪费的，不经济的；奢侈的

examples.en: a wasteful use of resources
examples.zh: 滥用资源

examples.en: The software is very wasteful of memory.
examples.zh: 这个软件很占内存。

words.definition: unemployment, inapplication
words.translation: 懒惰；赋闲无事；闲散；失业

examples.en: After a period of enforced idleness, she found a new job.
examples.zh: 她在被迫闲散了一段时间之后，找到了份新工作。

words.definition: shabby clothes, places, or objects are untidy and in bad condition because they have been used for a long time; poor, mean, tight, base, shot
words.translation: 破旧的；褴褛的；卑鄙的；吝啬的；低劣的

examples.en: Hugh’s jacket was old and shabby.
examples.zh: 休的夹克衫又旧又破。

examples.en: a shabby tramp
examples.zh: 一个衣衫褴褛的流浪汉

words.definition: dry powder consisting of extremely small bits of dirt that is in buildings on furniture, floors etc if they are not kept clean; powder, dirt; sift
words.translation: 灰尘；[环境]尘埃；尘土；撒；拂去灰尘

examples.en: All the furniture was covered in dust.
examples.zh: 所有的家具都蒙上了灰尘。

words.definition: when you leave a place in order to try and escape from a person or a dangerous situation; fly, liner; pot, take a shot at
words.translation: 溃退，逃跑；[航]飞行；班机；逃走；射击；使惊飞

examples.en: Donald Wood’s hasty flight from South Africa early in 1978
examples.zh: 1978年初唐纳德•伍德匆忙逃离南非

words.definition: great excitement and happiness; elation, gaiety
words.translation: 狂喜，欢天喜地；兴高采烈

examples.en: The boys gazed up at him in rapture.
examples.zh: 男孩们欣喜若狂地抬头注视着他。

words.definition: extreme, often uncontrolled anger; agriothymia, hopping mad
words.translation: 狂怒，暴怒；猛烈；狂怒；暴怒；激怒者

examples.en: I was shaking with fury .
examples.zh: 我气得发抖。

examples.en: Jo stepped forward, her eyes blazing with fury .
examples.zh: 乔满眼冒火地走上前来。

examples.en: The report was leaked to the press, much to the president’s fury.
examples.zh: 报告被泄露给了媒体，令总统大为光火。

words.definition: a feeling of happiness or pleasure because you have achieved something or got what you wanted; content, fill, satisfied with, Lays
words.translation: 满足，愉快；满意，满足；赔偿；乐事；赎罪

examples.en: She got great satisfaction from helping people to learn.
examples.zh: 她在帮助人们学习的过程中得到很大的满足。

words.definition: a small amount of food that is eaten between main meals or instead of a meal; proportion, portion, percent, part, integral; nosh
words.translation: 快餐，小吃；[贸易]小吃，快餐；一份，部分；吃快餐，吃点心

examples.en: I grabbed a quick snack.
examples.zh: 我赶紧吃了点零食。

examples.en: Drinks and light snacks are served at the bar.
examples.zh: 酒吧里供应饮料和小吃。

examples.en: snack foods like crisps and peanuts
examples.zh: 炸薯片和花生之类的小吃

words.definition: velocity, rate, speed
words.translation: 快，迅速；陡，险峻；迅速，急速；速度；险峻

examples.en: the rapidity of economic growth
examples.zh: 经济增长的高速度

words.definition: if you parade your skills, knowledge, possessions etc, you show them publicly in order to make people admire you; display, pageant; show off, brag about; file, show off
words.translation: 夸耀（才能等）；游行；阅兵；炫耀；行进；阅兵场；列队行进

examples.en: He is not one to parade his achievements.
examples.zh: 他不是一个爱炫耀自己成就的人。

words.definition: a piece of clothing that covers you from your waist to your feet and has a separate part for each leg; britches, short trousers
words.translation: 裤子；男用短衬裤；短裤

examples.en: She was wearing dark blue pants and a white sweater.
examples.zh: 她穿着深蓝色长裤和白色毛衣。

examples.en: a pair of pants
examples.zh: 一件内裤

words.definition: spite, hardship
words.translation: 苦味，辛酸，苦难；苦味；苦难；怨恨

examples.en: The flowers of the hop plant add bitterness to the beer.
examples.zh: 忽布花可增加啤酒的苦味。

examples.en: The pay cut caused bitterness among the staff.
examples.zh: 降低工资使职员们十分愤懑。

words.definition: if plants wither, they become drier and smaller and start to die; debilitate, devitalize; flag, damp off
words.translation: 枯萎；使衰弱；使凋谢；使畏缩；凋谢；衰弱

examples.en: The flowers in Isabel's room had withered.
examples.zh: 伊莎贝尔房间里的花朵已经枯萎了。

examples.en: Industries unable to modernize have been left to wither.
examples.zh: 无法实现现代化的行业已经自行衰落。

words.definition: to fasten something with a clasp; handshake, shake-hands; press, button; buckle, button up
words.translation: 扣住，扣紧，钩住；扣子，钩子；握手；紧抱；扣紧；紧紧缠绕；扣住

examples.en: She clasped the bracelet around her wrist.
examples.zh: 她把手镯戴上手腕扣牢。

words.definition: something that you use to join something together, such as a button on a piece of clothing; button, pushbutton
words.translation: 扣件，钮扣，揿钮；扣件；钮扣；按钮；使系牢之物

examples.en: shoes with velcro fasteners
examples.zh: 带维可牢搭链的鞋

words.definition: to speak with a lot of pauses and repeated sounds, either because you have a speech problem, or because you are nervous, excited etc; a speech problem which makes someone speak with a lot of pauses and repeated sounds; titubate, stumble over; impediment, mogilalia
words.translation: 口吃地说；口吃；结结巴巴地说；结巴

examples.en: Whenever he was angry, he would begin to stammer slightly.
examples.zh: 他一生气说话就开始有点结巴。

examples.en: Jeff spoke with a slight stammer.
examples.zh: 杰夫说话有点结巴。

words.definition: someone who uses violence such as bombing, shooting etc to obtain political demands
words.translation: 恐怖分子

examples.en: We refuse to talk to terrorists.
examples.zh: 我们拒绝和恐怖分子对话。

examples.en: a terrorist bomb that left 168 people dead
examples.zh: 恐怖分子引爆造成168人死亡的炸弹

words.definition: a large bird, the male of which has long blue and green tail feathers that it can lift up and spread out; peafowl; show off, brag about
words.translation: 孔雀；雄孔雀；爱虚荣的人；炫耀；神气活现地走

examples.en: ...peacocks strutting slowly across the garden.
examples.zh: ...孔雀在花园中趾高气扬地走来走去。

examples.en: peacock feathers
examples.zh: 孔雀翎

words.definition: impossible to put into practice; wonderful, excellent, famous, super, great; weirdo, geezer
words.translation: 空想的；奇异的；极好的；不可思议的；古怪的人

examples.en: a fantastic scheme
examples.zh: 异想天开的计划

examples.en: fantastic tales of dragons and fairy queens
examples.zh: 龙和仙后的奇幻故事

words.definition: filled with air; air-actuated, aerated
words.translation: 空气的；气动的；[物][机][动力]气动的；充气的；[脊椎]有气胎的

examples.en: pneumatic tyres
examples.zh: 充气轮胎

words.definition: in or moving through the air; romantic, fantastic; antenna, Arial
words.translation: 空气的；航空的；[昆][生物][航]空中的，航空的；空想的；[电讯]天线

examples.en: The banyan tree has aerial roots.
examples.zh: 榕树有气根。

examples.en: an aerial attack
examples.zh: 空袭

words.definition: relating to the position, size, shape etc of things; dimensional, spacial
words.translation: 空间的，占据空间的；[数]空间的；存在于空间的；受空间条件限制的

examples.en: ...the spatial distribution of black employment and population in South Africa.
examples.zh: …南非黑人就业和人口的空间分布。

words.definition: (of a contract, an agreement etc.) not valid or legal; empty, hollow, useless, bare, vacant; vacuum, room, clearance, blank, emptiness; invalidate, nullify
words.translation: 无效的；空的；无人的；空虚；空间；空隙；使无效；排放

examples.en: The agreement was declared void.
examples.zh: 该协议已宣布无效。

examples.en: void spaces
examples.zh: 空位

words.definition: to keep biting something hard; harry, worry, trouble, weather, tear; bite, grind down
words.translation: 啃，咬断，啮；咬；折磨；侵蚀

examples.en: Dexter gnawed his pen thoughtfully.
examples.zh: 德克斯特若有所思地咬着钢笔。

examples.en: A rat had gnawed a hole in the box.
examples.zh: 老鼠在箱子上咬了一个洞。

words.definition: a strong feeling of wanting something or someone; feeling or showing that you want sth very much; aspiration, eagerness; eager, desired, hungry, anxious, sick; craving, hankering
words.translation: 渴望；显示渴望的；渴望，热望；憧憬；渴望的，极想得到的；渴望（long的ing形式）

examples.en: She looked back with longing on the good old days.
examples.zh: 她回首往事，怀念着过去的美好时光。

examples.en: He gave a longing look at the ice cream.
examples.zh: 他看了看那冰激凌，显出很想吃的样子。

words.definition: not likely to be true or correct; suspicious, doubtful
words.translation: 可疑的，不可靠的；可疑的；有问题的

examples.en: The statistics are highly questionable.
examples.zh: 这个统计数据大有问题。

words.definition: able to be carried or moved easily; luggable, hand-held
words.translation: 可移动的；手提的，便携式的；轻便的

examples.en: a portable radio
examples.zh: 便携式收音机

words.definition: that can be moved to different positions or changed in shape or size
words.translation: 可调整的，可校准的

examples.en: an adjustable spanner
examples.zh: 一把活动扳手

words.definition: unpleasant or bad; terrible, tremendous, intense, horrible, awesome
words.translation: 可怕的；讨厌的；惊人的；非常的

examples.en: There’s been a frightful accident.
examples.zh: 发生了一起可怕的意外。

words.definition: causing fear or suffering; terrible, painful, horrible, awesome, fearful
words.translation: 可怕的；令人畏惧的；糟透的，令人不快的

examples.en: a dreadful accident
examples.zh: 可怕的事故

examples.en: They suffered dreadful injuries.
examples.zh: 他们严重受伤。

words.definition: unusually large; huge, tremendous, enormous, massive, macro
words.translation: 极大的；可怕的；巨大的；怪异的；荒谬的；畸形的

examples.en: a monstrous nose
examples.zh: 很大的鼻子

examples.en: a monstrous shadow on the stairs
examples.zh: 楼梯上一个可怕的影子

words.definition: A possibility is one of several different things that could be done.; probability, feasibility, potential, maybe, chance
words.translation: 可能的事；可能性；可能发生的事物

examples.en: There were several possibilities open to each manufacturer.
examples.zh: 每个制造商都可以有几种不同的选择。

words.definition: the degree to which something can reasonably be expected to happen; possibility, probability, feasibility, potential, maybe
words.translation: 可能（性）；可能性，可能

examples.en: Using a seatbelt will reduce the likelihood of serious injury in a car accident.
examples.zh: 系安全带可以降低在车祸中受重伤的可能性。

words.definition: considered by society to be acceptable, good or correct; venerable, honourable
words.translation: 可敬的；人格高尚的；值得尊敬的；相当数量的

examples.en: hard-working, respectable people
examples.zh: 勤勉可敬的人

examples.en: a respectable family
examples.zh: 正经人家

examples.en: Put a tie on - it’ll make you look more respectable.
examples.zh: 戴上领带，这样显得更体面。

words.definition: large enough to be noticed or considered important; palpable, perceptible
words.translation: 可察觉的；可感知的；[经]可评估的；相当可观的

examples.en: There’s no appreciable change in the patient’s condition.
examples.zh: 病人的状况没有明显改变。

words.definition: that should make you feel ashamed; salt, yellow-dog
words.translation: 可耻的；不道德的；不体面的；猥亵的

examples.en: It’s shameful the way some people treat their pets.
examples.zh: 有些人如此对待自己的宠物，真是可耻。

examples.en: a shameful family secret
examples.zh: 家丑

words.definition: similar to something else in size, number, quality etc, so that you can make a comparison
words.translation: 可比较的；类似的

examples.en: A car of comparable size would cost far more abroad.
examples.zh: 同样大小的汽车在国外要贵得多。

words.definition: used to emphasize that you are referring to one individual person, thing or type of thing and not others; extraordinary, strict, detailed, special, exclusive; detailed specification, detailed description
words.translation: 特称的；苛求的；特别的；详细的；独有的；挑剔的；详细说明；个别项目

examples.en: Most students choose one particular area for research.
examples.zh: 大多数学生选择一个特定领域进行研究。

examples.en: Marty’s very particular about his food.
examples.zh: 马蒂对食物很挑剔。

words.definition: by means of which or according to which
words.translation: 靠什么；靠那个

examples.en: a proposal whereby EU citizens would be allowed to reside anywhere in the EU
examples.zh: 允许欧盟公民在欧盟任何地方居住的一项提议

words.definition: the act of travelling through a place in order to find out about it or find something such as oil or gold in it; inquiry, detection, search
words.translation: 考察；勘探；探查；探测；探究；踏勘

examples.en: oil exploration facilities in the North Sea
examples.zh: 北海的石油勘探设施

examples.en: You can then use this hut as a base for explorations into the mountains around.
examples.zh: 你到时可以把这间小屋当大本营，去周围的山里探险。

words.definition: a generous attitude, or generous behaviour; liberality, large-handedness
words.translation: 慷慨，宽宏大量；慷慨，大方；宽宏大量

examples.en: an act of great generosity
examples.zh: 十分慷慨的行为

examples.en: I shall never forget the generosity shownby the people of Bastaisk.
examples.zh: 我永远也不会忘记巴斯泰斯克人的慷慨大方。

words.definition: to cut down a tree; fierce, destructive; floor, down with; hide; dropped
words.translation: 砍倒（树等）；砍伐；凶猛的；毁灭性的；打倒；击倒；[林]一季所伐的木材；折缝；兽皮；掉下；摔倒；下垂；变坏（fall的过去式）

examples.en: More than 100 trees were felled in just over an hour.
examples.zh: 短短一个多小时100多棵树就被砍倒了。

words.definition: if a newspaper, a television or radio broadcast, or a website carries a piece of news, an advertisement etc, it prints it or broadcasts it; encourage, have, hand, second, back; cannon-shot
words.translation: 刊登；拿，扛；携带；支持；搬运；[交]运载；[计]进位；射程

examples.en: The morning paper carried a story about demonstrations in New York and Washington D.C.
examples.zh: 晨报登载了纽约和华盛顿特区举行示威游行的报道。

examples.en: The national TV network carries religious programmes.
examples.zh: 全国电视网播出宗教节目。

words.definition: to introduce a new public official or leader at a special ceremony; pioneer
words.translation: 使就职；开始；创新；开辟；开创；举行开幕典礼；举行就职典礼

examples.en: He will be inaugurated (as) President in January.
examples.zh: 他将于一月份就任总统。

examples.en: The moon landing inaugurated a new era in space exploration.
examples.zh: 登陆月球开创了太空探索的新纪元。

words.definition: to arrange for something important to start, such as an official process or a new plan; institute, start in; beginning, threshold, opening, conception, fresh
words.translation: 开始，创始；启蒙；发起；使初步了解；开始；新加入者，接受初步知识者

examples.en: They have decided to initiate legal proceedings against the newspaper.
examples.zh: 他们决定向该报提起法律诉讼。

examples.en: Those kids were initiated into heroin use at a young age.
examples.zh: 那些孩子很小就被教会如何吸食海洛因。

words.definition: to begin or to start something; institute, initiate, launch on, enter upon, put in hand
words.translation: 开始；获得学位；着手

examples.en: Work will commence on the new building immediately.
examples.zh: 新大楼即将破土动工。

words.definition: to make an area of desert, wet land etc suitable for farming or building; exploit, carve out; protest against sth, exclaim at; reconstruction, influence
words.translation: 开垦，开拓；回收；开拓；回收再利用；改造某人，使某人悔改；抗议，喊叫；改造，感化；再生胶

examples.en: This land will be reclaimed for a new airport.
examples.zh: 这块土地将被开发用来建新机场。

examples.en: You can reclaim old boards and use them as shelves.
examples.zh: 旧木板可以废物利用，当搁板。

words.definition: to do something that you were not doing before, and continue doing it; institute, initiate; leave, set out, go forth into, sally out, set off/out; beginning, threshold, opening, conception, fresh
words.translation: 开动，着手；开设；开始；启动；出发；起点

examples.en: There’s so much to do. I don’t know where to start.
examples.zh: 有那么多的事情要做，我都不知道从哪里开始。

examples.en: She wanted to start her own catering business.
examples.zh: 她想自己创立一家餐饮公司。

examples.zh: 新总统概述了解决犯罪、毒品和教育问题的计划。

words.definition: an idea about what something is like, or a general understanding of something; idea, threshold, pregnancy, beginning, opening

examples.en: the conception of parliamentary democracy
examples.zh: 议会民主的概念

examples.en: changing conceptions of the world
examples.zh: 这个世界不断变化的观念

words.definition: giving only the main points of sth, not the details; condensed, terse; abstract, brief, resume
words.translation: 概括的；速决的；简易的；扼要的；概要，[图情]摘要

examples.zh: 财务汇总报表

words.definition: to form a general principle or opinion after considering only a small number of facts or examples; extend, summarise; ideate
words.translation: 概括出；概括；推广；使...一般化；形成概念

examples.zh: 她总爱把自己对丈夫的看法推及所有的男人。

words.definition: to press something into a soft surface so that a mark or pattern appears on it; propagate; print, mark, characteristic, trace
words.translation: 盖印，在…打记号；盖印；强征；传送；给予某人深刻印象；印象，印记；特征，痕迹

examples.en: patterns impressed in the clay
examples.zh: 压印在黏土上的图案

words.definition: to repair sth that has been damaged or broken so that it can be used again; improve, repair, doctor, modify; change for the better, polish up; reforming, improvement in
words.translation: 修理；改正；修理，修补；改善；修改；改善，好转；好转，改进；修补处

examples.en: Could you mend my bike for me?
examples.zh: 你能帮我修一下自行车吗？

examples.en: If he doesn’t mend his ways, he’ll be asked to leave.
examples.zh: 如果他不好好改改，会让他走人的。

words.definition: a problem or situation that makes something more difficult to understand or deal with; chaos, confusion, disorder, involvement, mix
words.translation: 复杂，混乱；并发症；复杂；复杂化；混乱

examples.en: The fact that the plane was late added a further complication to our journey.
examples.zh: 飞机误点给我们的旅行带来了更大的麻烦。

examples.en: Pneumonia is one of the common complications faced by bed-ridden patients.
examples.zh: 肺炎是卧床病人所面临的常见并发症之一。

words.definition: the state of being complicated; sophistication, intricacy
words.translation: 复杂（性）；复杂，复杂性；复杂错综的事物

examples.zh: 一项非常复杂的设计

words.definition: a country, area, or organization that is controlled by or is dependent on another larger one; moon, suite
words.translation: 附属国；[天]卫星；[航]人造卫星；随从；卫星国家

examples.en: a satellite country
examples.zh: 卫星国

words.definition: a part at the end of a book containing additional information; supplement, Appendix Appx
words.translation: 附录；阑尾；[图情]附录；附加物

examples.zh: 见附录2.6。

examples.en: Christine had to go into hospital to have her appendix out (=  have it removed  ) .
examples.zh: 克里丝蒂娜不得不去医院切除阑尾。

words.definition: an amount of something, especially money, in addition to the usual, basic, or necessary amount; specifically, particularly, badly, highly, greatly, too; walker-on, special edition; additional, added, excess
words.translation: 附加物；额外的东西；特别地，非常；另外；临时演员；号外；额外的事物；上等产品；额外的，[经]另外收费的；特大的

examples.en: I earn extra for working on Sunday.
examples.zh: 我星期天工作挣外快。

words.translation: 负荷；充电；装满；[会计]费用；电荷；掌管；[法]控告；命令；[电]负载；[电]使充电；使承担；指责；装载；对…索费；向…冲去；[电]充电；索价；向前冲；记在账上

examples.zh: 让电池充一晚上的电

examples.zh: 请各位斟满酒杯向新娘、新郎敬酒！

words.definition: less than zero; passive, destructive; infirmation, disaffirmation; deny, refuse
words.translation: 负的；（结果）阴性的；[数]负的；消极的；[语]否定的；阴性的；[语]否定；负数；[摄]底片；拒绝

examples.zh: 贸易逆差

examples.zh: 妊娠化验结果为阴性。

words.definition: the gradual destruction of metal by the effect of water, chemicals etc or a substance such as rust produced by this process; erosion, eating away
words.translation: 腐蚀，侵蚀；锈；[化学]腐蚀；腐蚀产生的物质；衰败

examples.en: They are sprayed with oil to prevent corrosion.
examples.zh: 它们被喷了油以防腐蚀。

examples.en: Check for signs of corrosion.
examples.zh: 检查一下有没有腐蚀的痕迹。

words.definition: the process by which rock or soil is gradually destroyed by wind, rain, or the sea; corrosion, eating away
words.translation: 腐蚀，侵蚀；糜烂；侵蚀，[化学]腐蚀

examples.en: the problem of soil erosion
examples.zh: 水土流失的问题

examples.en: the erosion of the coastline
examples.zh: 海岸线受到的侵蚀

words.definition: connected with, but less important than, something else; assistant, helping, affiliated, auxiliary; auxiliary, subcompany
words.translation: 辅助的，补充的；附属的；辅助的；子公司；辅助者

examples.en: The marketing department has always played a subsidiary role to the sales department.
examples.zh: 营销部一直都扮演着销售部的辅助角色。

words.definition: to be suitable for sth; to match sth; reply, meet with; reply, accord; response, defence, reply, result
words.translation: 符合，适合；回答；符合；答案；[法]答辩

examples.en: Does this answer your requirements?
examples.zh: 这个符合你的要求吗？

words.definition: always doing what you are told to do, or what the law, a rule etc says you must do; followed, subject, compliant, submissive
words.translation: 服从的，顺从的；顺从的，服从的；孝顺的

examples.zh: 听话的孩子

examples.en: citizens who are obedient to the law
examples.zh: 遵纪守法的公民

words.definition: when someone does what they are told to do, or what a law, rule etc says they must do; keeping, submission
words.translation: 服从，顺从；服从；顺从；遵守

examples.zh: 为狗和主人安排的服从训练课

words.definition: a refusal to give official permission for something, or the right to refuse to give such permission; neto; bar, inhibit; rule against, vote down
words.translation: 否决，否决权；禁止；否决权；否决

examples.en: The Senate had a sufficient majority to override the presidential veto (= not accept his refusal ).
examples.zh: 参议院有足够的多数票可以推翻总统的否决。

examples.zh: 有好几个月禁止雇用新职员。

words.definition: a statement saying that something is not true; contradiction, rejection, repudiation
words.translation: 否定；拒绝相信；否认；拒绝；节制；背弃

examples.zh: 政府发表了正式声明，否认谣言。

examples.en: His girlfriend is in denial, and refuses to admit that he will soon die.
examples.zh: 他的女友不肯接受事实，拒不相信他很快就要死了。

words.definition: a religion of east and central Asia, based on the teaching of Gautama Buddha
words.translation: 佛教，释教

examples.zh: 怀特先生已改信佛教。

examples.en: The custom derives its origin from Buddhism.
examples.zh: 这种习惯起源于佛教。

words.definition: to give all your attention and effort to one particular thing; give oneself, devote  to
words.translation: 奉献；献身；致力；题献

examples.en: The actress now dedicates herself to children’s charity work.
examples.zh: 这名女演员现在致力于儿童慈善工作。

words.definition: to praise someone in order to please them or get something from them, even though you do not mean it; please, glad, satisfy
words.translation: 奉承，阿谀，谄媚；奉承；谄媚；使高兴

examples.en: Perry would always flatter Mrs. Mitchell by praising her cooking.
examples.zh: 佩里常常奉承米切尔太太，称赞她的烹调手艺。

words.definition: a large yellow-brown tropical fruit or its sweet juicy yellow flesh; ananas, unemployment benefit
words.translation: 凤梨，波萝；[园艺]菠萝；凤梨；失业救济金

examples.zh: 菠萝汁

examples.zh: 她在补比利裤子的开线处。

examples.zh: 风车的帆叶现在静止不动了。

examples.zh: 那护士是个性格开朗、体形丰满的女人。

examples.zh: 那个婴儿很可爱，胖嘟嘟的。

words.translation: 丰富，充裕；充裕，[地化]丰富

examples.zh: 浓密的红色鬈发

examples.zh: 该队的一大特点是斗志昂扬。

examples.zh: 查尔斯发现他的名字没有出现在名单上，这让他深感愤慨。

examples.zh: 他义愤填膺，气呼呼地冲进她的办公室。

words.translation: 分子的；克分子的

examples.zh: 他可以用旅费抵税。

examples.zh: 学生们掌握了小数、百分数和分数。

examples.zh: 这场争吵可能会导致党内出现分裂，对该党产生不利影响。

examples.zh: 政府内部很深的分歧

examples.zh: …更好用户界面的开发。

examples.zh: 在这个问题上意见分歧很大。

examples.zh: 在有些城市，乱扔垃圾的人会被罚款。

examples.zh: 一堆笔记、考卷和课本乱七八糟地摊在桌子上。

examples.zh: 地板上乱七八糟扔了许多报纸。

words.translation: 废除，取消；废除，废止；取消，革除

examples.zh: 美国于19世纪废除了奴隶制。

words.translation: 匪徒，歹徒，暴徒；歹徒，流氓；恶棍

examples.zh: …一部黑帮片。

words.definition: extremely; badly, highly, greatly, too, most
words.translation: 非常地，特别地；非常；格外地；非凡地

examples.zh: 我们极其幸运。

words.definition: to move somewhere quickly and suddenly; flow, stream, dance; overfly; flight, volation; sharp, keen, prompt, quick, smart
words.translation: 飞跑；逃跑，消失；飞；驾驶飞机；飘扬；飞行；飞越；使飘扬；苍蝇；两翼昆虫；敏捷的

examples.zh: 埃伦从房间那头飞奔过来，给了她叔叔一个吻。

examples.zh: 警察赶到时，那些人已经逃走了。

words.definition: the science or practice of flying in aircraft; avigation, airmanship
words.translation: 飞行（术）；[航]航空；飞行术；飞机制造业

examples.en: ...the aviation industry.
examples.zh: …航空工业。

words.translation: 成群；放牧；兽群，畜群；放牧人；使成群

examples.zh: 犯人们被集合起来。

examples.zh: 汤姆的职责是放牛。

words.definition: a copy of something; simulation, mimicry; artificial, synthetic
words.translation: 仿制品，伪制物；模仿，仿造；仿制品；人造的，仿制的

examples.zh: 她戴着一顶仿制的水手帽。

words.definition: to make a copy of a picture, piece of text, etc.; generate, repeat; breed, increase
words.translation: 仿造；复制；再生；生殖；使…在脑海中重现；繁殖

examples.zh: 这种效果经证实很难再造。

words.definition: all of someone’s property and money, especially everything that is left after they die; identity, property, treasure, possession, worth
words.translation: 财产，产业；房地产；[经]财产；身份

examples.zh: 该产业是死者遗产的一部分。

examples.zh: 她想跑，但沉重的旅行箱拖累了她。

examples.zh: 对那几名男子的营救行动受到恶劣天气的阻碍。

words.translation: 妨碍，使不利；障碍；不利条件，不利的因素；妨碍，阻碍；使不利

examples.zh: 这个慈善机构因为缺乏资金难以开展工作。

words.definition: easy to use or to do; sharp, quick, smart, keen, fly
words.translation: 方便的；便于使用的；便利的；手边的，就近的；[水运]容易取得的；敏捷的

examples.zh: 好用的小工具

examples.zh: 清除污渍的妙招 / 窍门儿

words.translation: 犯罪，犯规；冒犯；犯罪；违反；过错；攻击
